tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /7skyabs rje mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che'i gsung rtsom thor bu phyogs bsdus/dkar chag
༄༅/ /7skyabs rje mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che'i gsung rtsom thor bu phyogs bsdus/dkar chag

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /7skyabs rje mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che'i gsung rtsom thor bu phyogs bsdus/dkar chag

1¿ khrid yig sogs phyogs bsdus/ gsol 'debs rdo rje 'chang thung ma'i khrid thung*/ 2 dbu ma gzhan stong smra ba'i srol phye sgron me'i sa bcad/ 16 dkyil 'khor gyi thig rtsa dang 'bri bya tshon gyi dbye ba sogs/ 47 dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs/ 622¿ blang dor bca' khrims phyogs bsdus/ blang dor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis rtsa 'grel/ 65 chang dang bzi sman gyi bca' khrims la bcos bsgyur/ 76 khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling gi dge 'dun pa gsar bzhugs rnams kyi na bza' gra sgrig dgos pa'i tho/ 77 khra 'gu dgon du dge 'dun gsar du 'dzugs skabs mthun rkyen tshang dgos pa rnams/ 78 dpal khra 'gu bkris chos gling dgon gyi dge 'dun rnams la sku 'gyed gtong phyogs skor/ 78 dge 'dun rnams kyi spyod lam thog bzang ngan dbye 'byed kyi thag gcod skor/ 81 legs bcos tshogs 'dus kyi sgrig gzhi/ 82 rig pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang du bzhugs pa'i dgyes rdor yab yum gyi sgrub mchod skabs kyi mchod rdzas dang*/ ser sbreng yo byad bdag gnyer byed tshul gyi sgrig gzhi/ 84 gnas kyi slob dpon dang slob ma'i bca' khrims/ 85 sgrub sde theg chen yid 'ong gling gi bca' yig 883¿ zhabs brtan dang gsol 'debs sogs phyogs bsdus/ chos la bskul ba'i tshogs glu thung ngu*/ 91 karma pa rig pa'i rdo rje mchog la rgyang 'bod gdung dbyangs kyi gsol 'debs/ 91 karma pa o rgyan phrin las rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum la phebs pa'i mtshams sbyor bkra shis bde legs/ 94 karma pa o rgyan phrin las rdo rje'i 'khrungs skar gsol 'debs/ 94 karma pa o rgyan phrin las rdo rje'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs/

95 'bo dkar mchog sprul myur 'byon gsol 'debs/ 96 sprul sku blo gros nyi ma'i zhabs brtan/ 97 sprul sku dam chos kyi zhabs brtan/ 97 sgrub dpon rin chen tshe ring gi zhabs brtan/ 98 sras mkhar bla ma 'jigs med 'od zer gyi zhabs brtan/ 98 bla ma bkra shis don grub kyi zhabs brtan/ 99 mkhan po ka mthar gyi zhabs brtan/ 99 shis brjod smon tshig skor/ 100 byams brtse'i bka' slob sogs/ 1094¿ lo rgyus dang*/ sgom bzlas kyi phan yon sogs phyogs bsdus/ dpal khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling gi bshad grwa'i lo rgyus snying bsdus/ 111 dpal khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling gi sgrub sde'i lo rgyus snying bsdus/ 117 wā ṇa badz+ra bid+yā gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gsar bzhengs zhus pa'i dgos pa/ 122 gnas mchog stag mo lus sbyin mchod rten gyi lo rgyus mdo mdzangs blun las btus pa/ 126 sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyal khab phyi nang du dar tshul/ 129 khra 'gu ba bod zhen gyis rma rgyal spom ra mjal bar phyin pa'i lo rgyus/ 141 nub ri bkra shis chos 'khor gling gsar btsugs zhus pa'i phyag yig 148 bod kyi gdan sa khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling du sgrub khang nyams gso ched gnang ba'i phyag yig 150 bod kyi gdan sa khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling du bshad grwa nyams gso ched gnang ba'i phyag yig 151 'jar man sgrub sde theg chen yid 'ong gling rnams la gnang ba'i phyag yig 152 gnyi shang btsun ma'i sgrub sde nyams gso ched gnang ba'i phyag yig 153 snar smad sa stegs dgon pa nyams gso ched gnang ba'i phyag yig 153 ke na ḍar gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i phyag yig 154 rgya nag dang bod kyi theg chen gnyis la khyad par yod med dang*/ bod du chos dar tshul gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/

155 rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ngo sprod dang brgyud pa ngos 'dzin/ de'i dbang zhu ba dang sngags bzla ba'i phan nus/ 156 bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong byung tshul dang de'i dbang 'thob pa'i phan yon/ 157 grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs dang dbang bskur thob pa gal che ba'i skor/ 158 spyan ras gzigs/ sman bla/ gu ru zhi ba bcas kyi sgom bzlas kyi phan yon/ 160 dam pa'i chos la sbyangs brtson nyams len dang sgom pa'i phan yon/ 161 bla ma la dad pa yid ches skye phyir rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar mjal dgos tshul/ 162 gter bum gyi phan yon dang*/ bum pa bca' ba dang sgrub tshul/ 163 so thar sdom rgyun/ 164 spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po yi ge drug pa'i phan yon/ 165 5¿ dris lan phyogs bsdus/ rgyal ba rin po che'i bka' bslab gnang ba'i gsung lan/ 169 skyo brag mkhan po dga' dbang gi zab mo nang don gyi dris lan/ 171 bud med dge slong ma sgrub thabs kyi dris lan/ 176 rgya mtsho'i gnod pa byung rgyu gang yin dang*/ de la phan thabs gang dgos pa'i dris lan/ 1776¿ dpe deb par skrun sngon brjod phyogs bsdus/ slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba par skrun sngon brjod/ 179 karma'i mkhan chen rin chen dar rgyas kyi sor mdo'i 'grel pa par skrun sngon brjod/ 180 karma nges don gzhan phan chos kyi dbang phyug gi sdom gsum snying bsdus par skrun sngon brjod/ 182 slob dpon seṅge bzang po'i sher phyin 'grel pa don gsal par skrun sngon brjod/ 185 rje zhwa dmar lnga pa'i sher phyin 'grel pa nyung ngu rnam gsal par skrun sngon brjod/ 186 rje karma phrin las kyi sher phyin sbyor ṭīka par skrun sngon brjod/

188 blo 'phel nor bu zhes pa'i dus deb par skrun sngon brjod/ 190 karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i tshad ma rigs gzhung rgya mtsho par skrun sngon brjod/ 191 tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel pa zur bkol par skrun sngon brjod/ 197 mkhan po tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i blo rig rtags rig par skrun sngon brjod/ 200 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa par skrun sngon brjod/ 202 shes bya kun khyab mdzod par skrun sngon brjod/ 205 rgyal bstan 'dzam bu gling du dar tshul par skrun sngon brjod/ 206 blo sbyong don bdun ma phal skad du bkral ba par skrun sngon brjod/ 207 karma chags med kyi phyag rdzogs zung 'jug par skrun sngon brjod/ 212 si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi bka' brgyud gser phreng rnam thar par skrun sngon brjod/ 214 se ra rje btsun gyi kar lan klu sgrub dgongs rgyan par skrun sngon brjod/ 216 blor 'dzin deb par skrun sngon brjod/ 218 stag mo lus sbyin bshad grwa'i nyer mkho kha ton par skrun sngon brjod/ 219 rje dgu pa'i dbu ma'i bsdus pa dang zur bkol khas len skyong tshul par skrun sngon brjod/ 220 deb spyi'i par skrun sngon brjod/ 221 bal bod skad gnyis la 'jug sgo par skrun sngon brjod/ 223 blo sbyong don bdun ma phal skad du bkral ba bskyar skrun sngon brjod/ 224 bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi legs bshad gces btus las/ bka' brgyud pa'i phyag chen dang chos drug skor par skrun gleng brjod/ 226 rab byung ri zla'i me pho khyi lo'i rgyud lugs lo tho 'bring po par skrun sngon brjod/ 236 phyag chen gnyug ma'i de nyid gsal ba dbyin skad du bsgyur ba par skrun sngon brjod/

237 khra legs rin po che'i gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len skor par skrun sngon brjod/ 238 kar rabs rim byon gyi rnam thar par skrun sngon brjod/ 239 lam theg gsum skor rgya yig tu bsgyur ba'i sngon brjod/ 240 blo sbyong don bdun ma rtsa 'grel ne pālī skad du bsgyur ba'i sngon brjod/ 240 dwags po'i chos bzhi rgya skad du bsgyur ba'i sngon brjod/ 241 blo ldog rnam bzhi spar bskrun thengs gnyis pa'i sngon brjod/ 142 maṅgal dīpa slob grwa'i dus deb sngon brjod/ 243 phyi lo 2002 lo'i bka' brgyud saṅgha smon lam chen mo'i sngon brjod/ 244 kar rabs rim byon gyi lo rgyus par skrun sngon brjod/ 244 sngon 'gro'i 'don cha phyogs bsdus par skrun sngon brjod/ 245 zur mang drung pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i rnam thar par skrun sngon brjod/ 246 mi pham mkhas 'jug par skrun sngon brjod/ 247 dbu ma gzhan stong la 'jug sgo par skrun sngon brjod/ 248 the wan bka' brgyud smon lam chen mo'i sngon brjod/ 2497¿ ngos sbyor yi ge bla ma bstan 'dzin rdo rje la gnang ba'i phyag yig 251 mkhan po 'jam dbyangs rin po che la gnang ba'i phyag yig 251 bla ma gur drag la gnang ba'i phyag yig 252 bla ma pad+ma tshe dbang la gnang ba'i phyag yig 252 karma zla ba la gnang ba'i phyag yig 253 btsun ma zla ba g.yang sgron la gnang ba'i phyag yig 253 7skyabs rje mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che'i mdzad rnam snying bsdus/ 254 ༄༅/ /dwags po bka' brgyud spyi'i gsol 'debs/ rdo rje 'chang chen tai lo nā ro dang*/ /mar pa mi la chos rje sgam po pa/ /dus gsum shes bya kun mkhyen karma pa/ /che bzhi chung brgyad brgyud pa 'dzin rnams dang*/ /'bri stag tshal gsum dpal ldan 'brug pa sogs/ /zab lam phyag rgya che la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /mnyam med 'gro mgon dwags po bka' brgyud la/

/gsol ba 'debs so bka' brgyud bla ma rnams/ /brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhen log sgom gyi rkang par gsungs pa bzhin/ /zas nor kun la chags zhen med pa dang*/ /tshe 'di'i gdos thag chod pa'i sgom chen la/ /rnyed bkur zhen pa med par byin gyis rlobs/ /mos gus sgom gyi mgo bor gsungs pa bzhin/ /man ngag gter sgo 'byed pa'i bla ma la/ /rgyun du gsol ba 'debs pa'i sgom chen la/ /bcos min mos gus skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yengs med sgom gyi dngos gzhir gsungs pa bzhin/ /gang shar rtogs pa'i ngo bo so ma de/ /ma bcos de kar 'jog pa'i sgom chen la/ /bsgom bya blo dang bral bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam rtog ngo bo chos skur gsungs pa bzhin/ /ci yang ma yin cir yang 'char ba la/ /ma 'gags rol par 'char ba'i sgom chen la/ /'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*/ /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa'ang ban sgar ba 'jam dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'o// ༄༅/ /nges don phyag rgya chen po'i don khrid rkang bzhi yi sgo nas ston pa rdo rje 'chang thung ma zhes grags pa'i gsol 'debs kyi 'grel bshad thar pa'i lam ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo//de yang chos kyi rje ban sgar 'jam dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'chang thung ma 'di yi don bshad pa la/ zhal 'don gyi lugs ltar dmigs rim bshad pa dang*/ khrid yig ltar sgom rim bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po dmigs rim bshad pa/ spyir phyag rgya chen po ni/ byin rlabs kyi lam la brten pas/ byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs/ mos gus las gzhan med cing*/ mos gus ni gsol 'debs la rag las pas na/ gsol ba gdab bya'i yul don brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la btab pas chog ste/

dwags po dang*/ dus mkhyen/ rgod tshang pa rnams kyis kyang*/ ma 'ongs par phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len la brtson pa rnams kyis gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas nyams rtogs skye bar 'gyur ro zhes zhal gyis bzhes pas na/ 'o skol rnams kyang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba la sems rtsa ma zhum par dga' zhing spro ba bskyed nas/ dmigs pa 'di ltar sgom zhing*/ gsol ba 'debs par byed pa la/ rang nyid yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'am/ tha mal pa'i lus 'di nyid lhar gsal ba'i spyi gtsug khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la/ 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos par mtshon pa'i phyir sna tshogs pad+ma/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa mtshon pa'i phyir nyi ma dang*/ zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid la phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag gi bka' drin thob pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma de dang dbyer med pa rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa sku mdog sngo skya bgres pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra dkar seng nge ba/ dge slong gi cha lugs chos gos rnam pa gsum dang*/ dbu la zhwa nag gser mdongs can/ de yi dbu gtsug na mnyam med dwags po lha rje bgres tshul dbu skra dkar zhing*/ dwags zhu gsol ba/ de'i steng rje btsun mi la ras pa sku mdog sngo skya/ dbu skra phod ka ling nge/ sku la dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ de'i steng sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsā/ sku mdog dmar smug dbu skra ral pa/ ag tshom skyes pa/ ral gu smug po ber phyam dmar po can/ de'i steng mkhas mchog nā ro pa sku mdog smug nag dang*/ de'i steng grub chen tai lo pa sku mdog mthing ga ste/ gnyis ka'ang thor tshugs rus rgyan grub thob brgyud pa'i cha byad can/ de'i steng rdo rje 'chang sku mdog mthing ga phyag gnyis rdo rje dang*/ dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes pa/

dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mtha' bskor thams cad du/ rje phag mo gru pa/ dwags po sgom tshul/ 'ba' rom pa/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon/ thang pa bkra shis dpal/ gling ras pa pad+ma rdo rje/ zhang tshal pa brtson 'grus grags pa/ chos rje g.ya' bzang pa sogs 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po la mnga' brnyes pa'i bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams/ khrom tshogs bzhin du gsal te sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams thams cad nas sgom pa lta bu spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstims nas/ dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad de/ dad gdung drag po'i sgo nas/ bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi tshul du gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ dbyangs snyan pos gsol 'debs kyi tshig rnams 'don/ gal te dbyangs snyan po ma shes kyang*/ gsol ba khyi skad ma ru gdab par gsungs pas/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi nyams dang bstun gang 'don dbyangs kyis brgyan te gsol ba btab pas mos gus kyis lus kyi ba spu g.yos/ mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs/ nyams 'bar zhing gsol ba btab pa ni/ sgom gyi thog mar mos gus yin la/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad 'od du zhu nas/ gtso bo dus gsum mkhyen pa la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim pas chos sku rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi sku gsung thugs dang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin 'dres nas byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la bzhugs par snyam ste/ gang shar sems kyi ngo bo la bzo bcos ma byas par yag tu re ba dang*/ nyes kyi dwogs pa med par thad kar ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la/ rnam rtog gi 'phro rgod sogs byung yang chu dang rlabs ltar bzang ngan med par lta zhing*/ mnyam par bzhag pa ni sgom gyi dngos gzhi ste/ de ltar gsol 'debs dang*/ nyams len stabs cig tu dril bas byin rlabs che zhing*/ bka' brgyud spyi yi gsol 'debs 'thus kyang che bas dmigs pa gsal zhing*/

gsol 'debs la rgyun du 'bad par bya'o//gnyis pa khrid yig ltar sgom rim bshad pa la/ gdams ngag gi brgyud pa'i che ba bshad pa/ che ba de ldan gyi khrid rkang dngos bshad pa/ spyod pa dang sa lam bstan pa'i sgo nas smon lam gyi rgyas gdab pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/rdo rje 'chang chen tai lo nā ro dang*//mar pa mi la chos rje sgam po pa// dus gsum shes bya kun mkhyen karma pa//che bzhi chung brgyad brgyud pa 'dzin rnams dang*// 'bri stag tshal gsum dpal ldan 'brug pa sogs//zab lam phyag rgya che la mnga' brnyes pa'i// mnyam med 'gro mgon dwags po bka' brgyud la//gsol ba 'debs so bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i gsang chen rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dang*/ bka' bab bzhi ldan gyi rnal 'byor chen po tai lo shes rab bzang po/ dka' chen nyer bzhi spyad de zab mo brda yi dbang la brten nas zung 'jug gi go sar gshegs pa paṇa chen nā ro pa dang*/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje mi yi gzugs su byon pa skad gnyis smra ba'i mchog mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ gangs ljongs grub pa'i dbang po mi la bzhad pa rdo rje/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa mnyam med chos rje sgam po pa chen po ste/ bka' brgyud yongs kyi spyi mes rnams dang*/ de'i slob mar byon pa/ dus gsum shes bya kun mkhyen pa dpal karma pa sogs sku phreng na rim du byon pa rnams las kaṃ tshang bka' brgyud/ rje sgam po tshul khrims snying po las dwags po bka' brgyud/ 'ba' rom dar ma dbang phyug las 'ba' rom bka' brgyud/ phag gru rdo rje rgyal po las phag gru bka' brgyud du gyes pa ste bka' brgyud che bzhi dang*/ 'gro mgon phag gru las gyes pa 'bri stag gnyis/ g.yam shug gnyis/ smar yel gnyis/ khro gling gnyis te chung brgyad du grags pa bcas kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i mkhas grub nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar byon pa rnams dang*/

khyad par skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi brgyud 'dzin 'bri gung bka' brgyud dang*/ thang pa bkra shis dpal gyi brgyud 'dzin stag lung bka' brgyud/ zhang tshal pa brtson 'grus grags kyi brgyud 'dzin tshal pa bka' brgyud gsum dang*/ grub chen gling rje ras pa'i slob ma/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyi brgyud 'dzin dpal ldan 'brug pa bka' brgyud la sogs pa phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa rnams kyis/ zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i rdzogs rim gyi mthar thug /nye lam phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur cing*/ gdul bya gzhan la man ngag gi sgo nas bstan pa'ang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i sku gsum ngo sprod dang*/ lnga ldan/ ro snyoms sogs khrid tshul gyi thabs rnam pa du ma la brten nas/ brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma phyag rgya chen po la mnga' brnyes pa rgya che la/ rgyun mi chad par byon pa'i mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon po dwags po bka' brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bka' brgyud kyi bla ma de rnams kyi rjes su bdag bsnyegs te/ rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa ji ltar gsan pa dang*/ g.yo med kyi ting nge 'dzin nyams su bzhes pa'i sgo nas mthar thug sgom med chos sku'i rgyal sar ji ltar gshegs pa bzhin du bdag gis kyang brgyud pa rin po che 'dzin no/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma de rnams kyi rnam thar ji lta bar phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob cing*/ skal pa dang ldan pa gzhan rnams kyang lam dang 'bras bu bzang po de nyid la 'god nus par byin gyis rlobs shig ces gsol ba btab pa ste/ 'di skabs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la mos gus 'phel zhing yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar rje zhwa dmar mkha' spyod pas mdzad pa dang*/ tai lo/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mi la/ dwags po rnams kyi rnam thar dang*/ mgur 'bum bka' bab bzhi yi brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/

che bzhi chung brgyad kyi chos 'byung dang*/ lo rgyus 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyi deb ther sngon po/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i mkhas pa'i dga' ston/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po'i chos 'byung bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi gser phreng rnam thar zla ba chu shel la sogs pa'i chos 'byung dang*/ rnam thar/ lo rgyus gdan rabs sogs mjal zhing yid ches pa'i mos gus skye nges kyi thabs la 'bad pa dang*/ gzhan la khrid ston pa'i skabs su yang rnam thar dang*/ chos 'byung de rnams la brten nas/ dang po chos phyir dka' spyad du ma'i sgo nas bla ma bsten pa'i tshul/ bar du 'jig rten gyi bya gzhag blos btang gis sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ mthar zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang sku tshe gcig la brnyes nas phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i tshul sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i sku che ba'i yon tan rnams brjod de/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa brtan po la sbyar bar bya'o//gnyis pa che ba de ldan gyi khrid rkang dngos bshad pa la bzhi/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro/ zhi gnas sgom pa'i tshul/ lhag mthong ngo sprod thabs so/ /dang po ni/zhen log sgom gyi rkang par gsungs pa bzhin//zas nor kun la chags zhen med pa dang*//tshe 'di'i gdos thag chod pa'i sgom chen la//rnyed bkur zhen pa med par byin gyis rlobs//zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ de yang 'khor ba la zhen pa log pa 'di sgom gyi rkang pa lta bur gsungs pa bzhin/ tshe 'di yi snang ba 'jig rten chos brgyad dang*/ zas nor longs spyod/ gtam snyan grags la sogs pa kun la chags pa dang*/ zhen pa med par/ ri yi bu byas/ na bun gyi gos gyon/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la bskur te/ dam pa'i chos kho na las gzhan la yid smon spu tsam med pa dang*/ tshe 'di'i gdos thag ling gis chod de 'khor ba las blo ldog pa'i thabs/

dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che shin tu rnyed par dka' ba la bsam pa dang*/ de yang mi rtag pa nam 'chi cha med pa dang/ 'chi ba'i rang bzhin las ma 'das shing myur du 'chi ba'i chos can yin par bsam pa dang*/ 'chi ba'i skabs su las dge sdig gi rjes su 'brang ba las bde sdug rang gi 'dod pa bzhin mi 'byung ba'i tshul la bsam pa dang*/ las de'i rjes su 'brang nas 'khor ba'i gnas ris gsum gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal rnam pa gsum las ma 'das par bsam pa ste/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro blo ldog rnam pa bzhi bsgoms nas/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir zhen pa gting nas log par bya ba dang*/ de ltar sgom gyi rkang pa lta bu'i 'khor ba la zhen thag chad pa'i sgom chen de nyid la 'phral rkyen bdud kyi bar chad/ 'du 'dzi dang snyan grags/ rnyed pa bkur sti sogs mi 'byung ba dang*/ gal te byung na'ang de la zhen pa med par byin gyis rlobs shig ces gsol ba btab pa'i sgo nas thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i khrid rkang bstan pa ste/ 'di skabs slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bshes pa'i spring yig /theg dman dang thun mong ltar gyi 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid bstan pa mngon pa mdzod kyi gnas lnga pa'i bar/ mnyam med dwags po'i gsung theg pa chen po'i lam rim thar pa rin po che'i rgyan las/ sngon 'gro'i skor rnams dang*/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa le'u bzhi pa nas brtsam le'u bdun pa'i bar dang*/ dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i gsungs kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung dang*/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i gsung sngon 'gro'i khrid gtso bor ston pa phyag chen nges don sgron me gnyis kyi blo ldog rnam bzhi'i khrid skor sogs mjal zhing 'khor ba las blo ldog nges su bya ba dang*/ gzhan la khrid ston pa'i skabs su'ang*/

gzhung de rnams zhib khrid dam/ de rnams kyi dgongs don ltar spyir 'khor ba dang*/ sgos tshe 'di'i 'dun ma/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong 'jig rten gyi bya gzhag sogs la snying po ci yang med par go zhing shes nas/ gtan gyi 'dun ma ni dam pa'i chos kho na yin par yid ches bskyed thub nges bya'o// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro ni/mos gus sgom gyi mgo bor gsungs pa bzhin//man ngag gter sgo 'byed pa'i bla ma la/ rgyun du gsol ba 'debs pa'i sgom chen la//bcos min mos gus skye bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ bcos ma min pa'i mos gus ni/ phyag rgya chen po sgom gyi thun min gyi sngon 'gro ste/ mgo bo lta bur gsungs pa bzhin/ mos gus bskyed pa gal che zhing*/ de yi yan lag tu thog mar gzhi rten/ skyabs 'gro dang*/ sems bskyed kyis gzhi bzung*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyis rang rgyud kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te/ nyams rtogs skye ba'i snod rung du byang ba dang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang*/ khyad par du rang nyid la chos zab mo 'di lta bu'i man ngag gi gter sgo 'byed pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la rgyun du gsol ba 'debs shing bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa dang*/ gzhan yang phyag rgya chen po thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro/ sgom gyi dmigs rkyen dang*/ bdag rkyen/ rgyu rkyen/ de ma thag rkyen te rkyen bzhi rgyud la bskyed pa sogs nyams len yang dag la brtson pa'i sgom chen la/ bcos min mos gus khyad par du 'phags pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs shig ces gsol 'debs kyi sgo nas thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro spyi dang*/ bye brag rnams ston par mdzad pa ste/ 'di skabs gong du bstan pa'i nges don sgron me dang*/

zhal lung gi thun min sngon 'gro'i skor rnams/ spyod 'jug las sems bskyed ston pa'i le'u bzhi/ dngul chu thogs med kyi gsung rgyal sras lag len so bdun ma/ thar rgyan gyi skyabs sems skor gyi le'u rnams dang*/ dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo/ kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i 'grel pa sogs blo sbyong gi rigs la sogs par zhib tu mjal zhing tshig don ya ma bral ba'i sgo nas sngon 'gro 'bum bzhi sogs la brtson pa gnad thog tu 'khel bar bya zhing*/ shugs kyis bstan pa skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen nas brtsam dge slong gi bar so thar gyi sdom pa gang rung dang*/ sems bskyed skabs srol gnyis kyi byang sdom zhu zhing*/ kā ri kā/ 'dul ba/ sdom gsum sogs mjal nas bsrung bya dang srung tshul ngo shes par bya zhing*/ srung sdom la brtson pa dang*/ skabs su gso sbyong sogs bslab pa yongs sbyong gi gzhi gsum la'ang brtson zhing*/ rang lugs thun min mar mi dwags gsum sogs bla sgrub rnams la'ang nyams len bya/ gzhan la khrid ston pa'i skabs su'ang*/ gong du bstan pa'i gzhung de rnams kyi dgongs don ltar/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i phan yon/ de bzhin sdig sgrib ma sbyang ba'i nyes dmigs/ sbyong byed la thun mong stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags tshul/ thun min rdor sems sgom bzlas ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ de bzhin maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba la'ang*/ spyir tshogs gnyis bsags thabs/ bye brag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i tshul/ ku sā li yi lus mchod sbyin gyi sgo nas tshogs bsags thabs sogs dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs/ nyams len gyi rtsa ba mos gus yin pa dang*/ de yang bla ma la rag las pas/ bla ma'i sku las dbang bzhi len pa sogs go brda 'phrod nges su bya zhing*/ so thar gyi sdom pa ris bdun dang*/

sems bskyed kyi bslab pa bcas gang la gang 'os sbyin zhing spang blang gi gnas rnams kyang zhib par bslab nas lag tu len shes par bya'o//gsum pa dngos gzhi zhi gnas kyi ngo sprod ni/yengs med sgom gyi dngos gzhir gsungs pa bzhin//gang shar rtogs pa'i ngo bo so ma de//ma bcos de kar 'jog pa'i sgom chen la//bsgom bya blo dang bral bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes pas bar gyis bstan te/ de ltar sngon 'gro nyams su blangs zin nas/ phyi rnam g.yeng dang*/ nang mtshan ma'i rnam rtog la yeng ba med par rtse gcig tu sgom pa ni/ sgom gyi dngos gzhi yin par gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa rnams su gsungs pa bzhin/ thad kar gang shar rnam par rtog pa'i ngo bo bcos bsgyur ma byas pa'i so ma de/ tha mal ma bcos pa'i shes pa de kar 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da ltar gyi shes pa rtsis gdab mi bya bar/ mnyam par 'jog pa'i sgom chen la/ sgom legs su re ba dang*/ nyes kyi dwogs pa/ sgom yod snyam pa dang/ med snyam pa/ bsgom bya dang sgom byed/ 'phro rgod/ bying rmugs sogs 'dzin pa'i blo dang bral bar byin gyis rlobs shig ces pas zhi gnas ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul gyi khrid rkang bstan pa ste/ 'di skabs theg dman gyi dbang du byas pa mngon pa mdzod kyi lam gang zag bstan pa sogs gnas rjes ma gsum gyis bstan don dang*/ theg chen pa'i lugs/ spyod 'jug dang*/ thar rgyan gyi bsam gtan le'u dang*/ phyag chen thun min gyi sgom rim dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi gsung zla ba'i 'od zer dang*/ rje karma pa dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i gsung nges don rgya mtsho dang*/ ma rig mun sel/ chos sku mdzub tshugs sogs kyi zhi gnas sgom rim rnams zhib par mjal zhing*/ bsam gtan 'bol chung dang*/ tshugs shing rnams bcang*/ lus gnad bcas te theg dman dang thun mong ltar/ 'dod chags shas che na mi sdug pa/

zhe sdang shas che na byams pa/ gti mug shas che na rten 'brel/ rnam rtog shas che na dbugs 'byung rngub sgom pa sogs spyod pa rnam byang gi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ theg chen thun mong gi lugs ltar/ phyi rnyed sogs kyi 'jig rten spangs pa dang*/ nang chags sogs kyi rnam rtog dor ba sogs la brten nas zhi gnas kyi rtsal sbyang ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa man ngag gi lugs ltar/ ma dag pa shing bu rde'u la brten nas sems 'dzin pa dang*/ dag pa la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la sogs la brten nas sems 'dzin pa dang*/ de bzhin rlung la brten nas sems 'dzin pa dang*/ brten med du sems 'dzin pa sogs la brten nas zhi gnas mthar phyin pa lhag mthong gi rten gzhir nus nges su sgom/ shugs la bstan pa yi dam gyi bskyed rim sgom pa'ang*/ kaṃ tshang rang lugs kyi bde rgyal phag gsum sogs kyi dbang dang khrid zhu/ gzhan yang brtag gnyis dang*/ phag mo'i rnam bshad sogs kyi bshad pa dang zab khrid zhus nas/ phyi nang gsang sgrub la brtson pa'am/ yang na dus dgyes gsang gsum sogs rang gi lhag pa'i lha gang yin gyi bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin zhing*/ drod rtags thon nges su 'bad par bya/ gzhan la khrid ston pa'i skabs su'ang*/ gong du bstan pa'i gzhung dang*/ khrid yig rnams kyi dgongs don ltar/ rim bzhin sbyangs pa thon nges su byed pa las/ lhag mthong la hol rgyug mi byed par zhi gnas 'byong ba'i rtags rnams myong thog tu thon nges par bslab cing*/ yi dam gyi bskyed bzlas sogs la'ang*/ smin byed kyi dbang*/ grol byed kyi khrid rnams nyams len gyi rim dang mthun par rim bzhin sbyin par bya'o//bzhi pa lhag mthong gi ngo sprod ni/rnam rtog ngo bo chos skur gsungs pa bzhin//ci yang ma yin cir yang char ba la//ma 'gags rol par 'char ba'i sgom chen la//'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs//zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te/

de ltar zhi gnas mthar phyin nas/ gang shar rnam rtog gi ngo bo ji lta bar rtogs pa ni chos kyi sku yin par grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis gsungs pa bzhin/ sems kyi ngo bo la hrig ger bltas pas/ ngos bzung mtha' dag dang bral ba ngo bo ci yang ma yin pa'am/ ma grub pa'i stong nyid yin bzhin du/ gsal cha ma 'gag pa cir yang 'char ba la/ ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ rnam pa ma 'gag pa'i rol par sku gsum nang nas 'char ba'i sgom chen la/ 'khor ba zhes skyon dang*/ myang 'das zhes yon tan du mi lta bar dbyer med mnyam pa nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs shig ces pas/ phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len gyi steng du ngo sprod pa lhag mthong gi khrid rkang ste/ 'di skabs bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa bstan pa/ rtsa shes/ 'jug pa sogs dang*/ bka' tha ma'i dgongs pa 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po rtsal du bton pa/ bstan bcos chen po rgyud bla ma/ kun mkhyen rang byung ba'i gsung de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa dang*/ rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa/ gzhan yang spyod 'jug dang*/ thar rgyan gyi shes le sogs mjal nas stong pa dbyings dang*/ gsal cha ye shes dbyer med zung du 'jug pa nyid yid dpyod kyis gtan la phab ste nges shes 'drongs par bya ba dang*/ phyag chen thun mong ma yin pa'i zab khrid nges don rgya mtsho sogs gsum dang*/ sgom rim zla ba'i 'od zer bcas kyi lhag mthong gi khrid skor dang*/ phyag chen bshad sbyar rgyal ba'i gan mdzod sogs zhib par mjal zhing sems kyi ngo bo rjen pa yid dpyod dang go bas ma sbags par phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs par bya zhing*/ shugs bstan du thabs lam la brten pa'i tshul ni/ rgyud sde rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub gong du song ba zhig yin na/ pha rgyud kyi rdzogs rim dben pa gsum dang*/

gnyis med kyi rdzogs rim sbyor ba yan lag drug lta bu'am/ lhag par rang lugs thun min gyi dgongs pa rgyud sde spyi dang*/ khyad par ma rgyud kyi rdzogs rim ston pa/ kun mkhyen rang byung ba'i gsung zab mo nang don sogs zhu zhing*/ zab mo nā ro chos drug gi nyams len la brtson nas phyag rgya chen po'i myong ba nang nas thon par bya'o/ /gzhan la khrid ston pa'i skabs su'ang*/ grol lam phyag chen la/ gzhung chen dang*/ khrid yig de rnams kyi dgongs don ltar lta bas nges shes 'drongs pa dang*/ lhag par gnas thog nas ngo sprod pa/ 'gyu thog nas ngo sprod pa/ snang thog nas ngo sprod pa sogs kyi thabs la brten nas/ snang ba sems/ sems stong pa/ stong pa lhun grub/ lhun grub rang grol du ngo sprod par bya ba ste/ de'ang paṇ+ḍi ta'i tshig khrid dang*/ sgom chen gyi dmar khrid dang mthun par myong ba nang nas thon cing ngo 'phrod pa las/ lta ba kha khyer dang*/ blun sgom rmongs zhen gyi dbang du ma song bar bya ba dang*/ thabs lam rnams kyang*/ thar pa don gnyer gyi nyams len la brtson pa rnams la sbyin zhing*/ nyams len kha la khyer ba'i gang zag rnams la gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa mi 'byung bar bya'o//gsum pa spyod pa dang sa lam bstan pa'i sgo nas bsngo bas rgyas btab pa ni/skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*//'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*//sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas//rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog/ ces pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ skye ba dang tshe rabs kun tu yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la brten nas/ dus nam du'ang 'bral ba med par zab cing rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa la/ thos bsam sgom pa'i sgo nas longs spyod cing*/ sa bcu po dang*/ lam lnga po rnams kyi yon tan rab tu rdzogs nas/ sa lam rim gyis bgrod de mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur du 'thob par shog ces smon lam btab pa'i sgo nas thog mar bla ma bsten pa nas bzung*/

mthar sangs rgyas ma thob pa'i bar gyi spyod pa dang*/ sa lam yongs rdzogs bstan par mdzad pa ste/ 'di skabs thar pa rin po che'i rgyan las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i le'u/ sa bcu lam lnga 'bras bu phrin las bstan pa'i le'u rnams dang*/ bstan bcos chen po rgyud bla ma las/ byang chub/ yon tan/ phrin las kyi le'u gsum/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sbas don sa lam gyi rim pa bstan pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan sogs/ thun mong sa bcu lam lnga'i skor dang*/ phyag chen thun min sgom rim rnams nas bstan pa'i rtse gcig nas sgom med bar rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi rnam gzhag gsal bar bstan pa rnams mjal zhing*/ las dang po pa nas gzung*/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang bar gyi sa lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rtags rnams shes par bya zhing*/ de lta bu yon tan yang rang re skal pa dman pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mjal bar mi nus pa rnams la bka' drin che ba ni/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa kho na yin pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong las bka' drin che ba'i bla ma ni/ sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor shes nas 'bral med du 'grogs shing dam pa'i chos la longs spyod par bya ba dang*/ gzhan la khrid ston pa'i skabs su'ang*/ gzhung dang*/ khrid yig de rnams kyi dgongs don ltar sa lam gyi yon tan gong ma rnams rim gyis ngo sprod cing*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang mi 'bral bar chos la longs spyod dgos pa dang*/ lta ba nam mkha' ltar mtho na'ang*/ las rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra ba nas rtsi bsrung bya dgos pa dang*/ chos thams cad stong par rtogs na'ang*/ bsags sbyang gnyis po gal cher 'dzin pa sogs bstan par bya'o//yang gang zag de ltar gzhung chen po rnams blta bar mi nus shing*/ nyams len kyang de tsam brtson par mi nus pa'i rigs la yang*/ dwags po rin po che'i gsung lam mchog rin chen phreng ba dang*/

phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag do ha mdzod brgyad/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i snying gtam tshig gcig ma sogs la brten nas khrid bshad de/ nyams len la brtson nas thos rtags zhi zhing dul ba dang*/ sgom rtags nyon mongs med pa zhig 'ong nges la brtson zhing 'bad par bya'o//de ltar rdo rje 'chang thung ma'i khrid nyung ngu 'di'ang*/ 7rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa bcu drug pa chen pos/ 'dzam gling nub phyogs kyi gling phran rnams su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che spel ba'i phrin las kyi sgo 'phar rnam par dbye ba'i skabs/ dge 'dun rgya mtshos gsung bskul gnang ba ltar/ rang la skyes sbyang gi yon tan dman zhing*/ sgom pa'i nyams rtogs kyang dben pas rang stobs kyis rtsom par mi nus na'ang*/ mkhas grub gong ma'i gsung rnams dpang por bkod nas/ bsdus pa la dga' ba rnams tshig don tsam gyis tshims par byed pa dang*/ rgyas par dga' ba dag zab pa dang*/ rgya che ba'i shes rab dang brtson 'grus mnga' ba rnams kyis gzhung chen po rnams la thos bsam bya ba dang*/ zab don gyi man ngag rnams ji ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul stabs cig tu bstan par byas pa 'di nyid/ 7rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gi zhabs 'bangs tha shal du gtogs pa shākya'i dge slong karma blo gros ring lugs smra ba'i seṅge'am/ nye bar gnas pa kun gyis mkhan ming khra 'gu sprul skur 'bod pa'i snyom las mkhan des/ yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi sa yi ya gyal dpal rum bteg bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling gi gtsug lag khang du dge 'dun rnams dbyar gnas pa'i chos grwar bris pa'i dge bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༄༅/ /dbu ma gzhan stong smra ba'i srol legs par phye ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dbu ma gzhan stong smra ba'i srol legs par phye ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'chad pa la gsum ste/ thog mar dge ba bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa/ bar du dge ba gzhung dngos/ tha mar dge ba mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /dang po la/ bar chad bsal ba'i phyir du yul dam pa la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir du gang las byung ba'i lo rgyus bshad pa/ mthar phyin pa'i phyir du rtsom par dam bca' ba gsum las/ dang po ni/) rang spyi gang dang ma 'dres gsang ba'i gsang*//glo bur sems kyis nam yang rtogs min par//rnal 'byor ye shes rdo rje las skyes pa'i//dbyings nyid de nyid rig pas gang mthong ba//ston pa rnams la bdag yid lhag par dad//(gnyis pa yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir du gang las byung pa'i lo rgyus bshad pa ni/)thub dbang bsil zer byed pa yi/ /bstan pa'i 'od dkar rgyas mod kyang*//dgongs don ji ltar gsal ba yi/ /ri dwags rtags can ri mo ni//ma pham pa las gzhan pa'i su/ /ma pham chos kyi gzugs brnyan ni//thogs med zla ba'i rgya mtsho la/ /shar tshe theg pa chen po bstan//rnam 'gyur ya mtshan mang du spel//(gsum pa mthar phyin pa'i phyir du rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/) de skad du rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams la bstod dbyangs ya mtshan pa'i phreng ba mtshar du dngar bar phul nas/ bden pa gnyis kyi don rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las byung ba'i chos kyi tshul cung zad brjod par bya'o//(gnyis pa gzhung don dngos la/ 1 bde gshegs snying po sgrub byed kyi rigs pa bstan pa/ 2 de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i ngo bo bstan pa/ 3 de dri ma sbyang pa'i lam la brtson tshul/ 4 snying po la dri mas bsgrib tshul dpe yis bstan pa/ 5 dgos pa bshad pa bcas las/ dang po la/ rdzogs sangs sku 'phro ba'i rigs pas bsgrub pa dang*/

de bzhin nyid la dbye ba med pa'i rigs pas bsgrub pa dang*/ rigs yod pa'i rigs pas bsgrub pa ste gsum las/ dang po la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku 'phro ba'am sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i tshul dang*/ rtogs pa'i ye shes ngos bzung*/ de 'byung ba'i rgyu ye shes ye gdod ma nas yod pa'i tshul bstan pa bcas gsum las/ dang po ni/) de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas zab mo'i dbyings las rtogs pa'i ye shes ye gdod ma nas dbyings bde gshegs snying po dang tha mi dad du yod pa'i rig pa ldang ba de'i tshe sgrib pa'i sa bon thams cad pa spangs te/ rtogs pa ye shes kyi rang rig pa de ni gnas gyur pa'i ye shes kyis tshogs dpag tu med pa bsgrubs te/ de yang ji ltar bsgrub ce na/ sgrib par bcas pa'i sems can gyi rnam rig la dri ma dang bral bar byas pa'i shes pa ye shes kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pas byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ dri bral gyi shes pa'i cha la'ang ye shes kyi cha yod pa gnyis ka'i nus pa las rnam rig de dri med gnas gyur te/ rtogs ye chos sku dang ro gcig tu gyur nas/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ye gdod ma nas gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang tha mi dad par de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub pa'i bya ba byed do//(gnyis pa rtogs pa'i ye shes ngos bzung ni/) de ltar na rtogs pa'i ye shes nyid kyis gang rtogs par bya zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbyings mngon sum du nges par byed pa'o/ /nges byed kyi rtogs rig de ni ji srid rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dngos dang*/ de dang rjes su mthun par sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar nges par 'byin pa bcu'i rtogs rig rnams te/ (gsum pa de 'byung ba'i rgyu ye shes ye gdod ma nas yod pa'i tshul bstan pa ni/) rtogs rig 'di ye gdod ma nas yod pa'i don gyis so skye'i sems dang sems byung la bltos pa'i lam des bsgrubs pa thams cad ngal ba don med du mi 'gro zhing*/

yang dag par tshul bzhin du mos pa don ldan gyi gzhi'am rten du 'gyur pas so/ /des na rdo rje lta bu'i rtogs rig dngos de bskyed pa'i thabs ni thog mar thos bsam sgom gsum gyi stobs las so so skye bo'i sems dang sems byung rnam par dag tu+u bcug pa'i rjes su thos bsam sgom gsum gang gi mthu la bltos mi dgos par/ rang byung du rdo rje lta bu'i rtogs pa ye shes de ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor skad cig tu 'char ba'i tshe ma rig bag chags kyi mun pa rtsa ba nas drungs 'byin pa ltar/ ye shes kyi 'od dbyung ba dang*/ ma rig pa'i dpung gnyis dus gcig char du skad cig thug phrad la gzhom par nus par ni rdo rje'i don te/ des na rgyud bla mar rdo rje'i gnas bdun zhes pa'i don ni de'o//(gnyis pa de bzhin nyid la dbye ba med pa'i rigs pas bsgrub pa la/ gnas skabs gsum la 'gyur ba med pa'i tshul gyis dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo yin pa mdor bstan/ de'i don rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/) gzhan yang lugs 'di la ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang*/ chos kyi sku dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnams ming tha dad pa tsam ma gtogs don gcig ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid mngon du gyur pa ni chos kyi sku zhes brjod la/ chos kyi sku zhes bya ba yang gnas skabs gsum kar gnas kyang*/ sgrib pa'i tshogs spangs pas khyad par du byas pa'i tshe chos thams cad kyi khyab byed du gyur pa'i khyab pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i sku mi zad par ston nus pas chos kyi sku dang*/ de bzhin du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni ye gdod ma nas mngon par byang chub pa ste/ de yang gnas skabs gsum du byang chub la 'gyur ba med pa ste/ ye nas de nyid la dri mas gos pa med cing rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin te/ des ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por ni thog mar dri mas gos pa dang*/

rjes su dri ma'i tshogs spangs pa yang med do zhes bstan nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni dkon mchog gsum nyid yin te/ gnas skabs su bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dang*/ mthar thug rang byung ye shes kyi dge legs sbyin par nus pas so//(gnyis pa de'i don rgyas par bshad pa la/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog /chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog gi skabs bcas la dbye ba med tshul bstan pa gsum las/ dang po la lnga/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid la dbye ba med pa'i tshul dang*/ de nyid kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po la rag las pa/ dbu ma'i lugs gzhan gyis de ltar ma rtogs pa'i tshul/ bde gshegs snying po mngon du gyur pa'i skabs yon tan gsum mngon du gyur tshul/ khyad par gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs pa ma yin pa'i tshul rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/)des na chos kyi sku de ni phyogs bcu dang dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dbye ba med cing*/ dbye ba med pa'i ye shes yon tan dang bcas pa de ni nyon mongs pa'i sbubs dang ma bral ba rnams la'ang de nyid gang yin pa de gnas so/ /de bas 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa la/ mnyam pa nyid gang zhe na don dam pa'i bden pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la brjod kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bla na med pa'i dbyings la so so rang rig gi ye shes kyi go 'phang mdzad pa de ni/ 'jig rten khams su bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams byang chub snying por mngon par gshegs zhes pa'i don to//(gnyis pa de nyid kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po la rag las pa ni/) des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni yon tan thams cad kyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyis mtshams sbyor ba 'joms pa'i rjes thog tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad pa de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi spyod yul du ston zhing*/

de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis de'i tshe chos thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba'i stobs kyis chos kyi 'khor lo nges pa'i don can dang*/ slob ma sa chen po la gnas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams skad cig tu ston par nus pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid do//(gsum pa dbu ma'i lugs gzhan gyis de ltar ma rtogs pa'i tshul ni/) 'di na theg pa chen po dbu ma par rlom pa 'ga' zhig phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i gtam khong du ma chud par/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni stong pa nyid kho nas phye ba'i dbang du byas nas don dam pa'i bden pa ni gang du'ang bstan du med pa'i don la mngon par zhen pa ni theg pa chen por gnas lugs don dam nges pa'i don du mi 'gro ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong nyid rgyun chad nyan rang gi dgra bcom dang mtshungs par 'gyur la/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni rang gzhan gyi don mngon par grub pa ste/ cho 'phrul bzod par dka' ba zad mi shes pa de bzhin gshegs pas ngo mtshar ba du ma ston pa ni phyi ma'i mur thug pa med par gda' bas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang mdzad pa rtag pa dang brtan pa'i rang bzhin can 'di ni don dam pa'i bden pa yin zhes dbu ma pa chen po thogs med zhabs kyis bzhed do//(bzhi pa bde gshegs snying po mngon du gyur pa'i skabs yon tan gsum mngon du gyur tshul ni/) des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni sangs rgyas kyi sar chos kyi sku'i ming 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ so so skye bo dang mos spyod pa rnams kyi lus ni nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga 'dus pa zag pa dang bcas pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa dang sa la gnas pa'i sems dpa' rnams kyi lus ni yid kyi rang bzhin rnam par 'phrul pa zag pa med pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku ni chos kyi dbyings khyab bdag gcig tu bsdoms pa du ma'i rnam par rol pa chos kyi sku ste zag pa dang zag med thams cad las rnam par grol ba'i sku de ni ye gdod ma nas skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba'i phyir 'dus byas kyi cha spangs pa dang*/

de nyid la spros tshogs ye nas zhi zhing sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgya mtsho lhun grub tu gnas la/ de nyid rtogs par byed pa'i rtogs rig yul can de ni spros pa'i tshogs gzhan la rag ma las pa/ ngo bo nyid kyis rang rig pa'i phyir rang rig dag pa nyid kyis dag pas gzhan la mi ltos pa de ni lugs bla na med pa ste/ [bye brag smra ba ltar spyod pa'i dbu ma pa rnams kyi yul min no//] de'i yon tan las rang gzhan gyi don mkhyen pa dang brtse bas sems can gzhan gyi dri ma sbyong bar mdzad do//(lnga pa khyad par gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs pa ma yin pa'i tshul rgyas par bshad pa ni/) des na de bzhin gshegs pa nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i skad cig ma'i ye shes de ni slob dpon med par rang byung gi ye shes kyis brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zhes thogs med zhabs kyis gsungs la/ don 'di dang mthun par gnas brtan dbyig gnyen gyis kyang mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel par/ rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ji lta ba de yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mngon par 'du bya ba dang po dang tha mi dad pa ste zhes gsungs la/ gzhan dag de ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sangs rgyas ma thag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur bas slob dpon du 'gyur ba dang*/ sngags kyi tshul la sangs rgyas sangs rgyas ma thag de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thun mong min pa'i don dam pa'i sems 'od gsal rdo rje bsgom du bzhugs pas so zhes zer la/ de ni thabs tsam du zad kyi/ sangs rgyas rang gi ye shes rang las skyes te rang gis mnga' dbang du mdzad pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gyi rgyud la rag ma las pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas 'gyur gyi rang mtshan kho na la'o/ /sangs rgyas nas ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang dbye ba med pa nyid do/ /des na dbu ma chen po thogs med zhabs kyis ni sgom lam tha ma'i tshe na sangs rgyas 'gyur gyi rgyud de nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa de la gnyen po rang rig shar te spangs pa ma lus pa spong la/

mthong ba dang bsgom pas spong ba gzhan rnams su ni de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gyi thugs rje dang ye shes kyi nus pa rdo rje dang ral gri lta bus sangs rgyas 'gyur gyi rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa phra rags rnams sel bar bzhed do/ /lugs 'di ni rje btsun byams pa'i man ngag gi nying khu nyid las brgyud dgos la/ gzhan du zab don 'di'i skal pa med do//(gnyis pa chos dkon mchog gi gnas skabs su ngo bo nyid la dbye ba med pa'i tshul la/ bsam med gnyis med kyi yon tan chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med tshul/ stong nyid kho nar sbyar na mi rung ba'i tshul/ chags thogs las grol ba'i tshul/ ma mthong ba tsam yang dag pa ma yin pa'i tshul/ de lta bu'i chos dkon mchog gi ngo bo yang ye gdod ma nas grub pa'i bde gshegs snying po yin par bstan pa bcas lnga las/ dang po ni/) de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po de mngon du byas pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi cho 'phrul ni dri ma med pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid can/ yod pa yang ma yin/ med pa yang ma yin/ yod med gnyis ka las gzhan du'ang min par/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis ni rang rig par rig cing zhi ba'i bdag nyid du gnas la/ so so skye bo bde gshegs snying po dang ldan pa rnams kyis ni/ bde gshegs snying po dbyings la gnas pa'i chos rnams la ni so so skye bo'i shes pas brtag par mi nus shing nges tshig dang bral bas don dam pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs rjes su ma dpogs pa'o/ /so so skye bo'i shes pas chos la brtags pa'i tshe med min yod min yod med ma yin/ yod med las gzhan du'ang ma rnyed pa de ni chos kyi gnas lugs yang dag par rjes su mthong ba min te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ so skye'i gzhal byed kyi shes pa tshad ma min pa des chos kyi gnas lugs tshad ma yang dag pa de rjes su mthong ba min zhes slob dpon thogs med sku mched kyis gsungs la/

(gnyis pa stong nyid kho nar sbyar na mi rung ba'i tshul ni/) zla grags dang seng bzang la sogs pas ni so skye'i shes pas chos kyi khams la yod med skye 'gog rigs pas brtags pas ma rnyed pa de ni don dam pa'i gnas lugs yin par 'dod do/ /'dir 'phags pa thogs med sku mched ni 'di ltar bzhed do/ /sgra brjod ngag dang nges tshig tha snyad brda rnams kyi sgo nas dpogs par gyur pa'i gnas lugs gang yin pa de ni don dam pa'i cha ma yin zhing rtog ge'i blo yi nus pas ji ltar 'bad cing*/ med pa dang yod pa dang*/ yod med gnyis ka ma yin par dpyod kyang nyi tshe ba ste/ rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis bsam med rtog brjod med par las dang nyon mongs pa kun 'byung ba tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i rtog pa'i tshogs 'gog ste/ de 'gog pa las de tshe rang byung gi ye shes kyi chos dang chos nyid kyi gnas snang so sor rig pa'i shes rab chags thogs med par skye'o// (gsum pa chags thogs las grol ba'i tshul ni/) shes rab chags thogs med par skye ba de ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshul bzhin gyi yid la byed pa rnal 'byor gyi mthu las skyes pa de ni ma rig pas kun nas slong bar mi byed cing*/ de'i gnad kyis kun gzhi'i sems dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i yid dang*/ yul la rnam par rtog pa'i shes pa dang 'brel ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /tshul bzhin gyi yid la byed pa gang yin pa ni skye ba med cing 'gags pa med pa ste/ don zab mo 'di ni so so skye bo'i yul min no// [da lta kha ba can pa'i phyag rgya chen po ba 'ga' ni/ so so skye bo la'ang don zab mo 'di 'char bar 'dod do//] des na glo bur gyi khams 'di ni thog ma nas ma skyes ma byung*/ zad pa nyid med pas/ glo bur gyi khams kyang 'gags pa dang*/ zad pa dang*/ 'gogs pa nyid dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /lugs 'di la so so rang rig gi ye shes kyis rang rgyud glo bur gyi dri ma'i cha la bltas pas glo bur gyi dri mas bsdus pa'i chos dang chos can 'ga' yang mthong ba med pa de'i tshe/

dri ma thams cad dang bral nas yang dag pa'i don mngon pa byas par bzhed la/ (bzhi pa ma mthong ba tsam yang dag pa ma yin pa'i tshul ni/) zla grags la sogs pas ni/ don dam chos nyid kyis chos nyid ma mthong ba la don dam pa'i bden pa mthong zhes ngos 'dzin kyang de ni don dam par smos ci dgos/ kun rdzob tshig la'ang 'gal ba du ma rang lugs la khas len dgos par 'gyur bas/ de'i skyon sel du nged dbu ma pas khas len ci yang med ces smra bar byed do//(lnga pa de lta bu'i chos dkon mchog gi ngo bo yang ye gdod ma nas grub pa'i bde gshegs snying po yin par bstan pa ni/) lugs 'dir ni don dam pa ni de bzhin gshegs pas gzigs pa'i yul yin te/ yod pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ don dam pa'i bden pa la sgrib byed kyi dri mas ngo bo la ma gos pas bsal bar bya ba med pa dang*/ de nyid la gzhan pa'i ye shes bzhag tu med pa'i mnyam nyid ye shes mngon par byang chub pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzigs pa rnam par dag pa ste/ glo bur gyi dri ma gtan bral du song ba'i rjes su de kho na nyid med par 'dzin pa'i gnyen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo las mthong ba dang sgom pa'i lam du chos kyi sku'i go 'phang 'grub byed kyi rgyu rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'bad nas sgrub dgos par rjes su gdams la/ de yang chos kyi sku'i rgyu bsgrub dgos zhes sngar med kyi rgyu gsal bar byed dgos par bshad pa ma yin la/ sngar yod kyi rgyu phyis mngon gsal du 'char ba'i thabs la brtson pa'i don no/ /'di la dbu ma par rloms pa 'ga' zhig rgyu dus su 'bras bu yod med kyi rtog ge'i rigs pas spros tshogs bral bar 'dod pa mang yang*/ nges pa'i don 'dir ni/ yang dag pa'i bde gshegs snying po la ni gnas skabs gang du'ang rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis su med la/ chu khams gser dang nam mkha' ltar rgyu nyid dang 'bras bu dbyer med dus thams cad du gnas par bzhed do//(gsum pa dge 'dun dkon mchog gi gnas skabs su yang ngo bo nyid la dbye ba med tshul la/

rig grol gyi yon tan bde gshegs snying po dang dbyer med par bstan/ don dam med rkyang du 'dzin pa'i lugs dgag /des na dge 'dun gyi yon tan ye gdod ma nas yod par bstan/ lugs 'di'i ji lta ji snyed kyi ye shes ngos bzung ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/) des na so so skye bo'i sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar gyur pa na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la reg par 'gyur te/ sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i don ni sems rang bzhin gyi dbyings la yal ba yin te/ kun rdzob kyi chos rang ngos stong pa dang 'od gsal ba ni de bzhin gshegs snying dang dbyer med pa ste/ dbyer med de'i ngo bo ni ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ 'di med na ni 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gang yang mi srid par 'gyur ro/ /sems yid rnam shes las nyon mongs sdug bsngal rnams ni glo bur ba ste/ rgyu dang rkyen las grub pa med pa'i phyir nyon mongs pa rnams la ngo bo med pa ste/ glo bur nyon mongs pa skyed byed kyi rgyu yod na ngo bo yod par 'gyur la/ skyed byed kyi rgyu med de/ glo bur ba nyid la rgyu med pas ngo bo yod par mi rung ngo*//(gnyis pa don dam med rkyang du 'dzin pa'i lugs dgag pa ni/) dri ma glo bur ba la ngo bo med pa de bzhin du dbu ma par rloms pa gzhan dag don dam pa'i bden pa la ngo bo med par 'dod pa ni nges pa'i don mthar thug tu 'dod snang yang*/ dbu ma pa chen po thogs med sku mched ni don dam par nges pa'i don la med par smra ba'i phyir de las chad pa'i mtha' ci zhig yod ces gsungs so//(gsum pa des na dge 'dun gyi yon tan ye gdod ma nas yod par bstan pa ni/) des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni ji lta ba bzhin 'gro ba thams cad la yod pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni bdag med pa'i bdag gi ming du rtogs shing*/

de yang thog mar bdag rnam pa gnyis la/ phyis nas 'jigs pa ma yin te/ ye gdod ma nas zhi ba'i rang bzhin yongs su dag pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba dang glo bur nyon mongs pa gnyis ni zag pa med pa'i dbyings su lhan du 'khod rung zhing*/ glo bur ba'i nyon mongs pa ni rang bzhin 'od gsal dang reg tu mi rung la/ rang bzhin 'od gsal nyon mongs pa dang reg tu mi rung zhing*/ rang bzhin 'od gsal ba nyid la ni gsal byed gzhan mi dgos la/ nyon mongs pa'i shes pa nyid ni/ nyon mongs pa nyid kyis nyon mongs par 'gyur la/ rang bzhin 'od gsal bas ni nyon mongs pa la rtog cing 'dzin par mi byed do//(bzhi pa lugs 'di'i ji lta ji snyed kyi ye shes ngos bzung ba ni/) des na lugs 'dir ni ji lta ba rtogs pa ni 'phags pa rnams rang rgyud kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po nyid rtogs pa la bya la/ ji snyed pa ni 'gro ba gzhan bde gshegs snying po rgyud ldan du rtogs pa la thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya zhing*/ kun rdzob kyi 'khrul pa mkhyen pa la ni ma yin te/ kun rdzob kyi 'khrul pa ni shes bya la rnam pa thams cad du med pas/ 'phags pa rnams kyis de ni mkhyen gzigs kyi yul du mi 'os te/ yul med pa'i phyir/ 'di la gzhan dag gis/ 'o na thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin te/ kun rdzob thams cad ma mkhyen pas so zhe na/ mkhyen yul gyi gzhal bya med na mkhyen pa nyid ga la rung ste/ yul med la 'dzin pa ni rtog pa log shes te/ thams cad mkhyen pa la de lta bu'i rtog pa mi mnga' bar bzhed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni chos thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro zhing thogs pa med la/ der zhen pa dang mtshan mar med pas na chags pa med pa'o//(gsum pa rigs yod pa la brten nas bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po sgrub pa la/ lam gyi rten dang ngo bo dang 'bras bur gyur pa'i rigs bstan pa dang*/

de nyid dri bcas dang dri med skabs kyi khyad par/ sangs rgyas pa'i skabs dri ma slar mi ldog pa'i tshul/ sangs rgyas nas sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs dang bde gshegs snying po'i nus pa gnyis las 'bras bu thob pa'i tshul bcas bzhi las/ dang po ni/) des na lugs 'di la ni mthar thug gi skyabs don dam par yod cing*/ de med na ni lam gyi rten dang lam gyi ngo bo dang*/ lam gyi 'bras bu yang med par 'gyur la sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dgos pa med cing*/ nges pa'i don thun mong min pa'i bka' rnams kyang drang don bslu ba can gyi dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lor 'gyur bas mthar thug gi dri med de bzhin gshegs pa yang yod de/ lam gyi rten yang zhib tu dbye na dri bcas de bzhin gshegs snying yin la/ de ni chos thams cad kyi dbyings dang dbyer med pa'i rigs te/ don 'di ni stong gsum dar yug chen po'i dpes bshad la/ de sgrub pa'i rten ni theg pa gsum gyis zhugs pa'i gang zag rnams te/ nyan rang gi tshul la zhugs pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs 'di las ches ring pa nyid do/ / lam gyi ngo bo yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs 'di ste/ 'di med na ni de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten du byung yang dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel ba'i gnas dang 'byung ba'i gzhi med pa'i phyir rdzogs pa'i byang chub la reg par mi 'gyur ro/ /des na rtag pa dang brtan pa g.yung drung gi skyabs ni mthar thug chos sku nyid la dkon mchog 'di'i rigs ni nges par yod pa yin la/ des na rang don chos kyi sku rtogs pa rnams kyis ni chos sku dang dbye ba med pa'i chos rnams ni rang gzhan gyi rgyud la bsdus pa dang*/ chos kyi sku de dang 'gal bar gyur pa rnams ni rang gzhan gyi rgyud la bsdoms par mdzad de/ de'i blang bya de de bzhin gshegs snying dang*/ dor bya glo bur gyi dri ma kun btags gzhan dbang rnams te/

'di dag gi bye brag rang gis mkhyen te gzhan la smra bar mdzad pa ni kun mkhyen ye shes kho na'i spyod yul lo//(gnyis pa de nyid dri bcas dang dri med skabs kyi khyad par ni/) des na 'phags pa thogs med sku mched ni glo bur dri ma'i sbubs su yod pa'i bde bar gshegs pa la bde gshegs snying po dang*/ khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po zhes brjod la/ de 'bral rung gi cha la rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs dang gnas yongs su 'gyur bzhin pa'i chos sku zhes brjod cing*/ glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba de la de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes brjod la/ (gsum pa sangs rgyas pa'i skabs dri ma slar mi ldog pa'i tshul ni/) gnas skabs gsum kar ming gcig tu bsdoms pa'i bde gshegs snying po ni bden 'dzin dang*/ bden med du 'dzin pa dang*/ spros bral du 'dzin pa thams cad dag nas bde gshegs snying po nyid kyang dmigs par mi 'gyur bas don de rtogs par dka' 'am zhe na/ de ni min te/ bde gshegs snying po ni gang gis kyang gzhom par mi nus pa'i rang bzhin la g.yo ba med par nges pa ste/ bde gshegs snying po ni nye bar nyon mongs pa'i khams la yongs su rtog par mi byed pa'i phyir/ lan gcig sgrib pa dang bral ba'i rjes la rang bzhin gyis 'brel ba lta ga la zhig bltos pa'i 'brel pa'ang med pas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur ro//(bzhi pa sangs rgyas nas sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs dang bde gshegs snying po'i nus pa gnyis las 'bras bu thob pa'i tshul ni/) des na de bzhin gshegs snying don dam pa'i bden pa de la 'phags pa'i shes rab kyi stobs bskyed nas 'du shes kyi mdud pa bsal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes so sor mngon par shes shing de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du gyur pa'i tshe na/ des lam bstan nas so so skye bo 'du shes kyi 'ching ba mtha' dag las bzlog par byed do/

/sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs ni glo bur gyi dri ma las 'das kyang*/ glo bur gyi dri ma rgyud ldan gyi sems can la sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi cho 'phrul zab mo ston la/ gdul bya de dang de yis kyang de'i sku gsung thugs kyi cho 'phrul mthong ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa don dam bden pa dbang btsan pa la dbang 'byor bas kun rdzob glo bur ba byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ sprul zhing bsgyur ba'i thugs rje dang*/ gdul bya de bzhin gshegs snying rgyud ldan de'i de bzhin gshegs snying gnyis ka'i mthu stobs las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi cho 'phrul rdo rje'i gnas mi shigs pa rnams so so skye bos kyang rtogs par nus so/ /des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang rang gi ngo bo rang gi mtshan nyid kyi dri mas dag pa ni glo bur dri bral gyi de bzhin gshegs snying dang*/ chos dbyings dang zab rgyas mnyam pa'i spyi'i ngo bo mtshan nyid ni rang bzhin gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes brjod do//(rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i ngo bo bstan pa la/ gtsang rtag bde ba sogs kyi ngo bor bstan pa dang*/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi ngo bo bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ ngo bo mdor bstan pa dang*/ gang du'ang khas mi len na mi 'thad pa'i tshul/ gtsang rtag bde ba bdag dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa/ de nyid nges don mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin pa'i tshul bcas bzhi las/ dang po ni/) mdor na so so skye bo ni kun rdzob pa'i nyer len gyi lus sems la rtag bde bdag gtsang du zhen pa'i sgrog gis bcings shing*/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa rnams ni don dam pa'i gnas la mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med pa dang mngon par zhen pa'i sred pa la mi gtsang bar 'dzin pa'i sgrog gis bcings la/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni chos thams cad kyi gnas tshul dang snang tshul ma lus pa mkhyen pas gnas lugs don dam pa'i bden pa gtsang rtag bde ba bdag dam pa'i pha rol du phyin pa mngon du rtogs la/

snang tshul kun rdzob pa'i sems can gyi khams glo bur ba ni mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ bdag med pa dang*/ mi gtsang bar mngon du rtogs te/ tshul 'di gnyis kyis ni rtag dang chad pa'i mtha' sel lo/ /de yang kun rdzob pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa ni ye gdod ma nas med la/ don dam bden pa ni kun rdzob kyi mtha' dang rgyar ma lhung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni yod pas so//(gnyis pa gang du'ang khas mi len na mi 'thad pa'i tshul ni/) don 'di dag khong du ma chud par dbu ma par rloms pa gzhan dag don dam bde gshegs snying po la mnyam par bzhag pa las langs te/ rjes shes sgyu ma lta bu'i sgo nas bsod nams kyi tshogs sgrub pa'i skabs su kun rdzob tsam du'ang yod med gang du khas ma len pa ni ngan g.yo'i lta ba ste/ rtog ge dang 'dres pa'i lta ba yin zhes dbu ma pa chen po thogs med zhabs kyis bzhed do//(gsum pa gtsang rtag bde ba bdag dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa ni/) gzhan yang don dam pa bde gshegs snying po gtsang rtag bde ba bdag dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba'i don yang*/ de bzhin gshegs snying gtsang rtag bde ba bdag gi dam pa kho nar zhugs pa'i nyi tshe ba phyogs re ba de bzlog pa'i phyir gtsang rtag bde ba bdag dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa zhes bya ba phyogs re ba thams cad las 'das pa khyab pa'i bdag nyid can zhes bzhed do/ /mdor na gtsang ba'i don dam spyi dang*/ khyad par gyi rang bzhin dang*/ dri ma med pas yongs su dag pa dang*/ bdag dang bdag med pa las rnam par grol bas bdag dam pa'i don dang*/ ji srid so so skye bo nas de srid sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar gyi lus dang sems g.yo bar gyur pa'i cha thams cad dang bral ba bde ba'i don dang*/ 'jig rten mi rtag mngon par bslu ba la mi zhen zhing mya ngan las 'das pa rtag pa la gcig tu mi rtog pa ni rtag pa'i don te/(bzhi pa de nyid nges don mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin pa'i tshul ni/)

'di don khong du ma chud pa'i dbu ma par rloms pa rnams ni/ stong pa nyid gang yin pa ni da lta'i so so skye bo'i blo yul las 'das pa zhes zer mod/ de ni tshig tsam du song ba'i don du yid dpyod kyis drangs pa'i med chos kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag thams cad dang 'gal ba gcig yid yul du byas te/ 'di ni dbu ma'i lta ba mchog yin zhes de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis sras kyi thu bo rnams la nges pa'i don mdo shin tu rgyas pa dgongs pa can dang*/ sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa nges pa'i don du gsungs pa'i gtsang rtag bde ba bdag dam pa'i pha rol du gyur pa'i chos kyi tshul la/ so so skye bo'i slob dpon rgya bod du byung ba rnams kyis don dam pa'i don gang yin pa rnams drang ba'i don du bkral snang mod kyang*/ de ni legs pa min te/ gtsang rtag bde ba bdag dam pa rnams kyi don 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rigs gsum mgon pos rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'i tshe'ang don 'dis gsal bar mdzad cing*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub dang thogs med rnams kyis kyang don 'di lan gcig min par bshad pa'i phyir ro//(gnyis pa 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi ngo bor bstan pa la/ spyir 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi ngo bor bstan pa/ bde gshegs snying po yod pa'i skabs kyi sdug bde'i skyon yon mthong tshul/ de ni dbu ma thams cad kyi lugs yin par bstan pa bcas gsum las/ dang po ni/) des na dbu ma pa chen po thogs med zhabs kyis/ nges pa'i don gyi dbang du 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bya ba ni/ so so skye bo'i 'jug yul la shes bya 'jug byed la shes pa zhes par bstan zhing*/ 'phags pa rnams kyi khyad par gyi 'jug yul ni chos dbyings dang*/ 'jug byed ni chos nyid de/ don 'di ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang gnad gcig la/ so so skye bo'i shes bya dang shes pa la ni chos kyi dbyings kyis khyab byed du 'gyur la/

khyab tu zin kyang de dang 'brel ba gtan med do/ /'o na so so skye bo'i rgyud la/ rgyal tshab byams pas/ chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed ces pa'i don ji lta bu zhe na/ chos spyi tsam ni shes pa dang shes bya'i dri ma glo bur ba la bshad nas chos nyid ni bde gshegs snying po la bshad do/ /'on kyang chos kyi dbyings 'di ni chos nyid thams cad la rnam par rtog pa dang 'du bya ba med par mi gnas pa'i tshul gyis 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin du zhugs nas chos dbyings nyid kyis mi stong par bshad pas/ don 'di khong du chud pa na 'khor ba nyid mya ngan las 'das pa'o zhes bzhed do/ /de ltar 'phags pa rnams kyis sems can rnams la/ nye ba dang*/ ring ba gang yang ma yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi khams dang mthun par ldan pa'i bdag sred bcad pas nye bar 'gyur ba'i 'brel thag gtan med la/ ring ba mi 'gyur bas/ snying rje chen pos yongs su mi gtong ba'i phyir nye ring gang la'ang mi gnas pas 'phags pa rnams mya ngan las 'das pa blang bar bya ba dang*/ 'khor ba nyid dor bar bya ba med pa'i 'khor 'das gnyis kar mtshungs par rnam par mi rtog pa'i spyod yul can yin pas/ 'khor 'das dbyer med/ 'khor 'das mnyam nyid yin no zhes bshad zin to//(gnyis pa bde gshegs snying po yod pa'i skabs kyi sdug bde'i skyon yon mthong tshul ni/) de ltar bde gshegs snying po dang glo bur gyi dri ma gnyis tha dad pa yin no//bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bde gshegs snying po ma mchis na/ so so skye bo dag sdug bsngal la skyo bar mi 'gyur ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa la 'dod pa don gnyer med par 'gyur zhes gsungs pas/ bde gshegs snying po nyid glo bur gyi dri ma la skyo bar gyur pa yin nam/ glo bur gyi dri ma nyid glo bur gyi dri ma rang nyid la skyo bar gyur pa yin nam zhe na/ 'dus ma byas de bzhin gshegs snying dang*/

chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang byin rlabs kyis thog med kyi tshe na rgyu rkyen med kyang*/ med bzhin pa'i 'dus byas glo bur gyi dri ma nyid kyis sdug bsngal la skyo ba dang*/ myang 'das la phyogs pa dang smon par byed do/ /phyis nas de bzhin gshegs snying las ye shes kyi 'od 'byung ste glo bur gyi dri ma 'joms par byed do/ /des na rgyu rkyen med pa 'dus byas glo bur ba de ni phan tshun mi rtag par 'gyur ba don gyis so//(gsum pa de ni dbu ma thams cad kyi lugs yin par bstan pa ni/) 'di la dbu ma par rlom pa gzhan dag rgyu rkyen med pa'i 'dus byas kun rdzob tu'ang mi 'thad ces zer/ de ltar na dbu ma pa khyed cag myu gu skyes pa mngon par gsal ba la 'dus byas su khas blangs bzhin par/ dpyad pa bzhugs pa'i tshe rgyu dang rkyen gang yang med par ltos pa tsam la grub par 'dod na/ 'dir ni kun rdzob pa'i chos thams cad la rgyu dang rkyen med kyang rmi lam ltar snang bas so/ /de la khyed cag rmi lam gyi snang ba ni rgyu dang rkyen yod pa yin te/ bag chags nyid kyi rang snang log pa'-i sbyor ba rkyen du 'gyur snyam na/ bag chags nyid dang des bzhag pa'i rten kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa thams cad kyang rgyu dang rkyen med par rang bzhin gyis ma dag par snang ba rnams la 'khrul pa'i 'khor lo sna tshogs snang ba yin te/ thag pa la sbrul gyi rgyu rkyen ma tshang ba bzhin no/ zhes 'phags pa thogs med kyis bzhed do//(rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa dri ma sbyang ba'i lam la brtson tshul la/ gnas skabs dri ma dang bral ba'i phyir lam la brten dgos pa/ mthar thug gzhi dang 'bras bu gnyis ngo bo dbyer med du gnas tshul/ gzhi'i skabs tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid byed la brten nas 'khrul ba 'byung ba'i tshul dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i skabs bde gshegs snying po'i ngo bor sangs rgyas te sku gsum bshad pa ste bzhi las/

dang po ni/) glo bur gyi dri ma la rgyu rkyen med kyang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dri ma dang bral ba'i thabs la ni/ ji srid sems can gyi dus su dri ma de sbyang ba'i rgyu rkyen yod dgos pa la/ rgyu rkyen ma tshang bar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su mi 'gyur te/ de'i tshul la rten 'brel legs tshogs sgrig dgos so/ /de la gzhan dag so so skye bo'i snang btags thams cad rgyu med rkyen med yin na de'i steng du gnas skabs kyi rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'brel bsgrigs kyang dgos pa med do snyam na/ de ni min te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rgyu thams cad dang*/ dkar po'i chos 'phel ba'i rkyen thams cad kyi bdag nyid dang rgyu mthun nas rgyu rkyen rten 'brel sgrig pa gnas skabs gzhan du mi 'gyur bas so// [gzhan yang gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/ 'phags pa thogs med la sdang ba 'ga' zhig slob dpon chen po 'dis ni rigs chad kyi rigs yod pa zhal gyis bzhes pa yin zhes pa dang*/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu mi bzhed pa yin no zhes skal pa ngan pa rnams sgrog par byed do//] gzhan yang ma 'ongs pa na de bzhin gshegs pa mngon 'gyur gyi skabs su chos sku dang*/ ye shes dang*/ thugs rje chen po rnams te/ de dag kyang re re nas gsal bar byed pa gang yin pa'i yang dag pa'i lam gyi rgyud la rtsol ba 'don dgos te/ chos sku dang*/ ye shes thugs rje re re la'ang*/ sgrib byed re res kyang 'ching bas gegs de dag bsal bar bya dgos pa nyid do/ /lam gyi rgyu gsal byed de yang de bzhin gshegs snying dang chos sku mthun pa ste mthar thug dbye ba med par 'gyur ba yin no/ /des na de bzhin gshegs pas mi slob pa mngon du byas pa de'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang dbye ba med do/ /gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi sku'i ngo bo ni chos nyid kyi sku ste/

de la chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa'i don ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos/ rgyal ba'i yum rnams sems can thams cad kyi blta bar dbang bar ston nus pa dang*/ shes bya thams cad la gnyis su med par sbyar nas/ chos thams cad kyi dbang phyug tu 'gyur ba ni chos sku'i don yin no//(gnyis pa mthar thug gzhi dang 'bras bu gnyis ngo bo dbyer med du gnas tshul ni/) de yang spangs pas khyad par du byas pa'i rten la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ sgrib bcas kyi rten la sems can zhes brjod la/ de gnyis ka'i rgyud la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa ni bzang ngan dang*/ 'phel 'grib gang yang med do/ /gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ shā ri'i bu de'i phyir na/ sems can gyi khams las chos kyi sku yang gzhan pa ni ma yin te/ sems can gyi khams nyid chos kyi sku/ chos kyi sku nyid sems can gyi khams te/ 'di ni don gyis gnyis su med de/ yi ge tsam du tha dad pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ 'dir la la zhig sems can gyi glo bur gyi dri ma'i khams dang*/ de bzhin gshegs snying gi chos sku gnyis gc-ig tu 'chad par byed snang yang*/ de ni min te/ sems can gyi khams zhes pa'i khams de ni/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi khams de dang rigs dang gzhi dus kyi bde gshegs snying po rnams don gcig par bshad nas/ de dang 'bras dus kyi chos sku gnyis gcig par bshad pa yin te/ don 'di ni yon tan gyi bdag nyid/ bde bar gshegs pa ni/ ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes rje btsun byams pas gsungs so/ /de la 'phags pa thogs med zhabs kyis kyang lugs 'dir/ sems can gyi dag pa gang yin pa dang tshul bzhin sems gnyis dbye ba med par bshad pa dang*/ chos nyid la mngon par phyogs shing tha mi dad pa'i sems dang*/ rang bzhin gyi chos nyid bde gshegs snying po chos gang la'ang gnas pa med pa dang tha mi dad du gsungs shing*/

(gsum pa gzhi'i skabs tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid byed la brten nas 'khrul ba 'byung ba'i tshul ni/) sems kyi dag byed la ma ltos pa'i dbang gis/ ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched/ las nyon rnams rim gyis grub la/ thog ma nyid nas gang zag re re ba'i rgyud la'ang spang gnyen 'gal zlar thog ma nas gnas par bzhed do/ /rang bzhin bde gshegs snying po la rgyu med rkyen med du bshad pa ni nam mkha'i dpes bstan te/ de'i don kyang tshogs pa dang 'dus pa dang phung por grub pa med cing des na skye 'gag 'dzin pa gang yang med pa'i phyir bshad la/ rang gi ngo bo ni rgyu yod de/ nam mkha' go 'byed kyi rten du yod pa bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yang chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs nyid du yod pas na rgyu dang tha mi dad du grub par bzhed do/ /gzhan yang so so skye bo rnams ni bde gshegs snying po sngar ma mthong ba mthong bar byed pa'i thabs la 'bad pa dang */ sngar mthong ba'i cha la mnyam par bzhag par gnyis ka 'phyugs par ma 'gyur la/ ji srid sa lnga pa thob pa na de gnyis ka blo stobs kyis chun par 'gyur bas/ don des na de skabs yan chad kyi byang chub sems dpa' kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba gnyis ka la/ ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi rtsal sgo du ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig char du ldang ba dang*/ 'jug pa la mi 'gal ba la dbang 'byor ro zhes bya ba 'di ni zhar las 'ong ba'o//(bzhi pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i skabs bde gshegs snying po'i ngo bor sangs rgyas te sku gsum bshad pa ni/) gzhan yang sems can thams cad kyi gshis la bzhugs pa ni ye nas mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ de ni phyi nas mya ngan las 'da' dgos pa min no/ /'o na sems can rnams mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba ni/ sems can gyi blo dang sems gang yin pa ni ye gdod ma'i mya ngan las 'das pa der rang bzhin gyis mi gnas par 'das pa la bzhed do/

/de yang so so skye bo'i lus dang sems yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa ni sprul pa'i sku ste/ de'i ma dag pa gnas gyur pas so so skye bo mchog dman kun la 'char ba'i sku dang*/ don dam bden pa ngo bo nyid sku dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa nang phan tshun du ro gcig tu 'dres pa rgyal ba gcig gi sku yin na thams cad kyi sku yin pa'i phyir longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ de 'khor 'das thams cad kyi gnas lugs de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yin pa'i phyir chos kyi skur bzhed do/ /thar pa gang yin pa ni rang rgyud kyi bde gshegs snying po la rang rig ye shes kyi dbang bsgyur ba ni thar pa yin la/ bdag 'dzin bdag med du 'gro ba ni thar pa min te/ med pa tsam gyis thar par 'gyur ba ni ri bong rwa la sogs pa de dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro//(rtsa ba'i sa bcad bzhi pa snying po la dri mas sgrib tshul dpe yis bstan pa la/ rgyud bla ma nas gsungs pa ltar dpe dgu dang sbyar te bshad pa dang*/ slob dpon klus chos dbyings bstod pa dang dus 'khor dang sbyar te bshad pa/ stong nyid bden med kho nas gnas lugs mi rtogs shing ma rig pa spangs mi nus par bstan pa bcas gsum las/ dang po ni/) de ltar theg pa chen po'i nges don 'khor lo tha ma nas gsungs pa rje btsun ma pham pas dpe dgu don dgu bsdus pa'i don la/ so so skye bo 'dod chen pa sngon de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang 'phrad par ma byung zhing*/ de'i rgyud kyi thob skal gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po de nyon mongs sgrib pa thams cad kyis de'i cha shas tsam yang mngon par ma byas par nyon mongs pa'i sbubs la gnas pa yin gyi/ dge ba'i rtsa ba cung zad bsags nas byang chub tu smon pa bskyed pas na phyogs re tsam gyi cha la'ang sgrib byed med pas/ don 'di so so skye bo'i shes rgyud phyogs re la de bzhin gshegs snying mngon par gsungs la/

(gnyis pa slob dpon klus chos dbyings bstod pa dang dus 'khor dang sbyar te bshad pa ni/) don 'di la slob dpon 'phags pas chos dbyings bstod par/ mar me bum nang gi dpes rgyas par gsungs pa dang*/ zla ba tshes pa'i dpes gsungs pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo las lus ngag yid gsum/ rtsa thig rlung gsum la ye shes kyi cha shas so so skye bo'i rgyud phyogs re rags pa la 'char bar 'chad pas/ zab mo'i don 'di ni 'phags pa thogs med nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa med par gzhan du min no/ /des na nyon mongs pa'i sbubs de grol bar byed pa ni bde gshegs snying po la don du gnyer nas mos par byed pa'i blo la rag lus shing*/ blo de ni rang byung du skye la/ de skye ba ni skal ba mchog gi yul te/ tshul 'di ni bdag gi rtogs pa brjod pa las/ bskal par 'bad lor byas na yang*//gnad kyi rang gsal ma rtogs na//mya ngan 'da' ba'i dus mi srid//ces bya ba 'dis nges so// (gsum pa stong nyid bden med kho nas gnas lugs mi rtogs shing ma rig pa spangs mi nus par bstan pa ni/) des na don dam par rnam par mi rtog pa tsam la nges pa 'drongs pa 'ga' zhig /stong pa nyid ni bden pa med par bshad la/ de ni yang dag pa min te/ de ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi dbyings mngon par rtogs par mi nus te/ ci'i phyi'i zhe na/ kun rdzob pa'i rnam pa la mi rtog pa tsam dang rdzas gzhan gyi bden pas stong pa nyid tsam ni nyan rang gis kyang mthong la/ nyan rang ni rnam pa thams cad du bde gshegs snying po'i cha tsam yang rtogs par dka' 'o/ /gzhan dag don 'di'i skyon spong du/ nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod par 'dod pa dang*/ nyan rang dang theg pa chen po spros bral dbu ma'i lta ba la khyad par med kyang*/ spros bral du 'bebs byed kyi rigs pa'i rgyas bsdus la brten nas/ spros bral ngo bo la rgya che chung ma gtogs zab mi zab la khyad par med ces phyogs re la rtsis su byas nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yongs rdzogs la smod pa rgya bod du mang du byung ngo*/

/byung ba rnams kyi don rtogs par dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni chos sku'i snying po nyid yin pas/ des na 'jig rten gyi snying po ni 'jig rten las 'das pa yin cing*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i snying po ni chos kyi snying po yin la/ de'i snying po ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yin no/ /de ltar gzhan gyis rtogs par dka' zhes 'phags pa thogs med skyob bzhed do/ /des na sa bcu pa'i sems dpas cung zad mthong ste/ mthong ba'i tshul gang zhe na/ 'khor 'das thams cad dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes dang tha mi dad du mthong ba'i tshul gyis so/ /'khor 'das tha mi dad du mthong ba 'di la lugs 'dir ni de bzhin gshegs snying tha mi dad du 'dod kyi gzhan dag ni stong nyid cha tsam nas tha mi dad du mthong ba la bzhag kyang*/ stong nyid tha mi dad tsam du mthong bas ni ma rig pa'i bag chags drungs 'byin par mi nus par bzhed do/ /ci ste/ nyan rang rnams kyang rang gi bdag med pa stong pa yin pa bzhin du 'gro ba gzhan dag gi bdag kyang stong pa nyid du mthong ba yod pa'i phyir ro//(rtsa ba'i sa bcad lnga pa bde gshegs snying po bstan pa'i dgos pa bshad pa la/ dgos pa dngos su bstan pa dang*/ gzhan gyis drang don du gsung pa'i lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/) don 'dis na sa thob pa'i sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi yul min na/ so so skye bo rnams kyi spyod yul gtan ma yin no zhe na/ de ni skyon med de/ rigs sad pa'i phyir dang*/ so so skye bo'i nyes pa lnga spangs pa'i phyir gsungs pa yin cing*/ gtso bor kun rdzob pa'i chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam sprin bzhin du stong par bshad pa'i rjes la lhag ma bla na med pa'i chos kyi snying pos mi stong pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yod do zhes gsungs so//(gnyis pa gzhan gyis drang don du gsungs pa'i lan la/

drang don yin na skyon lnga spangs mi dgos pa'i tshul gyis lan bstan pa dang*/ drang don yin na thogs med tshad ma'i skyes bu mi 'gyur bar thal ba'i lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/) 'di la gangs can gyi mkhas pa 'ga'/ rgyud bla mar de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po sems can la yod ces gsungs pa de drang ba'i don yin la/ ci'i phyir dgos pa skyon lnga spangs phyir gsungs par 'dod la/ de ltar na skyon lnga spang mi dgos par 'gyur zhing*/ sems can dman pa la brnyas pa na yang skyon med de/ sems can la de bzhin gshegs snying med pa dang*/ yang dag par bde gshegs snying po chos kyi 'dzin pa la dgos pa med de/ de drang ba'i don yin pa dang*/ chos sku bde gshegs snying po la skur pa btab pa 'ang skyon med de/ ye nas med pa la skur 'debs kyi mthar mi lhung bas gnas tshul brjod pa'i phyir dang*/ sems zhum pa'ang 'os par 'gyur te/ bde gshegs snying po rang rgyud la med pas sems mi zhum pa'i 'dzin stangs 'char ba don la mi gnas pa'i 'dzin pa yin pas so//(gnyis pa drang don yin na thogs med tshad ma'i skyes bu mi 'gyur bar thal ba'i lan ni/) gzhan yang de ltar byas na 'phags pa thogs med la sogs pa'ang tshad ldan gyi skyes bur mi 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das dang byams pa sogs kyis gsungs dgos pa dang dngos la gnod byed kyi dam pa'i chos rnams lugs 'dir dgongs pa can min par bkral bas so/ /des na 'phags pa thogs med skyob la 'goms par nus pa'i rjes su 'brang bar mi nus pas/ kho bo cag rnams ni 'phags pa nyid kyi rjes su 'brang bar bya'o//(gsum pa tha mar dge ba mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba la/ bka' bar pa nas stong nyid bstan tshul/ tha ma nas bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po bstan tshul/ smon tshig dang bcas mdzad byang smon pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/) mjug bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/

kun rdzob gdod nas bden par ma grub cing*//gnas skabs snang ba tsam yang snang tsam nas//brtag na skye ba mi 'grub skye med pa//des ni stong nyid dam pa yin par bstan//(gnyis pa tha ma nas bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po bstan tshul ni/) don dam gdod nas bden pas mi stong ba//skye 'gag bral ba dus gsum thams cad du//mi gnas don de gnas pa'i bde bar gshegs//sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po dam par bstan// (gsum pa smon tshig dang bcas mdzad byang smon pa ni/) don der mos pa'i don ldan 'ga' zhig gis//bkod na don ldan 'gyur zhes bskul ba'i ngor//legs par bsam nas bkod pa'i dge ba yis//'gro ba de bzhin gshegs snying shun bral shog/ces pa 'di mos ldan sangs rgyas dpal grub kyis yang nas yang du bskul ba'i ngor/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa rnams kyi zhal rgyun bar ma chad du byon pa la brten pa'i skal ba thob pa/ dpal mi bskyod dga' ba'i dbyangs kyis phrag yul zu ru gdong zhes pa'i tshal du bgyis pa'o// // (de ltar rgyal dbang mi bskyod rdo rje'i gsung 'di nyid shin tu tshig brling zhing go dka' ba dang*/ bar bar du ma phyi yang cung ma dag pa sogs shan phye dka' ba lta bur 'dug mod/ bka' drin gsum ldan 7rgyal ba'i dbang po [dpal karma pa rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje/] mchog gis nā' lan+dā'i bshad grwar chos bshad dgos pa dang*/ de yang rang lugs thun min gyi dgongs pa gtso bor bton dgos pa'i bka' gsal spyi bor yang nas yang du phebs pa'i thugs kyi bzhed pa yongs su bsgrub pa'i ched du dmigs nas/ gdung rten rin po che'i drung du gsol ba 'debs bzhin (sa bcad/) dpyad gzhi zin bris su byas pa lags pas thams cad kyis brtag dpyad zab nan bka' drin gnang rogs zhu rgyu dang*/ rang nas kyang go ba gsar du skyes pa lta bu byung tshe 'bri bsnan yang du zhu rtsis lags zhes/
gzhan stong smra ba'i gral mthar skyes pa
