[shākya'i dge slong karma blo gros ring lugs smra ba'i seṅge'am/] khra 'gu pas bris pa dge legs 'phel//༄༅/ /dbu ma gzhan stong smra ba'i srol legs par phye ba'i sgron me'i sa bcad bzhugs so// rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dbu ma gzhan stong smra ba'i srol legs par phye ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'chad pa la gsum ste/ thog mar dge ba bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa/ bar du dge ba gzhung dngos/ tha mar dge ba mjug yongs su rjogs pa'o/ /dang po la/ bar chad bsal ba'i phyir du yul dam pa la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir du gang las byung ba'i lo rgyus bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i phyir du rtsom par dam bca' ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ (rang spyi gang dang ma 'dres sogs/) gnyis pa ni/ (thub dbang bsil zer byed pa sogs/) gsum pa ni/ (de skad du sogs/) gnyis pa gzhung don dngos la/ bde gshegs snying po sgrub byed kyi rigs pa bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i ngo bo bstan pa de dri ma sbyang ba'i lam la brtson tshul/ snying po la dri mas sgrib tshul dpe yis bstan pa/ dgos pa bshad pa bcas las/ dang po la rdzogs sangs sku 'phro ba'i rigs pas bsgrub pa dang*/ de bzhin nyid la dbye ba med pa'i rigs pas bsgrub pa dang*/ rigs yod pa'i rigs pas bsgrub pa ste gsum las/ dang po la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku 'phro ba'am/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i tshul dang*/ rtogs pa'i ye shes ngos bzung*/ de 'byung ba'i ye shes ye gdod ma nas yod pa'i tshul bstan pa bcas gsum las/ dang po ni/ (de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sogs/) gnyis pa ni/ (de ltar na rtogs pa'i ye shes sogs/) gsum pa ni/ (rtogs rig 'di ye gdod ma nas sogs/) gnyis pa de bzhin nyid la dbye ba med pa'i rigs pas bsgrub pa la/ gnas skabs gsum la 'gyur ba med pa'i tshul gyis dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo yin pa mdor bstan/

de'i don rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ (gzhan yang lugs 'di la sogs/) gnyis pa la/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog gi skabs bcas la dbye ba med tshul bstan pa gsum las/ dang po la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid la dbye ba med pa'i tshul dang*/ de nyid kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po la rag las pa/ dbu ma'i lugs gzhan gyis de ltar ma rtogs pa'i tshul/ bde gshegs snying po mngon du gyur pa'i skabs yon tan gsum mngon du gyur tshul/ khyad par gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs pa ma yin pa'i tshul rgyas par bshad pa/ dang po ni/ (des ni chos kyi sku de ni sogs/) gnyis pa ni/ (des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sogs/) gsum pa ni/ ('di na theg pa sogs/) bzhi pa ni/ (des na de bzhin sogs/) lnga pa ni/ (des na de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/)gnyis pa chos dkon mchog gi gnas skabs su ngo bo nyid la dbye ba med pa'i tshul la/ bsam med gnyis med kyi yon tan chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med tshul/ stong nyid kho nar sbyar na mi rung ba'i tshul/ chags thogs las grol ba'i tshul/ ma mthong ba tsam yang dag pa ma yin pa'i tshul/ de lta bu'i chos dkon mchog gi ngo bo yang ye gdod ma nas grub pa'i bde gshegs snying po yin par bstan pa bcas lnga las/ dang po ni/ (de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po sogs/) gnyis pa ni/ (zla grags dang seng bzang sogs/) gsum pa ni/ (shes rab chags thogs med pa sogs/) bzhi pa ni/ (zla grags la sogs pas ni sogs/) lnga pa ni/ (lugs 'dir ni sogs/) gsum pa dge 'dun dkon mchog gi gnas skabs su yang ngo bo nyid la dbye ba med tshul la/ rig grol gyi yon tan bde gshegs snying po dang dbyer med par bstan/ don dam med rkyang du 'dzin pa'i lugs dgag des na dge 'dun gyi yon tan ye gdod ma nas yod par bstan/ lugs 'di'i ji lta ji snyed kyi ye shes ngos bzung ba ste bzhi las/

dang po ni/ (des na so so'i skye bo'i sems sogs/) gnyis pa ni/ (dri ma glo bur ba sogs/) gsum pa ni/ (des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po sogs/) bzhi pa ni/ (des na lugs 'dir ni sogs/) gsum pa rigs yod pa la brten nas bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po sgrub pa la/ lam gyi rten dang ngo bo dang 'bras bur gyur pa'i rigs bstan pa dang*/ de nyid dri bcas dang dri med skabs kyi khyad par/ sangs rgyas pa'i skabs dri ma slar mi ldog pa'i tshul/ sangs rgyas nas sangs rgyas kyis byin rlabs dang bde gshegs snying po'i nus pa gnyis las 'bras bu thob pa'i tshul bcas bzhi las/ dang po ni/ (des na lugs 'di la ni sogs/) gnyis pa ni/ (des na 'phags pa thogs med sogs/) gsum pa ni/ (gnas skabs gsum kar sogs/) bzhi pa ni/ des na de bzhin gshegs snying don dam pa'i sogs/ rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i ngo bo bstan pa la/ gtsang rtag bde ba sogs kyi ngo bor bstan pa dang*/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi ngo bor bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ ngo bo mdor bstan pa dang gang du'ang khas mi len na mi 'thad pa'i tshul/ gtsang rtag bde ba bdag dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa/ de nyid nges don mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin pa'i tshul bcas bzhi las/ dang po ni/ (mdor na so so skye bo ni sogs/) gnyis pa ni/ (don 'di dag khong du ma chud pa sogs/) gsum pa ni/ (gzhan yang don dam pa sogs/) bzhi pa ni/ ('di don khong du ma chud pa'i sogs/) gnyis pa 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi ngo bor bstan pa la/ spyir 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi ngo bor bstan pa/ bde gshegs snying po yod pa'i skabs kyi sdug bde'i skyon yon mthong tshul/ de ni dbu ma thams cad kyi lugs yin par bstan pa bcas gsum las/ dang po ni/ (des na dbu ma pa chen po thogs med sogs/) gnyis pa ni/ (de ltar bde gshegs snying po dang glo bur gyi dri ma gnyis sogs/)

gsum pa ni/ ('di la dbu ma par rloms pa gzhan dag sogs/) rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa dri ma sbyang ba'i lam la brtson tshul la/ gnas skabs dri ma dang bral ba'i phyir lam la brten dgos pa/ mthar thug gzhi dang 'bras bu gnyis ngo bo dbyer med du gnas tshul/ gzhi'i skabs tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid byed la brten nas 'khrul pa 'byung ba'i tshul dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i skabs bde gshegs snying po'i ngo bor sangs rgyas te sku gsum bshad pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ (glo bur gyi dri ma la rgyu rkyen med kyang sogs/) gnyis pa ni/ (de yang spangs pa'i khyad par du sogs/) gsum pa ni/ (sems kyi dag byed la sogs/) bzhi pa ni/ (gzhan yang sems can gyi gshis la sogs/) rtsa ba'i sa bcad bzhi pa snying po la dri mas sgrib tshul dpe yis bstan pa la/ rgyud bla ma nas gsungs pa ltar dpe dgu dang sbyar te bshad pa dang*/ slob dpon klus chos dbyings bstod pa dang dus 'khor dang sbyar te bshad pa/ stong nyid bden med kho nas gnas lugs mi rtogs shing ma rig pa spangs mi nus par bstan pa bcas gsum las/ dang po ni/ (de ltar theg pa chen po sogs/) gnyis pa ni/ (don 'di la slob dpon 'phags pas sogs/) gsum pa ni/ (des na don dam par rnam par mi rtog pa tsam la sogs/) rtsa ba'i sa bcad lnga pa bde gshegs snying po bstan pa'i dgos pa bshad pa la/ dgos pa dngos su bstan pa dang*/ gzhan gyis drang don du gsung pa'i lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ (don 'dis na sa thob pa'i sems dpa' chen po sogs/) gnyis pa la/ drang don yin na skyon lnga spongs mi dgos pa'i tshul gyis lan bstan pa dang*/ drang don yin na thogs med tshad ma'i skyes bu mi 'gyur bar thal ba'i lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ('di la gangs can gyi mkhas pa sogs/) gnyis pa ni/ (gzhan yang de ltar byas na sogs/) gsum pa tha mar dge ba mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba la/

bka' bar pa nas stong nyid bstan tshul/ tha ma nas bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po bstan tshul/ smon tshig dang bcas mdzad byang smon pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ (mjug bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa sogs/) gnyis pa ni/ (don dam gdod nas bden pas sogs/) gsum pa ni/ (don der mos pa'i sogs kyis grub bo/) de ltar rgyal dbang mi bskyod rdo rje'i gsung 'di nyid shin tu tshigs brling zhing go dka' ba dang*/ bar bar du ma phyi yang cung ma dag pa sogs shan phye dka' ba lta bur 'dug mod/ bka' drin gsum ldan 7rgyal ba'i dbang po/ (dpal karma pa rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje/) mchog gis nā' lan+dā'i bshad grwar chos bshad dgos pa dang*/ de yang rang lugs thun min gyi dgongs pa gtso bor bton dgos pa'i bka' gsal spyi bor yang nas yang du phebs pa'i thugs kyi bzhed pa yongs su bsgrub pa'i ched du dmigs nas/ gdung rten rin po che'i drung du gsol ba 'debs bzhin sa bcad dpyad gzhi zin bris su byas pa lags pas thams cad kyis brtag dpyad zab nan bka' drin gnang rogs zhu rgyu dang*/ rang nas kyang go ba gsar du skyes pa lta bu byung tshe 'bri bsnan yang du zhu rtsis lags zhes/ gzhan stong smra ba'i gral mthar skyes pa (shākya'i dge slong karma blo gros ring lugs smra ba'i seṅge'am ) khra 'gu pas bris pa dge legs 'phel//༄༅/ /dkyil 'khor gyi thig rtsa dang 'bri bya tshon gyi dbye ba sogs mdor bsdus su bkod pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ gdod nas spros pa kun bral yang*/ /mos blor sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul gar/ /ston mdzad rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /dpal ldan bla mar phyag byas nas/ /'di na rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /thig dang 'bri bya tshon la sogs/ /kun gyi rtogs par sla ba'i phyir/ /go bde'i tshig gis 'dir bshad bya/ /sa yi khyon nam stegs bu sogs/ /gzhi dang thig skud la sogs ni/

/tshad dang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ /tshad ldan gzhung nas gsungs pa ltar/ /blang dang dor bya'i gnas mtha' dag /zhib mo'i blo yi legs rtogs nas/ /dngos gzhi thig nyid gdab tshul ni/ /tshangs thig dang po legs btab ste/ /dbus nas zlum por bskor ba yi/ /shar nub tshangs zlum phrad mtshams kyi/ /tshad des bya rjes btsal ba'i steng*/ /lho byang tshangs thig gdab par bya/ /thig dang zlum bskor 'phrad mtshams nas/ /mtshams su bya rjes btsal ba'i steng*/ /tshangs zur thig rnams legs par gdab/ /dbus nas zur thig bzhi yi rtser/ /mtshan ma byas la gru bzhir gdab/ /gru bzhi'i thig dang tshangs thig rnams/ /'phrad mtshams grwa bzhir bcad nas ni/ /rim bzhin bcu drug cha dbye bya// ༈ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs dam lnga tshan lnga'i nang tshan bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi thig ni/ bcu drug thig ni gdab byas sam/ /yang na man ngag thig ces su/ /grags pa'i gdab tshul 'di lta ste/ /thig chen brgyad dang gru bzhir gdab/ /shar dang nub byang tshangs zur gnyis/ /sprad la thig gdab byang shar gyi/ /thig dang 'phrad mtshams nang logs su/ /cha gnyis phyi ma cha bzhir 'gyur/ /de gnyis go ldog mtshan ma bya/ /phyi ma gnyis bgos sgo tshad re/ /de'ang nang ma dbus dor zhing*/ /mtha' gnyis gdab la phyi ma ni/ /phyed gdab phyi phyed gdab pa'o/ /sgo dang sgo khyud cha chen re/ /sgo 'gram sgo logs gnyis gnyis dang*/ /shar bu'i thad du ya phubs la/ /cha chung brgyad de rtsig rgyun gyi/ /cha phran gcig gis bskor bar bya/ /mun 'khor ka ba ka rgyan yang*/ /zheng du cha phran re re dang*/ /srid du cha phran lnga re bya/ /rta babs phyir du ka ba'i rtser/ /cha chen bzhir gzhal ( la cha chen gsum cha mnyam brgyad du bgo /de yi 'og nas yar bgrangs pa'i/ /gsum pa bdun pa'i phyi mtha' dang*/ /lnga pa'i nang mthar sum cha bcad/ /shar bu rin chen rta rmig gser/ /chu srin gser dang rmig pa dang*/

/ rin chen rm-ig pa gser mda' yab/ /de dag rnams kyi g.yas g.yon na/ /tshangs thig las ni cha chung brgyad/ /snam bu 'og ma'i tshad du bya/ /gnyis dang gsum bzhir cha chung dgu/ /lnga pa drug pa cha chung brgyad/ /bdun pa brgyad pa dgu pa bcu/ /g.yas g.yon cha chung bdun re ste/ /bcu gcig pa la lnga re bya/ /de nas ghur+ṇa ha ri'i tshad/ /snam bu dang por tshangs las ni/ /cha chung phyed dang drug dor bcad/ /gnyis pa gsum pa drug nas bcad/ /bzhi pa'i cha chung bzhi dor zhing*/ /lnga pa cha chung phyed bzhi dang*/ /drug pa cha chung gsum dor zhing*/ /de nas g.yas g.yon thad kar sbrel/ /glang rgyab bya tshul lugs gcig ni/ /rta babs bzhi man sngar ltar la/ /lnga pa'i 'og nas phyed bzhi dang*/ /lnga steng phyed lnga bar du gsegs/ /drug par gsum re dor ba nas/ /bdun pa'i steng logs g.yas g.yon du/ /cha chung re re'i mtshams su bskum/ /steng logs sgo khyim dbyibs su bya/ /de steng cha chung dbus rwa'i dpangs/ /rwa rtsa'ang zheng du cha chen dang*/ /rtse mo cha phran gnyis yin te/ /cha phran phyi ma gsegs te bcad/ /de ni gdugs kyi sa bcad dang*/ /logs nas cha gcig pad+ma bri/ /bar du cha gnyis 'khor lo'o/ /snam bu lnga steng g.yas g.yon du/ /cha phran gnyis dor der bzung bas/ /mda' thig ka rgyan 'phrad mtshams nas/ /bskor ba rdo rwa'i nang logs dang*/ /tshad nges lnga steng g.yas g.yon du/ /cha phran lnga dor mtshams su bzung*/ /bskor bas rdo rwa'i phyi ngos 'byung*/ /rwa rtse'i phyi nas cha phran ni/ /gnyis gnyis bskor ba pad+ma dang*/ /rdo rje'i phreng ba de'i phyi nas/ /cha chen re re me ri dang*/ /dur khrod kyi ni sa gzhi'o/ /dkyil 'khor dbus kyi pad+ma ni/ /cha chen gcig gi lte ba dang*/ /de phyir ge sar cha phran gcig /'dab ma la ni cha chen gnyis/ /de yi mu khyud cha phran gcig /sgo khyams cha phran gnyis lhag 'gyur/ /de ltar thig ni legs btab bo//

༈ tshon ni/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba ljang*/ ge sar ser 'dab brgyad kyi phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan sngo/ mu khyud bzhi sngon por gri gug sngon po'i phreng ba/ nang khyams kyi shar dkar sngo gang rung*/ byang ljang nub dmar lho ser/ rtsig pa nang nas nag ljang dmar ser dkar ba ste lnga sbrags pa/ 'dod snam nas bzung dur khrod kyi bar dkyil 'khor spyir bshad pa ltar la lha mtshan ni/ lte bar nyi gdan la rdo rje sngon po dang yum gyi gri gug phyogs kyi 'dab ma la gri gug mtshams su bum pa'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re/ sgo'i nang khyams kyi g.yas g.yon la bum pa gnyis gnyis 'god pa slob dpon dā na rak+ṣi ta sogs bshad/ 'dod snam la mchod lha sogs snga ma ltar ro// ༈ rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /tshangs zur brgyad po legs btab ste/ /ji ltar mtshams pa'i zlum po bskor/ /dbus nas zlum po'i bar chad de/ /shar gyi tshangs zlum 'phrad sar bzung*/ /lho byang gnyis su mtshan ma bya/ /de steng gdan thabs chos 'byung gdab/ /nub kyi tshangs zlum 'phrad sa nas/ /sngar ltar gzhal te khang thabs gdab/ /dbus nas ngos chen la reg bar/ /cha chen gsum ste cha chung ni/ /bcu gnyis 'byung zhing lte ba nas/ /bzhi bdun mtshams su zlum por bskor/ /slar yang zlum bskor gnyis ka'i nang*/ /cha phran re res bskor ba ni/ /nang nas rim bzhin ze'u 'bru dang*/ /ge sar 'dab ma mu khyud yin/ /khang thabs gdan thabs gnyis ka la/ /nang nas cha phran re re gdab/ /gru gsum rtse nas cha phran ni/ /gnyis dang gcig dang bzhis bskor ba/ /thod phreng rdo rwa me ri'o// ༈ tshon ni/ thog mar khang thabs kyi chos 'byung gi re kha g.yon bskor du 'bri zhing de nas gzhan rnams kyang*/ rim pas 'bri la/ chos 'byung gi re kha dkar nang gzhi dmar po/ pad+ma'i lte ba dmar ge sar dmar ser 'dab ma bzhi'i shar sngo byang ljang nub dmar lho ser ba ste phyogs mdog

/gong ras mdzes tshon/ mu khyud dang khyams ljang khu/ phyi rol gzhi nag por thod phreng dkar po kha g.yon du lta ba/ rdo rwa gzhi phyogs tshon la rdo rje ser po'i phreng ba/ me ri spyi mthun zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pa ser po re/ lha mtshan ni dbus su pad+ma'i lte bar nyi gdan la gri gug so sngon po yu ba rdo rje phyed pa ser po/ /'dab bzhi'i shar du rdo rje sngon po/ byang du ral gri ljang khu/ nub tu pad+ma dmar po/ lhor rin po che ser po ste phyag mtshan lnga 'bri/ phyag mtshan so so'i lte bar me tog dmar po'am 'bru li khri rgya skyegs sogs kyis kha bsgyur bas tshom bu re yang dgod/ chos 'byung gi khug drug tu swa sti kaḥ'am dga' 'khyil dkar po g.yon du 'khor ba re 'bri ste go cha'i dpa' mo drug sku sbas pa'i rnam pa can no// ༈ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /spyi dang mtshungs shing dbus nas ni/ /cha phran bzhi gcig dgu gnyis rnams/ /bskor bas sna tshogs pad+ma ste/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol 'khor lo ni/ /cha chung gcig bzhi gcig dang bzhis/ /bskor ba pad+ma dur khrod dang*/ /rdo rwa me ri'o rta babs ni/ /ka ba'i rtse mor sgo tshad gsum/ /cha mnyam bcu gnyis bgos byas la/ /mas nas pha gu drwa phyed dang*/ /ze'u kha gsum tshan bzhi yin no/ /gong ma gsum nas re re 'phri/ /drwa phyed bzhi nas slar yang 'phri/ /snam bu lnga steng nas bzhis bskor/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis steng gsum bskor ba/ /glang rgyab de nang cha phyed bskor/ /drug dkyil tshangs nas gsum 'dus par/ /bzung ba ka rgyan rtser bskor zhing*/ /bdun dkyil tshangs nas drug 'dus par/ /snga ma'i tshad bskor rdo rwa'o// ༈ tshon ni/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba ljang*/ ge sar ser/ 'dab brgyad kyi phyogs bzhi dmar/ shar lho sngo/ lho nub ser/ nub byang dmar/ byang shar ljang*/ mu khyud sngon po/ sgo'i nang khyams kyi phyogs tshon shar dkar lho sngo nub dmar byang ser/

rtsig pa nang nas dmar sngo ser dkar ljang khu ste lnga sbrags/ 'dod snam nas bzung dur khrod kyi bar spyi 'grel rdo rwa gzhi sngon por rdo rje ser po'i phreng ba/ me ri spyi mthun ltar te lha mtshan ni/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir pad nyi'i steng du yi ge hrīḥre dang mtshams bzhi'i shar lhor ha lho nub tu ri nub byang du ni byang shar du sa rnams dang 'dod snam la 'dod yon lnga'i lha mos mchod pa dang bcas pa'o// ༈ kun rig dkyil 'khor nyis sbrag ni/ /phyogs re'i cha chen brgyad po de/ /dang po gnyis pa brgyad du bgo /dbus nas brgyad gcig gnyis bzhi gcig /bskor ba 'khor lo'o de lte bar/ /gnyis gcig zlum thig la reg bar/ /bsnol mar btab pa gdung re'u mig /gsum par sgo sogs thig dang ni/ /bzhi pa lnga pa phyed bgos pas/ /lha snam rim bzhi 'byung ba yin/ /rta babs phyi rol dang mtshungs so/ /drug pa bdun pa phyi ma yi/ /sgo sogs thig dang rta babs ni/ /brgyad pa'i steng du cha gsum bsnon/ /sgo dang sgo khyud 'gram dang logs/ /bzhi mnyam gnyis mnyam gang rigs bya/ /gnyis mnyam la ni mun pa dang*/ /ka ba ka rgyan cha chung re/ /de nas rta babs bya tshul ni/ /cha chen bzhi po de nyid kyang*/ /steng ma dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /de 'og bzhir bgos de'i 'og ma/ /dbus nas cha chung gcig bcad cing*/ /de 'og bzhi ru bgo bar bya/ /zheng du mas rim tshangs thig nas/ /g.yas g.yon cha chung brgyad brgyad dgu/ /brgyad bdun brgyad drug bdun tshan gsum/ /lnga bcas snam bu bcu gcig dang*/ /dbus rwa'i smad du cha chen gcig /rtse mor cha gnyis bsegs te bcad/ /bzhi steng tshang nas bzhi bskor la/ /gnyis steng bzhi nas gnyis gnyis bskor/ /cha phyed nang bskor glad gur ro/ /drug 'og tshangs nas cha gnyis nas/ /ka rgyan rtser bzung bskor ba dang*/ /drug dkyil phyed lnga nas des bskor/ /rdo rwa'i dbus rwa'i rtse mo nas/

/cha phran gzhi gcig gsum bskor ba/ /'jig rten 'khor yug rdo rwa dang*/ /'od zer phreng ba dang bcas so// ༈ tshon ni/ nang gi gdung gru bzhi dang gdung zlum 'khor lo'i mu khyud rnams sngon po la rdo rje dkar po'i phreng ba ka ba brgyad sngon po la rigs kyi mtshan mas spras te shar nas rdo rje rin chen pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje rnams phyogs mtshan gnyis gnyis bkra ba/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang rtsibs rten sngon po 'khor lo'i 'og bzhi phyogs mdog ri'u mig dgu dang dkyil 'khor gnyis ka'i sgo'i nang khyams phyogs mdog dbus/

( 'khor lo'i steng*/ ) dkar shar sngo lho ser nub dmar byang ljang*/ rtsig pa nang nas dkar sngo dmar ljang ser ba lnga sbrags/ ( 'di kun rig chung ba la yin/ kun rig che bar rtsig pa nang nas dkar ljang dmar ser sngo lnga'o// ) gnyis ka'i 'dod snam nas bzung me ri'i bar spyi 'gro bzhin la phyi'i khor yug gi gzhi dkar ro/ /phyi khyams ri rab kyi mdog shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa'o/ /lha mtshan ni/ dbus su pad zla'i steng du rdo rje dkar po/ ri'u mig brgyad kyi phyogs bzhir shar nas g.yas bskor gyis sbyong rgyal dkar dmar/ rgyal rin sngo/ shāg dbang dmar/ cher rgyas ljang*/ mtshams bzhir me nas g.yas bskor gyis spyan ma dkar/ ma kī sngo/ gos dkar dmar/ sgrol ma ljang*/ rtsibs bcu drug tu shar nas g.yas bskor gyis/ rdor sems dkar/ rgyal po ser/ chags pa dmar/ legs pa ljang*/ rin chen ser/ gzi brjid dmar/ rgyal mtshan sngo/ bzhad pa dkar/ chos dkar dmar/ rnon po sngo sangs/ rgyu ser po/ smra ba dmar/ las sna tshogs mdog srung ba ser/ gnod sbyin nag khu tshur ser/ dkyil 'khor nang ma'i sgo'i nang khyams kyi grwa bzhi'i mer sgeg mo dkar/ de'i rgyab tu me tog ma ser/ de bzhin srin por phreng ba ma ser/ rgyab tu bdug spos ma dkar/ rlung du glu ma dmar skya/ rgyab tu mar me ma dmar skya/ dbang ldan du gar ma sna tshogs mdog rgyab tu byug ma sna tshogs mdog nang ma'i sgo bzhir rim pas lcags kyu dkar/ zhags pa ser/ lcags sgrogs dkar dmar 'bebs pa sna tshogs mdog dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i lha snam bzhi'i dang po'i shar du byams pa ser/ 'jam dpal dmar ser/ ( 'di rnams rje chos grags rgya mtsho dang spyan snga rin po che'i kun rig chen mo'i bzhed pa ste mi bskyod zhabs kyi kun rig chung bar phyogs mdog yin/ mchan/ ) spos glang dkar ljang*/

ye shes tog sngo/ lhor bzang skyong dkar dmar/ mthong ba don yod ser/ blo gros mi zad pa dkar/ spobs pa brtsegs dmar/ nub tu mthu chen thob ser/ ngan song kun 'dren dkar/ mya ngan mun 'joms dkar ser/ drwa ba can gyi 'od dmar po/ byang du zla 'od dkar/ bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar/ nam mkha' mdzod dkar ser/ kun tu ser po ste bcu drug lha snam gnyis pa'i shar du sems dpa' dkar po bzhi lho sngon po nub tu dmar po byang du ljang khu rnam bzhi ste/ lha snam gsum par nyan thos phyogs su bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug dang lha snam bzhi par rang rgyal phyogs su gnyis gnyis dang mtshams su re re ste bcu gnyis rnams sku mdog nges med/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i shar sgor khro bo dkar po lhor sngo nub tu dmar byang du ljang khu rnams gnyis re ste 'di dag tshon spungs sam phyag mtshan gang rung*/ khor yug la dpal mgon don lnga'i mtshan ma rtsa rig gi phreng ba dkar po/ 'dod snam la mchod ('di kun rig che ba'i skabs yin brgyad pa'i chung ba mi bzhed do// mchan/) pa'i lha mo sna tshogs dang bcas pa'o//༈ mi 'khrugs rgyal ba lha dgu yi/ /dkyil 'khor dbus nas rim pa bzhin/ /cha phran bzhi gcig dgu gcig rnams/ /zlum por bskor ba lte ba dang*/ /ge sar 'dab ma mu khyud de/ /khyams la cha gcig rwa rtse'i phyir/ /cha phran gcig dang gsum zlum por/ /bskor ba rdo rwa me ri dang*/ /rta babs snam bu bzhi ma bya// ༈tshon ni/ dbus kyi lte ba ljang*/ 'dab brgyad kyi shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ mtshams bzhi mdzes tshon/ sgo'i nang khyams kyi phyogs mdog phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma'i mdog can/ rtsig pa nang nas sngo dkar ser dmar ljang lnga sbrags/ 'dod snam nas bzung me ri'i bar spyi mthun la sgo bzhir them skas kyis mdzes pa/ phyi khyams ljang khu'o/ /lha mtshan ni/ dbus kyi pad zla la rdo rje sngon po/

'dab brgyad du zla gdan la shar du lha mo dkar mos dpal be'u/ lhor dmar mos pad+ma/ nub tu sngon mos gdugs/ byang du ljang gus dang*/ mer dkar mos 'khor lo/ lho nub tu sngon mos rgyal mtshan/ nub byang du dmar skyas bum pa/ byang shar du ljang khus nya 'dzin pa rnams phyag mtshan nam/ tshon spungs sam/ sa bon 'god na dbus su hūm̐/ ho/ 'dab brgyad la shar nas g.yas skor du/ paṃ dkar/ paṃ dmar/ tshaṃ sngo/ shaṃ ljang*/ tsaṃ dkar/ staṃ sngo/ nyaṃ dmar skya/ laṃ ljang*/ rnams so// ༈ ye shes mgon po ber chen gyi/ /dkyil 'khor bri tshul 'dir bshad bya/ /tshangs thig dang po legs btab nas/ /dbus nas zlum por bskor byas pa'i/ /tshad des tshangs zlum 'phrad mtshams nas/ /g.yas g.yon bya rjes btsal ba'i steng*/ /gru gsum rtsa thig gdab par bya/ /nub kyi tshangs zlum 'phrad mtshams nas/ /snga ma'i tshad des g.yas g.yon du/ /mtshan ma byas steng zur gnyis su/ /sprad la thig gnyis gdab par bya/ /rtsa thig nas ni lte ba'i bar/ /tshad des gru gsum rtse la ni/ /mtshan ma byas la mda' thig gdab/ /rtsa thig mda' thig gnyis kyi bar/ /logs nas gzhal ba'i tshad de yi/ /gru gsum rtse nas mtshan ma bya/ /de steng thig gdab phyed bgos 'byung*/ / nang ma dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /phyi ma phyed bgos phyi phyed gdab/ /sgo dang rta babs byed tshul ni/ /mda' yab phyi rol sgo tshad bzhi/ /dang po gsum pa cha bzhir bgos/ /gnyis dbus cha chung gcig bcad bya/ /bzhi la chos 'khor gdugs kyi sa/ /'dod snam mda' yab phyi thig dang*/ /tshangs thig 'dzoms sa'i g.yas g.yon du/ /sgo tshad gnyis gnyis dor ba la/ /nang ma phyed gdab phyi phyed gdab/ /phyi ma cha bzhir bgo bar bya/ /rta babs snam bu bcu gcig gi /gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa rnams/ /mtha' nas cha phran re re bsnan/ /lnga pa brgyad dgu bcu rnams la/ /mtha' nas cha phran re re dbri/ /bdun pa la ni gnyis 'phri zhing*/ /bcu gcig pa la gsum 'phri'o/

/dang po dang ni drug pa la/ /'phri ba bsnan pa gnyis ka med/ /( phyi nas tshur rtsis pa'i ) bdun pa 'og ma'i nang thig dang*/ /tshangs pa'i thig gnyis 'dus pa'i mdor/ /sgo tshad gcig gi bskor ba dang*/ /de nas thur du cha phran gnyis/ /slar yang 'phrad du cha phran gsum/ /dor zhing sgo tshad phyed kyis bskor/ /glang rgyab lugs dang mthun pa 'byung*/ /rgyud nas sgo gsum gsungs pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spang bar bya/ /zur gsum mda' thig rtse mo nas/ /cha phran bzhi gcig gnyis gsum gnyis/ /bzhi bskor dur khrod ze'u 'bru/ /pad+ma mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dang*/ /rdo rje me ri'i phreng ba'o/ /de nas nang thig 'debs pa'i tshul/ /dbus nas cha chen gcig gis bskor/ /de nas rtsa thig bar du ni/ /cha mnyam bzhir bgos rim bzhin bskor/ /lte ba'i phyi nas cha phran phyed/ /'khor lo gzhan rnams nang logs nas/ /cha phran phyed res mu khyud bskor/ /phyi ma'i phyi nas cha phran ni/ /gcig gis mu khyud bskor bar bya/ /'khor lo bzhi ni rim bzhin du/ /dang po rtsibs brgyad gnyis pa bcu/ /gsum pa bzhi pa rtsibs brgyad dang*// ༈ de nas tshon bkye ba'i rim pa ni/ lte ba mthing nag la gru gsum gdan thabs sngon po bya zhing*/ de'i zur gsum dang phyi rol gyi sgo gsum thad kar 'grigs par bya/ 'khor lo bzhi sngon po/ rtsibs mchan rnams mdzes tshon/ rtsig par thod skam kha nang bstan gyi phreng ba/ 'dod snam dmar po/ pha gu ser po/ drwa phyed nag po la mi mgo skam rlon dang*/ snying dang rgyu ma'i lda ldi/ shar bu sngon po/ mda' yab dkar po/ ka ba ka rgyan mdzes tshon/ glang rgyab kyi nang nag po la mi lpags kyi bla bres/ snying dang rgyu ma'i drwa phyed pad+ma chos 'khor gdugs rnams spyi mthun/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon mda' yab kyi steng du ro skra'i rnga yab/ mi mgo'i tog dang ro ras nag po 'phyangs pa/ mi lpags kyi rgyal mtshan sogs bri/

phyi rol gyi khyams su dur khrod brgyad kyi bkod pa/ ge sar ser po/ pad+ma sna tshogs/ mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhi sngon po la mdung dang*/ ral gri dang*/ shak+ti dang*/ dgra s+t+wa dang*/ mda' dang*/ rtse gcig dang*/ phur bu dang*/ gri gug dang 'khor lo la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs bri/ rdor phreng dang me ri sogs spyi bzhin no//lha mtshan 'god pa ni/ chos 'byung mthing nag gi dbus su thig le nag po dang*/ sngo skya/ g.yas g.yon dang rgyab tu dreg pa skya gsum gyi thig le/ sngo/ dmar/ nag bcas dang*/ 'khor lo dang po rtsibs brgyad la thig le sngon po dang nag po gnyis re 'god/ 'khor lo gnyis pa'i rtsibs bcu la shar du thig le dkar po/ shar lhor nag po/ lhor dmar nag lho nub tu dmar ser/ nub tu dmar nag nub byang du dmar nag byang du ljang nag byang shar du ljang gu/ shar dang byang shar gyi bar du thig le sngon po dang*/ nub dang nub byang gi bar du thig le ser po bcas/ 'khor lo gsum pa'i rtsibs brgyad la shar du thig le ljang nag la 'khor ljang nag brgyad bcas dgos/ shar lho thig le sngo nag dgu/ lhor mthing nag dgu/ lho nub tu dmar po dgu/ nub tu nag po dgu/ nub byang du nag po dgu/ byang du nag po dgu/ byang shar du nag po dgu bcas/ 'khor lo tha ma la shar nas g.yon bskor du rim pa bzhin du thig le dmar po bdun dang*/ dkar/ sngo/ dmar/ ser nag bcas dang*/ byang shar du dmar/ dmar/ nag dmar/ dkar/ sngo/ ljang nag bcas/ byang du thig le nag po bdun dang*/ dkar/ sngo/ dmar/ ljang gu bcas dang*/ nub byang du dmar/ dkar/ ser/ dmar/ dkar/ sngo/ dmar bcas dang*/ nub tu thig le dmar po bdun dang*/ dmar/ smug sngo/ dkar bcas dang*/ lho nub tu thig le ser/ dmar/ dkar/ ljang nag dmar/ ljang nag ser bcas/ lhor thig le ser nag bdun dang*/ dkar/ ser/ dmar/ sngo bcas/ shar lhor thig le dmar nag dmar ser/ dkar/ ljang*/ sngo/ dmar/ dkar/ nag bcas dang*/

de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud du klu brgyad kyi ka gdan/ lha chen brgyad kyi ka ba/ gza' brgyad kyi gdung*/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ zhing chen rkang dang rtsibs ma'i gral grab sogs bri/ de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhir shar du thig le dkar/ lhor ser/ nub tu dmar/ byang du nag po rnams bkod par bya'o//༈ zhi sogs las bzhi'i thab thig ni/ /tshangs zur bzhi po legs btab ste/ /dbus nas sor mo bcu gnyis dang*/ /slar yang bzhi pa rim gnyis bskor/ /rgya khyon mchu dang kha cher yin/ /de dbus sor bzhi pad lte bskor/ /tshangs zur dbus gshags gcus thig gdab/ /pad 'dab brgyad 'byung zhi ba 'grub// ༈ dbus nas tshangs steng sor mo ni/ /nyer bzhi tshan gcig brgyad tshan gnyis/ /mtshan ma byas la de steng nas/ /zur thig steng du mtshan ma bya/ /de steng gru bzhi phyogs pa la/ /gsum gsum btab pas thab rgya dang*/ mu ran kha khyer yang dag 'byung*/ /sor mo brgyad dang bcu drug gi /pad+ma'i lte ba 'dab ma bskor/ /gcus thig btab pas rgyas pa 'byung*// ༈ dbus nas sor mo nyi shu dang*/ /gsum pa gnyis kyi zlum por bskor/ /rgya dang mu ran kha khyer 'byung*/ /ngos gsum zlum po ngos gzhan ni/ /thig gis bcad de zla gam bya/ /dbus su 'dab brgyad de'i sum chas/ /pad lte bskor bas dbang 'grub bo// ༈ dbus nas sor mo nyi shu dang*/ /gsum pa gnyis kyi zlum por bskor/ /dbus nas zlum mtha' so so'i tshad/ /nub kyi tshangs zlum 'dus steng nas/ /g.yas g.yon bya rjes btsal steng du/ /rim pa bzhin du gru gsum btab/ /dbus nas gru gsum nang ma la/ /reg par bskor la de'i sum cha/ /lte ba'i 'dab brgyad drag po 'grub// ༈ de dag gi tshon ni zhi bar lte ba ljang gu'i steng du rdo rje dkar po/ /'dab ma brgyad ni phyogs bzhi dmar/ /shar lho dang nub byang ser/ lho nub ljang*/ byang shar sngo bcas/ de ltar zhi ba las thams cad pa la dang*/

zhi ba kho na'i sa yin na/ pad+ma thams cad dkar po phyed pa sogs las kun la shes dgos so/ /kha khyer la rdo rje dkar po'i phreng ba/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje'i mtshan pa bri/ rgyas pa'i thab ser po/ dbus su rin po che/ kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng ba/ gru bzhir rin po ches mtshan pa'o/ /dbang gi thab dmar po dbus su lcags kyu/ kha khyer la lcags kyu'i phreng ba/ grwa bzhir ut+pal dmar pos mtshan pa'o/ /drag po'i thab nag po lte bar rdo rje nag po dang*/ kha khyer la rdo rje nag po yi phreng ba/ grwa gsum la rdo rje nag po'i spras pa bri'o// ༈ rnying lugs rta babs brgyad ma ni/ /mda' phyir cha chen gsum bcad pa'i/ / nang ma gnyis po bzhi bzhir bgo /rta babs snam bu brgyad yin no/ /phyi ma dbus dang mtha' gnyis gdab/ /pad+ma 'khor lo gdugs kyi sa/ /de dag phyi mtha'i rim pa ni/ / rta rkang ka rgyan mtha' dang mnyam/ /chu skyes dang ni sgrom bu gnyis/ /de las cha phran gcig gis ring*/ /zar tshag de las gcig gis thung*/ /sna 'phyong de las gcig gis ring*/ /chun 'phyang de las gnyis kyis thung*/ /shar bu de las gcig gis ring*/ /de las khyung mgo gcig 'phyar ro/ /pad+ma 'khor lo gdugs gsum po'i/ /rgya tshad cha phran gnyis re ste/ /pad+ma'i g.yas g.yon cha phran phyed/ /dor sar ri dwags re re bri/ /glang rgyab mig gsum bskor tshul ni/ snam bu gsum pa'i phyi thig dang*/ tshangs thig 'dzoms pa nas bzung ste/ /cha phran gnyis kyi dbus ma bskor/ /mun pa pha ti'i phyi thig dang*/ /tshangs thig 'dzoms pa'i g.yas g.yon du/ /cha phran gnyis re phyin pa nas/ /cha phran gnyis kyi g.yas g.yon bskor/ /de rnams phyi ru cha re bskor/ /'di la 'khyog dgu bya dgos na/ /snam bu dang po phyed dang bzhi/ /gnyis pa gsum pa drug drug go /bzhi pa la ni bzhi bzhi ste/ /snam bu lnga pa cha phran gsum/ /drug pa de nas tshangs rtser slebs/

/de rnams phyi ru phyed re bcad/ /de yi g.yas g.yon rwa skor tshul/ /snam bu gsum pa'i phyi thig dang*/ /tshangs phyir gnyis phyin 'dzoms pa nas/ /bzung ste ka rgyan rtse nas bskor/ /de nas 'phred gnyis phyi ru gcig /phyin te snga ma'i tshad de bskor/ /dbus rwa rtsa ba'i rgya tshad du/ /cha chen gcig yin mi mthong yang*/ /rim phra rtse mo cha phran gnyis/ /pad 'khor gdugs kyi 'og tu bri/ ༈ tshon ni/ rta babs brgyad rnams go rim bzhin/ /rta rkang bzhi sngo rdo rje ser/ /chu skyes dmar la sgrom mdzes tshon/ /zar tshag dkar la gzhi ma nag /sna 'phyang ser po pha gu 'dra/ /sgril 'phyang dkar la gzhi ma nag /shar bu dkar la gzhi ma sngo/ /rgya phub khyung mgo mthing kha'o/ /pad+ma dmar la 'khor lo dang*/ /ri dwags gser mdog gdugs dkar po/ /sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog ༈ gnyis pa rta babs bzhi ma ni/ /'dab thig phyi ru cha chen gnyis/ /nang ma cha bzhir bgo bar bya/ /rta babs snam bu bzhi yin no/ / phyi ma dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /pad 'khor gdugs kyi gnas su 'gyur/ /rta bab phyi mtha'i rim pa yang*/ /dang po ka rgyan mtha' dang mnyam/ /de rjes gsum po re re thung*/ /mig gsum skor tshul rta bab kyi/ /snam bu gnyis pa'i phyi thig dang*/ /tshangs thig 'dzoms pa nas bzung ste/ /cha phran gnyis kyi dbus ma bskor/ /snam bu dang po'i phyi thig dang*/ /tshangs thig 'dzoms pa'i g.yas g.yon du/ /cha phran gnyis re phyin pa nas/ /cha phran gcig re g.yas g.yon bskor/ /yang na g.yas g.yon mig gnyis po/ /brgyad ma lta bu bskor ba'ang yod/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra bskor tshul/ /tshangs phyir gsum phyin mda' phyir gcig /phyin te ka rgyan rtse nas bskor/ /de nas phred gnyis phyi ru gcig /phyin te snga ma'i tshad des bskor// ༈ tshon ni/ nang nas dmar sngo ljang ser ram/ /yang na ser mthing dmar ljang bya// de ltar nyer mkho'i phyir du rje bcu bzhi pa'i thig tshogs rgya mtsho dang*/

lo chen dharma shrī'i dkyil 'khor spyi'i thig tshon gyi bya ba las zur du bkol nas khra 'gu sprul ming 'dzin pas bris pa lags/ sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༄༅/ /dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ phyogs bzhi g.yon bskor dang mtshams bzhi g.yas bskor te brgyad du phye bas rim pa bzhin bkod par bya ste/ de'ang sdom 'byung las/ gtum drag de bzhin tshang tshing 'khrigs/ /rdo rje 'bar ba keng rus can/ /dbang ldan du ni mi bzad bzhad/ /byin za du ni bkra shis mchog /mun pa drag po bden bral du/ /rlung phyogs ki li ki li'i sgra/ /zhes dang*/ shing brgyad ni/ shar du shir+sha a shwat+tha/ /kang kel khyad par tsu ta'i shing*/ /pā ṭa de bzhin ka rañja/ /la ṭa sarka bsten/ ces pa ste de la/ a shwat+tha ni rta gnas te byang chub shing dang*/ pā ṭa ni 'khor byed de n+ya gro dha'o/ /ka rañja ni las 'dul te 'jam 'bras shing dang*/ shir+sha ni shi rī ka ste 'tshe byed/ kang kel ni ke lar grags pa ste chu shing rnams so/ /yang*/ keng rus dang ni gsal shing phug /'phyang dang phyed tshim pa dang mgo /thod pa byin pa mgo gral dang*/ /brtsegs pa'i mgo dang rus pa'ang*/ /zhes pa dang*/ khra dang 'ug pa bya rgod dang*/ /ce spyang ce spyang mo dang ni/ /'ol ba dang ni 'ol ba mo/ /seng ge'i gdong dang stag gi gdong*/ /drag cing 'jigs pa'i gdong can ma/ /sbrul ni ba lang sna can dang*/ /gdong gnyis pa sogs phyogs su rgyu/ /zhes dang*/ grub pa rig 'dzin du ma dang*/ /dam tshig spyod pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs rnams dang*/ /gnod sbyin ro lang srin po'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /ki li ki li chen po sgrogs rnams dang*/ /zhes sogs bshad cing*/ mngon brjod bla mar yang dur khrod kyi mtshan nyid mang du gsungs so/ /de dag tu phyogs skyong brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ klu brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ sprin brgyad/ ri brgyad/ shing brgyad/ me brgyad rnams grangs nges can du bshad la/

grub pa dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma sogs grangs nges med do/ /phyogs skyong ba brgyad ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dang phyag bzhi pa yang bshad kyang snga ma legs la/ de yang*/ srin po khros pa dang*/ gzhan rnams zhi ba yin te/ ji skad du/ de yang brgya byin dkar po yin/ /glang chen zhon cing rdo rje thogs/ /gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon/ /be con 'dzin pa'o chu lha dkar/ /chu srin zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /gshin rje sngon po ma he zhon/ /dbyug to 'dzin pa'o me lha dmar/ /ra la zhon cing bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /srin po nag po ro langs zhon/ /ral gri 'dzin pa'o rlung lha ljang*/ /sha ba zhon nas ba dan 'dzin/ /dbang ldan sngo skya glang la zhon/ /rtse gsum 'dzin pa'o de rnams ni/ /rang rang btsun mos g.yon nas brten/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /rlung lha'i bzhon pa ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇar grags pa nyid legs la/ me lha'i bzhon par dang lugs gnyis ka bshad do/ /zhing skyong ba brgyad ni phyogs skyong gi zhon pa'i gdong can/ mdog kyang de dang mtshungs par bshad cing*/ rang lugs bde mchog sogs la ni yum gtso bor byed pa la shar du khā'i gdong can sogs sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang rnam pa 'dra ba las/ shing lo'i gseb nas lus phyed thon pa/ /phyag g.yas sdig mdzub dang g.yon na thod pa'i nang du gtor ma ste/ mgo dang rkang lag gi lha du ma khrag dang bcas pas gang ba 'dzin pa'o/ /ri brgyad ni/ shar du lhun po sna tshogs mdog /de nas g.yas bskor gyi/ man+dha ra ljang*/ gangs ri dkar/ ma la ya ser/ dbang chen nag spos ngad ldan ser/ gangs can dkar/ dpal gyi ri sngon po rnams so/ /shar nas g.yas skor du mchod rten brgyad ni/ rdo rje dang*/ 'dus byas rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje chags pa/ rdo rje nag po/ thugs rdo rje/ sku rdo rje/ rin chen rdo rje/ chos rdo rje rnams kha dog so sor bshad kyang dkar po nyid bya zhing chu bo brgyad la/ klu chen brgyad lus phyed thon nas thal mo sbyar ba/

phyogs rnams phyogs mdog dang*/ mtshams rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa sbrul gyi gdengs ka dang mjug ma can/ de'i nam mkhar kha dog sna tshogs pa'i sprin chen brgyad char glog dang bcas pa/ 'bar zhing 'khrigs pa'i me brgyad dang*/ /grub chen brgyad ni phyogs bzhi g.yon bskor dang*/ mtshams bzhi g.yas bskor du phye ba/ /in+d+ra bo dhi btsun mor bcas/ /ku ku ri pa khyi mor bcas/ /pad+ma badz+ra yum dang bcas/ /klu sgrub snying po dge slong tshul/ /ṭoṃ bhi he ru stag la zhon/ /lu hi pas ni nya rgyu gsol/ /rdo rje dril bu yum bcas 'phur/ /sa ra ha ni mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /gzhan yang mi ro gsar rnying dang*/ /mthor ba tshig pa thod tshal sogs/ /keng rus ro langs sha za dang*/ /ce spyang bya rgod sbrul tshogs sogs/ /zhes pa ltar dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' bar bya'o/ /de ltar dur khrod bsgom pas gtsang ba/ bde ba/ rtag pa/ bdag yod pa bzhi dang*/ de'i gnyen po lam dman pa bzhi rnams sbyong*/ 'bras bu 'og min rnam snang rol pa'i dur khrod dang o rgyan rang byung gi dur khrod rnams mtshon/ lam dus su khams snyigs ma brgyad gsos su gyur pa'i ye shes kyi byed rgyu'o/ /rdul tshon skabs de dag rnams kyi sku'am rang rang gis mdog mtshungs kyi tshon spungs bya'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor las dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so//

skyabs sems ni/ na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ mchod gtor rnams/ ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi: gnam sa gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: sman gtor rak+ta lha mor bcas: zad med gyur cig pū dzaḥho: sa byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed ni/ rang nyid skad cig gu ru pad+ma 'byung : gsang ba'i bdag po dbyer med sku mdog mthing : rdo rje sdigs mdzub khro bo'i chas kun rdzogs: snang grags lha sngags bde chen rol par gyur: zhes gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra gu ru tsan+d+ra ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: ces ci nus bzla/ mdun rten/ oṃ āḥmṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa: kyis bsang*/ oṃ swabhā wa shūd+dhaḥsarba dharmā swabhā wa shūd+dho3 haṃ/ gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du lcang lo can gyi pho brang bkod pas mdzes pa'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan la skad cig gis: dzam+bha la ser po g.yas shing thog pū ra ser po: g.yon ne'u le ma ṇi rat+na skyugs pa: nor bu'i dbyibs 'dra ba khog stod dar dmar gyis brgyan pa: khog smad dar ljang gis brgyan pa: de'i spyi bor rang nyid o rgyan du gyur: kho yi khog smad dar de las yam̐ gcig chad pas rlung du gyur: khog stod kyi dar de las ram̐ gcig chad pas me chung ngur gyur: rlung de je che la byung me la brgyab me de che nas khog tu rgyug pas: kho skom pas rang gi lus chu babs nas me bsad pas: kho mgu nas dngos grub ci dgos lags dang sbyin zer te: nor gyi dngos grub dang gang 'dod brjod pas khos byin par gyur: bdag thugs 'od zer lcags kyu yis: chos dbyings khyab pa'i zhing khams dang : lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas: nor bdag 'khor bcas spyan drangs bstim: spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐: byang phyogs gter gyi gzhal yas na: nor gyi dbang phyug dzam+bha la:

thugs rjes gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: ji srid bar du brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya dza: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: mchod pa/ stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag gi: dpal 'byor blo yis blangs te 'bul: yid sprul rtags brgyad rgyal srid bdun: dngos 'byor mchod gtor 'di 'bul bzhes: oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ bstod pa/ hūm̐: bde gshegs sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin: gzugs kyi skur sprul dzaṃbha la: dran pa tsam gyis dbul phongs sel: dzam lha ser por phyag 'tshal bstod: bshags pa ni/ thog med ser sna'i las bsags rnams: mthol bshags byang zhing dag gyur cig: dbul phongs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ dpal 'byor nor dbyig 'phel zhing rgyas: 'dod dgu snang srid dbang du bsdus: snyigs dus mu ge'i bskal pa bzlog: thugs dam dus bab sa ma ya: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces phrin las bcol/ bzlas dmigs ni/ dzaṃ lha'i thugs kar zla gdan la: thugs srog sa bon sngags phreng bcas: rang mdog g.yas bskor 'khod par gyur: bdag thugs 'od kyis mchod pas mnyes: thugs bskyed dam bca' rjes dran te: 'od zer sprul tshogs 'jig rten khyab: mkho rgu'i dpal 'byor longs spyod bsdus: ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar gyur: zhes gsal gdab cing : oṃ dzaṃbha la dza len+d+ra ye swāhā: bsnyen sngags ci nus bzlas mthar rjes rim ni/ slar yang*/ stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag gi: dpal 'byor blo yis blangs te 'bul: yid sprul rtags brgyad rgyal srid bdun: dngos 'byor mchod gtor 'di 'bul bzhes: oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ hūm̐: bde gshegs sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin: gzugs kyi sku sprul dzam+bha la: dran pa tsam gyis dbul phongs sel: dzam lha ser por phyag 'tshal bstod: thog med ser sna'i las bsags rnams:

mthol bshags byang zhing dag gyur cig: dbul phongs thams cad zhi ba dang : dpal 'byor nor dbyig 'phel zhing rgyas: 'dod dgu snang srid dbang du bsdus: snyigs dus mu ge'i bskal pa bzlog: thugs dam dus bab sa ma ya: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: brtan bzhugs ni/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu: 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang : nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang : mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā: dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag: nor gyi bdag po 'grub gyur nas: 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa: de yi sa la 'god par shog: dge ba bsngo/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*/ /sems can re ba bskang mdzad ltar/ /bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog/ ces bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan cing bdag bskyed dmigs med du bzhag pas grub bo/ zhes gnam chos dang rgyal dbang bco lnga pa'i gsung gung bstun nas bklag chog tu khra 'gu sprul ming pas nyams len byed po rnams la phan pa'i ched du bris pa dge/ ༄༅/ /blang dor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis ma'i rtsa ba bzhugs so// ma 'dris 'gro ba'i bshes gnyen ston mchog la//mi phyed dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas//tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i grogs rnams la//lhag bsam dag pas blang dor bslab bya spel// drin chen pha ma'i re ba bskang phyir dang*//rang gi 'di phyi'i don chen rgyur nges pas//mar 'dren col chung rjes su mi 'brang bar//kun slong ma nor ma brjed lag len mdzod// tshangs spyod lag gtsang blo thub yon tan brtson//myos byed sho sbag ta se (Tash)tha ma kha//mtha' mi'i gos dang sngo ljang khyim pa'i chas//skra ring mtshan mo grong pa'i khrod du 'khyams// 1kha btsog don med kha gyong brdung brdeg byed//'grul pa mgo skor glog brnyan khang du 'gro//'thab rtsod bud med rtse rnams rgyun du spangs//chos gos gding ba rdor dril ḍā ma ru//

2dril gdan sgrig zhal phor ras shu ka li//rgyun mkho'i phyag dpe dpe ras dang bcas pa//bris chas sbyang deb mkho ba'i yo byad bcang*//gzan sham stod 'gag smad g.yogs rngul len dang*// 3 dmar ser lham bcas gtsang mar tshul mthun bgo/rang 'khri'i las 'gan 'thus shor med par gces//de skad dge ba'i bshes kyi ming 'dzin pa//khra 'gu ba yi brtse bas gdams par bris// 4 ༄༅/ /blang dor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis ma'i rang 'grel bzhugs so// 'dzam gling hril por 'khod pa'i skye dgu dag/sdug bsngal las nyon smag tu 'thum pa nyid//gsal mdzad nyin byed 'od stong 'bar ba ni//rin chen gsum zhes grags pa kho na las//gzhan du dka' spyad drag pos btsal byas kyang*//srid gsum khong 'dir rnyed par ga la nus//de phyir skyabs gcig dkon mchog rnam gsum gyis//mchog tu shis pa'i snang ba stsol mdzod cig/tshul khrims mi srung thos bsam la mi brtson//nyams len med pa'i grwa gzugs tsam 'chang ba//rgyal bstan bshig pa'i chom rkun lta bur nges//de bas mar 'dren mig ltos spangs nas kyang*//sgrigs dang kun spyod bzang ba'i dge 'dun sder//bzhugs na 'gro ba'i skyabs dang bstan pa'i rgyan//dam pa'i tshul dgu zhes pa'ang de kho na//de phyir blang dor gsal ba'i yig ris spel// de yang sngon dgon pa gsar 'dzugs skabs blang dor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis zhes tshigs bcad sho lo ka bzhi'i khongs su yod pa zhig bris pa de thams cad kyis shes dgos pa dang shes nas de dag lag len du theb pa zhig nges par byed dgos pa yin/ de las dang po tshangs spyod ces pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan mang po gzigs nas bud med la mi tshangs par spyod pa bkag pa dang*/ rjes 'jug rab tu byung ba rnams kyis kyang da lta'i bar bkag pa de nyams len gnang bzhin pa ste/ nyes pa de byung na 'gal tshabs che ba'i phyir/

de lta bu'i skyon byung tshe sgrigs nas thon dgos pa yin/ gnyis pa lag pa gtsang ba ni/ ma byin par len pa spangs pa ste/ gal te rin thang tshang ba zhig bor brlag byung na gal chung mi bya bar las byed pa rnams kyis rtsad gcod mthil phyin byed dgos/ rtsad chod nas lo bco brgyad yan lon pa dang*/ rin thang tshang ba zhig yin na nges par sgrigs nas thon dgos la/ gal te dngos po chung ngu'am/ lo chung bsam med lta bu zhig yin na/ pha ma'am gnyen bshes sogs la yang skad cha byas nas/ grwa chung 'di la spyod ngan 'di lta bu zhig 'dug /gal te sgrigs dang 'gal ba lan gsum byung na sgrigs las thon dgos pa'i sgrigs gzhi yod pa dang*/ bslab bya byas na skyon ngo shes nas ma 'ongs par gang legs 'byung rgyu yod par brten bslab bya nan po bya dgos pa'i bskul ma byed dgos shing*/ dgon gyi las byed pa rnams nas kyang lhag bsam rnam dag gis zhi drag gnyis kyi sgo nas bslab bya gang thub bya/ gal te yang thengs gnyis pa zhig byung na slar yang de ltar byas nas/ de'i skabs su yig cha yang bzhag /de rjes spyod ngan thengs gsum pa byung na sgrigs khungs las thon dgos pa las zhu ba 'bul ba'am deng dus kyi brjod srol ltar ltag sgo phye ba sogs bya mi rung*/ gsum pa blo thub pa ni/ rdzun spang ba dang*/ bzhi pa yon tan la brtson pa ni go sla mod/ de gnyis kyi skyon byung tshe bslab bya dang*/ legs bcos byung tshe rngan pa sogs sprad/ lnga pa myos byed ces pa/ chang dang*/ a rag /bhe yar (Beer) sogs dang*/ dmigs bsal deng dus thon gsar bzi sman rigs yin la/ gal te sman pas nad gzhi'i rigs bcos pa'i ched du sprad pa yin na dmigs bsal las/ gzhan de rigs kyi skyon byung tshe ma byin par len pa la lag len byas pa ltar bslab bya thengs gsum gyi rjes ma nyan na skyon gzhan la 'phel rgyu'i nyen kha yod pas sgrigs las thon dgos/

drug pa sho/ bdun pa sbag dang ma chang*/ brgyad pa ta se/(Tash) dgu pa tha ma kha dang*/ khe ni (khenee)bcas nges par spang dgos la/ gal te de dag lag len byed pa byung na tshogs la brgya phyag dang*/ thugs spro'i zhal 'debs sgor lnga brgya phul dgos/ 'di'i khongs su ḍi si ko (Disco) la 'gro ba yang gtogs pas/ brgya phyag phul dgos pa dang*/ der 'gro skabs 'gro song phangs med gtong ba zhig yin pa'i phyir thugs spro'i zhal 'debs sgor chig stong phul dgos par sems/ bcu pa mtha' mi'i gos ni/ koṭa (Coat) yin/ bcu gcig pa sngo ljang zhes pa/ rngul len/ o su/ lham sogs kyi kha dog yin pa dang*/ gal te de lta bu gyon pa byung tshe gzhung nas rtsis bzhes kyis rin thang can zhig yin na btsong nas rin babs thugs spro'i zhal 'debs gnang rgyu dang*/ rin thang ma tshang ba zhig yin na/ zhe chen bstan gnyis dar rgyas gling gi phyag srol ltar mer sreg nas med par byed rgyu/ bcu gnyis pa khyim pa'i chas ni/ gal te lag khyer med par sa mtshams brgal ba sogs la dmigs bsal las rang gar khyim pa'i chas byas na thugs spro'i zhal 'debs sgor lnga brgya phul dgos/ bcu gsum pa skra ring ba ni/ mthong tshul du bslab pa la gces spras med pa lta bus khyim pa sun 'byin pa yin pa'i phyir/ zla ba re'i tshes nyer drug la dbu skra bcad dgos shing*/ gal te thag ring nas 'byor ba sogs yin na/ nyin shas las ma 'gor bar dbu skra bcad dgos/ bcu bzhi pa mtshan mo grong du 'gro ba ni/ pha ma sogs mi shi ba'am na tsha chen po glo bur du byung ba la dgongs pa zhus nas 'gro chog /na tsha chung tsag la dgongs pa gnang rgyu med/ gal te gnyen tshan dang*/ ngo shes/ sbyin bdag sogs kyis gdan drangs na/ dmigs bsal chos khrims pa la dgongs pa zhu dgos/ de min thugs spro'i zhal 'debs sgor lnga brgya phul rgyu/ bco lnga pa kha btsog zhes pa ni/

bud med kyi rigs la 'khrig tshig rjen par smra ba ste/ gal te de lta bu'i skyon byung na/ brgya phyag dang*/ thugs spro'i zhal 'debs sgor lnga brgya phul dgos/ bcu drug pa kha gyong dang*/ bcu bdun pa brdung brdeg gnyis te/ las byed pas sgrigs lam gyi ched du de dag gnang ba yin na dmigs bsal las/ rang don du nyam chung la brnyas bcos dang*/ rang nyid stobs chen yin pa'i dpung ngom byas pa yin tshe/ brgya phyag dang*/ thugs spro'i zhal 'debs sgor lnga brgya phul dgos/ bco brgyad pa 'grul pa mgo skor/ bcu dgu pa glog brnyan khang du 'gro ba gnyis kyang*/ brgya phyag dang*/ thugs spro'i zhal 'debs sgor chig stong dgos/ nyi shu pa 'thab rtsod kyi chad las brdung brdeg dang gcig pa yin/ nyer gcig pa nye du ma yin pa'i bud med dang rtse ba/ zhes pa'i nye du'i khongs su sring mo gsar du bsgrigs pa sogs mi gtogs par ma zad/ sring mo gsar pa bsgrig pa sogs gtan nas mi chog /gal te bud med dang lhan du rtsed mo rtse ba byung na/ 'khrig tshig rjen par smra ba'i chad las dang gcig pa bcas/ de ltar spang bya'i kun spyod nyi shu rtsa gcig dus rgyun du spangs dgos/ blang bya'i kun spyod la/ 'tshog chas bcu gnyis nyar dgos pa las/ nyer gnyis pa chos gos la/ snam sbyar dang bla gos gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po snam sbyar ni/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'chang dgos/ de yang snam sbyar rgyas pa/ snam phran nyer gcig /nyer gsum/ nyer lnga gsum glegs bu phyed dang lnga pa/ snam sbyar 'bring po/ snam phran bco lnga/ bcu bdun/ bcu dgu pa bcas/ glegs bu phyed dang bzhi pa/ snam sbyar bsdus pa/ snam phran dgu pa/ bcu gcig pa/ bcu gsum pa bcas/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa/ tshad ni/ che skor gsum dpangs su khru gsum dang*/ srid du khru lnga/ chung skor gsum de dag las khru phyed phyed phri ba/ 'bring gsum de gnyis kyi bar te/

snam sbyar rgyas bsdus gang byed rang rang 'dod pa dang bstun nas 'chang dgos la/ gso sbyong gi skabs sogs la nges par bsnam nas tshul dang mthun par mchod dgos/ de bzhin dge tshul slong gnyis kar dgos pa/ gnyis pa chos gos bla gos ni/ snam phran bdun/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa/ tshad snam sbyar ltar gsum ste/ de yang nges par 'chang dgos/ ma zad gtsang mar nyar tshags bya/ gal te rnying hrul dang*/ nag po sogs byung tshe gal chung mi bya bar bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i rten yin pas gsar pa brje dgos/ de bzhin mthang sham/ snam phran lnga pa/ glegs bu phyed gnyis can/ tshad dpangs su khru do/ srid du khru lnga'am bzhi/ tha na 'khor gsum khebs pas kyang rung ba ste/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong rnams kyis 'chang dgos shing*/ de nyid dus rgyun mchod pa'am dbyar gnas dang gso sbyong sogs dus bzang gi skabs su nges par mchod dgos/ mthang sham de dge tshul rnams la med kyang rung ba bcas/ de ltar chos gos rnam pa gsum dang*/ nyer gsum pa gding ba ni/ dge tshul slong gnyis ka la yod dgos pa yin/ de yang gding ba ni/ srid du khru gsum/ zheng du khru do dang sor drug yod pa/ glegs bu phyed dang gnyis pa ste/ gding ba tshad dang ldan pa 'chang dgos la/ gso sbyong sogs kyi skabs nges par bsnam dgos shing*/ nam rgyun dreg pa dang dri ma sogs byung na khrus nas gtsang mar bya rgyu dang*/ gal te bug rdol byung na gding ba gsar pa 'tshem dgos/ 'tshogs la phebs skabs gding ba rgyab dgos par ma zad/ de rnams dus rgyun gtur bu'am sgril ras gang rung gi nang du bsgril nas gces nyar bya dgos pa bcas 'dul ba dang mthun pa'i mkho ba'i yo byad yin/ nyer bzhi pa rdor dril dang*/ nyer lnga pa ḍā ma ru/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig yin pas/ rdo rje dang dril bu shubs dang bcas shing*/ ḍā ma ru ḍā rgyan dang bcas nyar tshags bya dgos par ma zad/

bde mchog dang*/ phag mo sogs gsung skabs 'tshogs la nges par bsnam dgos/ nyer drug pa dril gdan ni/ spyir rdo rje dang dril bu ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ye shes kyi rten yin pa dang*/ ḍā ma ru rdo rje theg pa'i spyod pa dang dam tshig gi rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ rten khyad par can yin tshul kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung las gsal ba ltar yin/ des na dngos po phal pa'i 'du shes spangs nas gus pa bskyed pa'i ched du dril gdan nyar dgos/ de yang spus legs gos chen sogs rin thang can gyis bzo ba las/ sla chos bya mi rung zhing*/ dus rgyun phyag ḍā dril rnams dril gdan gyi steng du 'jog dgos/ nyer bdun pa grwa zhal dang*/ nyer brgyad pa phor ras sam phor phyis ni/ spyir 'dul ba ltar na dge tshul slong rnams kyis lhung bzed 'chang dgos shing*/ de'i nang du zhal lag bzhes pa dang bsod snyoms len pa sogs gnang ba yin mod/ bod du de'i tshab grwa zhal bed spyod gnang ba yin pa'i phyir/ grwa zhal dgos par ma zad de yang rang lugs kyi grwa zhal kar gzugs tshad ldan bcangs nas/ gsol ja dang bzhes thug sogs yod pa'i skabs bsnam dgos pa dang*/ ja thug sogs phul yong ba'i skabs bzhes 'dod med na mi len/ gal te bzhes dgos na ji tsam dgos pa de tsam blangs nas gtsang mar bzhes dgos pa ma gtogs ja thug lhag ma phor phyed tsam gtsug lag khang gi nang bag med du g.yug /de mi rgyus med zhig gis ma mthong bas pho nas bzhugs gdan dang*/ mchod rdzas rigs mi gtsang bar bzo ba sogs ma dag pa'i rgyur 'gyur bas/ dus rgyun dran shes bag yod dang bcas pas mchod zhal gtsang ma byas/ de dang lhan du phor ras sam phor phyis bcang nas/ phor pa phyis/ phor ras kyis sgril dgos shing*/ tshogs grol ba'i skabs rang shag tu bsnams nas nyar tshags bya dgos/ nyer dgu pa shu ka li'am dpe shog ni/ phyag dpe bzhugs yul yin pa'i phyir lha khang chung ngu ka bzhi ma zhig bzhengs pa'i phan yon yod par dam pa rnams kyis gsungs pas 'byor ba dang ldan na/

tsan dan dang*/ gser dngul/ gos chen sogs rin thang can las bzhengs pa'am/ gal te bya bral ba lta bu yin na spros med stabs bde bya ba las/ rin thang can med na mi rung ba lta bu yang min pas/ rgyas spros can nam stabs bde gang yang rung*/ phyag dpe zhal 'don rgyud sde'i skor ram/ gzhung bshad rtsa 'grel skor gang yin rung*/ de las nyung tsam zur bcad kyis de'i nang du bzhag /'phros dpe ras kyis sgril te rang shag tu nyar nas phyag dpe khag ma 'thor bar gces skyong bya dgos pa las/ gal chung byas na tshogs ngan gyi rgyur 'gyur bas mi rung*/ sum cu pa rgyun mkho'i phyag dpe dang*/ so gcig pa dpe ras gnyis las/ phyag dpe mkho gal che ba/ rtsa ba dang 'grel pa/ sbyang dpe dang*/ zur blta'i yi ge khag dang*/ tshes bcu dang nyer lnga'i dus mchod sogs kyi phyag dpe/ dus rgyun blo 'dzin gyi yi ge dang*/ zin bris sogs dgos nges kyi phyag dpe khag med na gsar du 'tshol ba dang*/ rang la yod pa'i dpe cha khag mthong chung ma yin par gces nyar byas te dpe ras gtsang zhing spus legs kyis bsgril nas mchod khri'i steng du bzhag ste gus bkur zhu dgos/ so gnyis pa bris chas dang*/ so gsum pa sbyang deb ni/ bslab sbyang skabs kyi yo byad de/ bris chas/ smyu gu/ zha smyug /thig shing*/ thong cha/ dmar rtags dang*/ ser rtags sogs dang*/ sbyang deb bcas bcang dgos shing*/ bslab sbyang byas pa khag mi brjed pa'i phyir du zin bris sogs bya dgos/ de nas gos bgo tshul skor las/ so bzhi pa gzan dang*/ so lnga pa sham thabs yin/ de gnyis ka kha dog ha cang nag po dang*/ ha cang skya bo ma yin pa/ che chung lus tshad dang mthun pa de las sham thabs ni/ rgyun du gyon dgos pa dang*/ gzan yang rgyun du mchod na rab/ de min yang shag nas phyi rol du 'gro ba'i skabs nges par gyon dgos shing*/ gyon pa'i skabs/ so sor thar pa'i mdo las/ chos gos zlum por bgo bar bya'o/

/zhes dang*/ sham thabs zlum por bgo bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa nyid nyams su len pa'i sgo nas drud pa dang*/ ring thung shor ba sogs ma yin par dran shes dang bcas gyon dgos/ so drug pa bod kyi rab byung thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i na bza' stod 'gag yin pas dus rgyun ma bral bar mchod dgos shing*/ dus chen sogs la rin thang che ba'i stod 'gag cig kyang yod dgos/ de bzhin so bdun pa smad g.yogs dang*/ so brgyad pa rngul len gnyis po yang gzan sham sogs gtsang ma 'byung ba'i ched yod dgos la/ de yang dmar po'am ser po'i kha dog las gzhan sngon po dang*/ ljang gu/ dkar po dang nag po sogs ma yin pa zhig dgos/ de bzhin so dgu pa lham yang*/ spyir bod du ras mgo dang ras zom sogs mchod pa'i srol byung mod/ deng rgya bal tsha ba dang zha rlon che bas/ de rnams mchod rgyu'i mthun rkyen ma tshang stabs de lta bu phyag len gnang mi thub par brten/ dus dang gnas skabs dang mthun pa zhig dgos pas khyim pa'i lham nag po dang*/ dmag mi'i lham lta bu ma yin par kha dog dmar po'am ser smug lta bu zhig dang*/ zhabs sug sngo ljang dkar po ma yin par rung ba'i kha dog dang ldan pa dgos/ bzhi bcu pa gtsang ma dang*/ zhe gcig pa tshul mthun gnyis ni/ gong gi na bza' sne lnga dang*/ lham bcas drug po de rnams ha cang btsog pa/ dreg pa dang dri ma can ma yin par dus rgyun khrus nas gtsang sbra dang bcas pa dang*/ gyon tshul yang mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba ste/ ha cang thabs sdug smyon pa'i tshul lta bu dang*/ ha cang mdzes chos che drags pa zhig kyang ma yin par mthong na mi mthun pa med pa zhig dgos/ zhe gnyis pa las 'gan 'thus shor med pa ni/ shin tu gal che ste/ 'gro ba'i bde skyid ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las shing*/ bstan pa dar gud ni/ las sne 'dzin pa po rnams kyi lhag bsam che chung dang*/

nus shugs bskyed min la rag las pas na/ mkhan po/ phyag mdzod/ gnyer pa/ chos khrims sogs nas/ ja 'dren yan chad kyis rang la babs pa'i las 'gan rnams bstan pa la lhag bsam che bskyed byas nas/ nyams gud mi shor ba zhig dang*/ gong 'phel 'gro ba zhig gi ched du/ rang gzhan gyi dgon sde khag la bya mig gyen lta byas te/ kun slong dang*/ 'bad brtson gnyis ka'i thog nas/ 'thus shor med pa zhig dgos par ma zad/ yang 'ga' zhig bstan pa spyi pa'i don la 'bad brtson byas na yang*/ rang gi bslab pa la gces spras chung ba/ thos bsam la mi brtson pa/ nyams len mi byed pa lta bu yang yong srid pas/ de ltar ma yin par yang dag pa zhig dgos pa bcas thugs la nges pa zhig gnang rogs zhu/ sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba'i mdzes rgyan dang*//dal 'byor thob pa don ldan 'byung ba'i slad//thos pa kha khyer stong rgyug mi byed par//thos don ji bzhin lag tu len par gces//de phyir dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sder zhugs nas//rang gis rang nyid bslu ba ma yin cing*//gzhan gyis mjal tshe dang ba bskyed nus pa'i//chos mthun spyod pa bzang por bslab par mdzod//de skad blang dor bstan pa'i yig ris 'di//bklags pas byin rlabs 'jug par mi 'gyur zhing*//'chang na gdon bgegs srung ba'i nus pas dben//'on kyang ji bzhin lag len byas gyur na//'di phyir dgos pa'i 'bras bzang smin par nges//mdor na rnam gsum ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'di//tshe 'dir mi 'bral dam bca' gnang bar gces//de skad bslab byar gces spras bya ba'i tshul//bris pa'i dge bas dge 'dun sde 'phel zhing*//rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

ces khra 'gu sprul ming pas rang la snying nas re ltos byed pa'i slob bu rnams la phan pa zhig byung na snyam pa'i kun slong gis rgyal bu snying stobs chen po'i sku lus sbyin pa gnang ba'i gnas mchog tu rab gnas chu mo lug gi lo sa ga nya pa'i tshes la bris pa dge legs 'phel/ ༄༅/ /chang dang bzi sman gyi bca' khrims la bcos bsgyur/ spyir chang ni dge 'dun pas 'thung mi rung ba dang*/ bzi sman nag po za mi rung bar gzhir bcas pa ltar/ chu lug lo/ spyi lo 2003 la bris pa'i blang dor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis zhes pa'i deb chung du gsal rung*/ der skyon byung na bslab bya thengs gsum rjes gnas dbyung bya dgos zhes lhod yangs lta bur song bas/ da lta skyon de mang po 'phel rgyu'i nyen kha chen po byung bar brten/ chang 'thung ba dang*/ bzi sman za ba byung na/ de ga rang la gnas dbyung ma gtang thabs med kyis/ me pho khyi yi lo/ bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu/ spyi lo nyis stong bdun gyi zla ba dang po'i tā ri nyer brgyad (spyi lo 2007 zla 1 tshes 28) mgon po'i tshogs 'bum phul ba'i nyin dgu pa'i dgong mor bca' khrims la bcos bsgyur gtang te nyi ma de ring nas bzung de lta bu'i skyon byung na gnas dbyung bya rgyu nyag gcig yin pas/ ma go ma thos med par kun gyi dran shes bag yod kyis thugs la nges pa gnang rogs zhu rgyu dang*/ spyir dgon pa la chang khrims gang legs yod dgos pa gzhir bcas pa ltar/ sngon ma de ltar yod mod/ bar lam skyon cha 'byung ba'i rgyu/ stag mo lus sbyin nas skyes tshes dang*/ chang sa la mgron du 'bod pas chang sprad pa dang*/ 'thung ba'i rgyu zhig byung 'dug par brten/ de ring gi tshes nas bzung mtho dman drag zhan su yang*/ de lta bu'i 'gron du 'gro mi chog par thag chod zin pa yin pas/ de yang thams cad kyis ma go ma shes med pa zhig dgos zhes khra 'gu sprul ming pas rig pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang nas gong tshes nyin bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/

/khra 'gu bkris chos gling gi dge 'dun pa gsar bzhugs rnams kyi na bza' gra sgrig dgos pa khag gi tho gsal/ 1 sham thabs kha dog dmar smug grwa chung gi lus tshad dang 'tshams pa grangs gnyis/2 gzan sham thabs las cung srab pa dmar ser ram dmar smug gang rung gnyis/3 stod 'gag dmar ser ram dmar smug gang rung grangs gnyis/4 rngul len kha dog ser po grangs gnyis/5 stod gos dmar smug nang sha yod pa'am med pa gang rung gcig6 ske rags ser po grangs gcig7 o su kha dog dmar smug can grangs gnyis/8 lham 'ju ta (Joota)kha dog dmar po can gcig9 dbyar kha'i lham ca pal (Chappal)grangs gcig 10 nyal gdan nang tshangs can phyi g.yogs sra mkhregs ldan pa gcig11 ca gdar (gdan khebs ) kha dog dmar po'am ser po gang rung*/12 nyal chas kam 'bal (phu khebs ) mtshan mo ma grang ba zhig13 sngas nang tshangs can/14 sngas shubs sra mkhregs can grangs gnyis/15 de rnams bcug sa'i snod sgam gcig bcas de rnams ma tshang na grwa chung la dka' ngal chen po yong gi 'dug pas grangs tshang zhig gra sgrig gnang dgos pa thugs nges zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas/༄༅/ /'di ga khra 'gu dgon du dge 'dun pa gsar du 'dzugs pa'i skabs mthun rkyen tshang dgos pa ni/ 1 lus la nad gzhi chen po can ma yin pa/ 2 sems pa skyon can nam lkugs nad can ma yin pa/ 3 dbang po dang*/ yan lag la skyon med pa/4 gzugs tshad phi kri (Feet) bzhi ma lon pa'i byis pa ma yin pa/ 5 dgon pa gzhan nas khrims 'gal gyis thon pa ma yin pa bcas dgos pa dang*/ dgon pa grwa tshang la shin tu bka' drin che ba'i sbyin bdag lta bu byung na dmigs bsal las/ gzhan lo rer dge 'dun gsar bzhugs grangs bcu zin nas lo der mtshams 'jog rgyu lags pas/ de bzhin thugs la nges gnang zhu/ dge 'dun 'dus spyi'i gros tshogs nas thag gcod zhus pa lags/ [khra 'gu sprul ming pas/] ༄༅/ /dpal khra 'gu bkris chos gling dgon gyi dge 'dun pa rnams la sku 'gyed gtang phyogs skor/

sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig lhag bsam rnam dag gis sku 'gyed sogs gang drag phul bas/ ¿bskal pa bzang po'i ja 'dren de/ /dus tshod ngan pa'i bsho 'jags//¿ zhes pa ltar/ sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig gis nyis skal sogs phul ma thub pa'i skabs bla grwa kha shas dgongs pa 'tshoms pa sogs byung rkyen/ sgrig lam bzos pa yin pas dgongs 'gal mi bzhes pa zhu rgyu dang*/ spyir sku 'gyed la sde tshan gnyis yod pa las/ dang po bla grwa phyi rgyal nas tshur phebs pa'i dkor babs dang legs skyes kyi ched du btang ba'i sku 'gyed yin na dgon gyi mtshan tho nang thebs pa yongs rdzogs la phul dgos pa dang*/ nyis skal sogs sbyin bdag rang rang gi mos pa dang*/ 'dod pa ltar phul rgyu yin/ gnyis pa gzhan gshin po'i dge rtsa dang*/ rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i zhabs rim ched yin tshe sbyin bdag gi sems la dang ba skyes pa zhig dang brdab gsig ma 'gro ba gal che bas stabs bde ba zhig dgos pa'i phyir/ nga rang tsho la dgon sde khag gsum yod pa las/ dang po stag mo lus sbyin la thog mar sngon 'gro'i sgrub khang du bla ma bsod nams dang*/ rgan mgon bla gnyis la nyis skal dang*/ sgrub dpon/ dbu mdzad las thog bcas la nyis skal/ gzhan thams cad la rkyang skal yin/ chos kyi 'byung gnas las byed pa rnams sgrub khang du de nyin tshogs la phebs dgos shing*/ de ring tshogs 'phar ma'am sku 'gyed yod ces lan bskyal dgos/ gal te tshogs la ma phebs na sku 'gyed ma phul na legs/ bshad grwa rnams las sprul sku dang*/ dpe khrid gnang mkhan drug /dbu mdzad las thog bcas la nyis skal/ gzhan rnams la rkyang skal/ tsag tsig bsnyungs nas tshogs ma thub na 'gyed ma phul na legs/ gzhi rim las dpe khrid gnang mkhan gsum dang*/ dbu mdzad bcas la nyis skal/ gzhan rkyang skal/ gal te gtor gzheng dang*/ mchod bshams dgos tshe mchod g.yog rnams la nyis skal/ gtor gzheng sogs ma dgos na rkyang skal/

yan lag slob grwa'i slob spyi la nyis skal/ de skabs dge rgan rnams re mos kyis dbu mdzad/ mchod dpon/ dge bskos bcas gnang rgyu dang*/ las sne gsum las thog yin na nyis skal/ las thog ma yin na rkyang skal/ tshogs la phebs ma thub tshe sku 'gyed ma phul na legs/ tsag tsig na ba yang de ltar yin/ las byed pa las gtso 'dzin phyag mdzod la nyis skal/ gzhan ku li'i (Cooli)'go 'dzin/ mo krar (Motor)btang mkhan/ gnyer pa gnyis/ ma byan bcas tshogs la med na yang sku 'gyed dgos/ 'khor khang dkor gnyer dang*/ dge rgan lug rwa gnyis la rkyang skal/ gla cha sprad yod pa'i las byed pa la sku 'gyed ma phul na legs/ gnyis pa mchod rten mdun bkra shis chos gling dgon du mkhan po sku bgres/ sprul sku/ rdor slob/ phyag mdzod/ chos khrims/ dbu mdzad/ mchod g.yog /slob spyi las thog bcas la nyis skal/ gzhan rnams la rkyang skal/ na ba sogs kyis tshogs la med na sku 'gyed ma phul na legs la/ slob grwa'i las byed pa gsum/ mo krar gtong mkhan/ ma byan bcas tshogs la med na yang 'gyed dgos/ gsum pa wā rā ṇa sī bshad grwa ltar las phyag mdzod la nyis skal/ gnyer pa tshogs la med na yang 'gyed dgos/ dkor gnyer dang dpe mdzod las byed pa rnams tshogs 'phar ma la tshogs 'tshogs dgos pa bcas kyi yi ge phyi lo 2003 zla 4 tshes 14 nyin khra 'gu sprul ming pas phul/pha ma'i zhabs zhus dgos zhes bsgrigs thon pa//de don dngos su dran pa yin nges kyang*//don du 'ong ba mna' ma'i zhabs phyi tsam//de phyir ma nor lam bzang skyong ba gces//'tsho ba'i zas dang gos kyis mi phongs shing*//nad kyis mnar na sman gyi mthun rkyen dang*//ldan bzhin thos dang bsam dang sgom pa la//brtson pa'i go skabs bzang po thob pa nyid//'di phyi gnyis ldan mchog gsum thugs rje yis//gnang ba'i pha 'babs bzang po yin nges pas//'di tsam chog shes bzang po bsten na legs//da ni rang don rang gces bslab sbyang dang*//nyams len dag la brtson pa shin tu gces//tshogs dang dus mchod nya stong gso sbyong las//g.yas byol g.yon bros thub na grung por bsam//'gyed la hab thob nyis skal rtsod la sogs//mnog chung dag la chags sdang byed pa ni//rang gis rang phung yin nges chog shes dang*//dran shes bag yod bsten pa shin tu gces//de skad snying nas brtse ba'i bslab bya la//rna bar snyan po med pa srid mod kyi//phan pa'i sems kyis bris phyir bzod par zhu//༄༅/

/phyi lo 2001zla 11tshes 11nyin dgon du dge 'dun pa rnams kyi spyod lam thog bzang ngan dbye 'byed kyi thag gcod byas pa'i skor/ skabs skabs su dge 'dun pa rnams rgya bal sa mtshams rgal dgos skabs/ sa mtshams las byed pas rnyog phra mi 'byung ba'i ched/ skya chas gyon chog pa dmigs bsal ma gtogs skya chas gyon nas grong khyer dang*/ grong gseb sogs la phebs pa sogs mi bya/ gal te byas na spyi thog la ne sgor chig stong 'bul dgos shing*/ dngul de gtsang sbra byed pa'i skabs su chu mngar mo nyo byed byed dgos/ de bzhin kor ṭi (Coat)yang mo krar (Motor)kha lo ba dang*/ kha lo ba'i grogs gnyis phud/ de min che phra thams cad nas gyon na gong gsal ltar thag gcod rgyu/ de bzhin sbri si ko (Disco)la 'gro na yang gong gsal ltar thag gcod bya dgos/ gal te dngul gtan nas med pa zhig yin na/ dgon pa'i gsang spyod khag gtsang ma kha dog dkar po 'ong ba zhig bya dgos pa bcas rang nas thag gcod byas pa yin/ de bzhin bshad grwa ba yar mar phebs skabs a ni dgon pa'i sba si (Bus)rgya bal sa mtshams bar g.yar rgyu dang*/ sa mtshams nas wā rā ṇa sī bar sba si (Bus) kri keṭa (Ticket)dang*/ gong gsal a ni dgon pa'i sba si'i (Bus) snum rin bcas bshad grwa'i bde don tshogs pa nas gtang rgyu/ zhal lag 'gro gron rang rang nas gtang rgyu bcas kyang thag gcod byas pa yin/ [khra 'gu sprul ming pas/] ༄༅/ /legs bcos tshogs 'dus kyi sgrig gzhi/ gnas mchog stag mo lus sbyin sgrub sde dang*/ bshad grwa/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor mdun gyi dgon pa/ 'phags shing btsun dgon/ maṅgal dīpa slob grwa bcas gsar bskrun gyis grwa btsun lhan 'dzoms byung nas lo 'ga' shas bar/ chos mthun gyi sgrig lam ci yong gang yong lta bu las/ sgrig gzhi sra brtan gang yang med cing*/ de skabs bca' yig lta bu blang dor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis zhes pa zhig bris nas/

de nyid lag len gnang rogs zhes zhu ba tsam las/ lag thog tu len pa ma byung zhing*/ spyir bsam pa'i khyer so dang*/ lugs srol goms gshis/ skad rigs sogs mi gcig pa'i yul lung ma 'dra ba nas phebs pa sha stag la song ba dang*/ lhag par dgon sde 'di nyid shin tu gsar pa zhig la song stabs sngar srol bzang po'i rgyun skyong rgyu lta bu zhig med pa'i rkyen gyis phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen sna tshogs zhig rgyun mthud nas byung mod/ spyi thog nas bltas tshe 'gal rkyen khag las rgyal zhing*/ byas rjes mi dman tsam byung ba ni/ grwa btsun yongs nas chos la dad gus che zhing*/ lhag bsam bzang ba las byung ba zhig yin la/ da dung de bzhin bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar du de bzhin rgyun 'khyongs gnang rgyu gal che ste/ gal te bla ma'am/ bstan bdag sku drag sogs 'ga' zhig gi las 'gan nam/ thob thang lta bur bsam pa ni shin tu nor ba ste/ dngos don du sgrig lam nyams shing*/ las don khag la tshags tshud ma 'byung ba la brten nas/ gyong gun zhig 'byung na de grwa btsun yongs kyi zas gos longs spyod kyi steng du gyong phog rgyu dang*/ yang sgrig lam legs shing las don khag tshags tshud pa zhig byung na/ khe phan dge 'dun yongs la 'ong rgyu nyag gcig gi phyir/ rgan gzhon thams cad kyis rang don rang gces phya ra gru 'degs brtson dgos pa'i phyir/ da nas brtsams mkhan po/ sgrub dpon/ dbu mdzad/ chos khrims/ gnyer phyag dge rgan/ drung yig bcas bla grwa rgan gras rnams zla rer thengs re lhan 'dzoms gnang thog bka' bgros gnang rogs zhu rgyu dang*/ de skabs gros gzhi yang*/ spyir bstan don la 'khor lo chen po gsum zhes bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad las yongs su grags pa ltar/dang po klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo bslab pa slob gnyer skor la/ 'thus shor yod min brtags zhib thog 'thus shor yod tshe yo bsrang thabs shes dang*/

yar rgyas legs bcos dgos rigs gros bsdur thog thag gcod gnang rgyu/gnyis pa spong ba bsam gtan gyi gtso bor tshul khrims skor/ sgrig lam 'thus shor rtsad gcod dang*/ yo bsrang legs bcos skor thag gcod gnang rgyu/gsum pa bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i sde tshan/ mchod 'bul/ 'grul pa sne len/ yongs 'babs bzo rgyu/ dge 'dun pa'i mthun rkyen/ sman bcos sogs gang legs gtang phyogs skor 'thus shor rigs yo bsrang gnang rgyu/ bzhi pa thag gcod gang byung yig thog tu bkod nas/ zla ba sngon ma lo sngon ma sogs la thag gcod byas rigs/ lag thog tu len thub yod med gzigs zhib thog lag len thub nges bya rgyu/ lnga pa sku bgres rnams kyis dgongs 'char lhug par gnang rgyu dang*/ rgyun las pa rnams kyis gsan zhib thog dwangs len/ lag bstar gnang rgyu/ gal te 'gal rkyen che bas lag len thub re bral na rgyu mtshan gsal bkrol gnang rgyu/ de yang lag len po nas las 'gan gtsang bsnams byed rgyu thag gcod thog sa yig (signature) 'god dgos pa bcas zhu ba lags/ [khra 'gu sprul ming pas/] ༄༅/ /rig pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang du bzhugs pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje yab bka' yum bka'i sgrub mchod skabs kyi mchod rdzas rnams dang*/ ser sbrengs yo byad bcas bdag gnyer byed tshul gyi sgrig gzhi/ spyi lo 2002 lor 7rgyal mchog bcu bdun pa chen pos rgya bal du yod pa'i bka' brgyud dgon sde thams cad 'tshogs 'du gnang nas/ mar lugs rgyud sde rnams kyi sgrub mchod tshugs dgos tshul gyi bka' bslab don phan dang ldan pa bstsal zhing*/ dgon pa khag so sor rgyud sde gnyis re'i sgrub mchod tshugs nas/ cho ga phyag len/ thig rdul tshon sogs ma nyams par rgyun skyong dgos tshul bka' phebs pa'i skabs/ rang dgon du mar lugs dgyes pa rdo rje yab bka' dang*/ yum bka' gnyis lhag pa'i lhar bstsal ba ni ha cang bskal pa bzang po zhig byung bas/

mchod pa'i yo byad dbang rdzas sgrub thang sogs ma tshang ba med pa rin thang che zhing spus legs 'ong ba'i thabs shes gang thon zhig byas pa'i mchod rdzas de rnams/ ji srid bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar du gces spras gang gzab kyis bar ma dor chud zos mi 'gro ba'i ched dang*/ de bzhin bla chen rnams dgon du ched phebs skabs mkho ba'i ser sbreng dang thog rol gyi yo byad rnams kyi ched/ do dam gsum bsko bzhag thog rtsis sprod byas pas/ gzhan bla grwa rgan gzhon mchog dman thams cad nas las byed do dam pa rnams la brnyas bcos dbang shed sogs mi byed par brtsi bkur dang bdag skyong byed pa'i dbang cha sprad dgos/ do dam pa rnams kyis kyang bstan don du bsam shes kyis mchod rdzas rnams bdag po yag po dgos/ gal te dgon pa la phan thogs che zhing bstan don gal chen byung na g.yar dgos pa las sger gyi 'brel ba cung zad la brten nas spyi don gal chung gis gang byung du g.yar ba sogs mi byed/ gal te gros mthun thog g.yar dgos pa byung na/ phar khyer ba'i skabs su rtsis sprad dgos pa dang*/ tshur len pa'i skabs su yang rtsis len pa dgos pa bcas thams cad kyis yid nges gnang rogs zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas mtshur lugs me khyi zla ba dang po tshes bcu la dgon 'di bstan pa yun gnas yong ba'i ched du bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /gnas kyi slob dpon dang slob ma'i bca' khrims/

spyir dge 'dun pa rnams kyi sku yon dang gcig /spyod lam dang gnyis/ lhag bsam dang gsum bcas gong 'phel dang*/ gang legs zhig bzo thub dgos pa ni dgon gyi las 'gan zhig yin la/ de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu ni/ khor yug bzang po zhig la rag las pas/ sngon du rgya gar dang bod kyi 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyis dge tshul slong gsar bu ba dang sku yon cha tshang ma rdzogs pa/ spyod lam dang lhag bsam tshugs thub pa zhig ma byung gi bar du gnas kyi slob dpon la brten dgos par dge tshul kā ri kā dang 'dul ba mdo rtsa sogs las gsal bar bstan yod stabs/ dge tshul slong bcu nas nyi shu bar la gnas kyi slob dpon re yod pa'i gra sgrig bzos pa ltar lag len bstar tshul ni/1¿ gnas kyi slob dpon rang nyid mig dpe blta ba'i yul yin pa'i phyir/ na bza' bzhes tshul sogs tshul dang mthun pa dang*/ zhogs pa snga por bzhengs nas zhal 'don nam slob sbyong la brtson 'grus gnang ba las/ dgong mor glog brnyan tshod med blta ba dang*/ zhogs par nyi ma shar nas kyang nyal nas bsdad pa sogs dang*/ 'tshogs dang chos rwa/ gso sbyong sogs la g.yas byol g.yon bros byed pa sogs mig ltos ngan pa gtan nas gnang mi rung*/ 2¿ na tsha byung ba'i skabs su sman bcos kyi thabs shes dang*/ nad g.yog gi gra sgrig/ sman rin dngos sgrub tshogs pa nas zhu rgyu dang*/ 'gro song rtsis khra dngos grub tshogs pa la 'bul rgyu sogs gnas slob kyis gzigs dgos/ slob dpon na ba'i tshe slob mas kyang de bzhin du gzigs rgyu/3¿ dgongs zhu dgos rigs dang por gnas slob la dgongs zhus kyis/ gnas slob brgyud gnas tshul gsal por mkhan slob chos khrims sogs la zhus nas dgongs pa thob nas thag gcod byed pa las/ dgongs zhu yi ge btang ba dang*/ gzhan zhig la lan bskur nas dgongs pa zhu ba sogs byed mi rung*/4¿ dus rgyun grwa pa'i sku 'gyed dang*/

po ke kri (pocket) dngul bcas ma 'thor ma brlags par nyar tshags rogs ram dang*/ dngos su gtong dgos pa byung skabs so sor rtsis khra bcas gtang rgyu/5¿ grwa pa rnams pha ma dang gnyen bshes sogs bral nas rang nyid gcig pu grogs med kher rkyang lta bur song skabs stobs chen rnams kyis dpung ngoms dang*/ nyams chung rnams skyabs med mgon med lta bu 'ong srid pas de 'dra byung na gnyis ka la bslab bya gang legs bya rgyu/6¿ grwa chas gyon tshul dang gtsang sbra bzo tshul rnams bslab rgyu dang*/ chang dang*/ bud med dang*/ 'khrig tshig rjen par smra ba sogs la dran shes bag yod dgos pa'i bslab bya yang yang gnang rgyu/7¿ dgon spyi pa'i las don la g.yo byol med par lhag bsam cher bskyed dgos pa dang*/ spyi pa'i ca dngos la ma chag/ ma ral/ skyon ma shor ba'i bdag 'dzin dang gces spras gal chen bya dgos tshul dang*/ spyi thog nas 'gro song btang ba la phangs med ma rabs kyi spyod pa mi bya bar/ rab na rang sger las spyi par gces spras che ba/ de min gces spras 'dra mnyam nges par dgos pa las/ rang gal chen dang spyi pa gal chung byed mkhan ni ma rabs tha shal yin tshul gyi bslab ston bya dgos/8¿ gnas pa rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi gnas kyi slob dpon la brtsi bkur dang*/ bslab bya gnang ba rnams la ma 'dod pa dang ma gus pa'i rnam 'gyur ngan pa spangs nas ci gsungs dang len zhu rgyu/9¿ blang dor zhe gnyis dang 'gal rigs de ma thag sgrig gzhi ltar bshags sbyangs byed du bcug nas nyes med dkar 'don bya dgos/ de ltar byung na gnas slob dang gnas pa gnyis ka byas rjes can du ngos 'dzin rgyu/ gal te gnyis ka nas gal chung byas pa'am gsang ba byas pa'i nyes skyon byung na gnyis kar nag nyes can du ngos 'dzin bya rgyu/10¿ gnas slob rnams zla stod dang zla smad kyi tshogs 'du thengs gnyis re gnang rgyu dang*/

legs bcos gang dgos skabs der thag gcod gnang rgyu/ tshogs 'du thog grwa pa so sos slob sbyong yar rgyas gang byung*/ dgongs zhus sogs gang byas/ spyod ngan rigs byung ma byung sogs re re bzhin deb thog bkod nas/ lo 'khor skabs byas rjes can la dpa' dar dang spyod ngan can la brgya phyag thugs spro'i zhal 'debs phul ba sogs nyes bshags bya rgyu bcas/ mdor na chang dang bud med kyi 'brel ba gtan du spong ba'i lag len thub pa zhig dgos/ de ltar don tshan bcu lag len bstar dgos zhes khra 'gu sprul ming pas spyi lo 2007 zla 3 tshes 21 nyin bris pa dge/༄༅/ /sgrub sde theg chen yid 'ong gling gi bca' yig da lam sgrub sde theg chen yid 'ong gling gi nyams len skor/ dbang ni rang gis mar pa dang*/ mi la/ dwags po bcas kyi bla sgrub/ gcod dang phur pa/ phag mo/ bde mchog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho bcas kyi dbang lung bgyis/ 'don bya dang*/ nyams len byed tshul sogs rim pas bslab ston byed po bla ma kun dga' rdo rje ched 'dzugs kyis mngags bya byas yod pas/ de nas bslab ston zhu rgyur ma zad/ khong la yang gus bkur dang bcas/ bslab bya sogs gang gnang dang len nges par zhus na phan thogs chen po 'byung nges dang*/ de bzhin nyams len byed mkhan phal cher khyim pa kho nar song bas/ bsgrig lam sogs dgon sde khag gi phyag bzhes lta bu ma yin par gu yangs po'i thog nas nyams len thub pa'i thabs kho na byas pa yin pas/ thams cad kyis rang don rang gces kyi nyams len la brtson 'grus bskyed thub pa zhig gal che la/ lhag par rdo rje'i mched grogs rnams dang mi mthun pa'i kha rtsod/ 'khon 'dzin/ dbyen dang phra ma sogs la spang byar 'dzin rgyu dang*/ de ltar 'byung ba'i 'phral rkyen ngan pa/ log g.yem/ chang dang a rag /bzi sman sogs yin pas/ sgrub khang 'dir 'di dag nges par spang dgos par ma zad/ tshogs 'khor gyi skabs su yang tshogs chang la shing 'bras kyi khu ba sogs myos byed kyi nus pa med pa kho na dgos shing*/

gal te nad gzhi sogs byung na 'phral du sman bcos bya ba shin tu gal che/ gtso bo sangs rgyas kyis/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*//dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad//rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul//'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa spang zhing*/ dge ba'i tshogs sgrub par brtson dgos la/ khyad par du rang gi sems nyon mongs pa'i dbang du mi shor bar yongs su 'dul nas/ zhe sdang*/ nga rgyal/ gnod sems sogs mi bya bar/ bzod pa/ byams sems/ lhag bsam dang ldan pas spyod lam zhi dul/ bag yod/ kun dang mthun pa zhig gnang rgyu gal che khra 'gu sprul ming pas/ ༄༅/ /chos la bskul ba'i tshogs glu thung ngu bzhugs so// a ho/ sngon bsags bsod nams bzang pos dal 'byor lus thob pas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma grub thob rgya mtsho yi tshogs kyis/ /byin rlabs snying la bstsal ba'i skal pa dang ldan 'dug /kha tsam min pa'i dad pa mos gus zhig bskyed mdzod/ /sngon byon mkhas grub gong ma'i bka' drin la brten nas/ /rgyud dang sgrub thabs man ngag ji snyed cig bzhugs pas/ /mchog thun dngos grub thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan 'dug /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi bsnyen sgrub la brtson mdzod/ /chos skyong ma hā kā la lcam dral dang bka' sdod/ /bu bzhin brtse bas skyong zhes zhal bzhes dang ldan pas/ /phrin las thogs med sgrub pa'i skal pa dang ldan 'dug /tshul bzhin sgrub la gzhol ba'i brtson 'grus zhig bskyed mdzod/ /'dir tshogs sgrub la brtson pa'i rdo rje yi mched grogs/ /'dir snang sgyu ma'i chos la chags zhen dag spangs te/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dga' ston tshogs 'khor la rol nas/ /grub thob brgyud pa'i man ngag nyams len la brtson mdzod//ces lta ba mthon po'i mgur dbyangs dang ldan pa'i tshogs glu zhig thos pa la brten nas/ chos la bskul ba'i tshogs glu thung thung zhig yod na phan 'bras che snyam stai khra 'gu bas bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/
