/rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa rig pa'i rdo rje mchog la rgyang 'bod gdung dbyangs kyi gsol 'debs bzhugs so// bla ma mkhyen no/ /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las rang gzugs nyid/ /'jig rten mgon gcig phyag na pad dkar 'chang*/ /bdag cag gdul bya'i mgon du mi yi zol/ /rang byung khyab bdag rig pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so rgyal dbang karma pa/ /gdung bas 'bod do rig grol ye shes mchog /thugs rgyud byin rlabs 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs/ /snyigs lnga'i rgud pas gangs ljongs rgyal ba'i bstan/ /nyams par gyur tshe me ro gso ba'i slad/ /thugs bskyed btsan pos go cha cher bgos te/ /rgyal bstan 'dzam gling tha grur spel mdzad po/ /gsol ba 'debs so rgyal dbang karma pa/ /gdung bas 'bod do rig pa'i rdo rje mchog /gtan bde'i go 'phang 'thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshul khrims rnam dag yon tan gzhi yin phyir/ /dam chos 'dul bar gces spras dgos so zhes/ /brtse ba'i gdams zab yang nas yang bstsal mod/ /ji bzhin nyams len mi nus bdag sogs la/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig rgyal dbang karma pa/ /gdung bas 'bod do rig pa'i rdo rje mchog /nyams med tshul khrims ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /thos pa'i shes rab mun sel sgron me ste/ /mdo sngags rig pa'i gnas bcas 'chad nyan gyis/ /bstan pa skyongs zhes brtse ba'i bkas bskul mod/ /ji bzhin lag len mi nus bdag sogs la/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig rgyal dbang karma pa/ /gdung bas 'bod do rig pa'i rdo rje mchog /thos bsam shes rab rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor lo tha ma'i nges don mdo sde yi/ /dgongs pa thun min gzhan stong dbu ma'i srol/ /rang lugs gzung zhes khyed kyis bka' bstsal mod/ /da dung gzhan zer rjes zlos bdag sogs la/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig rgyal dbang karma pa/ /gdung bas 'bod do rig pa'i rdo rje mchog

/nges don lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /mar rngog nas brgyud rgyud sde'i bskyed rdzogs dang*/ /thun min phyag chen chos drug gdams ngag gi /sgo 'phar yangs por phyes te bstsal mod kyang*/ /slar yang mching bu 'tshol ba bdag sogs la/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig rgyal dbang karma pa/ /gdung bas 'bod do rig pa'i rdo rje mchog /man ngag nyams len nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang man ngag gnad/ /nyams len nus na rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /tshe rabs gzhan la re ltos mi dgos zhes/ /dbugs dbyung bstsal mod le lo'i dbang shor bdag /thugs rjes gzigs shig rgyal dbang karma pa/ /gdung bas 'bod do rig pa'i rdo rje mchog /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par byin gyi rlobs/ /gdan sa gsar bzhengs bka' bstan gsar spel gyis/ /bstan pa'i me ro rmang nas gso ba yi/ /thugs bskyed bdag gir bzhes pa'i phrin las rgyun/ /mi skyong yal bar 'dor ba bdag sogs la/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig rgyal dbang karma pa/ /gdung bas 'bod do rig pa'i rdo rje mchog /bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag sogs bag med 'khrul pas nongs gyur tshe/ /byams dang thugs rjes yal bar ma dor bar/ /thabs dang shes rab zhi lhag zung 'brel gyis/ /skyon rnams spang zhing yon tan spel ba'i slad/ /nyin mtshan ltos med sku ngal khyad bsad nas/ /rjes su skyong ba'i bka' drin deng 'dir dran/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig rgyal dbang karma pa/ /gdung bas 'bod do rig pa'i rdo rje mchog /thugs yid dbyer med 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar gdungs ba'i shugs kyis gsol btab pas/ /seng ge khyung gi phru gu ji bzhin du/ /slob ma las kyang yang slob bzang ngo zhes/ /grub thob gong ma'i rdo rje'i lung gi don/ /ji bzhin bdag rgyud smin par byin gyis rlobs//zhes pa 'di dil yag sgrub dpon rin po che nas gnang skyes dang bcas rgyal mchog bcu drug pa chen por bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi gsol 'debs shig bris zhes nan tan chen pos bskul ma gnang ba bzhin/

khra 'gu sprul ming 'dzin pas gnas mchog stag mo lus sbyin du mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad khrid zhig dbu 'dzugs skabs mgon po gang gis bstan 'gro'i don chen la dgongs nas bstsal ba'i rdo rje'i gsung rnams rjes su dran bzhin gsol ba btab pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ//༄༅/ /karma pa o rgyan phrin las rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum la phebs pa'i mtshams sbyor bkra shis bde legs/ rgyal bstan 'dzam gling kun tu spel mod kyi/ /rtsa ba lta bu gangs can bod ljongs su/ /dar rgyas yun du brtan la rag las phyir/ /'dren mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po karma pa/ /rgyal dbang rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje mchog /bsam bzhin sku tshe'i 'du byed brjes nas kyang*/ /slar yang rgyal bstan me ro gso ba'i slad/ /bsil ldan ke la'i ljongs su sku bltams nas/ /bstan pa spyi dang khyad par sgrub brgyud kyi/ /ring lugs spel ba'i 'phrin las ngo mtshar can/ /mngon du gyur bas bgrang bya bcu phrag la/ /gsum gyi lhag pa'i skal bzang dga' ston 'dir/ /bka' brgyud gral mthar 'khod pa'i rgan bu yis/ /gus phyag dang bcas bkra shis bde legs zhu/ zhes byang phyogs (Canada)yi grong khyer (Vancouver)nas khra 'gu sprul ming pas gus phul/༄༅/ /karma pa o rgyan phrin las rdo rje'i 'khrungs skar gsol 'debs/ rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bdun/ o rgyan phrin las rdo rje'i/ che ba'i yon tan mjal bas/ dad gus gting nas skyes byung*/ lo ngo brgya phrag gong nas/ gter chen mchog 'gyur gling pas/ lung bstan gsal por gnang ba/ nor med 'khrul bral byung song*/ bcu drug rig pa'i rdo rjes/ mgur dbyangs sku rtsed lta bus/ lung bstan rjes su gnang bar/ nor 'khrul bral bar byung song*/ rdzu 'phrul mngon shes stobs kyis/ 'jam mgon sku phreng bzhi pa/ ngos 'dzin 'khrul med gnang bas/ ngo mtshar nges shes skyes byung*/

bcu bzhi lon pa'i byis pas/ mkhas grub che las lhag pa'i/ zab rgyas don dang ldan pa/ gsung rtsom 'gran med gnang 'dug che ba'i yon tan mjal bas/ dad gus mi skyes dbang med/ de ring 'khrungs skar dus chen/ sku tshe zhabs pad brtan cing*/ bka' brgyud bstan pa dar ba'i/ gsol 'debs smon lam zhu 'ong*/ zhes slob bu karma zla ba'i re ba ltar a ri'i nub byang snyan grags can gyi gangs ri bhe kar zhes dang nye ba'i ljon shing gi tshal du snyan ngag dang sdeb sbyor gyis ma brgyan par khra 'gu sprul ming pas go bde bar bris pas bstan pa la phan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/༄༅/ /karma pa o rgyan phrin las rdo rje'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs/ bsil ldan ljongs su dam pa'i chos kyi srol//slar yang spel ba'i go cha cher bgo ste//bsam bzhin srid du skye ba bzhes mdzad pa//o rgyan phrin las rdo rjer zhabs brtan gsol//mkhan ming 'chang ba khra 'gu pas smon pa'o//༄༅/ /bsil ldan ljongs kyi ris med rgyal bstan la/ /'phral rkyen ngan pas nyams nyes byung ba'i skabs/ /thugs bskyed dus su smin pa'i skyes chen rnams/ /rang dbang 'phags pa'i yul du byol nas kyang*/ /thabs kyis bstan pa skyong zhing spel ba yi/ /phrin las khur du bsnam pa'i gnas skabs su/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po rig pa'i rdo rje yis/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang lhag par sgrub brgyud kyi/ /ring lugs bshad sgrub las gsum gyis spel skabs/ /gzhung chen rig gnas man ngag zab mo yi/ /phyag dpe'i rgyun rnams bstan rtsar dgongs nas kyang*/ /rgyal dbang brgyad pa'i gzhung chen bka' bzhi dang*/ /bdun pas mdzad pa'i rigs gzhung rgya mtsho bcas/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam pas phyag tu bzhes mdzad de/ /bka' bstan la sogs spar bskrun gnang nas kyang*/ /bstan pa 'dzam gling khyab par spel mdzad mod/ /da dung thugs kyi dgongs pa ma khengs pa'i/ /rnam pa lta bus sku skye brjes zin cing*/

/sku yi rnam pa byis pa'i tshul bstan mod/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel ba'i ched/ /gsung rab nyams pa gso ba'i thugs bskyed rgyun/ /thugs la bag chags brtan por bzhugs pa yis/ /dpe rgyun gal chen deng 'dir dgos so zhes/ /mar lugs bskyang ba'i 'go khrid chen por yang*/ /zhum pa bral ba'i spobs pas bka' stsal nas/ /rang lugs yig cha'i rgyun bzang spel ba yis/ /bstan pa rmang nas gso bar mdzad pa yi/ /bka' drin yang yang rjes su dran nas kyang*/ /gus pas thal mo spyi bor sbyar byas nas/ /zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtshor bzhugs par smon/ /zhes khra 'gu ba rgan bus stag mo lus sbyin gyi dben gnas nas gsol ba btab pa lags/༄༅/ /'bo dkar mchog sprul myur 'byon gsol 'debs bzhugs so//

dkon mchog rin chen gsum dang rtsa ba gsum/ /thugs rje bslu med bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dwags shangs bstan pa'i gsal byed 'bo dkar rje'i/ /mchog gi sprul pa'i zla zhal myur 'byon gsol/ /lhag par mar ston chos kyi blo gros dang*/ /bzhad pa rdo rje sgam po pa la sogs/ /bka' brgyud gser ri'i phreng ba rim byon gyis/ /mchog sprul myur du 'byon par byin gyis rlobs/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ni dhi rnam gnyis dang*/ /mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor sogs/ /gser chos man ngag brgyud pa rim byon gyis/ /mchog sprul myur du 'byon par byin gyis rlobs/ /khyad par ma hā kā la ber nag can/ /thugs rje'i thugs dam dus 'dir ma dgongs na/ /phyag chen chos drug bstan pa nyams nye bas/ /mchog sprul myur du 'byon pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i/ /lha tshogs thugs dam dus las g.yel gyur na/ /dpal ldan shangs pa'i man ngag nyams la nye/ /de phyir mchog sprul myur 'byon phrin las mdzod/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rnams/ /mi mngon dbyings su bzhud par mdzad lags na/ /rgyal bstan nyag phra skyong bar su la re/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar su yis nus/ /bstan 'gro'i khur chen bzod par dka' na yang*/ /bdag cag mi bzod gdung bas 'bod lags na/ /thugs bskyed go cha btsan po slar bzhes nas/ /bstan pa skyong ba'i mchog sprul myur 'byon gsol//zhes 'bo dkar mchog sprul rin po che dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs zin par thos pas rgan bu khra 'gu bas snying nas ma bzod de gsol ba btab pa'o//༄༅/ /sprul sku blo gros nyi ma'i zhabs brtan/ chos dang chos nyid gzigs pa'i blo~X gro~Xs ni//sprin bral nyi~X ma~X'i 'od bzhin rab gsal ba'i//bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan mchog gi sprul pa'i sku//zhabs pad mi 'gyur yun ring brtan gyur cig/rang grwa 'ga' zhig nas bskul ngor khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge/༄༅/

/sprul sku dam chos kyi zhabs brtan/ rgyal dang de sras 'phags tshogs dge 'dun sde//thugs bskyed da~Xm bca' btsan po'i bden mthu yis//lung rtogs cho~Xs kyi phrin las rab 'phel zhing*//zhabs pad yun du brtan pa'i rgyur gyur cigaces zhal slob dad pa can gyis bskur ngor khra 'gu bas bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /sgrub dpon rin chen tshe ring gi zhabs brtan/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog ri~Xn che~Xn rnam gsum gyis//bden pa'i byin mthus bstan 'dzin skyes bu mchog/ sku tshe~X zhabs pad yun ri~Xng brtan nas kyang*//bstan 'gror smin (sman )pa'i mdzad phrin rgyas gyur cig/ces pa'ang khra 'gu'i sgrub grwa ba rnams kyis bskul ba ltar khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /sras mkhar bla ma 'jigs med 'od zer gyi zhabs brtan/ 'chi med mgon po tshe mtha' yas pa dang*//rnam par rgyal ma yid bzhin 'khor lo ste//rnam gsum thugs rje bden pa'i byin mthu yis//rje btsun ras pa 'jig rten khams 'di ru//slar yang byon pa sras mkhar bla ma zhes//yongs su grags pa gang de'i zhabs pad+mo//'ji~Xgs pa me~Xd par rdo rje'i khrir bzhugs te//phrin las 'o~Xd ze~Xr phyogs brgyar rab 'phro nas//rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par sgrub brgyud kyi//bstan pa 'dzam gling kun tu rgyas nas kyang*//nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa rab zhi nas//'gro rnams bde dga'i dpal la spyod gyur cig/ces sras mkhar dgon gyi gdan 'dzin pa karma phrin las dar rgyas rin po che nas gsung bskul gnang ba bzhin khra 'gu sprul ming pas bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor mdun rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /bla ma bkra shis don grub kyi zhabs brtan/ dge legs bkra~X shi~Xs dpal yon 'phel ba dang*//ston mchog do~Xn kun gru~Xb pa'i byin mthu yis//bla ma'i zhabs pad yun du brtan nas kyang*//mdzad phrin gnas dus kun tu 'phel gyur cig/ces zhal slob rnams kyis bskul ba ltar khra 'gu sprul ming pas 'jar man sgrub sde theg chen yid 'ong gling du smon pa de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/

༄༅/ /mkhan po ka mthar gyi zhabs brtan/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang*//bdag cag slob 'bangs lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus//rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal ldan kaXrma pa'i//phrin las mtha~Xr phyin byed po'i zhabs brtan gsol//zhes zhal slob rnams kyis bskul bar brten khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge/༄༅/ /nad yams zhi ba'i smon lam bzhugs so// 'jig rten mgon mchog don kun grub pa sogs//bskal bzang rnam 'dren stong gi thugs rje yis//ya nga'i nad yams 'jigs pa rab zhi nas//skye dgu ma lus bde skyid ldan gyur cig/lung rtogs gnyis bsdus zhi bsil bdud rtsi'i sgo//chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong byin mthu yis//ya nga'i nad kyi 'jigs pa rab zhi nas//mi rnams bde ba'i dpal la spyod gyur cig/'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug sogs//nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun sdes//shin tu ya nga'i nad rims zhi nas kyang*//'jig rten khams 'di bde zhing shis gyur cig/ ces khra 'gu sprul ming pas nad yams zhi ba'i smon tshig tu 5/4/2003bris pa don dang ldan par gyur cigasangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dkon mchog gsum//bla ma yi dam chos skyong rtsa gsum ste//skyabs gnas dam pa rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis//nad dang mu ge dmag gi 'jigs pa dang*//'byung bzhi 'khrugs te tsha grang ma snyoms pas//lhun chags gangs ri sra mkhregs khyags rum rnams//zhu nas nyams te chu bo mtshe'u sogs//dkon por gyur pas gdod ma'i nags tshal dang*//mdzes pa'i ljon shing dag kyang 'chir nye bas//'dzam gling khyon kun brgya ngam thang chen du//'gyur ba'i nyen kha mi zad 'byung nyen dag/rab tu zhi nas bkra shis bde skyid kyi//dpal yon bzang po rnam par 'phel nas kyang*//'gro rnams phan tshun brtse zhing byams pa yis//skyong bas dga' spro'i snang ba rab rgyas te//bsam pa'i don rnams chos bzhin 'grub gyur cig/ces skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che'i zhal slob/

tshan rig pa JohnStanley nas bskul ba ltar khra 'gu bas smon pa'o//oṃ swasti/ bal yul gnas mchog mchod rten chen po'i mdun//bkra shis chos 'khor gling zhes grags pa 'dir//bskal bzang sangs rgyas bdun pa rab gsal gyi//rnam par 'phrul pa kha che paṇa chen gyi//sdom pa'i rgyun las bsnyen par rdzogs pa yi//dge slong rnam dag thub pa'i grangs dag dang*//rab byung dge tshul bcu phrag gsum gyi thog/phar phyin drug gis 'phel ba'i dge 'dun sdes//rab gnas shing bya lo 'dir dbyar phyi ma//zhal gyis bzhes te klog pa thos bsam dang*//spong ba bsam gtan mdo sngags zung 'jug gi/nyams len dag la 'bad pa bskyed nas kyang*//'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i sman gcig pu//bstan pa mi nyams yongs su skyong ba dang*//spel ba'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo la//brtson pa'i phrin las rnam par skyong ba yis//rgyal bstan 'phel zhing de mthus yul khams 'dir//nad mug mtshon gyi bskal ngan rab zhi nas//skye dgu zhi bde'i dpal la spyod gyur cig/ces rgan bu khra 'gu bas dben gnas stag mo lus sbyin du bris pa de bzhin 'grub par rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rin chen rnam pa gsum gyi byin mthu yis//bdag ni mthong dang thos pa'i 'gro rnams la//byams dang snying rje byang chub sems skyes nas//chos 'byor bde dga'i dpal la spyod gyur cig/ces khra 'gu sprul ming pas hong kong grong khyer du smon pa'o//phan bde'i bsil zer rgyas pa'i zla~X gzhon gyis//bstan dang 'gro la bza~Xng po'i phrin las can//gang gis dam cho~Xs spel ba'i sde 'di dag/phun sum tsho~Xgs pa'i dge mtshan 'bar gyur cig/ces 2004 lor khra 'gu sprul ming pas smon pa dge legs 'phel/byin rlabs chags shing gzi brjid dang ldan pa//'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po dang mtshungs sku~X//gang gi zhabs pad lo brgyar rab brtan pa//sanga~Xs rgya~Xs dkon mchog bden pas shis pa stsol//deng 'dir yul gru spyi dang khyad par du//hong kong gling gi skye 'gro ma lus par//blang dor ston mdzad gang gsu~Xng 'jig rten 'dir//da~Xm cho~Xs dkon mchog byin mthus gnas gyur cig/pha mar gyur pa'i yid can skye dgu la//phan bde'i phrin las 'byung ba byams brtse'i thu~Xgs//byang chub sems kyis yongs su gtams pa nyid//dge~X 'du~Xn dkon mchog bden pas brtan gyur cig/ces mgon po gang nyid dgung grangs brgyad cur byon pa'i rten 'brel shis pa'i smon tshig tu spyi lo 2005

zla 3 tshes 10 nyin khra 'gu sprul ming pas phul/༄༅/ /bod rgyal lo 2127 gnam lo gsar du bzhad pa'i dga' ston la bkra shis bde legs grangs med zhu/rnam dag lhag bsam bzang pos nyer drangs pa'i//chos mthun sbyin pa gnang ba'i legs byas kyis//shes rig dpal yon bzang po 'phel ba'i mthus//'dzam gling kun tu bde dga' 'bar gyur cig/ya nga'i nad rigs ma lus dbyings su yal//'dzam gling dpal 'byor phywa g.yang nyams pa gsos//'jigs bskul ring lugs bsam sbyor rab zhi bar//rin chen gsum gyis lo 'dir shis pa stsol//sā li'i ljon shing rgyas pa'i nags tshal na//byang sems sprul pa sprel rgan las brgyud pa'i//gangs ri'i ljongs su skyes pa'i mi rigs kyi//dam chos 'dzam gling kun tu spel 'di rgyal//dwangs bsil yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo dang*//lhan cig 'grogs pa cang shes rta mchog gi/gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i rten 'byung du// bkra shis bde legs smon tshig bcas te phul//stong tsho gnyis dang nyag ma drug gi lo//gsar du tshes pa'i bskal bzang dga' ston du//bkra shis bde legs snang ba 'bum 'char bar// rin chen rnam pa gsum gyis shis pa stsol//nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs//nyin mo'i gung yang bde legs shing*//nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa//dkon mchog gsum gyis bkra shis shog/nad dang mu ge mtshon gyi bskal ngan dag/yongs su zhi zhing dga' dang bde ba yi//dpal la spyod pa'i skye 'gro ma lus pa//phan tshun brtse zhing byams pas skyongs gyur cig/ khra 'gu bas bris/dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum byin mthu yis//me mo phag gi gnam lo gsar tshes 'dir// nad mug mtshon gyi rgud pa rab zhi nas//bde skyid rdzogs ldan dpal yon 'phel gyur cig/ces khra 'gu bas smon pa'o//sa la'i ljon shi~Xng rgyas pa'i nags tshal du//byang chub sems dpa' spre~Xl rgan tshul 'dzin pas//mi'u gdung drug spel bas bkra~X shi~Xs kyi//dga' ston bzang por bde~X lega~Xs 'phel gyur cig/ces khra 'gu bas hong kong 'brug dgu 'dzoms pa'i dga' tshal du smon pa dge/yangs pa'i khyon kun ljon shi~Xng nags tshal dag gis khyab pa dang*//skye bo pho mo~X rnams kyang dpal 'byor longs spyod rab rgyas shing*//bcu gnyis rten 'brel khams las bya~X yi rgyal po'i lo~X 'di la~X//tshe ring nad med bkra~X shi~Xs dpal dang bde~X le~Xgs rgyas gyur cig/ces khra 'gu bas smon pa'o//gangs can skad yig la bzhugs chos 'khor mdo//rig pa'i rdo rje slob gnyer khang nas phul//de dges rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che//'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon du rgyas gyur cig/phyi lo 2002

zla 1 tshes 8 nyin wā ra ṇa sī badz+ra bid+yā gtsug lag slob gnyer khang du khra 'gu sprul ming pas smon pa dge legs su gyur cig/dkon mchog bla ma rnams kyi byin mthu yis//chos mthun bgyi ba bzang po dang ldan zhing*//lha mo rje btsun sgrol mas rjes bzung nas//bde skyid rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod gyur cig/ces slob ma rnams kyis bskul ngor khra 'gu sprul ming pas og si phor ḍi'i (Oxford) grong khyer du bris pa dge legs 'phel/'dir gnas gzhi yi bdag po 'khor bcas la//gser skyems dkar phud gtsang ma 'di phul bas//sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*//mchog thun dngos grub sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod//khra 'gu sprul ming pas/gnas mchog wā ra ṇā sī rig pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang du bslab sbyang gnang ba'i grwa/ ( 'dir ming bris dgos/ ) 'di nyid mkhas pa'i yon tan/ shes rig gi 'dab ma rgyas shing thos bsam gyi rtsal rdzogs nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga/ rig gnas dag sum snyan gsum bcas mthar phyin cing 'chad spel gyi nyams myong yang lo kha shas bsags yod/ btsun pa'i yon tan dge tshul slong gi sdom pa thob la ma nyams shing bslab pa la gces spras che bas/ tshul khrims kyi skyon che phra dag la mthong thos dwogs gsum gyi dri mas ma gos pa/ bzang po'i yon tan/ rang thog tu babs pa'i las 'gan gang 'os byed pa las/ las don dman pa'i rigs ma mos par che 'dod byed pa'am/ las 'gan lci ba byung na g.yas gzur g.yon zol byed pa ma yin zhing*/ gshis ngan g.yo sgyu/ dbyen dang phra ma/ ngan shed dpung ngoms byed pa sogs kyi nyes skyon lo mang rgyun 'khyong du+u gtan nas ma byung bar ma zad/ bstan pa la phan pa'i lhag bsam mi dman pa zhig yin par brten/ mkhan por mnga' gsol zhing che 'don byas pa yin pas bstan pa skyong zhing 'gro la phan pa'i bgyi ba gang gzab zhig gnang rogs bka' drin zhu/

khra 'gu sprul ming pas bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor du phyi lo 2003 zla ba 10 tshes 10 la bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo phul nas chos ston par gsol ba'i sku brnyan/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas shing sgrol rgyu'i drung du bzhugs pa'i tshe rang gis rnyed pa'i chos zab mo de 'jig rten pa kun gyis mi rtogs par dgongs te/zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas//bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos zhig bdag gis rnyed//su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas//mi smra nags 'dab nyid du gnas par bya//zhes gsungs te/ bzhugs pa na tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul nas chos ston par gsol ba btab pa'i sku brnyan/༄༅/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar g.yas 'khyil phul nas chos ston par gsol ba'i sku brnyan/ lha tshangs pas bcom ldan 'das la chos ston par gsol ba btab kyang ma gnang ba na brgya byin grogs su sbran te lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas gdul bya rnams kyi dbang po'i rim pa legs par gzigs te bdud rtsi'i sgo dbye bar zhal gyis bzhes pa na de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ro zhes pa'i sgra tshangs ris kyi bar du grags pa ltar lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phul nas gsol ba btab pa'i sku brnyan/༄༅/ /gtsug lag khang srung ba'i rgyal chen bzhi yi sku brnyan/ yab rgyal po zas gtsang gis rgyal byed tshal gyi bkod pa la dpe blangs nas grong khyer ser skya n+ya gro dha yi kun dga' rwa ba'i gtsug lag khang brtsig /der bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la lding ste byon pas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa dad par gyur te/ zas gtsang dang lhas byin gnyis ma gtogs rgyun du bzhugs pa'i 'bras bu la bkod/

de nas yab la phan btags pa'i phyir n+ya gro dha yi kun dga' rwa ba na lha rnams kyi khang bzang gi bkod pa rdzu 'phrul gyis bskrun te/ de yi nang du bcom ldan 'das kyis lha yi 'khor 'ba' zhig la chos ston cing bzhugs pa na/ rgyal po chen po bzhi yis sgo bzhi srung nas yab zas gtsang gis nang du son par ma nus par phyi rol du lus pa na/ ston pas khang bzang de nyid rin po che shel gyi rang bzhin du sprul te sku ma sgrib par bzhugs nas chos ston pas yab rgyal po bden pa mthong ba la rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ rgyal po chen po bzhi gtsug lag khang gi sgo srung du bzhugs pa'i phyag srol ltar/ shar phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung*/ lho phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ nub phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po spyan mi bzang*/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras bcas kyi sku brnyan/༄༅/ /byams brtse'i bka' slob/

bkra shis gling gi slob grwar/ pha ma bzang po'i drin las/ chos dang rig gzhung gnyis la/ sbyang ba'i go skabs thob byung*/ 'dzam gling nub phyogs rig gsar/ blta ba'i mig dang 'dra ba/ hi ma la yi rig gzhung*/ khog pa'i snying dang 'dra 'dug /de gnyis mnyam du 'dzoms na/ dga' sprod bde skyid thob yong*/ nga tsho slob phrug pho mo/ slob sbyong yag po bgyis dang*/ shes yon bde skyid mi tshe/ thag ring rgyang la mi 'dug /lag pa'i mthil la len chog /chang dang tha mag nag po/ pha mar brtse gdung med pa/ spyod ngan mi rigs zhabs 'dren/ rgyang thag ring por g.yugs shog /drin can pha ma'i lam ston/ dge rgan bzang po'i bslab bya/ ma brjed sems la bzhag na/ skyid pa'i nyi ma shar yong*/ zhes slob grwa 'di nyid gsar 'dzugs byed po khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge/༄༅/ /7skyabs rje mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog nas bstsal ba'i bka' slob/ dpal bkra shis gling slob grwa de nyid thog mar btsug dgos don ni/ khyed slob bu rnams shes yon dang ldan pa zhig 'byung zhing*/ rang rang so so'i mi tshe de bde skyid kyi ngang 'tsho thub pa zhig 'byung ba'i ched du yin/ de lta'i mi tshe don ldan bde skyid kyi ngang 'tsho thub pa zhig 'ong ba la shes yon nges par du dgos pas khyed slob phrug rnams nas slob sbyong la 'bad brtson gang drag byed dgos/ de ltar byas tshe ma 'ongs par chen po chags skabs mi tshe skyid po zhig gi ngang 'tsho thub pa 'ong*/ lus tshad chen po chags pa dang shes yon mtho tshad slebs skabs kyang lus ngag gi kun spyod gang legs byed dgos pa ni lhag par du gal che/ mdor na shes yon dang ldan zhing kun spyod yang gang legs yod na rang gi mi tshe bde skyid kyi ngang gtan du 'tsho thub pa 'ong*/ ༄༅/ /dpal khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling gi ches mtho'i bshad grwa chen mo'i lo rgyus snying bsdus bzhugs so//

spyir bal yul mchod rten rnam pa gsum gyi ya gyal stag mo lus sbyin 'di nyid bdag cag gi ston mchog shākya'i dbang pos/ slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su rgyal bu snying stobs chen por skye ba bzhes nas/ sku lus stag mo bkres pas nyen pa la 'phangs med du sbyin pa btang ba'i gnas mchog khyad par can du song stabs gnas 'di nyid du chos kyi phrin las 'byung ba/ spyir 'dzam gling*/ lhag par bal bod kyi yul gru dag tu+u nad mug 'khrugs rtsod sogs dus kyi rgud tshogs zhi ba dang*/ bde skyid bkra shis legs tshogs 'phel zhing rgyas pa ni/ ston pa dang bstan pa'i byin rlabs las 'byung bar nges pas/ chos sde 'di nyid/ 1978 lor gsar bzhengs kyi dbu 'dzug zhus pa yin la/ de yang ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rjes su 'jug cing dam pa'i chos nyams su len cing bstan pa 'dzin pa'i tshul ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ston pa'i bstan pa rnam gnyis te//lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do//de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang*//sgrub par byed pa kho na'o//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che rnam pa gnyis la 'jug dgos pas/ lung gi chos bka' dang bstan bcos la thos bsam dang*/ 'chad nyan byed pa'i bshad grwa dang*/ rtogs pa'i chos mdo sngags kyi lam la nyams len gnang ba'i sgrub grwa med na/ chos sde dang dgon pa zhes pa dam pa'i chos kyi gzugs brnyan lta bu zhig tu 'gyur bas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying po lta bu bshad grwa dang sgrub grwa ni shin tu gal che ba lags te/ de la dang po bshad grwa yang*/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la bslab sbyang gi sgo nas bstan pa dam pa'i chos dang*/ de ston pa'i ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la nges shes khyad par can bskyed par nus pa'i bstan bcos/ 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*/ slob dpon thogs med/

chos kyi grags pa/ dbyig gnyen dang*/ zla ba grags pa sogs yongs su grags pa'i rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rnams kyi gsung*/ dbu ma/ sher phyin/ mngon pa/ 'dul ba bcas gzhung chen bzhi dang*/ ma zad mngon sum dang rjes dpag gi rig shes tshad ma bskyed byed tshad ma'i bstan bcos te/ gzhung chen bka' pod lngar grags pa dang*/ khyad par thun mong ma yin pa'i sgom rim gyi gzhi sems dang*/ lus dang*/ lha yi gnas lugs gsal bar bstan pa bstan bcos chen po rgyud bla ma/ zab mo nang gi don/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa bcas la thos bsam gnang dgos pa dang*/ de dag gi dgongs pa zab cing gting dpog dka' ba rnams ji lta bar rtogs pa'i phyir/ rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs 'grel/ rgyal dbang karma pa chen po sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje dang*/ bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho/ brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho sogs kyis mdzad pa'i dgongs 'grel khag la bslab sbyang lo lnga'am bcur gnang ba'i sgo nas/ nges don gyi mdo sde dang*/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde zab mo rnams kyi dgongs pa ji lta bar rtogs shing*/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba sgom pa spyod pa sogs kyi gnad legs par mkhyen pa'i tshul sngon gyi dus dpal na leṇ+ḍa yi gtsug lag khang la sogs par thos bsam 'chad nyan gnang ba'i phyag srol mi nyams shing*/ bshad pa tshig gi brgyud pa bar ma chad par skyong ba'i bshad grwar thos bsam byed pa ni/ rang nyid kyi shes yon mthar phyin pas phan thogs che bar ma zad/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas yun ring spel zhing skyong ba'i thabs rmad du byung ba lags so//dpal khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling gi ches mtho'i bshad grwa chen mo'i lo lnga'i ring thos bsam bya rgyu'i slob tshan gsham gsal/

lo rim dang po la/ 1 rje dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i spyod 'jug 'grel pa zab rgyas mtha' yas snying po/ 2 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi shes bya mdzod las sdom gsum rtsa 'grel/3 blo bzang tshul khrims byams pa rgya mtsho'i rigs lam 'phrul gyi lde mig4 dwags po rin po che'i lam mchog rin chen phreng ba/5 dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje'i legs bshad ljon dbang gi rtsa 'grel/6 khu nu bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyi dag yig ngag sgron 'grel pa/lo rim gnyis pa la/1 rje brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i 'jug 'grel dwags brgyud grub shing*/2 mi pham rin po che'i dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel pa 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i zhal lung*/ 3 rje bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i tshad ma rigs gzhung rgya mtsho las/ le'u dang po tshad ma grub pa'i le'u/4 dngul chu dharma bha dra'i sum rtags 'grel pa si tu'i zhal lung*/5 dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje'i dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long gi 'grel pa/lo rim gsum pa la/1 rje brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa rje btsun ngal gso/2 dwags po rin po che'i thar rgyan/3 rje bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i tshad ma rigs gzhung rgya mtsho las/ le'u gnyis pa mngon gsum gyi le'u/4 dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje'i ming gi mngon brjod/5 bod mkhas pa'i snyan ngag daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs rgyan gyi don rgyan so lnga las/ rang bzhin brjod pa nas dpe rgyan bar/6 mi pham rin po che'i sa mtha'i rnam dbye/lo rim bzhi pa la/1 rje brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa grub bde'i dpyid 'jo/2 rje bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i tshad ma rigs gzhung rgya mtsho las/ le'u gsum pa rang don rjes dpag gi le'u/3 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i 'grel pa rang byung dgongs rgyan/4

'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi snying po bstan pa'i 'grel pa rang byung dgongs gsal/5 bod mkhas pa'i snyan ngag daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs rgyan gyi don rgyan so lnga las gzugs can gyi rgyan nas rgya che ba'i rgyan bar/6 si tu'i sum rtags 'grel chen mu tig phreng mdzes las/ sum cu pa'i 'grel pa/lo rim lnga pa la/1 rje brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba'i 'grel chen nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/2 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa phyir m-i ldog pa seng ge'i nga ro/3 karma nges don bstan rgyas kyi phyag chen smon lam 'grel pa dwags brgyud dgongs rgyan/ 4 rje bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i tshad ma rigs gzhung rgya mtsho las/ le'u bzhi pa gzhan don rjes dpag gi le'u/5 bod mkhas pa'i snyan ngag daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs rgyan gyi don rgyan so lnga las/ bsnyon dor rgyan nas dgongs pa can rgyan bar/ 6 si tu'i sum rtags 'grel chen mu tig phreng mdzes las/ rtags 'jug gi 'grel pa/ stag mo lus sbyin khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling bshad grwa'i slob sbyong re'u mig snga dro/ chu tshod/ mdzad rim/ 5 30 nas 6 sku gzhengs dang zhal khrus gnang rgyu/ 6 0 nas 7 rtsa ba zhal 'don gnang rgyu/7 nas 7 30 snga dro'i gsol ja/ 7 30nas 8 phyi nang gtsang sbra/8 0nas 9 0 'dzin grwa9 0nas 10 'dzin grwa10 nas 11 'dzin grwa 11 nas 12 'dzin grwa12 nas 1 nyin dgung zhal lag phyi dro/ chu tshod/ mdzad rim/1 0 nas 2 0 gtor bsngo mkha' dbyings ma/ 2 0 nas 3 0 rang sbyong*/ 3 0 nas 3 30 phyi dro'i gsol ja/ 3 30 nas 4 30 nang sbyong*/ 4 30 nas 6 0 rtsa ba blo 'dzin/ 6 0 nas 7 0 dgong mo'i zhal lag 7 0 nas 8 30 skyor sbyong*/ 8 30 nas 10 30 rtsod pa/ 10 30 sku gzims/ ༄༅/ /dpal khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling gi sgrub sde'i lo rgyus snying bsdus bzhugs so// gnyis pa sgrub grwa yang*/ ji skad du/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/

/sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i mkhan slob khyad par can gyi drung nas/ tshigs gsum rim nod kyis dge tshul slong gi sdom pa zhus nas ji srid 'tsho yi bar du'am/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ mi nyams par srung ba'i dam bca' brtan po'i sgo nas/ chos la thos bsam gyis shes pa tsam ma yin par nyams su len dgos te/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis/ sgom par mi nus lta ba yang*//phyug po ser snas bcing pa 'dra//rang gzhan dgos pa'i 'bras mi byin//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyir dam pa'i chos kyi gnas tshul shes pa legs mod/ 'on kyang gal te nyams len ma byas na mthar thug gi 'bras bu mi thob pas nyams len gal che zhing*/ de yang gcig pur dben par gnas pa las/ sgrub grwar nyams len gnang ba ches bzang ste/ de yang ras pa zhi ba 'od kyis/ chos mthun grogs po dge sbyor gyi rten//zhes gsungs pas dad pa dang*/ brtson 'grus 'phel zhing*/ le lo dang*/ snyom las bzlog pa la chos mthun bla ma dang grogs kyis bskul ma 'byung ba'i phyir/ de yang las dang po pa'i nyams len nas brtsam/ lam rim pa bzhin nyams su len dgos pas/ thog mar chos kyi bag chags brtan por 'byung ba'i phyir mi rtag par sgom pa sogs thun mong gi sngon 'gro blo ldog rnam pa bzhi nas brtsam/ lam thams cad kyi rmang gzhi skyabs 'gro dang phyag 'tshal/ sngar byas kyi las ngan dang*/ gnas skabs kyi nyon mongs dang*/ rnam rtog rags pa bcas zhi ba'i ched rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ nyams rtogs rgyud la skye ba'i mthun rkyen bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i ched maṇ+ḍal dang*/ gcod kyi lus mchod sbyin/ sgom rgyud la skye ba byin rlabs la rag las pa'i phyir spyi dang bye brag gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ kun slong khyad par can byams pa dang*/ snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems bcas ma skyes pa skye ba dang*/

skyes pa mi nyams shing gong du spel ba'i blo sbyong*/ bdag gzhan brje ba/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa/ bdag las gzhan gces sgom pa sogs sngon 'gro'i nyams len dang*/ dngos gzhi rgyud sde chen po rnams nas gsungs pa'i yi dam gyi bskyed rim spyi dang*/ lhag par rje mar pa lo tsās dpal nā ro pa'i drung nas zhus pa/ mar pa'i mgur las/ rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rje zhus//yang snying 'khor lo bde mchog zhus//zhes pa ltar snying po yang snying du gyur pa 'khor lo bde mchog gi bskyed rim dang*/ de yang thabs yab kyi rnam pa dang*/ shes rab yum gyi rnam par sgrub pa gnyis las shes rab dang ye shes gtso bor bton nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nyams len/ de yang snyan brgyud kyi tshul byung ba/ phyi sgrub/ nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub la brten nas bskyed rim mthar phyin pa dang*/ rdzogs rim zab mo thabs lam rtsa rlung thig le sogs la brten nas sgom pa nā ro chos drug grol lam sems nyid kyi gnas lugs thad kar ngo sprod nas sgom pa phyag rgya chen po bcas la nyams len gnang nas/ kha bshad go ba skam pos thos pa kha khyer dang*/ blun sgom rmongs dad/ gol shor gyi dbang du ma gtang bar smin byed kyi dbang*/ grol byed kyi khrid/ rgyab rten gyi lung bcas brgyud pa cung zad kyang ma nyams pa dang*/ lhag par nyams len byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa la brten nas/ rab lo gsum gyis grub pa thob pa/ 'bring drod rtags kyi yon tan ci rigs skye ba/ tha mas kyang nyams su blang nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam sne ma nor zin pa sogs sgrub khang gi dgos pa dang*/ phan yon khyad par can dang ldan pa lags/ zhes khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti/ sngon rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i sku yi skye rabs 'dzin pa rgyal po snying stobs chen pos sku lus 'phangs med bkres pa'i stag mor sbyin pa btang ste gshegs shul gnas mchog stag mo lus sbyin zhes grags pa ru sgrub sde dpal khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling du nā ro chos drug thun min gyi lo gsum phyogs gsum mtshams bsnyen sgrub nyams len gnang tshul dus tshod gsham gsal/rdo rje phur pa zhag bdun/

dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhag gsum/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa zhag gsum/ las rgyu 'bras zhag gsum/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs zhag gsum/ skyabs phyag sbrag ma zhag bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ yig brgya bzlas pa zhag sum cu/ maṇ+ḍal zhag sum cu/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhag bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ rje mar pa'i bla sgrub zhag sum cu/ sgrub mchod zhag gsum/ rje mi la'i bla sgrub zhag nyer gcig /rje dwags po'i bla sgrub zhag nyer gcig /rje karma pak+shi'i bla sgrub zhag nyer gcig /dkon mchog spyi 'dus/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhag gcig /'chi ba mi rtag pa zhag gcig /las rgyu 'bras zhag gcig 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs zhag gcig /phyi sgrub zhag bdun/ nang sgrub zhag bdun/ gsang sgrub zhag bdun/ yang gsang sgrub pa zhag bdun/ tshe sgrub zhag bdun/ las bzhi zhag gcig /sbyin sreg zhag gcig /blo sbyong don bdun ma zhag bco lnga/ zhi gnas zhag bco lnga/ lhag mthong zhag bco lnga/ phag mo'i phyi sgrub zhag drug cu/ nang sgrub zhag brgya dang nyi shu tham pa/ gsang sgrub zhag bdun/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa zhag bdun/ sbyin sreg mi grangs 'gro dgos/ 'khor lo bde mchog phyi sgrub zhag brgya dang so lnga/ nang sgrub zhag bdun/ gsang sgrub zhag bdun/ sbyin sreg zhag gcig /nā ro chos drug dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhag gsum/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa zhag gsum/ las rgyu 'bras zhag gsum/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs zhag gsum/ gtum mo zhag drug cu/ sgyu lus zhag nyer lnga/ rmi lam zhag sum cu/ 'od gsal zhag nyer gcig /bar do zhag bcu bdun/ 'pho ba zhag bcu gsum/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho phyi sgrub brgya dang nyer gcig nang sgrub zhag bdun/ gsang sgrub zhag bdun/ yang gsang sgrub zhag bdun/ dril sgrub zhag bdun/ sbyin sreg zhag gcig /'od dpag phyi sgrub zhag nyer gcig 'pho ba zhag bdun/ sgrub mchod zhag gsum/ sbyin sreg zhag gcig /gcod tshogs rin chen phreng ba zhag bzhi bcu/ gcod gdan thog gcig ma zhag bdun/

sbyin sreg gcig sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo zhag bdun/ sgrub mchod zhag bdun/ sbyin sreg zhag gcig༄༅/ /stag mo lus sbyin khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling sgrub khang gi thun gyi sgrig gzhi gsham gsal bkod pa/

snga dro/ dus tshod/ mdzad rim/ 3 00 nas 6 00 tho rangs kyi thun/ 6 00 nas 7 00 chab gtor dang bsang gsung rgyu/ 7 00 nas 8 00 snga dro'i gsol ja bzhes rgyu/ 8 00 nas 11 00 snga dro'i thun/ 11 00 nas 12 00 zhal lag bzhes rgyu/ phyi dro/ dus tshod/ mdzad rim/ 1 00 nas 3 00 dgong thun/ 3.00 nas 4.30 gsol ka gsung rgyu/ 4 30 nas 6 00 phur gsol gsung rgyu/ 6 00 nas 7 30 dgong mo'i zhal lag 7 30 nas 9 00 srod thun/ 9 00 nas 10 00 gcod gsung rgyu/ ༄༅/ /wā ṇa badz+ra bid+yā gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gsar bzhengs zhus pa'i dgos pa/ yul wā rā ṇa sī drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags tshal 'di nyid bdag cag gi ston mchog thub pa'i dbang pos zhi bsil dam pa'i chos kyi sgo 'phar thog mar dbye ba'i gnas mchog khyad par can du gyur pa'i phyir/ gnas 'dir dam pa'i chos 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyi gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde bcas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa zhig byung na/ spyir 'dzam gling yongs la bde skyid 'byung ba dang*/ lhag par rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang*/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs gnyis su snod bcud kyi rgud pa zhi zhing*/ srid zhi'i legs tshogs 'phel zhing rgyas pa ni/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus las gsal bar mkhyen pa zhig ste/ sngon dus drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags tshal sogs/ ston pa'i gnas chen rnams su rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas pa'i dus/ spyir 'dzam gling yongs rdzogs zhi bder gnas shing*/ dmigs bsal du rgya gar yul gru 'di nyid chos rgyal chen po a sho ka sogs rgyal rabs rim par byon pa'i rgyal 'bangs yongs kyis snod bcud rnams bskyangs ba'i skabs dpal 'byor longs spyod/ shes rig yon tan sogs phul du byung bas rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul zhes 'dzam gling yongs la grags pa byung zhing*/ phyis gnas chen rnams dang*/ nā lan+dā sogs gtor bshig byung bar brten/

'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon kun tu dmag chen dang po/ gnyis pa sogs nad mug mtshon gyi bskal ngan ya nga ba byung zhing*/ rgya gar gyi yul gru 'di nyid kyang*/ nad 'khrugs dang*/ phyi rgyal gyi dbang 'og tu tshud pa sogs mi mthun 'gal rkyen sna tshogs zhig byung la/ phyis dge bsnyen chen po dharma pā las drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags tshal 'dir/ mūl gan+dha ku ṭi'i gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs sogs kyis/ dam pa'i chos kyi me ro slar yang gnas 'dir gso bar mdzad pa'i rten 'byung phun sum tshogs pa la brten nas/ 'dzam gling gi khyon du yang*/ dmag chen gsum pa phyir bsrings bas skye 'gro mang po sdug bsngal las bskyabs pa dang*/ rgya gar du yang rang dbang rang btsan gtsang ma thob cing*/ rgyal yongs gcig bsgril gyi bde skyid nyi ma shar ba 'di lta bu dang*/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs su yang*/ rig gnas gsar brje zhes chos dang rig gzhung rtsa gtor dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams kyi dbus ya rabs shes yon spyod bzang ldan pa rnams la dbu nyes 'byung rgyu dngos mthong byung ba'i skabs/ gnas mchog rdo rje gdan dang*/ wā rā ṇa sī sogs gnas chen rnams su byang chub chen po'i tshogs pas ston pa'i mdzad pa rjes dran gyi dus chen gnang ba dang stabs khel gyis bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen mang po zhig gnas mjal dang*/ mchod 'bul ched chibs bsgyur gnang bas sgo phyes te/ de rjes rim par chos lugs chen po lnga yi mdo sngags rigs gzhung*/ nyams len man ngag rig gnas bslab sbyang sogs ma nyams par skyong thub pa ma zad/ byang mtha' is si lenaḍi (Iceland) nas lho mtha' ni'u si lenaḍi (New Zealand) bar/ 'dzam gling ril po 'di'i yul gru rnams su bod kyi chos tshogs/ dpe mdzod/ gtsug lag khang*/ sgrub khang*/ mchod rten sogs kyis khyab cing 'phel ba 'di nyid spyir ston pa thugs rje can gyi bka' drin dang lhag par ston pa'i gnas chen rnams la byi dor byas pa'i rten 'brel bzang po'i 'bras rtags kho nar nges pa bzhin/

da lam gyi skabs su yang 'dzam gling spyi dang*/ khyad par 'phags bod gnyis su rgud pa zhi zhing bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi dpal yon 'char ba'i smon lam dang*/ kun slong bzang po'i mtshams sbyor gyis/ khra 'gu yid ches dge rtsa'i tshogs pa nas/ phyi lo 1990 lor sa cha gtsang nyos thog phyi lo 1993 phyi zla 12 pa'i tshes 18 nyin rmang rdo bzhag ste/ rim par gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs zhus pa lags shing*/ de yang bkod pa mig lam du mdzes chos tsam ma yin par sngon rgya gar du ston pa zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs mnyan yod mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' rwa ba dang*/ ser skya'i gnas n+ya gro dha yi kun dga' rwa ba la sogs par gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge 'dun rnams nyon mongs dang rnam rtog zhi zhing*/ ting 'dzin dang ye shes 'phel bar ma zad/ dad mjal gyi skye bo pho mo rnams kyi dad gus spro ba brtas pa'i byin mthu dang ldan pa dag la dper byas nas/ dharma a sho ka sogs chos rgyal rnams dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub sogs 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i mkhas grub chen po rnams kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams 'dul ba gnas mal gyi gzhi dang mthun la/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len 'phel ba'i ched/ rgyud sde zab mo rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pas brgyan te shing brtsegs/ rgya phibs/ bya 'dab sogs phyi yi rnam pa dang*/ ka ba/ bre gzhu che chung sogs nang gi mdzes bkod kyis brgyan pa'i phyag srol byung la/ de bzhin bod yul gangs can du sprul pa'i chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spel ba'i ched/ lha sa dga' bzhi 'phrul snang dang bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang sogs gsar bzhengs skabs/ o dan+ta pū rī bkod pa la dpe gnang ba'i lo rgyus ltar sngon gyi phyag srol ma nyams pa zhig gal che ba'i phyir na/ bu ston rin chen grub kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsang zha lu'i gser khang dang rgyal dbang karma pa chos grags rgya mtshos bzhengs pa'i karma'i g.yen mo che sogs la dpe byas nas/

pha ran si'i ar ki kreg car rdo mi ne nas bkod pa bzos te/ don med rgyas spros dang*/ stabs bde bya bral ba'i lugs te mtha' gnyis su ma lhung bar gsar bzhengs zhus pa yin la/ de skabs shing lung gsi yi mkhan po theg chen lugs kyi dge slong ma gsi shing tshun dang*/ sbyin bdag tshan lis ha gnyis sogs sbyin bdag rnams kyis gtong phod kyi phyag yangs por brkyangs pa la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal nas dka' spyad khur du blangs te sa gsar du nyos/ rang dgon gyi las byed pa gcen po yon tan rgya mtsho dang*/ bkra shis tshe dbang*/ bstan 'dzin rdo rje gsum gtsos rang dgon gyi las byed pa rnams kyis dka' tshegs khyad du bsad de/ gron chung sbyin bdag gi dad rdzas mig sman mig thog tu btang thub pa bcas la bka' drin shin tu che zhing*/ sngon bskal pa bzang ba'i dus su yang*/ gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs skabs/ mthar thug bsod nams kyi tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i rgyur 'gro ba smos med kyang gnas skabs tsam du khral dang*/ las bskul sogs kyi dka' ngal mchis mod/ skabs 'dir ston pa sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnas chen gyi byin rlabs la brten nas/ 1 sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i go skabs thob pa'i dga' ba/ 2 sa rdo shing sogs kyi las byed pa rnams las ka thob pa'i dga' ba/ 3 bye ma rdo lcags tshong pa rnams tshong rdzas brin pa'i dga' ba/ 4 sa cha'i bdag po rnams gong tshad mi dman tsam thob pa'i dga' ba/ 5 rang re'i bla grwa rnams gnas chen khyad par can la gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i dga' ba/ 6 ma 'ongs par dge 'dun rnams spang klog la brtson pa'i dga' ba/ 7 dad ldan gnas mjal ba rnams tshogs gsog yul thob pa'i dga' ba ste rgyal srid kyi grangs ldan byung bas dga' ba bdun ldan/ badz+ra bid+yā'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid phyi lo 1999

lor gsar bzhengs grub pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mi nyams dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ces khra 'gu sprul ming pas bod rgyal lo 2126 rab byung bcu bdun pa sa mo yos kyi lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga rgyal bas dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen nyin smon lam btab pa'o//༄༅/ /gnas mchog stag mo lus sbyin mchod rten gyi lo rgyus mdo mdzangs blun las btus pa bzhugs so// bal yul mchod rten rnam pa gsum zhes yongs su grags pa'i gnas mchog bla na med pa'i ya gyal/ stag mo lus sbyin 'di nyid ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog gis slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su stag mo shin tu bkres pas mnar ba la rang nyid kyi sku lus phangs med du sbyin pa btang ba'i gnas yin par stag mos zhus pa'i mdo la sogs pa nas gsal por ngos 'dzin gnang bas 'khrul pa dang bral ba'i gnas mchog khyad du 'phags pa'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon 'das pa'i dus bskal pa grangs med pa'i snga rol na 'dzam bu gling 'di na rgyal po shing rta chen po zhes bya ba yod de/ rgyal phran lnga stong snyed la dbang byed do/ /rgyal po de la yang sras gsum mnga' ste/ rab ni sgra chen po zhes bya'o/ /'bring ni lha chen po zhes bya'o/ /tha chung ni sems can chen po zhes bya ste/ sras tha chung de chung ngu nas byams pa dang snying rjer ldan te/ thams cad la bu gcig pa dang 'dra'o/ /de'i tshe rgyal po de blon po dang bcas/ btsun mo dang sras su bcas te phyi rol tu 'chag cing dong ba las/ cung zad gcig ngal bso ba'i bar du sras gsum po tshal gyi nang du dong dong ba las stag mo gcig bu byung nas zhag du ma lon pa bkres skom pas nyen te/ phyir yang bu za la thug pa zhig mthong nas rgyal bu tha chung des phu bo gnyis la smras pa/ stag mo 'di ni shin tu sdug bsngal gyis gzir te nyam chung la rid pas shi la thug pa 'di lta bu bu byung ma thag pa yang za ru 'dod do/

/zhes smras so/ /nu bos yang phu bo gnyis la smras pa/ stag mo 'di zas su ci za zhes dris nas/ phu bo gnyis kyi bsad ma thag pa'i sha rlon dang*/ khrag dron gyis de'i yid tshim par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras so/ /yang smras pa/ gang su yang rung ste de lta bu'i dngos pos 'di'i srog bskyabs te mi nyams par byed nus pa yod dam/ phu bo gnyis kyis smras pa/ de ni shin tu yang dka' bas med do/ /de nas rgyal bu tha chung des yid la 'di snyam du bsam mo/ /bdag yun ring po nas 'khor ba na 'khor zhing lus dang srog grangs med pa zhig chud gsan te/ bar 'ga' ni 'dod chags kyi phyir/ bar 'ga' ni zhe sdang gi phyir/ bar ni gti mug gi phyir lus btang ste/ chos kyi phyir bsod nams kyi zhing dang lan 'ga' yang ma phrad pa'i lus 'di ci rung snyam bsam pa thag bcad nas gsum char 'grogs te song ba las ring por ma phyin par phu bo gnyis la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mched gnyis slar gshegs shig dang*/ bdag don zhig gnyer te slad bzhin du sleb par mchi'o/ /zhes smras nas lam de nyid du zhugs te stag mo'i tshang gang na 'dug par myur du song nas stag mo'i drung du nyal ba dang*/ stag mo kha 'thams nas za ma nus so/ /de'i tshe rgyal bus shing gi tshal pa rnon pos lus la khrag phyung nas stag mo la ldag tu bcug pa dang*/ kha yang phye nas lus kyi sha ma lus par zos so/ /phu bo gnyis kyi bsdad nas ring zhig tu ma 'ong pas phyir rjes bzhin du tshol du dong ba las sngar smras pa'i tshul la brtags nas gdon mi za bar stag mo ltogs pa snyod du song ngo snyam bsam nas der phyin te bltas pa na/ nu bo tha chung stag gi zos te sha dang khrag gis kun tu bsgos nas btsog btsaug pa ltar 'dug pa mthong nas lus sa la brdabs te brgyal lo/ /ring zhig lon pa dang dbugs phyir phyung nas cho nges btab ste sa la 'gre zhing 'khams par gyur to/

/de'i tshe na btsun mo yum mnal ba'i rmi lam du phug ron gsum zhig kun tu 'phur zhing rtse ba las/ nang gi chung ba gcig khras khyer ba snyam rmis ma thag tu sad nas sngangs skrag ste rgyal po la bsnyad do/ /bdag gi gtam du thos na/ phug ron ni bu'i bla ste/ phug ron nang gi chung ngu khras khyer ba las bdag gi bu nang gi sdug pa bkra mi shis su nges kyi zhes de ma thag tu kun tu tshol ba btang ba las/ ring por ma lon par rgyal bu gnyis ni 'ongs kyi/ bu nang gi sdug pa cang ma nyes sam/ ga re zhes dris na phu bo gnyis skad kyis brnangs te ring zhig tu dbugs kyang ma phyin/ smra yang ma nus nas de'i 'og tu dbugs phyin pa dang*/ stag gi zos so zhes smras so/ /lha mos de skad ces smras pa thos nas 'khums te sa la 'gyel nas ring zhig lon pa dang dbyugs phyin te/ bu gnyis dang*/ btsun mo dang*/ pho brang slas su bcas te myur bar rgyal bu gang du tshe 'phos pa'i gnas su song ngo*/ /de'i tshe stag mos rgyal bu'i sha ni zad par zos nas rus pa dang*/ khrag 'ba' zhig sa la rtsog rtsog pa ltar 'dug pa mthong nas btsun mos ni mgo nas bzung*/ rgyal pos ni lag pa nas bzung ste cho nges btab nas ngus pa dang*/ der yang 'khams nas ring zhig lon te phyir sangs so/ /rgyal bu sems can chen po de der tshe 'phos nas dga' ldan gyi lha yi gnas su skyes so/ /bdag ci spyad pas 'dir skyes snyam bsam ste/ lha'i mig gis rgyud lnga kun tu brtags nas bdag tshe 'phos pa'i rus bu tshal na 'dug pa la pha mas bskor te shin tu yid la gcags pas mya ngan gyi zug ngus sdug bsngal zhing cho nges 'debs pa mthong nas lhas bsam pa/ bdag gi pha ma 'di ltar mi dga' ba'i rkyen gyis gal te na lus dang srog gi bar chad du 'gyur gyi/ de la spro ba bskyed cing gtam byar 'gro snyam bsam nas nam mkha' las babs te steng gi nam mkha' las tshig snyan pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis pha ma gnyis spro ba bskyed do/

/pha ma gnyis kyis nam mkhar bltas nas lha khyod su zhig lags pa bdag la smros shig ces smras pa dang*/ lhas smras pa/ bdag ni rgyal bu sems can chen po zhes bya ba yin te/ bdag lus stag mo ltogs pa la byin nas dga' ldan gyi lha'i gnas su skyes so/ /rgyal po chen po/ /'di ltar mkhyen par mdzod cig /ji tsam du srid pa dang bcas pa'i chos ni mthar 'jig pa 'ong*/ skye ba yod na nges par 'jig go /sdig pa byas na sems can dmyal bar ltung gi /dge ba byas na mtho ris su skyes te/ skye ba dang 'jig pa ni kun la srid na/ ci'i slad du bdag 'ba' zhig gi phyir mya ngan gyi rgya mtshor lhung ba mi tshor ram/ dge ba'i phyogs la brtson 'grus mdzod cig /de'i pha mas smras pa/ khyod ni snying rje chen pos stag mo snyod de thams cad la snying brtse ba yin na/ bdag cag btang ste tshe'i dus byas pas nged ni khyod dran pa'i phyir sha yang dum bu dum bur bcad pa tsam du sdug bsngal gyis gdungs na/ snying rje chen po spyod pa khyod 'di lta bu bya ba rigs sam/ de nas yang lha des tshig snyan pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bzhams te spro ba bskyed pas de'i pha ma yang spro ba cung zad skyes nas rin po che sna bdun gyi sgrom byas te rus bu de'i nang du bcug nas sbas pa'i steng du mchod rten byas so// ༄༅/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyal khab phyi nang du dar tshul/

de yang sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar dar ba'i skabs su 'dzam bu gling 'dir chos lugs 'dra min sna tshogs yod de/ par sig la swo lo yā si ti'i chos lugs dang*/ krung gor khrun chi'u kran go'i rig gnas/ zhi lā rgyal khab tu rtog ge smra ba sogs yod cing*/ spyir nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos dar tshul las/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang*/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs su chos dar ba'i tshul ni yongs su grags che bas 'dir ma bris la/ 1¿ bstan pa siṅga lar dar ba'i tshul ni/ 102 dus rabs gsum par chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis rgyal sras mngags nas siṅga lar bstan pa thog mar spel zhing*/ gtsug lag khang chen mo bzhengs pa dang*/ ngag brgyud bstan bcos yi ger phab/ dus rabs lnga pa'i dus mgo la rgya gar gyi dge 'dun pa sangs rgyas dbyangs siṅga lar phebs nas saṃ ga ra'i yi ges rnam dag lam gyi bstan bcos brtsams/ dus rabs drug par rgyal pos gtsug lag khang chen po sde pa la gzigs skyong chen po mdzad pas bstan pa nyams pa rnams slar dar gyur/ dus rabs bdun par sh+yan tsang gi zin tho ltar na bstan pa nyams dmas su gyur 'dug zer/ dus rabs brgyad par 'jigs med ri'i sde pa gtso ru gyur pa'i chos sde rnams la gsang sngags dar la/ krung go'i slob dpon byang chub rdor rje dang stong min rnam gnyis siṅga lar dam chos slob tu phebs/ dus rabs bcu par rgya gar lho'i tha'e smir bas siṅga lar btsan 'dzul byas te bstan pa nyams rgud tshad med btang ngo*/ /dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dus smad du bhar ma nas gnas brtan dge slong gdan zhu byas te bstan pa nyams pa sor chud/ dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i rjes su tha'i smir bas btsan 'dzul byas pa dang*/ mu'u se lin gyi chos lugs dar ba dang*/ phu tho yas dmag btang nas siṅga la blangs pa dang bcas kyi dbang gis bstan pa ming gi lhag mar gyur/ dus rabs bcu drug pa'i dus smad du rgyal pos slar yang pho nya mngags nas bhar ma dang shan lo

(tha'i go ) gnyis nas nang bstan spyan drangs pas bstan pa'ang dar/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dus mjug tu bstan pa nyin byed ltar 'phel zhing*/ dharma bha rā zer bas rgyal sa kho lung pho dang rgya gar gyi bodhi gā ya'i sar byang chub chos grwa chen po bzhengs la/ bstan pa'i rten dang brten pa bsrungs shing*/ dam chos brtsams/ 1945 lor rgyal khab dbu brnyes nas srid gzhung gis bstan pa spel rgyu gtsigs su bzung bas mi phal che ba chos sgor zhugs pa yin la/ dge 'dun pa'i nang du bhar ma stod pa dang*/ bhar ma smad pa dang*/ shan lo ba dang bcas brgyud pa gsum du dbye/ dgon pa lnga stong drug brgya bcu med gnyis dang grwa pa nyis khri yod zer ro//2¿ bstan pa bhar ma la dar ba'i tshul ni/ dus rabs lnga pa'i rjes su theg chen dang theg chung dar rgyas che/ dus rabs brgyad pa dang dgu pa'i bar du theg chen dang gsang sngags dar/ dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dus dkyil du rgyal po ā nu ra to zer bas rgyal khab gcig gyur mdzad nas siṅga la nas dam chos spyan drangs shing*/ sde snod gsum par du bkod pa dang*/ chos grwa chen po dang mchod rten mang po bzhengs pas dgon bzhengs rgyal rabs kyang zer/ dus rabs bcu gsum par sog pos dmag drangs nas rgyal khab lho byang gnyis su btang rung phyogs gnyis kar bstan pa sngar mus bzhin dar 'phel che ste/ mdzes mtsho gser gling yang skabs de nas bzhengs/ dus rabs bco lnga par rgyal po dharma shes rab kyis grwa pa mngags nas siṅga la nas sdom pa len tshul dang dbang skur srol bslabs pa dang bstan pa la dag ther mdzad/ dus rabs bcu drug par rgyal rabs tung yu'i skabs su rgyal khab gcig gyur byas nas bstan pa rgyas par spel zhing*/ cong chen po gcig lugs pa'i steng du dam chos brkos/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dus mgor rgyal po mang 'dun gyis dbu mdzad nas bstan 'dzin chen po zhugs pa'i bka' bsdu lnga pa mdzad cing*/

sde snod gsum slar yang zhu dag bgyis te par du btab pa dang*/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog rdo ring bdun brgya nyer dgu'i steng du brkos/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dus smad du dbyin ji bas dbang bsgyur ba'i skabs su'ang bstan pa sngar bzhin dang*/ 1954 nas 1956 lo'i bar du ya gling rgyal khab so so'i bstan 'dzin 'thus mi nyis stong lnga brgya zhugs pa'i bka' bsdu drug pa mdzad la/ sde snod gsum gsar du bsgrigs/ da skabs chos la dad mkhan khri nyis stong lnga brgya yod la/ des mi grangs spyi'i brgya cha go lnga zin pa dang*/ grwa pa kho na khri bcu yod cing*/ dgon pa khri gnyis yod/ grub mtha' gtso bo la dam chos pa dang*/ ru'e chin pa dang*/ sgo ba pa dang bcas gsum du dbye/ dam chos pa ni lo rgyus ring zhing dge 'dun pa mang ba dang*/ sdom pa cung zad lhod de/ du ba 'then/ go yu 'cha'/ zhwa dang lham gyon/ zang zing len/ ru'e chin pa ni dam chos pa las gyes pa yin la/ dus rabs bcu dgu par ru'e chin pa dar ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku la phyag mi 'tshal zhing*/ chos thog sbub chal sogs med la/ sdom pa dam po ste dge slong rnams bsam sbyor gnyis nas tshul khrims dang mi 'gal ba gtso cher byed/ sgo ba pa ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi cha nas chos la dad pa byed cing*/ sgo gsum dmigs yul dam par brtsi ba dang sdom pa ha cang dam mo//3¿ bstan pa shan lo (tha'e go) la dar ba'i tshul ni/ thos pa ltar na/ dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i dus dkyil du krung go'i yun nan nas tha'e rigs rnams lho phyogs su song nas mu na chu stod rgyud kyi swo kho tha'e sa char rgyal khab btsugs pa dang theg chen la dad pa byed/ 1361 lor swo kho tha'e rgyal rabs lnga pa'i rgyal po dho mo rā hrī lis dbang sgyur byed dus siṅga la nas bla ma chen po spyan drangs nas theg chung la dad par byed la/ ring por ma thogs par grong khyer gyi 'chad nyan pa dang nags gseng gi sgom sgrub pa gnyis kyi grub mtha' byung*/

dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i dus dkyil du rgyal po rā mā dhi byang chub kyis rim gyis can phu kre blangs shing*/ swo kho tha'i rgyal rabs kyi sa cha 'ga' zhig kyang blangs nas ā yu to ye rgyal rabs btsugs te theg chung spel/ 1753 lor rgyal po pho lo mo rā shrīs siṅga lar grwa pa bco lnga mngags nas bstan pa spel/ 1767 lor rang rgyal gyi krin zhin zer bas bhar ma gcig gyur byas nas mon gho rgyal rabs btsugs/ phyis su dmag dpon pha ye cho kher gyis krin zhin bkrongs nas lha ma sku phreng dang po'i rgyal rabs btsugs nas 1788 lor nang bstan tshogs chen 'tshogs shing*/ bstan 'dzin grags can nyis brgya drug cu spyan drangs nas sde snod gsum la zhu dag mdzad/ 1851 lo nas bzung nang bstan la dag ther byas pas nang du lta tshul ma mthun par dam chos pa dang thun mong ba gnyis kyi grub mtha' byung*/ 1919 lo nas 1928 lo'i bar du sde snod gsum gyi 'grel pa bcas par du brkos/ nang bstan ma gtogs chos lugs gzhan la dad pa mi byed pa'i rgyal khab 'dzam gling 'di na shan lo las med pa dang*/ grwa pa khri nyi shu rtsa drug dang dgon pa nyis khri lnga stong drug brgya gya brgyad dang mchod rten khri bcu lhag dang bcas yod/ theg chen la dad pa'i krung go'i grwa pa brgya phrag dang dgon pa sum cu 'dug zer ro//4¿ bstan pa can phu'u kra'e la dar ba'i tshul ni/ dus rabs drug pa'i skabs su can phu'u kra'e la phu nan zer zhing*/ grwa pa rnams krung go'i lho la 'ongs nas dam chos spel la/ chos gzhung pod bcu gcig bsgyur pa mang shos theg chen gyi skor yin/ phu nan brgyud nas krung gor 'ongs pa'i 'phags yul gyi grwa pa bden grub ces bya bas gzhung pod nyis khri khyer 'ongs zer/ dus rabs drug pa'i dus 'jug tu phu nan gyi mnga' 'og krin lā zer ba'i rgyal phran dar bar gyur nas phyis phu nan la dbang bsgyur te sangs rgyas dang*/

pad ma'i mig dang*/ pad+ma 'byung gnas dang bcas la dad pa byed/ dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i skabs te/ sog pos rgyal yongs la dbang sgyur byed skabs yin la/ sog rgyal gyis mngags pa'i lta skor tshogs pa gcig krin lā la song ba las byung ba'i zin tho'i nang du/ krin lā'i khyim re res nang bstan la dad pa byed cing*/ dgon pa'i nang du jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku 'dra bzhengs la/ grwa pas skra gzhar/ gzan ser po dang mthang gos ser po gyon/ rkang rjen red ces bkod yod/ dus rabs dgu pa nas bcu gsum pa'i bar du wu'u go rgyal rabs kyis wu'u go grong khyer du rdo las grub pa'i pho brang dang*/ dgon pa/ sku 'dra bcas shin tu mang po bzhengs/ dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i dus dkyil nas bzung ste krin lā la can phu'u kra'i zer/ tha'e gos dmag lan du ma drangs pas rgyal srid nyams shing*/ siṅga la'i theg chung dar ba byung*/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dus mjug tu h+pha ran sis mnga' 'og tu bsdus la/ nang bstan la the gtogs byas/ 'on kyang dad ldan rnams kyis sngar bzhin nang bstan 'dzin spel byas nas dus rabs nyi shu pa'i skabs su rgyal sa pe zhang pin la nang bstan mtho rim slob grwa bzhi brgya btsugs/ da lta'i lo lnga bcu'i gong du chos rgyal zhi hwa nu khe'i nang bstan slob grwa chen mo dang nang bstan zhib 'jug khang btsugs shing*/ sde snod gsum par du brkos so// 5¿ bstan pa lo'i wo la dar ba'i tshul ni/ deb ther du 'byung ba ltar na/ dus rabs bcu bzhi par bstan pa'i dbu brnyes zer/ skabs der rgyal po chos dar gyis gzhung shar gyi rgyal po bcom/ khong dgung lo phra dus can phu'u kra'i la bzhugs ring nang bstan la zhugs pas theg chung gi chos shes pa rjes su la'o wo la spel zhing*/ chos grwa bzhengs la/ dam chos par du brkos de nas bzung nang pa'i bstan pa de rgyal khab kyi chos su gyur/

dus rabs bcu drug pa'i dus dkyil du rgyal po we sig gis gtsug lag khang mchog tu gyur pa bzhengs shing*/ sde snod gsum par du brkos/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su rgyal po su'u les thog mar bstan pa'i bdag po zhes thob rnams skyes bu chen po la gnang ba dang*/ tshul khrims bcas shing grwa pa'i sgrig lam 'thus tshang du mdzad/ dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus mjug tu tha'e gos dmag drangs nas la'o wo blangs pas bstan pa nyams par gyur/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i skabs su h+pha ran si dang a me ri ka'i mnga' 'og tu gyur rung dad ldan rnams kyis bstan pa 'dzin spel byed rgyu rgyun ma chad/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus mgor bstan pa nyams pa sor chud byung zhing*/ nang bstan slob grwa gang mang btsugs pa dang*/ sde snod gsum slar yang par du brkos so// 6¿ bstan pa hin rdu nyi zhi yā la dar ba'i tshul ni/ spyi lo 412 la krung go'i pa chos 'phags zhes bya ba su mon tā la gling tshom du yong skabs bram ze'i chos lugs dar rgyas che bas nang pa'i bstan pa nyam chung yin zer/ 424 lor rgya gar byang gi bla ma chen po cho nā bha ma krung go'i la phebs pa'i lam bar gnas 'dir byon nas nang bstan dar rgyas che ba gzigs te rgyal po dang rgyal yum gnyis la dbang bskur zer/ 430 lor gnas 'di'i pho nya sung rgyal rabs la song nas nged kyi rgyal khab kyis dkon mchog gsum la dad pa byed cing*/ mchod rten brten pa bzheng mkhan yin zer skad/ dus rabs lnga pa'i rjes su theg chen theg chung gnyis dar/ dus rabs brgyad pa'i dus dkyil du zha lan the rā rgyal rabs kyis gsang sngags spel la/ dgon chen bla na med pa bzhengs/ dus rabs bco lnga par mu'u si lin gyi chos lugs dar bas sangs rgyas bstan pa nub par gyur/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i rjes su bstan pa'i me ro slar yang gsos nas da lta chos grwa drug brgya lhag dang grwa pa khri brgya tsam yod zer ro//

7¿ bstan pa khra'o zhan la dar ba'i tshul ni/ dus rabs bzhi pa'i dus smad du bstan pa'i dbu brnyes zer la/ skabs der rgyal phran gsum gyi tshul du yod/ rgyal phran gsum ni kang li dang*/ pe ci dang*/ zhin lo tan dang bcas so// 668 lor zhin los kang li dang pe ci bcom nas rgyal srid dar rgyas che par gyur cing*/ bstan pa'ang nyin mo ltar 'phel pa byung*/ krung go'i pa'i thang rgyal rabs las dam chos spyan drangs te lta lnga ri dgu'i grub mtha' byung*/ lta ba lnga ni mi rtag lta ba dang*/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ dpal brjid lta ba/ chos nyid lta ba/ chos bzhin spyod pa bcas so/ /ri dgu ni gnyug ma ri dang*/ ka kri ri/ hri co ri/ thung le ri/ lha bzhugs ri/ seng ge ri/ zhogs pa ri/ dga' tshal ri/ ri rab bcas so/ 936 lor rgyal po wang can gyis khra'o zhan gcig gyur mdzad nas dgon pa rgya cher bzhengs shing*/ gdams pa bcu'i khrims bcas/ 1101 lor don lhas lta sgom gcig dril gyi lta ba spel/ 1201 lor shes rab 'dzin gy-is sgom sgrub gcig dril gyi lta ba spel/ dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i skabs su sde snod gsum par du brkos nas glegs bam lnga stong lhag byung la/ sog dmag 'ongs nas sde snod gsum brlags/ rjes su'ang sde snod gsum par du brkos te glegs bam drug stong lhag byung*/ dus rabs bco lnga'i skabs su rang rgyal gyi ru'u chos dar nas sangs rgyas chos lugs go 'phang dma' bar gyur/ 1894 lo'i tshun chad du 'jar pan gyi mnga' 'og tu gyur nas 'jar pan gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i nang bstan dar/ 1916 lor rdzogs chen gyi grub mtha' byung*/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa mjug rdzogs rjes rgyal khab rang rkya thub par gyur/ da skabs khra'o zhan lho mar bsam gtan pa'i grub mtha' bco brgyad dang*/ dgon pa nyis stong sum brgya/ grwa pa dgu stong nyis brgya/ dad ldan khri lnga brgya bcas yod do//8¿

bstan pa 'jar pan la dar ba'i tshul ni/ spyi lo 522 lor pe ci rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po 'phags gsal gyis 'jar pan gong ma then hor la thang ga dang*/ chos gzhung*/ 'phan gdugs bcas phul ba'i tshul de bstan pa dbu brnyes pa'i rtags su 'dod/ 604 lor rgyal sras 'phags drin gyis dkon mchog gsum la dad pa byed dgos pa'i bka' phab cing*/ dgon pa zhe drug bzhengs pa dang*/ grwa pa brgyad brgya bcu drug dang jo mo lnga brgya zhe lnga byung*/ 645 lor rgyal po dpal chen gyis nang bstan rgya cher spel dgos pa'i bka' bstsal cing*/ dgon pa la zhing mang tsam gnang*/ dus rabs bdun pa'i dus mjug tu dgon pa lnga brgya bzhi bcu yod/ 710 lor ming grags che ba'i dgon chen bdun bzhengs shing*/ grub mtha' drug byung rgyud gsum pa/ chos nyid pa/ bden 'grub pa/ mngon pa ba/ mdo sde ba/ 'dul ba pa bcas so// 754 lor rang rgyal gyi hā shang can krin 'ongs nas 'dul gzhung bskyangs/ dus rabs brgyad pa'i skabs su slob dpon khung ha'e bden tshig pa'i grub mtha' spel ba/ de yang rdor rje rtse mo gtso bor byas nas dad pa byed/ dus rabs bcu gnyis par yon khung gis zhing khams sbyong ba'i grub mtha' btsugs shing*/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dang tshe dpag med sogs kyi bstan bcos gtso bor bslab pa dang*/ thar pa thob na gzhan dbang ste sangs rgyas kyis ma gtogs rang dbang gis 'thob mi srid la/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi mtshan rtse gcig tu brjod na dag zhing du skye ba len par 'dod/ sgrub pa gtso bor mi dmigs te/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la bsam pa rnam dag gis dad pa byas nas 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur la/ sdig pa can yin na sangs rgyas kyis lhag par bskyang dgos par snyam/ dmar zas dang bud med len pa la dgag sdom med/ dus rabs bcu gsum par nyi ma'i chu skyes kyis nyin pad ma pa'i grub mtha' btsugs nas dam chos pad dkar mdo gzhung gtso bor brtsis/

rgyal rabs len tshang gi skabs sgom sgrub pa'i grub mtha' dar/ gong ma ming kri'i skabs bstan pa nyams/ 1889 lor bstan pa'i me ro gsos/ deng sang dad ldan khri brgyad stong bdun brgya dang*/ grub mtha' bcu gsum gyi nang gses su'ang yan lag brgya dang drug cu yod do//9¿ bstan pa yo nan la dar ba'i tshul ni/ spyi lo 2 pa'i dus mjug tu krung go nas dam pa'i chos drangs pa yin la/ de yang dam chos dbu brnyes pa'i dus su 'dod/ dus rabs drug pa'i tshe dgon pa nyi shu lhag dang*/ grwa pa lnga brgya lhag /yo 'gyur bstan bcos po ti bco lnga dang bcas yod zer/ dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i skabs su rgyal po dang bstan 'dzin chen po gnyis kyis rgyal srid mnyam du bskyangs/ 1031 lor srid gzhung gis mthun rkyen sbyar nas dgon pa dgu brgya dang lnga bcu bzhengs/ 1129 lor mchod rten brgyad khri bzhi stong bzhengs par rab gnas mdzad/ de'i tshe sgom pa ba dang spyil bu pa'i grub mtha' byung*/ dus rabs bco lnga pa'i bar bstan pa nyams/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa nas bco brgyad pa'i bar te lo nyis brgya'i ring la rgyal khab lho byang gnyis su gyes shing*/ byang gi rgyal pos bstan pa tshul bzhin bskyangs rung dmag 'khrug mang bas dar rgyas ma byung*/ 1696 lor smyug tshal ba'i hwa shang se dkar khyung tog gis pad ma pa'i grub mtha' spel/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus mgor bstan pa nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong du spel/ da lta theg chen pa khri nyis stong dang nyan thos khri nyis brgya yod do//10¿ bstan pa bal yul du dar ba'i tshul ni/ thos pa ltar na spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo lnga brgya nyi shu yas mas te rgyal po khi lā tis dbang sgyur mdzad pa'i dus su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas bal yul du phebs nas dam chos spel zer/ dus rabs bzhi par theg chen dar ba dang*/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen yang gnas 'dir phyag phebs/

633 lor thang sin bla ma der phebs nas zin tho btab pa'i nang du bal yul du theg pa che chung gnyis dang grwa pa nyis stong lhag yod zer/ dus rabs brgyad pa nas dgu pa'i bar du rgya gar gyi bram ze'i chos lugs der dar nas nang bstan nyams rung sa mtha' rnams dang byang phyogs su da dung nyams med/ dus rabs bcu gsum par ma'u se lin gyi dmag gis bhang ga lar dpung 'jug byas nas chos sde ming grags can rnams brlags pas grwa pa mang pos gsung rab mang po khyer te bal yul du byon/ skabs der sa skya pa'i grub mtha' der dar/ dus rabs bco lnga pa'i bar karma pa'i grub mtha' dar/ da skabs grwa pa khri gya drug yod/11¿ bstan pa li yul du dar ba'i tshul ni/ thos pa ltar na 'od srungs kyi ring bsrel gyi mchod rten yul der yod zer/ jo bo shākya thub pa der phebs nas lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od lung bstan pa zhes pa'i mdo gsungs/ 'u then mkhar du lha khang brtsigs/ rgyal po dharma a shwas tsārma'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgyal po bi dza yas dgra bcom pa saṃ gha ko sha spyan drangs nas gtsug lag khang du ma brtsigs/ rgyal po bi dza ya singhas byams pa'i dus ston btsugs/ rgyal po bi dza ya dharmas bong mkhar du byams pa bzhengs so//12¿ bstan pa nang sar tu dar ba'i tshul ni/ han rgyal rabs kyi ming dhi rgyal po'i dus su bstan pa'i dbu brnyes zer/ rgyal po des bang chen la wang tsong grub mtha' 'tshol bar btang*/ rgya gar nas kyang dgra bcom pa ma taṅga dang paṇ+ḍi ta go bhar na zer ba gnyis kyis ston pa'i bris thang zhig dang*/ ring bsrel bum pa gang*/ theg pa che chung gi mdo'i glegs bam mang po khyer nas nang sar 'ongs/ pe ma zi sogs btsun pa'i lha khang bdun dang btsun ma'i lha khang gsum bzhengs/ rgyal po a shā kas ri bo rtse lngar mchod rten chen po zhig dang*/ zhān thung zi dgon pa btab/ rab byung drug brgya nyi shu dang btsun ma nyis brgya sum cu byung*/

dgra bcom pas mdo sde rim par phye ba zhe gnyis pa zhes dang*/ paṇ+ḍi tas sa bcu pa'i mdo sogs mdo sde lnga bsgyur/ han ming dhi rgyal po'i dus su to shrī dang slob dpon de gnyis kyi bar du rtsod pa byung nas to shrī rnams pham/ thang tha'i tsung gi ring la lo tsā ba thang san tsan zer ba byung ste dam chos mang po bsgyur cing bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ de yan chad la lo tsā ba nyis brgya byung zer/ yon rgyal rabs skabs sog pos dbang 'dzin pa na dkon mchog la dad pa byed cing*/ sa skya paṇa chen khu dbon spyan drangs nas bstan pa rin po che rgyas par mdzad/ tā ming rgyal po yung lo'i dus su byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes spyan drangs nas tā go shrī zhes pa'i mtshan gnang*/ ching rgyal rabs skabs rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po spyan drangs/ bde skyid rgyal po'i dus su dge 'dun gyi sde mang po btab/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan sogs mkhas grub du ma spyan drangs/ rgyal po chan lung gi dus su gtsug lag khang dang dgon sde mang po bzhengs shing*/ rje ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung*/ de ltar nang sar sde snod 'dzin pa dang grub pa thob pa'i hwa shang bgrang yas pa byung ngo*//13¿ bstan pa sog yul du dar ba'i tshul ni/ jing gir rgyal po'i sras go dan gyis sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan spyan drangs nas mchod yon du 'brel/ se chen rgyal po'i ring la 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te dbu blar gyur/ gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde mang po btsugs/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gdan drangs nas mdo dang bstan bcos du ma sog skad du bsgyur/ bu yan thu rgyal po'i ring la snar thang gi bstan 'gyur bzhengs/ rgyal dbang gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho spyan drangs te dam pa'i chos spel bar mdzad/ rgyal po bo shog thu han gyi ring la mdo sngags kyi grwa tshang mang po btsugs/

spyir sog yul du rje tsong kha pa'i ring lugs dar che la/ bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur sog skad du bsgyur ba mang*/ bkra shis lhun po dang dpal ldan 'bras spungs sogs nas mkhas grub mang po gdan drangs nas mdo sngags kyi bstan pa spel du bcug /'dul ba'i bca' khrims dang lam rim che chung gi 'chad nyan gtso bor byas/ phyis su mtshan nyid kyi 'chad nyan yang btsugs/ gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten shin tu mang po bzhengs pas sog po phal che ba sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa zhig go/ 14¿ bstan pa 'jar man la dar ba'i tshul ni/ 1913 lor se tan si to khre zer bas thog mar bho lin grong khyer du nang bstan tshogs pa btsugs/ 1921 lor ghi lin dang se tan si to khre rnam pa gnyis kyis mo ne he grong khyer nas nang bstan mnyam 'brel tshogs pa btsugs shing*/ de la dad ldan lnga brgya zhugs yod/ 1932 lor dar khe zhes bya bas dgon pa bla na med pa gcig bzhengs shing*/ de la 'du khang*/ sgom grwa/ dpe mdzod khang bcas bkod/ 1960 lor 'jar man nang bstan mnyam 'brel tshogs pa btsugs shing*/ han bho sa char gdan sa btab/ lo der bod mi 'gas bod 'gyur bstan pa spel zhing*/ gtso bo gsang sngags nyams len byed/ da skabs 'jar man yongs la nang bstan gyi dad ldan pa khri bdun yod zer ro//15¿ bstan pa h+pha ran si la dar ba'i tshul ni/ da lta'i bar du nang bstan la zhib 'jug byed pa'i yun ni lo brgya lhag song*/ bho lo phu zhes bya bas thog mar dam chos pad dkar h+pha yig tu bsgyur/ li'e we zer bas theg chen gyi gzhung pod h+pha yig tu bsgyur/ li'e we slob ma phu sangs rgyas kyis mngon pa mdzod bsgyur/ 1945 lor yo nan gyi bstan 'dzin mang po zhig h+pha ran sir phebs nas bstan pa spel/ da skabs bod dar nang bstan grub mtha' du ma h+pha ran si la gzhi chags nas dar 'phel che la/ rnying ma bas lha sa'i dgon pa la dpe blangs nas chos sde chen po bzhengs/

da lta h+pha ran si yongs la dad ldan pa khri gsum yod do//16¿ bstan pa a me ri kar dar ba'i tshul ni/ 1893 lor nang bstan la zhib 'jug byed 'go brtsams/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dus mjug tu 'jar pan gyi bstan 'dzin dag gis zha we dbyi sogs kyi sa cha la dag zhing pa'i dgon lag bzhengs/ 1899 lor nang bstan mthun tshogs btsugs shing*/ de'i 'phror lo hran ci dang*/ kri ca gho/ nyug yo sogs kyi grong khyer du dgon pa btab pa dang*/ skye bo rnams bstan pa la btsud/ 1900 lor bstan pa'i sgor zhugs mkhan stong 'ga' las med mod/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa mjug sgril rjes grwa pa chig khri brgyad stong thon/ 1950 lo'i skabs su gtso bo theg pa chen po dar/ 1970 lo'i skabs su bod kyi rnying ma pa dang*/ sa skya pa dang*/ bka' brgyud pa sogs kyis so so'i grub mtha' spel zhing*/ dgon pa btab pa dang*/ skye bo mang po chos la bkod/ da skabs bstan pa'i sgor zhugs mkhan khri sum cu yod pa dang*/ nang bstan rtsa 'dzugs bzhi bcu yod zer ro//[sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyal khab phyi nang du dar tshul 'di ni/ 'dzam gling gi chos lugs khag bcu'i ngo sprod blo gsal bung ba'i dga' ston zhes bya ba las/ 7skyabs rje mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po ches zur bkol mdzad/]༄༅/ /khra 'gu ba bod zhen gyis rma rgyal spom ra mjal bar phyin pa'i lo rgyus/

rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me pho khyi/ rang lo bdun cu don bzhi/ bod zla gsum pa/ spyi lo nyis stong drug gi zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin bal yul nas hong kong brgyud rim pas the wan la phyin/ tshes nyer dgu nyin nas ka'o zhung gi chos tshogs la lha mo dpal gyi g.yang chog nyin gsum 'don dgos pa zhig byung bas/ de skabs cho ga dang*/ g.yang bsang gi tshig don las/ spyir lha mo dgu dang*/ de'i 'khor du lha klu gnyan gsum yod pa dang*/ de las gnyan chen po ni rma rgyal spom ra yin stabs/ rma chen ni yul lha khyad par can zhig yin pa'i dran bskul byung*/ ma zad zla ba rjes mar pha yul du 'gro rgyu'i 'char gzhi zhig kyang yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni rang dgon du grwa pa nyis brgya lhag tsam yod 'dug /'on kyang mang che ba dge tshul slong gi sdom pa ma thob pa sha stag yin stabs/ snga lo dbyar gnas tshugs ma thub/ der brten lo 'dir rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhig gnang rgyu gal che ba dang gcig /de bzhin dgon du thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub pa lo rtag par tshugs kyi yod cing*/ de yang mkhas grub karma chags med kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha ltar yin/ spyir de'i phyag len gyi rgyun dkon pa zhig yin kyang*/ rang dgon du sngar gyi phyag bzhes ma nyams pa yod/ 'on kyang grwa pa phal cher la dbang lung med par brten/ sngar dgu bcu go bdun lor rang pha yul du 'gro ba'i skabs dbang zhig bskur thub na bsam pa byung yang*/ dus tshod kyis ma 'dang ba'i rkyen gyis lag len ma thub par lus/ de'i phyir dbang rgyas pa zhig ma grub na thabs med snyam pa ni rgyu mtshan gnyis pa yin pas nges par 'gro dgos yod pa ltar/ der 'gro skabs lam du rma rgyal gyi gnas rir rgyang thag mi ring ba zhig yin tshod la/ de dus nges par mjal dgos snyam pa byung bas/ rgyus yod pa'i mi 'ga' zhig la dri mol byed skabs/

thag nye ba zhig na yod pa yang shes rtogs byung*/ de rjes the wan nas hong kong dang*/ de nas bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bzhi nyin me 'khor thog rgya nag lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi zhing chen kong tong gi grong khyer gtso bo kan kron la 'byor/ der sbyin bdag gsar pa si tis ban wang dang*/ de'i chung ma pho les cha'o zhes pa gnyis kyi khang par bsdad nas khong gnyis kyis gra bsgrigs dang*/ sne len phun sum tshogs pa byas byung zhing*/ rdzing bu zhig kyang yod stabs sa gnas tsha ba che ba'i yul du 'ong bar brten/ chu rkyal byas pas shin tu skyid pa'i tshor ba byung*/ tshes bco lnga nyin kong tong nas thon te gnam gru'i thog 'gro skabs sge'u khung nas bltas pas/ rgya nag lho phyogs kyi yul ljongs rnams ri dang ljon shing gi phyug cing*/ bar bar du ri bo'i rtse mor kha ba brgyab pa yang kha shas yod pa bcas shin tu mdzes pa 'dug/de nas rgya nag byang phyogs la slebs skabs/ bye thang skyo bo yod pa'i mthong snang byung*/ mthar zi ling gi gnam thang du 'byor skabs sngar rang 'gro bskyod byed pa'i skabs las yar rgyas che bar bzos 'dug /der slebs nas blo gros nyi ma dang*/ kar dge sogs rang dgon gyi bsu ma rnams dang*/ zi ling du rgas yol ched 'byor ba'i rang gi nye du kha shas ngo 'phrad la byung zhing*/ dul mo chos rje yang ched du phebs pa ma yin kyang*/ phyi nyin pe cing brgyud dbyin ji bsam yas gling du phebs rgyu yin 'dug pas/ zhor du gnam thang la phebs pa zhal mjal byung zhing*/ rjes su mgron khang la ngo 'phrad ched phebs byung*/ de'i phyi nyin ngo shes rnams la ngo 'phrad ched der bsdad pas mi rnams dang thug 'phrad byung*/ de rjes zi ling nas thon te/ khra 'gur 'gro ba'i skabs 'char gzhi la zi ling nas khra 'gu bar nyin gnyis byas nas/ nyin gcig mgo log gi sa gnas mdzo rgan ra ba zhes par sdod pa dang*/

de nyin rma rgyal spom ra mjal bar 'gro rgyu byas rung*/ mgron khang nas thog mar thon skabs su yang char pa shugs che tsam babs pa dang*/ de nas rim gyis sa gnas je mthor song stabs/ char pa de kha ba la 'gyur song zhing*/ snga mo chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skabs rgya bod gnyis kyi sa mtshams yin pa rma nyi zla la zhes grags pa der slebs/ de ni rgya bza' kong jo bod du byon skabs/ yab kyis gal te rang gi sras mo pha ma la sems shin tu 'phreng na/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las phan thogs gang yang med pas de 'dra zhig mi 'byung ba gal che la/ de yi thabs ni yab yum gyis brtse ba de tsam med pa'i mthong tshul 'byung ba zhig dgos pa de'i ched du sgam zhig gnang nas/ 'di ni khyed la pha ma gnyis kyis brtse ba ji tsam yod par bstan pa'i rtags kyi rngan pa yin pas/ rgya bod gnyis kyi sa mtshams la ma slebs kyi bar kha ma phye zhes bsgos pa ltar kong jos de bar kha ma phyes/ der phebs skabs/ bod kyi phyogs la bltas pas stong sang nge ba lta bu'i tshor ba dang*/ skyo snang zhig byung bas yab yum gnyis kyis gnang ba'i phyag rtags kyi sgam de la gzigs nas kha phye ba na rdo yi nyi ma dang*/ zla ba zhig las gang yang ma byung bas/ yab yum gnyis la re thag chad pa lta bu zhig byung ste der bor bar brten rdo yi nyi ma dang zla ba de/ da lta'i bar der yod pas ming yang de ltar thogs pa yin 'dug/ skabs der rlangs 'khor las phyir thon tsam byas kyang*/ rlung dang kha char shugs che bas sdod gnas sogs gang yang ma 'byor yang*/ bod yul bde ba'i smon lam dang*/ bstan rgyas smon lam phyogs bcu dus bzhi ma zhig kha ton byas te smon lam gang nus btabs nas lam du zhugs pa yin/ de nas thag ring tsam slebs nas gnam gshis cung zad dwang ste/ tshwa chu yod pa'i sa gnas su 'byor/ der za lar mi rigs kyi za khang zhig tu nyin gung gi bza' bca' byed par phyin pas/

za khang de gtsang sbra zhan pa dang*/ yun 'gor che bar byung ste/ mched grogs rnams hong kong*/ the wan/ ma la shi ya bcas yar rgyas ldan pa'i sa gnas nas 'ong ba yin stabs/ sun snang lta bu byas rung*/ rang gis rnam rtog ma byas par grod pa 'grang bar byas/ de rjes mgo log gi sa gnas mdzo rgan ra ba zhes par snga tsam 'byor rung*/ char rlung shugs che ba dang na bun gyi sgrib nas thag ring gi sa cha dang ri bo sogs mi mthong ba zhig byung bar brten/ de nyin rma rgyal mjal bar mi 'gro bar slar dgon nas phyir log 'ong skabs 'gro rgyu'i thag gcod dgos pa byung*/ de nas bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin dgon du 'byor skabs/ mi dmangs dang dgon pa grwa tshang nas sne len gang gzabs dang*/ de nas dge tshul slong gi sdom pa dang*/ thugs rje gsang 'dus kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas stong dbang*/ rang dgon la sku 'gyed dang*/ zhal lag dgon pa gzhan la sku 'gyed mang ja/ rnam snang la gnas mjal sogs bgyi 'os rnams legs grub kyis bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes sum cu nyin/ dgon nas grwa mangs nas skyel ma bcas chu tshod brgyad thog bstan rgyas smon lam sogs byas te thon/ dge bsnyen la snyan dar phul/ de nas shel dkar dang*/ skye mdo/ seng ze grong bcas nas skyel dar sprad mkhan rnams byung*/ zi ling bar skyel mkhan la/ blo gros nyi ma dpon g.yog gnyis/ sgrub dpon khye'u rin chen/ mkhan po phrin las dpal bzang*/ rin chen nor bu'i tsha bo/ kar dge sogs yod cing*/ snum 'khor dul mo chos rje'i phebs 'khor/ karma mdo sngags/ bo rog nas ril ma tshang gi mi brgyud yin pa mthar phyin zhes pa sogs yod cing*/ 'bri chu zam par ma slebs tsam du rgya yi lo tsā ba chen po thang zhon tsang gi dpe steg yod sar slebs skabs/ rjes dran du spar kha shas btabs/ de rjes 'bri chu zam pa brgal/ 'bri chu dang rdza chu gnyis bar gyi ri brgyud zhe'u la rgyab/
