rdza chu kha yi phyogs mja' thang zhes par 'brog pa kha shas gur phub nas zho tshong mkhan 'dug pas/ dbyar gyi spang dang me tog rgyas pa dang*/ gnam gshis shin tu legs pa bcas byung stabs zho 'thung nas cung zad bsdad/ rogs pa rnams kyi 'bri yi be'u dang*/ lug gi lu gu sogs mthong ma myong stabs pang du bzung nas ya mtshan chen pos spar btabs pa sogs byas song*/ de nas rim gyis rdza chu dang rma chu gnyis bar gyi ri brgyud khra la zhes sngon gling ge sar byon pa'i dus su spyi dpon rang tsha khra rgan bzhugs gnas yin pa der slebs skabs/ rlung rta mang po gtor nas bod yul bde ba'i smon lam 'don/ 'on kyang sa cha shin tu mtho ba'i skad grags yod par brten/ la dug phog dogs kyis rlangs 'khor las phyir ma thon par thad khar phyin pas rma chu'i phyogs la slebs/ spyir 'bri chu dang*/ rdza chu 'babs pa'i lung gshongs rnams su ljon shing sogs shin tu dkon mod/ spang ljongs me tog sogs yod cing*/ mi khyim dang 'brog sde mang la/ 'bri g.yag dang*/ rta lug sogs kyis gang sar khyab pas/ yul ljongs kyi bkod pa mdzes pa dang*/ rma chu'i phyogs kyi lung gshongs rnams su spang dang me tog de tsam med pas bye thang lta bu dang*/ mi yi rgyu 'grul nyung zhing*/ lug nyung shas tsam las/ 'bri g.yag sogs dkon pas stong pa lta bu'i tshor ba byung*/ rma chu'i zam pa brgal bas chu bo'i stod du song stabs de tsam chen po mi 'dug /rma chu brgal zin nas cung zad song ba'i 'tshams glo bur du brag ri dkar po dang*/ spang ljongs yod pa'i ri brgyud mdzes pa zhig mthong rgyu yod pa de ni mgo log gi sa gnas mdzo rgan rwa ba zhes pa de yin/ ri brgyud de nas lho phyogs su bltas na/ brag dang rdza spang 'dres pa'i ri bo chung chung bkod pa shin tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba mang po zhig mthong rgyu yod pa de rnams rma rgyal spom ra'i ri brgyud yin 'dug/spyir rma 'bri rdza gsum gyi chu bo thams cad byang nas lhor gzhol ba sha stag yin/

der dmigs bsal chu bo che tsam zhig lho nas byang gi phyogs la 'bab pa yod/ de rma rgyal spom ra'i ri brgyud rnams nas thon pa'i chu bo yin la/ chu de byang phyogs su mtsho zhig yod sar babs te/ der thim nas chu 'jug med par sa khra la bris 'dug /chu bo de la zam pa che tsam zhig bzos nas de'i thog rlangs 'khor che chung khag 'grul bskyod byed kyi 'dug cing*/ der rlangs 'khor gyi snum tshong sa zhig yod stabs/ der nga rang tsho'i rlangs 'khor rnams snum gyis bsgyangs nas rim par lam chen las zur du thon te/ rma rgyal spom ra'i phyogs su bskyod pa yin/ de skabs lam yag po med pa dang*/ kyag kyog mang po zhig yod par brten/ rlangs 'khor kha shas 'khor lo gas nas bzo bcos gtang dgos pa byung song*/ lam thag kyang ring po 'dug /rma rgyal spom ra la rgyang ring po nas mjal ba'i skabs gangs ri chen po gzi brjid dang ldan pa zhig mthong gi 'dug /'on kyang drung du nye ba na sa cha mtho bar phyin pa'i rkyen gyis ri bo cung chung du song ba lta bu'i snang tshul byung*/ mthar mgo log gi yul mi rnams kyi bsang mchod phul gyi yod pa'i sa gnas su 'byor song bas/ spyir sa cha der dgon pa chung chung zhig yod 'dug la/ de'i bstan bdag bla ma'i yang srid skye dgu mdor 'khrungs yod pa dang*/ sprul sku des dgon pa ri khug nas thang du spos te/ deng dus kyi ar 'dam gyis dgon pa rgya che tsam zhig gsar gzhengs gnang gi 'dug cing*/ der las ka'i mgo byed skye dgu nas yin pa sga pa'i mi zhig 'dug pa de la bsang shug gang nas thob ces dris pas/ khong gis lab par spyir mgo log yul mi rnams kyis lci bas bsang gtang gi yod pa dang*/ khong rnams kyis rdo sol gyi bsang gtang ba tsam las bsang shug sogs thob rgyu med tshul zer bas/ spos sogs bsreg nas bsang gtang ste/ ri bo bsang mchod dang*/

sde brgyad gser skyems phul/ bod yul bde ba'i smon lam dang*/ bstan rgyas smon lam phyogs bcu dus bzhi bcas kha ton byas nas smon lam gang drag btabs/ mthar rlung rta mang po zhig 'dug pa nam mkha' la gtor nas lha rgyal gtang*/ spyir de nyin gnam gshis shin tu legs kyang*/ de skabs sprin 'dus nas char pa zim bu gtang ba dang*/ rang gis brtag dpyad ma byas kyang grogs po kha shas kyis mthong bar 'ja' zhig kyang shar song zer/ gang ltar rtags mtshan legs tsam byung ba ni/ rang gis kun slong rnam dag gi sgo nas bstan don gyi bya ba sgrub pa la yul lhas rgyab skyor dang sdong grogs yod pa'i rtags yin snyam spro snang 'phel ba zhig byung*/ de nas rim par thon te lam chen du slebs skabs gnam gshis yag po byung*/ 'on kyang lam thag ring bas mtsho lho kra'o zhes par dgong mo chu tshod bcu gnyis pa tsam las ma 'byor/ der 'byor ba na sa cha'i mtho tshad dma' ba dang khrus khang dang*/ gsang spyod sogs kyi mthun rkyen 'dzom par brten/ tshor ba bde ba dang*/ sems lhod lta bu byung*/ phyi nyin nyi zla la brgyud nas 'gro skabs/ der blta skor ba mang po zhig 'dug la/ tshong rdzas tsag tsig kha shas tshong gi 'dug /der rgyang shel zhig thob byung bas ri klung kun la ltad mo bltas shing*/ lhag par dran rten du bod kyi phyogs la rgyab ljongs yod pa'i spar kha shas yod pa byas/ de bzhin ri khug zhig tu spangs ljongs yag po yod par brten sngon ma brgyad cu gya bzhi lor ja bskol nas tsha bog gcig byed myong ba'i sa der/ rgya bza' kong jo'i sku dang*/ khang pa mang po zhig bzos 'dug la/ sgo chen mdzes pa zhig kyang 'dug pas nang du blta bar phyin kyang*/ de ni rgyu mtshan mi shes pa'i mi rnams mgo skor gtang byed tsam las/ khungs lung yod pa dang*/ bkod pa mdzes pa/ dngos gtsang ba'i sku bcas gang yang mi 'dug /de nas zi ling du phyin nas mtsho sngon mgron khang du bsdad/

bod zla lnga pa'i tshes gnyis nyin/ nyi ma sprul sku zhes pa sga khog nas yin pa zhig gis mi dmangs spyi gling gi nang du lha khang chung chung dang*/ thang stong rgyal po/ gling rje ge sar sogs kyi sku bzos 'dug pa mjal/ de bzhin tsha mo o skyes rkang pa chag 'dug pas de'i nad dri la phyin cing*/ phyi nyin kong tong brgyud hong kong la 'byor song*/ ¿khra 'gu sprul ming pas/¿༄༅/ /nub ri bkra shis chos 'khor gling gsar btsugs zhus pa'i phyag yig de yang thog mar dman bu rang gi mi tsher bsod nams dman pa'i dbang gis spyir bod gangs can kyi ljongs su bstan pa nyams chags byung ba dang*/ lhag par rang gi me tog gang la phog pa'i lha skal rgyal ba'i dbang po sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtshos phyag btab gnang ba'i bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling de nyid rmeng med byung zhing*/ rang yang nyes med btsan byol du 'khyams dgos byung ba'i skabs/ rgya che zhing spus legs pa zhig dpal 'byor phra bas rngo ma thogs mod/ gdan sa de nyid ming med du ma song ba'i ched/ bal yul mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi mdun/ sa cha chung chung zhig gtsang nyos thog dgon pa gsar bzheng gi skabs/ dge 'dun gsar bzhugs shin tu dkon par brten/ 'brel yod 'ga' zhig la thabs shes byas kyang*/ de dag gis deng sang slob grwa khag tu bslab sbyang bya rgyu gal che ba dang*/ bslab sbyang med pa khag kyang tshong las khe bzang yod par brten/ grwa pa gsar zhugs ni phal cher re ba med pa lta bu lab pas shin tu blo pham pa zhig byung*/ 'on kyang dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa las re ba med stabs/ rten gtso thub dbang gi sku bzhengs pa'i skabs dge 'dun 'du ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ dge 'dun mthun pa'i 'khor lo so sor grangs brgya re gzungs dang lhan du phul nas/ kun slong bzang po'i smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor bcas gsol ba btab pas/

lo der nub ri nas grwa chung gi thog ma bstan 'dzin rdo rje byung zhing*/ rim pas gong 'phel gyis sngon bod du bstan pa dar ba'i skabs kyi dge 'dun las grangs mi dman tsam byung bas rten 'brel gyi la nye shin tu bzang bar ma zad/ chos ldan bal po'i yul ljongs 'di nyid chos lugs gang la yang yid ches dang*/ dad gus che zhing*/ lho phyogs rgya gar dang thag nyer bde thang gi steng du 'khod pa rnams phal cher bram ze'i chos lugs 'dzin cing*/ dbus tshogs rgyal sa dang 'brel ba'i bal po'i mi rigs rnams sngon nas dar ba'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len gyi rgyun legs sbyar thog zhal 'don gnang ba dang*/ byang phyogs pa rnams bod kyi skad yig thog 'khod pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos kyi rjes su 'brang nas dam pa'i chos kyi nyams len byed pa spyi dang*/ hi mā la yi lho brgyud ri sul du gnas pa'i mi rigs dang*/ lhag par nub ri'i phyogs kyi mi rnams chos dad che zhing*/ srog gcod spang ba la yul gru gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par ma zad tshes bcu dang*/ nyer lnga la tshogs 'khor dang mchod 'bul/ nya stong la bsnyen gnas srung ba sogs khyad chos du ma yod pa'i shin tu bsngags 'os su gyur bas bstan pa'i gzhi ma rab tu byung ba'i sde gtsang ma zhig byung na snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag gis/ rang dgon du bzhugs pa'i nub ri'i dge 'dun pa rnams la bgros mol byas par dga' tshor gyi steng nas dang len byung bas/ na mo bud+dha chos kyi shes rig dang nyams len gces skyong gi yid ches tshogs pa'i gdugs dkar 'og nub ri bkra shis chos 'khor gling zhes pa gsar btsugs zhus pa lags/ [khra 'gu sprul ming pas/]༄༅/ /bod kyi gdan sa khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling du sgrub khang nyams gso ched gnang ba'i phyag yig

rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal 7karma pa chos grags rgya mtshos phyag btab pa'i gdan sa khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling du si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bka' shog dang mthun rkyen bcas gsol ras gnang shing*/ rdza dge bla ma bkra shis lha dar zhes pa sgrub dpon du ched gtang gis nā ro chos drug gi sgrub khang gsar 'dzug thog /dbang lung man ngag phyag len myong khrid bcas zhib rgyas gnang ba ma nyams shing*/ rnam par dag pa'i rgyun bzhugs mod/ dus dbang gis nyams chags byung ba ni kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar las/ deng skabs chos dad rang dbang gi skal bzang gsar du tshes pa'i dus skabs dbang lung man ngag khrid phyag len gyi rgyun bcas ma nyams par slar gso thog /sgrub pa nyams len mthar phyin pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas su gyur pa mang po zhig 'byung dang 'byung bzhin pa la/ dad 'byor dang ldan pa'i rgyal phyi nang gi yul grur 'khod pa rnams kyis sgrub khang yar rgyas kyi ched du zhal 'debs tshogs rdzogs gnang na so so'i bsod nams 'phel zhing*/ bstan pa'i rgyun skyong ba'i phan pa rlabs po 'byung nges lags pas/ rang gis dka' ba spyad nas bsags pa'i nor rdzas las rang la phan pa'i snying po len thub pa zhig thugs la ma brjed par zhu zhes khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /bod kyi gdan sa khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling du bshad grwa nyams gso ched gnang ba'i phyag yig gdan sa khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling du mdo smad kyi mkhas pa'i dbang po 'ju mi pham 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje phebs nas lo gsum tsam bzhugs shing*/ gnas bdag dge bsnyen chen po la gsol ka yang gsar rtsom dang*/ khyad par bstan bcos chen po mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo las mkhas pa'i bya ba gnas bcu cha tshang gsar rtsom gnang nas/ thugs bskyed dang smon lam khyad par can gyis byin rlabs bstsal ba'i mthus/

khra legs nyi ma'i mtshan can brgyad pa bshad sgrub chos kyi nyi mas bshad grwa gsar 'dzug gnang thub pa byung ste/ zhe chen kong sprul pad+ma dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyis bstan bcos chen po shes bya mdzod kyi bshad khrid kyis dbu btsugs nas mkhan po blo gros rab gsal mchog gis dbu phar 'dul mdzod tshad ma dang bcas pa'i gzhung chen yongs rdzogs cha tshang bar gnang ste/ mkhas pa mang po zhig byon/ da lta de'i rgyun slar yang gsar spel gnang bzhin pa la/ rgyal phyi nang gi dad 'byor ldan pa khag gis rogs ram dang zhal 'debs gnang na rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing du 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur nas/ bsod nams rgya chen po 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gtong phod kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phyes nas rang rang gis bsags pa'i nor rdzas las rang la phan pa'i snying po len thub pa zhig kun gyi thugs la bzhag par zhu/ [khra 'gu sprul ming pas/]༄༅/ /'jar man sgrub sde theg chen yid 'ong gling rnams la gnang ba'i phyag yig spyir rgyal dbang bcu drug pa chen pos/ 'dzam gling gi sa gnas mang por zhabs kyis bcags shing*/ rgyal bstan spyi dang*/ lhag par sgrub brgyud karma kam tshang gi man ngag /zab lam na ro chos drug dang*/ dam chos phyag rgya chen po dag /'dzam gling gi yul gru mang por 'khod pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis nyams su len thub pa'i phrin las rgya cher spel ba'i nang tshan/ bla ma dge 'dun rin po che yo rub (Europe) phyogs ched gtang gnang nas/ 'di ga 'jar man hal ci sha yi (German Halscheid) la lo gsum gyi sgrub sde tshugs thub pa byung yod/ 'on kyang sgrub thengs gcig gi rjes bar chad lta bu'i rgyun skyong ma byung bar brten/ bar lam rang nas/ karma bka' brgyud kyi las byed pa yongs dang*/ slob ma rnams la 'bod bskul zhus pas khong rnam pa spyi dang*/ lhag par bla ma rdo ro this ya nas 'bad brtson chen po gnang bas sgrub khang gsar 'dzugs thub pa byung nas/

rgyal dbang bcu bdun pa chen pos sgrub sde theg chen yid 'ong gling zhes pa'i mtshan gnang shing*/ rang nas bla ma kun dga' rdo rje ched 'dzug gis sgrub sde gsar 'dzug skabs/ sgrub par bzhugs mkhan la lar chos dang sgrub pa la bzlog med kyi dad gus mos pa dang ldan mod/ dpal 'byor thog phyag dngul gyis ma 'dang bas bar chad chen po zhig 'ong gi 'dug par brten/ dad 'byor dang ldan pa khag nas de dag la mthun rkyen rogs ram gang drag gnang na/ chos nyams len gnang ba po rnams kyi bar chad bral ba dang*/ rogs ram gnang mkhan la yang bsod nams chen po thob pas phyag dngul gtang ba don yod par 'gyur nges la brten/ thams cad nas gang drag gnang rogs zhu/ khra 'gu bas/ ༄༅/ /gnyi shang btsun ma'i sgrub sde nyams gso ched gnang ba'i phyag yig deng dus spyir gsang sngags kyi chos nyams len gnang 'dod yod pa mang po zhig yod pa dang*/ lhag par bud med a ne byed 'dod yod pa dang*/ nyams len la mos pa yod mkhan shin tu mang po zhig yod na yang*/ nyams len gnang yul btsun ma'i sgrub sde shin tu dkon par brten/ sgrub sde zhig med thabs med pa zhig yod par ma zad/ sa gnas gnyi shang brag dkar rje btsun mi la ras pas khyi ra ba mgon po rdo rje rjes su bzung ba'i gnas dang thag nyer/ lo shas ring shin tu stabs bde'i btsun ma'i sgrub sde zhig btsugs kyang*/ da lta khang pa rnying nas nyen kha che ba lta bur song bas/ sgrub sde de gsar bzhengs mi bya thabs med du 'dug pas/ sgrub sde'i ched zhal 'debs gnang ba shin tu phan thogs che zhing*/ lhag par bud med rigs brtson 'grus che bas/ gal te sgrub khang gi mthun rkyen legs pa zhig byung tshe/ nyams len shin tu legs pa mang po zhig 'byung nges la brten zhal 'debs gnang ba'i sbyin bdag la bsod nams rgya chen 'byung bar nges pas/ de bzhin rang gzhan gnyis phan la thugs bsam gnang rogs zhu/

khra 'gu sprul ming pas/ phyi lo 2001 zla ba 7 tshes 10 la/༄༅/ /snar smad sa stegs dgon pa nyams gso ched gnang ba'i phyag yig ༄༅/ /ne pal byang phyogs hi ma la ya'i ri brgyud dol po/ gnye shang snar bcas par mkhas grub karma blo bzang zhes pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa zhig byon nas zhal slob mang po la gdams ngag gnang zhing*/ bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa 'ga' zhig phyag btab pa'i nang tshan/ snar lung par stod smad gnyis yod pa'i/ snar smad du sa stegs dgon pa zhes pa zhig phyag btab ste/ yul mi yongs la chos kyi 'gro don dang phan thogs ci che byung mod/ deng gi dus bal bod sa mtshams dang*/ hi ma la ya'i ri gzar du song stabs rgyu 'grul dka' ba'i dbang gis dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs dman pas/ gtsug lag khang de yang bdag med lta bur gyur nas nyams gud ci cher byung bar brten/ gtsug lag khang de ma nyams par skyong ba'i thabs shes byed 'char 'dug pa la/ dad ldan rnams kyis zhal 'debs gang drag gnang na dgon pa nyams chags las skyabs pa dang*/ rang nyid kyang bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa ste rang gzhan gnyis sman du 'gro 'dug pas/ thams cad kyi tshogs rdzogs zhal 'debs gang zab gnang rogs bka' drin zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas hin sgor sum stong bcas phul/ ༄༅/ /ke na ḍar gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i phyag yig spyir ke na ḍa ni/ zhi bde che la/ mi rigs dang*/ chos lugs ma 'dra sna tshogs zhi mthun du gnas pa zhig yin pa dang*/ lhag par B.C.yul ljongs mdzes shing bsil drod snyoms pas lta bskor ba dang*/ thugs spro la yong ba'i mi mang stabs dam pa'i chos kyi bsti gnas gtsug lag khang zhig yod na/ chos ldan gyi mi dang*/ chos med pa'i mi sogs kun la zhi bde bag phebs kyi snang ba dang*/ bag chags bzang po zhig 'byung bar nges pas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa 'di la kun gyis 'brel ba gnang rogs zhu/

zhes khra 'gu sprul ming pas spyi lo 2005 zla 8 tshes 10 nyin ne pal mchod rten bya rung kha shor nas bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /rgya nag dang bod kyi theg chen gnyis la khyad par yod med dang*/ bod du chos dar tshul gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ rgya nag lugs kyi theg pa chen po dang*/ bod lugs kyi gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis gcig tu mthun pa'i gnas ni/ gnyis ka ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyam med shākya'i dbang po'i rjes 'jug yin par gcig pa dang*/ de'i gsungs pa'i mdo sde rnams dam pa'i chos yang dag par khas len cing*/ 'dul ba/ mdo sde/ mngon pa ste sde snod gsum zhal gyi bzhes pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum/ bden pa bzhi/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ phar phyin drug tshad med bzhi/ bdag med gnyis/ mi dge bcu spang*/ dge bcu sgrub pa sogs dam pa'i chos kyi brda chad dang*/ dam pa'i chos kyi ngos 'dzin/ nyams su len tshul sogs phal cher dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig yin pa smos med la/ khyad par cung zad yod pa ni/ rgya gar nas chos dar ba'i skabs su rgya yi mkhas pa dang lo tsā ba rnams kyis rgya yig dang rgya skad du bsgyur zhing*/ de bzhin bod kyis mkhas pa dang lo tsā ba rnams kyi bod skad dang bod yig tu bsgyur bas/ deng dus so so'i yul gyi skad yig thog zhal 'don dang*/ chos kyi slob sbyong sogs gnang gi yod pa dang*/ yul so so'i lugs srol ltar rab tu byung ba rnams kyi na bza' dang na bza'i dbyibs/ de bzhin kha dog sogs ma 'dra ba yod la/ gsang sngags kyi lugs la lha bdag bskyed du bsgoms pa de bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs srol lta bu lags/de bzhin bod kyi chos dar tshul lo rgyus ni/ dus rabs bdun pa'i nang rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs blon po thu mi sam bho ṭa rgya gar du byon nas rgya gar gyi yi ge la dpe byas shing*/

bod kyi skad dang mthun pa'i yi ge rtsom nas chos bsgyur/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga yi rjes rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skabs sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung nas dge 'dun gyi sde tshugs shing*/ gu ru rin po ches rnying ma/ 'brog mi lo tsā bas sa skya/ mar pa lo tsā bas bka' brgyud/ rje tsong kha pas dge lugs bcas dar bar mdzad pa lags so zhes khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge/༄༅/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ngo sprod dang brgyud pa ngos 'dzin/ de'i dbang zhu ba dang sngags bzla ba'i phan nus/ spyir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs ni/ rgyal ba rigs gsum mgon po ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs dmigs pa med pa snying rje chen po'i rang gzugs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang*/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rang gzugs 'phags mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs/ phrin las nus pa'i rang gzugs gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje yin pas na/ rang nyid ye shes dang shes rab 'phel ba dang*/ gzhan la yang bu dang bu mo la sogs par shes rab 'phel ba'i thabs ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs la gsol ba btab pa dang*/ sku bsgom pa dang*/ sngags bzla ba bcas shin tu gal che ba yin la/ yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs drag tu khros pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa nyid yin pas/ mthu stobs nus pa che zhing shes rab dang ye shes 'phel ba la nus pa myur bas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang zhu ba dang sngags bzla ba sogs phan nus shin tu che zhing*/ spyir bod du dar ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed la brgyud pa ma 'dra brgyad bzhugs pa las/ bka' brgyud lugs kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed 'di ni brgyud pa gsum du 'dus pa/ mal gyo lo tsā ba blo gros grags kyi brgyud pa las byung bas byin rlabs dang*/

nus pa lhag par che zhing*/ skabs 'dir rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang byed rgyu byung ba 'dis dpal 'byor nyams pa gsos shing*/ 'jigs bskul ring lugs kyi 'tshe ba 'jig rten kun tu zhi zhing bde skyid dang byin rlabs 'phel bar 'gyur bas thams cad kyis do gal chen po'i sgo nas sgrub pa nyams len gang gzab gnang rogs zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas/༄༅/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong byung tshul dang de'i dbang 'thob pa'i phan yon/ spyir rang re rnams kyis dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa'i gnas 'di dang*/ dus tshod 'di ni bskal pa bzang po zhes sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang*/ mkhas grub mang pos bstan bcos las gsungs pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang bskal pa 'di thog mar chags pa'i skabs/ gser gyi me tog stong skyes pas lha rnams kyis ma 'ongs par bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong byon nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur bas bskal pa bzang po yin no zhes brjod par grags/ des na bskal pa 'dir skyes pa ni rang ngos nas skye ba snga mar bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa la brten nas/ sangs rgyas stong la dad pa dang mos gus bskyed pas sngon bsags dge ba'i las 'phro yod pa zhig dang*/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ lhag par ston mchog shākya'i rgyal pos thugs rjes rjes su bzung ba'i skal ldan zhig yin par brten/ bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong la gsol 'debs smon lam zhus na 'bras bu chen po nges par thob thub pa'i 'brel ba bzang po zhig yod par brten/ da lam sangs rgyas stong gi dbang dang byin rlabs zhu na sangs rgyas stong la 'brel ba bzang po zhig byung bas 'di phyi'i rkyen ngan zlog cing*/ legs tshogs kyi 'brel ba la brten nas bskal pa bzang ba'i sgo phye ba yin pas/ thams cad kyi go skabs bzang po chud zos ma 'gro bar shin tu gal che zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas/༄༅/

/grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs dang dbang bskur thob pa gal che ba'i skor dang*/ yi dam gyi lha zhal sbyor gyi rgyu mtshan/ spyir bdag cag gi ston mchog shākya'i rgyal po 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir byon te dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad pas/ rgya gar nas brtsams yul gru rnams su nyan thos kyi theg pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa bcas so sor dar zhing rgyas pa'i nang tshan/ bod du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos dar ba yin la/ de'i phyir rdo rje theg pa'i man ngag sogs 'chad nyan gyi srol/ nyams len gyi rgyun rnams da lta'i bar du ma nyams par 'phel zhing rgyas par ma zad/ grub pa thob pa'i skyes bu chen po rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes sogs la mnga' brnyes pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byung thub pa ni/ dmigs bsal dam pa'i chos khyad par can yod pa las byung ba ste/ de yang mar pa lo tsā sogs skyes chen mang po bod nas rgya gar du byon/ nā ro dang mai tri pa sogs grub thob mang po zhig dang mjal/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde chen po bzhi thams cad dang*/ lhag par rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde chen po rnams kyi dbang dang gdams ngag /man ngag thams cad zhus nas thugs nyams su bzhes te/ zab chos de rnams gdan drangs shing spel ba las byung ba yin la/ de ltar zab chos zhu yul grub thob chen po yang*/ pho grub pa thob pa dang*/ mo grub pa thob pa/ rab byung grub pa thob pa dang*/ khyim na bzhugs pa grub pa thob pa/ mkhas pa grub pa thob pa/ bya bral grub pa thob pa sogs gtso bo grub thob chen po brgyad cu rtsa bzhi byon pa yin pas/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i zab chos nyams len byed na grub thob chen po de rnams la dad pa dang*/ mos gus/ gsol 'debs ma byas na byin rlabs 'jug dka' bas/ gsol 'debs sogs nyams len byed rgyu gal che zhing*/

de ltar nyams len byed pa la grub thob chen po brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun dbang bskur thob pa shin tu gal che ba lags/yi dam gyi lha zhal sbyor gyi rgyu mtshan ni/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos las/ yi dam gyi lha zhal sbyor gyi bskyed rim sgom pa dang*/ de bzhin dmigs pa'i rten zhal thang*/ sku brnyan sogs bshams pa dang*/ gsar gzhengs gnang ba ni/ spyir chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa dang*/ de yang stong pa ci yang med pa ma yin par snang ba rten 'brel zung du 'jug pa mtshon pa'i phyir dang*/ stong pa dbyings skye ba med pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa zung 'jug tu yod par ston pa'i ched du yin pa ma zad/ zhe sdang can 'dul ba'i ched du khro bo'i rnam pa dang*/ 'dod chags can 'dul ba'i ched du zhal sbyor gyi rnam par sgom na nyon mongs zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyi zhi ba dang*/ stong par shes pa sogs dgos pa shin tu gal che ba las/ rang gar skyes pa bud med kyi chags sred dang*/ chags sred 'phel ba'i ched lta bu ga la yin/ de bzhin ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i skabs su chos kyi gnas lugs rjen par rtogs pa dang*/ stong nyid kyi gnas lugs rjen par dngos su mjal ba'i mtshon don du yi dam gyi lha yi sku gcer bur sgom pa dang*/ yul stong pa nyid dang*/ yul can shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskyed pa'i yum lta bur gyur pa'i phyir yi dam gyi lha yum gyi rnam par sgom pa yin lags/ [khra 'gu sprul ming pas/]༄༅/ /spyan ras gzigs/ sman bla/ gu ru zhi ba bcas kyi sgom bzlas kyi phan yon/

skabs 'dir spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom bzlas 'gro don mkha' khyab dang*/ sman bla'i sgom bzlas/ gu ru zhi ba'i sgom bzlas bcas sgra 'dzin 'khor thag dang*/ phyag dpe bcas hong kong khra 'gu chos tshogs nas gsar bskrun gnang ba 'dis/ slob ma tshos nyams len byed skabs phan thogs chen po 'byung bar ma zad/ spyir bsgom bzlas bsdus pa 'di dag nyams len gnang bde la/ byin rlabs che bas thams cad kyis dus rgyun nyams len byed pa'am/ skabs skabs su nyams len byed pa gang yin rung*/ phan thogs dang dgos pa shin tu che ste/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom bzlas byas pas nyon mongs dang las ngan zhi zhing*/ ngan song gi skye sgo chod pa dang*/ sman bla nyams len byas na/ lus sems bde ba thob cing*/ na tsha dang rkyen ngan zhi/ gal te nad med sogs lus sems bde ba yod/ de nyid yun ring du gnas/ gu ru rin po che'i sgom bzlas byas na gzugs can gyi dgra dang*/ gzugs med kyi bgegs sogs kyi gnod pa dang bral nas gnas skabs rkyen ngan dang bar chad zhi ba dang*/ mthar thug mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob pas kun gyi do gal chen pos sbyangs brtson dang*/ nyams len gnang grub pa zhu zhes khra 'gu sprul ming pas spyi lo 2007 zla 6 tshes 25 nyin hong kong du bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /dam pa'i chos la sbyangs brtson nyams len dang sgom pa'i phan yon/ spyir dam pa'i chos byas na gnod sems dang phrag dog la sogs pa chung zhing*/ rang las che ba rnams la brtsi bkur dang*/ rang las dman pa rnams la byams sems dang snying rje skye bas gcig gis gcig la mthun lam dang 'brel ba bzang po 'byung bas gzhan la mi gnod cing phan thogs pa dang*/ de la brten nas rang la yang gzhan gyis brtsi mthong dang*/ rogs ram thob pas rang gzhan gnyis ka la phan thogs chen po 'byung*/ dam pa'i chos sbyang na gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam pa ngan pa dang bslu ba'i rdzun dang g.yo sgyu'i bsam pa rnams nyung du 'gro bar ma zad/

spyi phan dang lhag bsam/ mthong rgya che ba sogs la brten nas/ yul mi spyi dang nang mi spyi la 'khon 'dzin dang 'khrug pa la sogs pa med par kun la phan zhing gnod pa med pas rang nyid kyang sems la dga' spro dang*/ de la brten nas lus bde/ tshe ring nad med/ bya ba lam du 'gro bas bde skyid 'phel/ sgom byas pa'i phan yon ni/ spyir rang rang gi spyod lam ngan pa/ goms gshis ngan pa/ bsam pa ngan pa rnams spang dgos/ spyod lam bzang po/ goms gshis bzang po sogs brten dgos/ de lta bu 'gyur bcos byed pa ni bshad sla ba dang shes sla ba zhig yin kyang*/ lag len la de ltar sla ba ma yin pas/ de la phan pa'i thabs sgom dgos/ sgom byas na de rnams 'gyur bcos sla ba zhig yin pas sgom byed pa ni shin tu gal che/ sgom byed pa de shin tu gal che mod/ de yar rgyas btang ba la dka' ngal yod pas/ sgom yar rgyas 'gro ba la mtshams bsdad dgos/ mtshams bsdad na sgom yag po yong gi red/ deng dus dpal 'byor dang shes yon sogs gong 'phel 'byung bzhin pa ni mi yi bsod nams zhig red/ 'on kyang bsam pa bzang po/ spyod lam bzang po mthun lam sogs gong 'phel 'byung gi med/ de la brten nas dmag 'khrugs/ nad yams/ 'byung ba'i gnod pa sogs che ru 'gro gi yod/ de la phan pa'i thabs chos dar dgos/ chos dar ba la lha khang dang mchod rten la sogs pa gzhengs dgos pa'i phyir/ zhal 'debs phul na chos dar bas gnod pa zhi zhing bde skyid 'phel/ bsod nams chen po 'byung*/ bsod nams chen po 'byung na/ rang yang tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rgyas/ bya ba gang sgrub kyang bar chad zhi ba sogs 'byung bas phan thogs chen po yod/ ces khra 'gu sprul ming pas spyi lo 2005 zla 3 tshes 10 nyin bris/༄༅/ /bla ma la dad pa yid ches skye phyir rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar mjal dgos tshul/ spyir chos byed pa mthar thug gtan gyi bde ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub pa'i kun slong khyad par can dang ldan pa zhig yin na yang rung*/

yang gnas skabs 'phral gyi rkyen sel/ bar chad zhi zhing bsam don 'grub ste/ bya ba lam du 'gro ba'i ched du yin kyang rung*/ gang ltar rtsa ba chos dang bla ma la dad pa rnam par dag pa dang*/ yid ches khyad par du 'phags pa skye ba shin tu gal che ste/ yid ches dang dad pa khyad par can zhig byung na chos kyi nyams len dang*/ gnas skabs kyi zhabs rim gang la yang nus pa thon pa zhig 'ong ba yin cing*/ de lta bu'i dad pa dang yid ches skye ba'i rgyu ni/ spyir rnam thar dang lo rgyus gsung mgur sogs mjal dgos pa yin/ de las kyang rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa'i rnam thar mjal na/ khong gi dang por bla ma bsten tshul/ bar du nyams len skyong tshul/ mthar 'bras bu thob tshul bcas shin tu ngo mtshar dang yid ches skye 'os pa zhig yin pa'i phyir/ da lam mi la ras pa'i mgur gyi chos thun dang gsung mgur dbyangs su len pa/ rnam thar nyung shas 'khrab ston byed pa mjal rgyu 'di ni shin tu gal che ste chos chos su 'gro ba dang*/ chos lam du 'gro ba'i thabs khyad par can lags pas thugs la mnga' bar zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas/༄༅/ /gter bum gyi phan yon dang*/ bum pa bca' ba dang sgrub tshul/ spyir deng dus dpal 'byor dang 'phrul 'khor yar rgyas phyin pa'i stobs kyis gser dngul/ zangs lcags/ rdo rje pha lam/ pad+ma ra ga sogs rin po che'i rigs/ gzhan yang nye bar mkho ba snum dang rlangs rdzas/ tha na sa rdo/ bye ma sogs kyi gter kha bcas bsngog 'don byas dang byed bzhin pa dang*/ de bzhin gdod ma'i nags tshal gcod 'breg /chu bo dang rgya mtsho 'bag btsog byung ba sogs kyis/ 'dzam gling gi snod bcud gnyis kar nyams nyes sna tshogs zhig 'byung dang 'byung bzhin par ma zad/ ma 'ongs par ha cang nyen tshabs che ba'i tshul tshan rig pa rnams nas 'bod bskul byed bzhin pa ltar la/ rkyen ngan de dag las skyobs pa dang*/ nyams pa gso ba'i thabs/

dam pa'i chos kyi sgo nas bkra shis pa'i gter gyi bum pa 'di nyid yin la/de yang bum pa bca' ba dang sgrub pa'i tshul ni/ rin po che sna tshogs dang*/ bkra shis pa'i smon tshig /lhag par byin rlabs dang nus pa che ba'i gzungs sngags khyad par can mang po sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ grub thob gong ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten sna tshogs bsdus nas bum pa'i nang du tshul dang mthun par bzhag /bla grwa bsnyen song can mang pos cho ga'i sgo nas sgrub pa byas shing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis byin gyis brlabs dang*/ rab gnas gnang ba'i bum pa 'di nyid ri dang*/ mtsho/ brag la sogs par sbas kyang rung*/ lhag par gtsug lag khang ngam/ lha khang gi rten gtso gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas su sbas na/ spyir 'dzam gling gi snod bcud gnyis kyi rgud pa gso zhing*/ khyad par nad dang dmag 'khrugs sogs rkyen ngan rnams zhi nas/ bde skyid dpal 'byor sogs 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur la/ lhag par gang du gnas pa'i yul gru de nyid dang*/ grong khyer de nyid la gnas pa'i skye 'gro yongs la bar chad zhi zhing*/ bkra shis bde legs 'byung ba'i gter gyi bum pa lags so zhes gter bum gyi phan yon khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge/so thar sdom rgyun/ bod du dar ba'i so thar sdom rgyun la/ smad 'dul dang*/ stod 'dul/ kha che lugs te gsum byung ba'i gsum pa kha che lugs/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dpal mtshan rnam gnyis kyi ya gyal byang chub dpal/ dbang phyug grags pa/ gzhon nu byang chub/ gnas brtan yon rgyal/ yon tan blo gros/ 'dul 'dzin seṅge dpal/ rab 'byor seṅge/ chos grub seṅge/ karma pa brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje/ zhwa dmar lnga pa dkon mchog yan lag karma pa dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje/ zhwa dmar drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug/ grub dbang bdud rtsi/ ding ri ba karma rnam rol/ zhwa dmar brgyad pa chos kyi don grub/

si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed/ karma pa bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ karma pa bcu bzhi pa theg mchog rdo rje/ zla ba bzang po/ mkhan chen bkra shis 'od zer/ si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po/ karma pa bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje nas bka' drin thob pa lags/ [khra 'gu sprul ming pas/]༄༅/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po yi ge drug pa'i phan yon/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po yi ge drug pa'i phan yon ni/ spyir 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs snying rje chen po'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ yig drug bzlas pas byams pa dang snying rje 'phel zhing*/ zhe sdang dang phrag dog zhi/ de la brten nas sems la bde skyid dang*/ yon tan gyi rigs 'phel ba dang*/ gzhan yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs ni/ phyag stong spyan stong bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi spyi gzungs yin pa'i phyir/ yig drug la brten nas sangs rgyas stong gi byin rlabs 'jug pas rang gis bzlas pas byin rlabs 'jug cing*/ ma zad sgra thos pas byin rlabs 'jug pa dang*/ yi ge mthong bas byin rlabs 'jug pa dang*/ mgul du btags pas byin gyis rlabs nas bar chad sogs las srung*/ yig drug gis sgrub pa'i ma ṇi ril bu zos pas byin rlabs 'jug ste nad gdon zhi ba sogs thun mong gi yon tan dang*/ yig 'bru re re'i phan yon ni/ gsham gsal re'u mig tu gsal bas gzigs par zhu/yig drug so so/ nyon mongs drug zhi ba/ rigs drug las thar ba/ ye shes drug thob pa/ rgyal ba rigs lnga dang rdo rje 'chang*/ zhing khams drug tu skye ba/ phrin las rnams 'grub pa/ oṃ/ nga rgyal/ lha/ mnyam nyid/ rin 'byung*/ dpal dang ldan/ rgyas pa/ ma phrag dog/ lha min/ bya grub/ don yod grub/ las rab rdzogs/ drag po/ ṇi 'dod chags/ mi/ ye shes lnga/ rdo rje 'chang*/ chos sku'i zhing khams/

mchog/ pad gti mug/ dud 'gro/ chos dbyings/ rnam snang*/ 'og min/ thun mong*/ me ser sna/ yi dwags/ sor rtog/ 'od dpag med/ bde ba can/ dbang*/ hūm̐ zhe sdang*/ dmyal ba/ me long*/ mi bskyod pa/ mngon par dga' ba/ zhi ba/ de ltar yig drug la phan yon khyad par can dang ldan pas yid bzlas sam rdor bzlas dbyangs dang bcas pa sogs gang ltar yang rung ste/ bye ba dung phyur sogs bzla ba dang*/ yig drug bzlas pa'i sgra rang gis nyan pa dang*/ gzhan la thos su bcug pa/ spyan ras gzigs bsgom bzlas la brtson pa shin tu gal che zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /rgyal ba rin po che'i bka' bslab gnang ba'i gsung lan/ 'dzam gling skye rgu yongs rdzogs dus 'khrugs kyi yo lang las bskyabs pa'i thugs bskyed dang phrin las bka' drin bskyang nas/ skyabs dang mgon dang dpung gnyen gcig pur gyur pa/ rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i zhabs pad gser khris mngon par gtegs pa'i nyer drung du/lha phyag grangs med bcas gus khra 'gu sprul ming pas zhu gsol 'debs snying*/ deng mgon po mchog nyid bdag cag gangs can pa'i skye 'gro rnams kyi bsod nams bgo skal du zhabs pad rdo rje'i ngo bor brtan bzhin bzhugs pa dang*/ lhag par gus skyabs 'og par thugs rtses rjes su skyong nas/ mdzad brel shin tu rgyas na yang*/ dman bus gsar gzhengs zhus pa'i dgon du lan gsum zhabs kyis bcags te byin rlabs gnang ba dang*/ de skabs pha mas bu la brtse ba lta bu'i bka' bslabs snying gi bdud rtsi spyi bo'i rgyan du bstsal ba bka' drin bsam pa'i rwa ba las brgal bas snying nas thugs rje che zhu rgyur ma zad/ de dag snying gcang gis zhib 'jug zhus pa khag snyan gsan zhu rgyu/ de yang bka' bslab dang po bka' drin bskyang ba ni/ dgon 'di 'grems ston khang lta bu ma yin par 'chad nyan gyi sde zhig grub par gyis zhes phebs pa snying gcang gis 'bad brtson gang nus bgyis kyang*/

kha 'khos zhan stabs rgya che ba zhig ni ma grub mod/ 'on kyang rang nus dang bstun pa'i stabs bde zhig go bsgrigs byas nas rim pas yar rgyas 'byung ba'i re ba bya bzhin pa lags/ de bzhin bka' bslab gnyis pa/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ sku mdog dkar po min nam zhib 'jug gyis zhes phebs par/ rang don rang gces gyis zhib 'jug nan tan zhus pas/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsdus rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ brtag pa phyi ma'i le'u lnga pa sku gsung thugs mngon par 'byung ba'i le'ur/ bskyed rim sgom pa'i tshul gsungs pa las/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bstan pa'i skabs/ nyi mar bzhugs shing rol mor bcas//kha dog nag po 'jigs pa po'i//sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin//sogs sku mdog nag po yin pa'i tshul zhal gsal tsam zhig /rda sar spar bskrun gnang ba'i bka' 'gyur/ rgyud sde/ pod ka ldeb 369mdun phreng 6nang 'dug pa/ zhib 'jug gzab nan zhus pa yin/ bka' bslab gsum pa/ gal te bsnyen tshad med na/ 'brug smyon kun legs kyi mgur las/ dbang bskur mang po zhus lags sam//dam nyams mang po bsags lags sam//zhes pa lta bu zhig 'byung nyen che bas/ dgyes rdor bsnyen tshad nges par gtang dgos zhes bka' bstsal gnang ba snying gcang gis/ 'bad brtson zhu bzhin lags mod/ spyir btang gi dbang du byas na/ dbang bskur dang*/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg sogs slob dpon gyi phyag len gnang ba po rnams la bsnyen tshad med na mi rung mod/ nyams len dkyus ma sgrub mchod sgo nas mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ sngags bzla ba tsam la bsnyen tshad med kyang mi rung ba zhig e yin snyam pa lta bu byung ba bcas/ thugs brtses rjes su skyong ba'i bka' bslabs snying gi bdud rtsir bstsal ba khag /gal chung byas nas yal bar dor ba ni ga la rung snyam/ 'bad brtson gang nus thog zhib 'jug zhus pa rnams/ snyan gsan zhus pa lags pas/

nor 'khrul gang mchis la bka' slob spyi bo'i rgyan du stsol gnang bka' drin zhu rgyu dang*/ 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar thugs brtses rjes su bzung nas/ 'gal rkyen bar chad sogs mi 'byung ba'i skyabs srung thugs rje'i rwa gur las mi 'dor bar skyabs 'jug zhu mtshon rin chen dang po'i rdzas mtshon tsam zhig dang mjal dar bcas gus pas phul/༄༅/ /skyo brag mkhan po dga' dbang gis zab mo nang don gyi dris lan/ mnyam med rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni//'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i sman yin zhes//ched du bsngags phyir de 'dzin mkhas grub rnams//gus pa'i phyag gi yul du cis mi bsten//de la dus tshod yun ring po zhig gi sngon du/ phran rang byes bgrod gcig gi skabs mkhas pa'i dbang po mchog gis zab mo nang don las brtsams pa'i dri ba kha shas shig gsung rtsom thog phran la gnang byung yang*/ de la lan ma phul ba yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dang po de skabs byes bgrod yin par brten yig cha la zhib 'jug byed pa'i go skabs ma byung ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ rang gi bsam 'char la de ni mkhas pas rnam dpyod ngoms pa'i ched tsam yin 'dra bas lan med pa gzi brjid che snyam nas gus zhabs kyi tshul du byas pa dang*/ gsum pa ni/ dris lan dang dgag lan sogs mang po byas na/ dze smad rin po ches shugs ldan rtogs brjod rtsom pa bzhin/ don med rnyog zing gi rgyur 'gyur nyen yod pas blun po smra ba nyung na mdzes snyam nas spros pa bskyung ba yin mod/ nye char kun dga'i skyed tshal zhes pa'i dus deb las/ dri ba de yang du mjal bas phal cher lan zhig phul na snyam pa byung ba'i khar/ bshad grwa'i phyag dpe mkho sprod kyi phyag las gnang ba po grwa pa gzhon nu phyag dpe la thugs snang che zhing*/ lhag par btsun tshugs dang 'dul ba la gces spras phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa dge slong tshe ring gis bskul ma gnang ba la brten nas bris pa tsam las zab gnad rtogs pa'i nges shes dang*/

rnam dpyod gang yang med pas dris lan la nor 'khrul byung yod na bzod gsol zhu gi yin/ de yang dri ba gsum gnang ba'i dang po/ lus 'grub tshul gyi le'u+u las/ lus ni 'grub pa'i tshul bshad pa//kun gzhi srog rlung dang bcas pa//khams gsum skye bar sbyor ba na//zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang rlung gi le'u las/ thog mar rnam shes la brten pa//srog rlung a yi rnam pa can//nam mkha'i khams kyi rang bzhin yin//zhes gsungs pa de gnyis/ 'grel pa rnams nas 'du byed yid kyi g.yo bar bshad pas de gnyis gcig par mi rung ste bskyed bya skyed byed gcig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes dang*/ dri ba'i gsal byed du/ dri ba dang po'i dwogs gzhi kun gzhi rnam shes khams gsum skye ba sbyor byed kyi srog rlung dang*/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga yi ya gyal gyi srog rlung gnyis gcig yin min zhes gsungs 'dug pas de la lan phul ba ni de gnyis gcig lags zhes zhu rgyu yin/ 'on kyang bskyed bya skyed byed yin pa ni/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i nang don rtsa ba dang*/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi 'grel pa zab don snang byed/ dwags ram pa chos rgyal bstan pa'i sems kyi rnam par thar pa'i rgyan gang du'ang ma mjal bas/ gzhi med kyi dwogs pa zhig yin 'dra lags/ dri ba gnyis pa/ rlung gi le'u las/ spyir ni lus rnams kun khyab kyang*//rtsa ba dbu ma srog rlung ni//dbus gnas kun gzhi brtan par byed//nam mkha'i mgon po zhes bya ba//'chi ba'i tshe na yang dag rgyu/ /zhes dang*/ yang*/ de gnyis dbus nas rgyu ba'i rlung*//drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga ni//sgra gcan mkha' dang ye shes kyi//rlung ste gnyis su med pa thugs/ /zhes dang*/ mdor na dbugs gcig so gnyis cha//bsags pas de ltar gyur pa yin/ /zhes dang*/ ye shes las ni thams cad pa//thun mtshams mnyam du rgyu dus so/ /zhes dang*/ yang*/

khams kun las ni yang dag 'byung*//rten dang brten pas bzung ba ni//rnam par snang mdzad rang bzhin te//'chi ba'i mthar ni 'byung bar 'gyur//zhes pa rnams gcig par mi rigs te rgyu tshul mi mthun pa dang*/ dgag sgrub kyi rlung gcig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ tha dad par mi rung ste spyi'i go babs gcig tu bstan pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dri ba'i gsal byed las/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga yi ya gyal srog chen po'i rlung ngam dgag bya mun pa chen po'i rlung dang*/ sna bug gnyis nas rgyu ba'i sgra gcan gyi rlung*/ dbugs kyi cha shas su rgyu ba'i ye shes kyi rlung ste/ gsum bshad gda' ba de dag gcig yin min zhes gsungs pa'i dris lan ni/spyir rlung zhes pa ni/ theg pa thun mong gi lugs mngon pa mdzod las/ sra gsher dro nyid g.yo ba rnams//'jig rten gyi ni tha snyad du//kha dog dbyibs la sa zhes brjod//chu me yang ngo rlung tshogs khams//nyid yin de dang 'dra ba'ang yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi mtshan nyid yin pas mtshan nyid de dang ldan pa ni/ nang gi shes pa/ brjod pa ngag /rags pa lus la sogs pa thams cad la khyab pa'i phyir/ bem shes bye brag pa zhig la ngos 'dzin ga la rung*/ des na srog rlung ni/ rlung thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ bdun pa nyon mongs pa'i yid yin pa dang*/ des gshis skye med la bdag dang*/ gdangs 'gags med la gzhan du 'dzin te/ chu rlabs lta bu g.yos pas rlung du ngos 'dzin gnang zhing*/ de nyid spang bya nyon mongs pa yin pas dgag bya zhes gsungs pa dang*/ ngo bo ma rig pa yin par brten mun pa chen po/ tshe 'di'i gnas lus longs spyod kyi 'khrul snang rnams brtan por gnas pa'i rgyur gyur pas srog chen po'i rlung zhes bya ba yin/ 'on kyang 'khrul snang de dag chos nyid gdod ma'i gnas lugs las ma 'das pa'i phyir/ dus 'khor ltar na sgra gcan gyi rlung dang*/

rgyud gzhan dag gi dgongs pa ltar na ye shes kyi rlung ste/ de dag dang dbyer med du 'dres te gnas par ngos 'dzin gnang ba zhig dang*/ lhag par rlung la gnad du bsnun pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes bskyed nus pa zhig yin pa'i phyir/ dgag sgrub kyi rlung gnyis gcig tu 'gyur ba'i thugs dwaugs ga la dgos/ de bzhin thugs dwogs gnyis pa rgyu tshul mi mthun pa'i skyon yang mi 'byung ste/ nang don rtsa ba las/ spyir ni lus rnams kun khyab kyang*/ /rtsa ba dbu ma srog rlung ni//zhes sogs gsungs pas lus kun la khyab pa'i phyir/ lha bzhengs na bzhugs rgyu med pa dang*/ bzhugs na bzhengs rgyu med pa zhig ma yin par nges/ de'i phyir gong du gsungs pa'i gzhung tshig gi dgongs par gnas pa'i rlung gsum po de rnams ngo bo gcig yin/ tha dad du khas len mi dgos/ de nas dri ba gsum pa/ phyi nang du 'gro 'ong byed pa'i rlung 'di sems yin na bem shes gcig tu 'gyur zhing*/ min na/ mdor na rlung gi rnam rtog ste/ /zhes pa dang 'gal lo zhes dang*/ dri ba'i gsal byed du/ phyi nang du 'gro 'ong byed pa'i rlung 'di sems yin min rnams yin/ zhes gnang ba'i dris lan ni/ phyi nang du 'gro ba'i rlung 'di sems yin/ de tsam du ma zad snang ba thams cad sems kyi snang ba yin/ bem shes gcig tu 'gyur ba'i skyon ga la 'byung ste/ gal te de lta bu la skyon 'byung na/ gzugs stong pa'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa tsam yang dngos dngos med gcig tu 'gyur ba'i skyon 'byung nges pas/ ha cang thal ba'i phyir/ des na snang tshul du rlung la 'gro 'ong gi rnam pa lta bu zhig yod mod/ brtags na ngos bzung yod pa'i dngos po zhig med stabs/ rnam rtog gi tshor ba tsam du 'dzin pa la skyon ci yang yod par mi sems so/ /zhes rab gnas sa bya'i dga' ldan lnga mchod nyin khra 'gu bas bris pa lags/ mkhas pa dgyes pa'i rnam dpyod ma mchis pas//dris lan ma phul ba yis thugs pham zhes//thos pa 'dzin pa'i bu gar son pa na//dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod sprin 'di phul lo//༄༅/
/bud med dge slong ma sgrub thabs kyi dris lan/

'dzam gling zhi bde'i ded dpon 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i phrin las kyi byed po/ chos don lhan khang gi mdzad gtso mchog la gus gsol/ deng gi char 7skyabs mgon rin po che gang gi bka' drin las gangs can bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung rnams ma nyams gong 'phel gyis 'dzam gling gi yul gru kun tu khyab cing 'phel bzhin par ma zad/ rten dman pa bud med kyi rigs rnams kyis dge slong ma'i sdom pa thob pa'i go skabs gnang 'char ni shin tu skal pa bzang po'i dga' ston zhig byung 'dug pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ skabs 'dir dri ba gnyis gnang nas lan phul dgos pa'i phyag bris phebs don bzhin lan phul ba'i shes yon phra na yang*/ bong ba gser gzigs kyis phyag bris spyi bor phebs pa la zhu yig ma phul thabs med song stabs/ da lam gang dran zhu rgyur/ spyir dge 'dun pha tshogs kyis dge slong ma bsnyen par rdzogs nas phyis dge slong ma tshad ldan byung skabs/ pha tshogs dang ma tshogs gnyis nas bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad na yang ma 'os pa med mod/bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i phyag srol bzhin/ dang po gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i pha tshogs dang chos srung sde pa'i ma tshogs gnyis 'dzoms nas dge tshul ma rnams bsnyen par rdzogs/ phyi nas dge slong ma tshad ldan byung mtshams/ thams cad yod par smra ba'i pha tshogs dang ma tshogs gnyis nas bsnyen par rdzogs na legs cha che snyam pa rmongs 'char lags pas thugs dbyings su mnga' bar zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas spyi lo 2007 zla 6 tshes 23 nyin gus pas phul/༄༅/ /rgya mtsho'i gnod pa byung rgyu gang yin dang*/ de la phan thabs gang dgos pa'i dris lan/ dri ba dang po/ lo 'dir rgya mtsho'i gnod pa byung ba'i rgyu gang yin zhes pa'i lan du/ spyir snang bar 'gyur ba sems can thun mong gi las nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba gang zag so so'i las te/

las la rnam pa gnyis yod pa las/ sems can spyi mthun nas deng gi dus nyon mongs pa mang zhing*/ mi dge ba shas che bas 'jig rten 'dir sa g.yo ba sogs 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa byung ba yin la/ dmigs bsal gang zag so sos las ngan bsags pa la brten/ mi kha shas skyes yul dang*/ gnas yul a ri dang yu rob sogs yin mod/ 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa yod pa'i gnas de dag tu slebs nas srog dor dgos pa byung ba 'di lta bu ni las kyi 'bras bu ldog med yin par shes pa'i rgyu mtshan lta bu zhig byung yod pa yin/dri ba gnyis pa/ de la phan pa'i thabs gang dgos zhes pa'i lan du/ sngar byung ba la phan pa dang phyis de lta bu mi 'byung ba'i ched smon lam bzang po dang*/ sdig spong dge sgrub byed pa gal che zhing*/ dmigs bsal bsam ngan spyod ngan sogs spang dgos pa'i bskul ma bya ba ni nges par dgos pa zhig lags so// [khra 'gu sprul ming pas/]༄༅/ /slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba par skrun sngon brjod/ spyir rang re rnams dal 'byor dang ldan pa'i mi lus thob cing*/ rab byung sgrub nas/ ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis byin rlabs thob pa'i go skabs byung ba ni/ shin tu bskal pa bzang po zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang de tsam mthar thug gi dmigs yul ma yin par mthar thug gi dmigs pa'i gtad so dngos ni/ ji skad du/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas//sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po cher bslab cing nyams su len thub pa zhig gal che ba yin la/ de'i ched du dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhus pa'i mod la/ kā ri kā lnga bcu pa'am/ sum brgya pa dang*/ bsnyen rdzogs sgrub nas/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba'am/ me tog phreng rgyud lta bu zhig la sbyang brtson gnang dgos pa yin te/

sngon byon bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po rnams kyi phyag srol rnam thar khag las kyang yongs su gsal ba ltar lags/ 'dul ba de gnyis las kyang*/ deng yongs su grags pa ni 'dul ba'i bstan pa spel ba la 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan du gyur pa slob dpon chen po yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa'i mdo rtsa ba nyid yin pa dang*/ de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos kyang*/ mtsho ṭīka dang*/ kar ṭīka sogs dgag bzhag spong gsum dang ldan zhing*/ zhib cha che la rgyas pa mang po zhig bzhugs mod/ de dag dpe cha gsar bu ba sdom pa zhus ma thag pa rnams kyis 'phral du gsan sbyang gnang bar sku ngal che tsam zhig lags mod/ 'on kyang gal chung du bskyur 'jog byed pa ni ga la rung*/ de'i phyir las dang po pas 'jug bde la rtogs sla ba ni/ rtsa ba nyid yin te tshig lhug par song bas go bde bar bzhugs pa de nyid gzhung gi khog khrol sla ba'i ched du kar ṭīka gi sa bcad dang sbyar na blo gsal rnams la phan thogs shin tu che zhing*/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che'i rtsa ba tshugs pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba lta bu zhig mthong nas/ rang dgon gyi bshad grwa'i mkhan po shes rab phun tshogs la/ de'i go bsgrig dgos tshul bskul ma zhus pas khong gis kyang de don phyag las yang dag pa zhig gnang 'dug pa la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ de nyid rig pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gi phyag dpe mkho sprod sde tshan nas spar skrun gyis 'grems spel zhus pa lags pas/ spyir bod du sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba nas bzung*/ rab byung gi sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'phel rgyas byung na yang*/ da lta'i gnas skabs 'dir dpe cha la mkhyen rtsal rgyas zin pa'i bslab pa sku bgres rnams kho nas 'dul ba la gsan sbyang gnang ba las/ sdom pa bzhes ma thag pa rnams kyis do snang de tsam ma gnang ba ni skyon gyi cha zhig ste/

'dul ba la gsan sbyang gnang ba phyi drag pas/ sdom pa bzhes nas yun ring ma song bar/ bslab sbyang gnang rogs 'bod bskul zhu ba lags/ zhes khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /karma'i mkhan chen rin chen dar rgyas kyi sor mdo'i 'grel pa par skrun sngon brjod/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i mkhyen pa dang brtse ba'i nyi 'od hi mā la yi ri bo chen po las brgal te/ gangs can bod kyi yul kun khyab cing*/ mi rabs nas mi rabs mang por ma nyams par 'phel zhing rgyas nas bzhugs pas mkhas shing grub la/ grub cing mkhas pa'i skyes bu khyad par can bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas/ so so'i mkhyen pa'i yon tan dang*/ sgom pa'i nyams myong khyad par can rnams ma 'ongs pa'i dus rabs kyi skyes bu rnams la thugs brtse bas dgongs te/ gdams ngag dang bstan bcos dpag tu med pa zhig rtsom 'bri gnang ba khag bar lam dus kyi 'gyur ba la brten mi mngon pa'i dbyings su byon nas sa yi steng 'dir phan bde'i phrin las mjug bsdu bar nye ba na/ skyes bu lhag bsam dang snying stobs kyis phyug pa du ma zhig gis rang gi srog dang lus la nyen kha yod min ma ltos par thabs shes sna tshogs kyis sgo nas gter du sbas pa khag slar yang 'dzam bu gling gi khyon 'dir gsung gi 'phrin las kyi rgyun 'phel ba'i go skabs thob nas bskal bzang gi dga' ston la longs su spyod pa'i nang tshan 'jam mgon kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas kyi zhal slob mkhan chen gnyis zhes grags pa'i ya gyal/ karma'i mkhan po rin chen dar rgyas kyi gsung*/ 'grel chung brgya dang brgyad mchis pa rnams spar du ma 'khod pas dpe rgyun shin tu dkon mod/ da lam ¿so thar mdo'i 'grel pa snying po nor bu'i shing rta dang*/ legs par gsung pa'i chos 'dul ba'i gleng gzhi dang rtogs pa brjod pa lung sde bzhi kun las btus pa rin po che'i mdzod las nyung ngur bsdus pa mchog sprul rgyas pa'i mchod sprin/¿”zhes bya ba'i phyag dpe lag rtser son nas spar du skrun pa'i go skabs thob ste 'grems spel zhus pas bstan bcos mdzad pa po dang gter du sbed pa po rnams kyi thugs dgongs bzhin du bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig

ces khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /karma nges don gzhan phan chos kyi dbang phyug gi sdom gsum snying bsdus par skrun sngon brjod/ bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po mchog zhing 'dir byon te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ dam pa'i chos rim gyis 'phel zhing dar ba'i gnas skabs su/ nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad byung zhing*/ de dag kyang rim pas 'phel 'grib kyis/ gnas brtan sde pa dang*/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba ste rtsa ba'i sde pa gnyis dang*/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba las gyes pa'i chos srung sde pa ste/ da lta'i skabs 'dir sde pa gsum kho na bzhugs shing*/ de las gnas brtan sde pa ni/ sing ga la/ bhar ma sogs lho phyogs kyi yul gru khag la dar te/ deng gi dus yongs grags la theg pa chung ngu zhes nyan thos kyi theg par ngos 'dzin byed pa dang*/ de dag gis 'tsho ba bsod snyoms la brten cing*/ phyi dro'i kha zas mi bzhes pa sogs ston pa zhal bzhugs pa'i gnas skabs lta bu'i 'dul ba'i phyag len dang ba 'dren pa gnang bzhin bzhugs yod/ de bzhin chos srung sde yi sdom rgyun/ kha che nas li yul brgyud rgya nag dang*/ nyi hong sogs la dar te/ deng dus yongs grags su theg pa chen po'i lugs su ngos 'dzin byed cing*/ de dag gis kyang dmar zas gtan du mi bzhes pa dang*/ gzhan don la shin tu brtson pa bcas byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang mthun pa'i phyag len gnang bzhin bzhugs yod/ 'on kyang de gnyis las gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sdom rgyun 'dzin pa po rnams ni khyad par du thon pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa zhig ste/ spyir sdom rgyun de bod dang sog po sogs la dar zhing*/ yongs grags su rdo rje theg pa zhes ngos 'dzin byed bzhin ltar gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len gnang gi yod mod/ 'on kyang gsang sngags kyi nyams len rkyang pa ma yin par sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug dang*/

mchog gnyis sogs bzhugs pa'i skabs bzhin/ dpal nālan+dā dang*/ bi kra ma shī la'i gtsug lag khang sogs kyi phyag len ma nyams par phyi so thar/ nang byang sems/ gsang ba rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa ste/ sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lam cha tshang bar nyams len gnang bas/ mkhas la grub cing*/ grub la btsun pa'i skyes chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa yin pa'i phyir/ rjes su 'jug pa'i slob tshogs rnams kyis kyang*/ de ltar sdom gsum chig dril du nyams su len pa gal che bas/ thog ma nas sdom gsum gyi bstan bcos la 'chad nyan phun sum tshogs pa zhig gnang dgos nges shing*/ sdom gsum bstan pa'i bstan bcos kyang sngon dus dang*/ phyis byon gyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gsungs mang du bzhugs pa las/ deng gi dus rgyu mtshan gnyis la rten nas phyis byon mkhas grub rnams kyi gsungs gal che bar 'dzin dgos te/ rgyu mtshan dang po/ spyir ming tshig yi ge rnams lo rabs dang dus rabs kyi dbang gis 'pho 'gyur 'byung ba ni chos nyid la/ de'i phyir da lta'i dus rabs 'dir skyes pa'i skye bo rnams kyis/ sngon gyi bstan bcos rnying pa khag las/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mjug dang*/ nyi shu pa'i nang du byon pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung tshig dang don gyi cha gnyis kar go bde zhing shes sla ba zhig yong gi yod pa dang*/ de bzhin rgyu mtshan gnyis pa/ sngon byon mkhas grub rnams kyi gsungs khyab brdal du 'phel zin cing par skrun sogs zhus zin par brten/ dpe rgyun dang bshad rgyun chad pa'i nyen kha dang bral ba zhig la/ phyis byon gyi bstan bcos khag ni khyab brdal du spel ma grub pa'i gong*/ dus 'gyur byung bas/ dpe rgyun sogs chad nyen la brten myur skyob bya rgyu gal che bas/ da lam li thang spang phug gi mkhan po nges don gyis mdzad pa'i sdom gsum snying po bsdus pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa gnas gsar bla ma bkra shis chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa bcas par skrun zhus pa yin la/

de ltar mdzad pa po gnyis ka 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal slob yin cing*/ de las rtsa ba mdzad pa po ni/ 'jam mgon rnam thar zhal gsungs/ blo gros mtha' yas kyi byung ba brjod pa nor bu sna tshogs mdog can zhes pa las ches bsngags brjod gnang ba ni/ de nyid las/ “gzhan la bshad pa'i go chod pa ni/ spang phug bla ma nges don dang*/ lhag bsam rgyal mtshan gnyis yin/” zhes gsungs pa'i ya gyal de nyid yin pa dang*/ 'grel pa mdzad pa po yang zhal slob kyi gtso bo'i gras/ 'jam mgon rin po che 'das rjes kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar nor bu'i snang ba dang*/ rgya chen bka' mdzod kyi dkar chag zab rgyas rgya mtsho mtha' yas la 'jug pa'i gru bo zhes pa gnyis rtsom par mdzad pa po ste rnam pa gnyis yin la/ rtsa 'grel gnyis po de dag sngar dgon sde khag mang po zhig gis dbyar gnas skabs 'chad nyan gnang ba'i srol/ dran thang mkhan po karma 'od zer zhes pas spel gnang 'dug kyang*/ phyis dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis phyag dpe'i rgyun tsam yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nas mi mngon pa'i dby-ings su 'byon par nye ba na/ dwags shangs bstan pa'i srol 'byed 7skyabs rje 'bo dkar rin po che dang*/ mkhan po blau gros don yod rnam pa gnyis kyis phyag dpe gces nyar gnang bar ma zad/ da lam par skrun zhu ba'i ma phyir skyabs 'jug bka' drin che zhing*/ de skabs rang dgon gyi bshad grwa ba karma phun tshogs kyis dang blang kho nas deng dus thon gsar rig mdzod du bcug ste/ wā rā ṇa sī badz+ra bid+yā'i bshad grwa nas rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags mo sbrul/ phyi lo 2001 gi lor par skrun zhu rgyu'i go skabs thob pas thams cad la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ sngar 'di nas par skrun zhus pa'i phyag dpe khag gcig rin med du phul yang*/ phyag dpe thugs mkho che bar yod med shan ma phye ba dang*/ phyag dpe nges par mkho gal gnang ba khag cig gis dngos su bka' gnang ma bde ba lta bu 'ong gi 'dug par brten/

da lam stabs bde ba'i phyir dpe rin phran bu zhus nas 'grem spel zhus pa yin pas phyag dpe thugs mkho yod rigs nas thad kar bka' gsal gnang grub zhu rgyu dang*/ chad lhag nor 'khrul gang byung la bzod gsol snying thag pa nas zhu ba lags/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas/༄༅/ /slob dpon seṅge bzang po'i sher phyin 'grel pa don gsal par skrun sngon brjod/ 'dir rje btsun byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa don gsal nyid 'grel pa thams cad kyi nang nas ches khyad par du 'phags pa yin mod/ spyir rgya 'grel rnams la sa bcad gnang ba'i srol ma byung bas/ dus rabs 'di yi dpe cha ba rnams kyis bstan bcos spyi'i khog khrol dka' ba lta bu zhig yong gi yod pa dang*/ yang rgyal dbang karma pa brgyad pas mdzad pa'i rje btsun ngal gso nyid tshig don gnyis ka'i steng nas khyad par du 'phags pa zhig bzhugs mod/ rtsa ba'i 'grel pa dang*/ 'grel pa don gsal gyi yang 'grel dang*/ rgyan nyi khri sbyar ba'i mdo sbyar bcas lhan du bzhugs pas dpe cha gsar bu ba rnams glegs bam mthong bas 'jigs skrag skye ba las bzlog pa'i ched/ kar ṭīka rje btsun ngal gso'i sa bcad 'grel chung don gsal dang sbyar bas/ rgya 'grel gyi dgongs pa khrol bde ba dang 'grel pa don gsal la sbyangs nas/ kar ṭīka gi dgongs pa khong du chud sla bar brten/ da lam badz+ra bid+yā yi slob gnyer ba tshe ring bkra shis kyis bshad grwa'i gnyer pa gnang ba'i las bar rnams su 'grel pa don gsal kar ṭīka shan sbyar 'di nyid bzos gnang 'dug pas/ ma 'ongs par sher phyin kar ṭīka gi steng nas slob sbyong gnang mkhan tshor/ dgongs don bde blag tu mkhyen pa la phan thogs che nges shig 'dug par mngon/ rtsom pa po rong mtshams su skye ba'i bod rigs byis pa 1992

lor rab tu byung zhing*/ de rjes bshad grwar slob sbyong gnang nas yun thung zhig la 'di lta bu las don sgrub pa'i lhag bsam dang snying stobs phun sum tshogs pa byung ba la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba lags/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas wā rā ṇa sī nas spel/ sarba maṅgalaṃ/༄༅/ /rje zhwa dmar lnga pa'i sher phyin 'grel pa nyung ngu rnam gsal par skrun sngon brjod/

rang re bka' brgyud pa rnams kyi gzhung chen po dag la thos bsam gnang ba'i tshul/ bstan bcos chen po shes bya mdzod las/ “rang lugs kun mkhyen rang byung rgyal ba nas//nang brtag rgyud bla'i bshad bka' gtso bor mdzad//gzhung chen bka' bzhi mi bskyod rgyal la babs//sras bcas legs bshad nyi 'od brdal ba'i rgyun//”zhes sogs rtsa ba las gsungs pa de nyid 'grel pas bkral bar mdzad pa'i skabs/ ji skad du/ “rje brgyad pa thams cad mkhyen pa chen po mi bskyod dga' bas gzhung lugs mtha' yas pa gsan cing*/ gzhan la ma ltos par thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis shing rta'i srol gsar du phyes te/ 'dul ba'i rnam 'grel nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ mdzod 'grel grub bde'i dpyid 'jo legs bshad yongs kyi rgyal po/ mngon rgyan 'grel pa rje btsun ngal gso/ 'jug ṭīka dwags brgyud grub pa'i shing rta bde bar 'dren pa'i shul lam/ tshad ma rigs gzhung gi 'grel pa sogs mdzad cing*/ gzhung chen bka' bzhi'i lam gsal bar mdzad pa nas mi bskyod rgyal ba kho na la bshad pa'i bka' babs pa ltar gyur te/ dwags po legs bshad gling sogs bshad grwa rnams rim par byung zhing*/ sras kyi thu bo rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag /dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba/ karma phrin las gnyis pa dang bcas pa rnams kyis legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od snang rab tu brdal bar mdzad la/ khyad par rje dgu pas mngon mdzod dang 'jug ṭīka /gar dbang lnga pas mngon rgyan/ drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis 'dul ṭīka bcas/ kar ṭīka chen mo rnams las snying po bsdus pa'i tshul du mdzad cing*/ za dam nyin byed gling sogs su 'chad rtsod kyi srol rgya che ba byung*/” zhes gsal ba ltar/ da lam dpe cha gsar bu ba rnams la phan thogs 'byung ba'i ched/ gar dbang lnga pa dkon mchog yan lag gis mdzad pa'i “sher phyin gyi 'grel pa nyung ngu rnam gsal ”'di nyid/ hong kong du bzhugs pa'i rang dgon gyi bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug dang*/

karma zla ba gnyis nas par skrun gyis sbyin bdag gnang ste/ badz+ra bid+yā'i phyag dpe mkho sprod sde tshan nas spar skrun zhus pa 'di/ phyag dpe gsan sbyang gnang ba po rnams la phan thogs nges zhig ste/ 'grel pa 'di nyid kyi mdzad byang las kyang*/ “gang tshe skom pas nyen pa'i sems can phra mo'i mdun du glo bur rgya mtsho lud gyur na/ /de tshe rab tu skrag cing 'thung ba'i spros pa nye bar zhi bar 'gyur gyi gzhan du ci/ /de bzhin yum don bde blag rtogs par 'dod pa'i skye bo blo gros dman pa 'ga' zhig gis/ /bla ma'i legs bshad zab rgyas mi rtogs de phyir bdag gis chu thigs lta bu 'di brtsams so//”zhes mdzad pa po gang gis bstan bcos 'di nyid gsung rtsom gnang ba'i skabs/ mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod ngom pa'i ched du ma yin par/ las dang po pa dang shes rab dman pa rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs nas/ thog mar kar ṭīka chen mo la bslab pa'i sngon 'gro lta bur gsan sbyang gnang ba'i ched gsung bar mdzad pa zhig ste/ phyi nas rje btsun ngal gso nyid la 'jug dgos pa'i phyir/ ma 'ongs par sher phyin 'chad pa po dang*/ thos bsam gnang ba po thams cad kyis de ltar phyag len gnad du smin pa zhig gnang grub par bka' drin zhu/ zhes khra 'gu sprul ming pas rig pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang du rab gnas shing bya yi lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes nyin bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /rje karma phrin las kyi sher phyin sbyor ṭīka par skrun sngon brjod/ spyir deng gi dus 'di ni snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i skabs lta bu zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang rang re'i bgo skal du spyod pa dam pa'i chos kyi dbang du byas na de tsam gyi dus ngan zhig ma yin pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi thugs bskyed dang*/ phrin las smon lam gyi stobs kho na ste/ deng dus dam pa'i chos 'phel rgyas 'byung bzhin pa 'di lta bu ni/

sngon chos kyi rgyal po mya ngan med kyis 'dzam gling la dbang bsgyur ba'i skabs dang*/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po sogs kyis bod gangs can gyi yul grur dam pa'i chos spel ba'i skabs su yang byung ma myong bar ma zad/ sngon chad dam pa'i chos kyi sgra tsam yang ma grags pa'i gling dang gling phran rnams su 'khod pa'i skye bo pho mo mang po zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po cher rang bzhin dad gus skyes nas/ sa gnas de dag tu dam pa'i chos 'phel rgyas 'byung bzhin par ma zad/ de rnams kyang phal cher cal sgrogs rjes 'jug lta bu ma yin par/ dam pa'i chos kyi yon tan thun mong ma yin pa rnams shes nas dad gus skyes te/ chos sgor zhugs pa zhig yin pa dang*/ kha shas 'khor ba 'di la snying po med par mthong bas nges 'byung skyes te/ chos kyi nyams len la brtson pa'i sgo nas dam pa'i chos dar bas/ 'dzam gling 'di yi lho phyogs (New Zealand) ni'u dzin lan ḍi nas/ byang phyogs (Scandinavia)si kin da ne wi ya bar 'khod pa'i yul gru phal che ba zhig la chos kyi tshogs pa tshugs shing*/ rab tu byung ba dmar snum gyi na bza' dang*/ snam sbyar gyi rgyal mtshan can sa gnas gang sar mjal rgyu yod pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs sna tshogs thos 'dzin gyi yul du longs spyod pa'i skal bzang gi dga' ston dang ldan pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ chos byed spyi dang lhag par dge 'dun pa gzhon nu rnams kyis dam pa'i chos kyi gsan sbyang dang*/ nyams len phun sum tshogs pa zhig gnang nas thos bsam sgom sgrub kyi spus tshad je bzang du gtang rgyu gal che la/ lhag par grub mtha' so so'i rang rang gi brgyud pa'i man ngag dang*/ khyad chos rnams rgyun ma chad par 'dzin skyong spel gnang dgos pa ni/ ma bskos thog tu babs pa'i so so'i las 'gan zhig yin par brten shin tu gal che zhing rang re rnams kyi dbang du byas na yang bka' brgyud gong ma rim byon gyis gnang ba'i gzhung 'grel dang*/

khrid yig man ngag sogs kyi yig cha yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs pa de rnams kyi dpe rgyun spel te/ chos dad ldan pa spyi dang lhag par dge 'dun pa sku gzhon nu thos bsam dang*/ nyams len la brtson pa rnams kyi spyan lam du bstar nas phyag dpes ma phongs pa zhig shin tu gal che bar brten/ rig pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gi dpe rnying gsar spel sde tshan nas/ phyag dpe gal che rigs gang 'byor rnams gang thub thub spar du 'khod pa zhig zhu 'char las/ skabs 'dir rje karma phrin las pas mdzad pa'i sher phyin gyi 'grel pa 'di nyid spar du skrun pa lags te/ de yang karma phrin las pa chen po ni/ brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rjes gzhung chen rnams gsan pa'i bshes gnyen du bsten par mdzad pa zhig yin pa'i phyir*/ sher 'grel rje btsun ngal gso dang dgongs pa mthun nges yin par ma zad/ 'grel tshul yang sbyor ngag bkod pas/ phyag dpe gsan sbyang gnang ba po rnams kyis go ba len bde zhing*/ nges shes skye sla ba bcas dge mtshan dang phan thogs shin tu che ba zhig yin pa'i phyir/ rang rkang 'dzin pa'i bshad grwa ba rnams kyi zur gzigs gnang rgyu'i phyag dpe shin tu gal che la/ de'i phyir thams cad kyis gces spras gang gzab gnang rogs bka' drin zhu zhes sngon brjod 'di nyid du gong gsal sde tshan nas bskul ma gnang ba ltar/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas bka' brgyud bstan pa dar rgyas yun du gnas pa'i smon lam dang bcas bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /rig pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gi blo 'phel nor bu zhes pa'i dus deb par skrun sngon brjod/ de yang ji skad du/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ ston pa'i bstan pa rnam gnyis te//lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do//de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang*//sgrub par byed pa kho na'o//zhes gsungs la/

smra bar byed pa'i tshul yang*/ 'chad pa dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ rtsom pa gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa spel dgos shing*/ de las kyang rtsom pa ni yun du gnas pas shin tu gal che ba'i phyir/ dpe cha gsar bu ba rnams rtsom pa la spro ba bskyed pa dang*/ rtsom la sbyang bdar yong ba'i ched du/ rig pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang nas blo 'phel nor bu zhes pa'i dus deb 'di gsar skrun zhus pa lags pas/ thos bsam pa rnams spyir phyag dpe la sbyang brtson dang*/ lhag par rtsom 'bri la do snang bskyed nas snyan ngag gis brgyan pa dang*/ ma brgyan pa'i gsung rtsom/ tshig bcad/ tshigs lhug /lo rgyus/ ka rtsom/ gdams ngag /bslab bya/ mgur ma sogs/ zur za dang*/ tshig ngan med cing*/ brjod pa mdzes la/ go bde ba khag rang rang gis gsar rtsom la sbyangs brtson mdzad rgyu dang*/ gzhan gna' rabs dang deng dus kyi mkhas dbang khag gi gsung rtsom la do snang gis dpyad gzhi gnang ba sogs shin tu gal che bas thugs la nges par zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas rab gnas me khyi gsar tshes la bris pa dge legs 'phel/ ༄༅/ /karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i tshad ma rigs gzhung rgya mtsho par skrun sngon brjod/ bdag cag gi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa shākya'i dbang po mchog gis/ chos can dang chos nyid kyi gnas lugs ma nor ba ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i so so rang rig gi ye shes kyis gzigs nas/ 'gro ba kun la dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rjes rjes su dgongs te/ bde nas bde bar 'gro ba'i lam bzang tshang la ma nor ba/ bden pa bzhi'am/ bden pa gnyis kyi khongs su bsdus nas/ bden pa nyag gcig tu gsungs te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas gdul byar gyur pa ma lus pa thar pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam du bkod par mdzad mod/ deng gi dus snyigs ma lnga bdo zhing bstan pa mar 'grib kyi gnas skabs su slebs par gyur la/

'on kyang shes rig slob sbyong gi mthun rkyen tshang zhing*/ gzhi rim dang mtho rim gyi slob grwa gong 'phel du 'gro ba la brten nas/ rang rigs dang*/ phyi rgyal gyi yul gru kun tu shes rig dang*/ tshan rig sogs dar zhing rgyas nas dus dang rnam pa kun tu rmongs dad kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar/ rigs pas brtag dpyad gzab nan thog 'jug ldog byed pa'i srol bzang po 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon kun tu dar zhing rgyas par brten/ dngos stobs kyi rigs pa dang ldan pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bgo skal rig gsar shes yon gyis phyug pa'i mkhas dbang rnams la bsten na/ de rnams lam bzang po khyad par can dang*/ dbang po rnon po chos kyi rjes 'brang dang 'phrad pas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde la sbyor ba'i don chen po dang ldan pa ma zad/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid mi nyams par slar yang gong nas gong du spel ba'i mthun rkyen rnam par dag pa nyid du yang 'gyur bas/ de lta bu la brtson dgos shing de yang g.yo sgyu dang*/ zol zog /chags sdang gi thabs la brten pa ma yin par yang dag pa'i rigs lam rnam par dag pa la brten dgos pas na/ rigs lam phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos ni/ dus rabs 'dir shin tu gal che zhing rmad du byung ba'ang yin la/ de lta bu'i bstan bcos rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang*/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs gnyis kar nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa ni/ dpal chos kyi grags pa'i gsung tshad ma sde bdun/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po'i tshad ma mdo dang bcas pa yin la/ de dag gi dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i 'grel pa/ spyi don/ mtha' dpyod sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas grub chen po rnams kyis shin tu rgya che zhing grangs mang por bkral mod/ khyad par du 'phags pa ni rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho (AD.1454-1505)

de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i tshad ma rigs gzhung rgya mtsho kho na yin te/ de ni mkhas pa gzhan gyis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos la sogs pa ltar/ gnas skabs sbyor byung gi shes rab dang brtson 'grus la brten nas gsungs pa'i bstan bcos ma yin par/ rtsom pa po nyid dpal chos kyi grags pa'i skur skye ba bzhes pa'i sngon gnas rjes dran gyi sgo nas gsungs pa yin la/ de yang bstan bcos 'di nyid gsar du rtsom gnang ba'i gnas skabs kyi lo rgyus chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las gsungs pa tshur mthong gi blos bsam gyis mi khyab pa lta bu ni/ tshad ma'i gzhung gi rtsa ba tsam yang sku 'khris na med/ phyag dpe la gzigs rtog kyang mi gnang*/ dus rtag tu phyag mnyam bzhag /spyan lta stangs/ thugs ting nge 'dzin dang mi bral zhing skabs su gsung chos dang*/ lugs gnyis kyi bka' bkod gnang ba sogs kyi bar seng nam byung skabs/ thugs rtsom gnang ste/ gsung rtsom yi ger 'god pa po dang ched du zhu skul gnang ba po dwags po rab 'byams pa la/ 'phro gang na yod gsungs te bka' 'dri gnang ba tsam las/ thogs pa med par spyan lta stangs kyi ngang nas sha ra ra ljags dpod mdzad de gsungs pa dang*/ bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i tshul yang*/ rgyal dbang 'di nyid kyi bzhed par slob dpon phyogs glang dang chos grags kyang zung 'jug dbu ma'i don ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa'i mkhas grub kyi skyes bu chen po lags pas de dag gi bstan bcos rnams su'ang gnas skabs mdo sems grub mtha' 'dres pa'i tshul lta bur gsungs kyang mthar thug dbu ma'i lam kho na gsal bar ston par bzhed de/ rgyal dbang de nyid kyi dngos slob rje karma phrin las rnam rgyal gyis/ sde bdun rtsa ba mdo dang bcas rnams kyang*// dgongs pa'i mthar thug dbu ma che yin mod// gnas skabs gdul bya gang la gang 'dul du// dbu ma che dang sems tsam mdo sde pa'i//

grub mtha' 'dres pa lta bur gsungs pa la// rnam dpyod dman rnams blo gros ma zhugs pas// la las mdo sems dbu ma pa ru 'dod// 'ga' zhig sems tsam smra ba kho na zer// de dag rang mgo 'khor ba'i col chung yin// grub thob chen po phyogs kyi glang po dang*// chos kyi grags pa'i lta ba mthar thug pa// zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas dbu ma che// ji bzhin gsal bar ston pa'i gzhung lugs ni// sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa kho na'o/ /zhes sogs dang*/ yang*/ rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho'i bzhed pa la// sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa mthar thug gi/ dgongs pa dbu ma chen por gnas pa na// phyag rgya chen po'i lta ba dang mthun pa// tshad ma'i gzhung lugs rnams su bzhugs zhes gsungs// zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu dbu ma'i lam 'di yang klu sgrub yab sras kyi gzhung dang mthun zhing rje btsun byams pa nas thogs med sku mched las brgyud pa'i dbu ma'i dgongs don dang mi gnyis par gsal te/ rje de nyid kyis/ bdag gi bla ma rgyal ba'i dbang pos ni/ rigs gzhung rgya mtsho zhes bya'i legs bshad der// sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas// zhes sogs mdo sde rgyan gyi lung drangs te// sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i mthar thug gi/ dgongs pa rje btsun byams pa nas gzung ste// 'phags pa thogs med sku mched las brgyud pa'i// dbu mar gnas shing klu sgrub yab sras kyi// dbu ma'i gzhung rnams dang yang mthun no zhes// gzugs med na ni sems yod ma 'dzin zhig/ ces sogs dbu ma 'jug pa'i lung yang drangs//mdor na gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba yi// shes pa ngo bo stong nyid chos kyi dbyings// rang bzhin gyis ni rnam dag 'od gsal ba// rnam pa cir yang 'char ba'i sems nyid 'di// don dam bden pa yin zhes phyag mdzub btsugs// gzhung las sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal te// dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba zhes pa'i// lung dang theg pa chen po'i rgyud bla mar//

sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa// de ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med de// zhes dang shes rab pha rol phyin mdo las// sems la sems ma mchis te sems kyi ni// rang bzhin 'od gsal ba 'o zhes gsungs pa// thams cad dgongs pa mthun zhing don 'di ni// rdo rje theg la 'jug pa'i sgo yin zhes// byang chub sems 'grel sems nyid ngal gso'i lung*// zung 'jug mngon sum mig la ston phyir drangs/ /zhes gsungs so//'di'i bstan don dbu ma yang med dgag tsam gyi ngo bo rang stong chad pa'i stong pa nyid ma yin gyi rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i gzhan stong don dam bden pa yin la/ de yang sems tsam gyi lta ba la gzhan stong du ming btags pa ma yin par nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde rnams kyis bstan pa/ shing rta chen po rnams kyis bkral ba/ grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis bsgom pa/ bstan pa'i snying po mtha' bral dbu ma chen po'i lam kho na yin par gsal te dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas/ phar tshad 'di gnyis lta ba gzhan stong gtso cher bkral mod kyang sems tsam gyi lta ba la gzhan stong du ming btags pa bod kha cig gi 'dod pa ltar bkral ba ni ma yin la/ spyir rje 'di sems kyi gshis stong nyid gtso bor ston pa zab mo lta brgyud/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gtso bor ston pa rgya chen spyod brgyud ste sems kyi zab pa dang gsal ba ni gnyis su mi phyed pas na shing rta'i srol gnyis dgongs pa gcig tu bzhed pa yin no// zhes gsungs so//de ltar tshad ma'i mdo kun las btus pa nyid bshad gzhir mdzad/ sde bdun las/ rtsa ba lus lta bu'i bstan bcos rgyas pa rnam 'grel/ 'bring po rnam nges/ bsdus pa rigs thigs bcas gsum gyis dgongs pa 'grel ba'i tshul du bstan/ 'phros pa yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos/ rgyud gzhan grub pa/ gtan tshigs thigs pa/ 'brel pa brtag pa/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa ste rnam pa bzhis zur gyi dka' gnad rnams la/

spyi don dang*/ mtha' dpyod kyi tshul du bzhag /lha shāka rgyan sogs rgya gar gyi mkhas pa'i dgongs pa 'grel tshul tha dad pa rnams kyang ma 'dres par mdor bsdus te bkral ba tshad ma'i legs bshad chu bo kun 'dus su bzhugs pas/ deng gi dus rabs 'dir ched du mngags pa lta bu'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gang la yang shin tu gal che ba'i med du mi rung bar dgongs nas/ dad gtong lhag bsam gyi 'o mtsho gyen du 'khyil ba bal yul byang phyogs snye shang gi yul grur skyes pa'i dge slong phun tshogs lags nas 'gro gron ched gtong dang*/ wā ṇa mtho rim slob grwa ba bstan 'dzin don yod dang*/ khu nu ba ngag dbang tshul khrims/ karma thub bstan chos 'phel bcas nas sku ngal 'dzem med gnang ste/ da lam deb grangs 500 spar skrun zhus pa dang*/ lhag par rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che nyag gcig la dgongs nas phyag dpe blu yon 'bul skabs kyang*/ ma gnas tsam las blu yon deb rin yul lugs ltar zhu ma dgos pa gnang ba la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu ma zad/ gong gsal phyag gron gnang ba po dang*/ phyag las gnang ba po gnyis ka'i thugs kyi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i dgongs don rnams de de bzhin du 'grub pa'i smon tshig bcas/ dpal karma pa'i gdan sa chen po rum bteg bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling nas/ khra 'gu sprul ming 'chang bas/ 1985 zla 9tshes 29 la/༄༅/ /tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel pa zur bkol par skrun sngon brjod/

spyir rang re rnams dam pa'i chos kyi sgo la bzhugs nas/ thos bsam mam/ nyams len gang gnang na yang khyad med par thog mar dam pa'i chos dang*/ de ston pa'i ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la nges shes phun sum tshogs pa zhig dang*/ ldog med kyi yid ches brtan po zhig med na lam mthar phyin pa zhig mi 'byung bas nges par nges shes dang yid ches yod dgos la/ de dag 'byung ba'i rgyu ni rnam pa gnyis te/ mngon sum gyis drangs pa dang*/ rjes dpag gis drangs pa'o/ /de las dang po ni/ spyir so so'i skye bo la 'byung mi thub pa lta bu zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang las dang skal par ldan pa'i slob bu tshad ldan rnams byin rlabs dang nyams rtogs khyad par du 'phags pa'i bla ma dam pa dang mjal nas/ chos nyid dam sems nyid kyi gnas lugs thug phrad mngon sum du ngo 'phrod cing myong ba rgyud la skyes/ ye shes klong nas rdol te nges shes tsam ma yin par rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skyes nas/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun grub tu 'byung ba ni sngon gyi bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho na rim du byon pa lta bu lags mod/ 'on kyang rang re tha mal pa rnams la bka' brgyud gong ma de rnams lta bu'i zhen log dang nges 'byung*/ dag snang dang mos gus/ brtson 'grus dang sems gnas/ shes rab dang ye shes ldan pa zhig dkon stabs/ rtogs pa khyad par can 'byung bar dka' bas da lta rang re 'bad brtson byas na dngos su bskyed thub pa ni/ rjes dpag gi rigs lam nas drangs pa de yin pas/ de nyid gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog /gzhan gyis drangs du mi btub pa'i nges shes khyad par can gsal ba dang brtan po yod pa zhig gal che la/ de lta bu rgyud la bskyed par byed pa'i thabs ni/ dpal phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa'i tshad ma mdo kun las btus pa dang*/ chos kyi grags pa'i gsung tshad ma sde bdun te/ de dag la thos bsam yang dag pa zhig byas nas nges shes bskyed dgos pa las/

thabs gzhan med pa lta bu yin stabs/ de rnams la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa zhig shin tu gal che la/ sbyangs pa gnang ba'i skabs su yang 'grel pa zhig la brten dgos pa ma gtogs/ rtsa ba rkyang pa ni tshig sbram pas go ba skye dka' la/ 'grel pa la yang rgya 'grel dang bod 'grel mang du bzhugs pa las/ dpal rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i tshad ma rigs gzhung rgya mtsho 'di nyid ni/ mgon po gang nyid sngar chos kyi grags par sku skye ba bzhes pa'i sngon gnas rjes dran gyi sgo nas gsungs pa zhig yin par chos 'byung dang rnam thar khag las gsal ba ltar/ legs bshad khyad par du 'phags shing rmad du byung ba zhig ste/ rtsa ba mdo kun las btus pa nyid gzhir bzhag /de'i dgongs pa tshad ma sde bdun las/ rgyas pa tshad ma rnam 'grel dang*/ 'bring po tshad ma rnam nges/ bsdus pa rigs pa'i thigs pa ltar bkral bar mdzad la/ de yang lha shāka rgyan sogs rgya 'grel rnams kyi dgongs pa so sor phyes/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zab gnad rnams spyi don gyis gsal bar mdzad/ mi 'os pa rnams rigs pas sun dbyung ste/ 'gran zla dang bral bar bzhugs pa 'di nyid ni/ bstan pa spyi dang*/ lhag par rang re rjes 'jug rnams kyi don du bzhag par mdzad pa zhig ste/ de yang rgyal dbang bdun pa nyid bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don gyi phrin las nyin mtshan bar med bka' drin gnang bzhin pa'i skabs/ bar seng cung zad byung ba na/ sku ngal gso ba tsam ma gnang bar/ mgon po mchog gis 'grel chen 'di nyid ljags spod gnang ba dang*/ de nyid dung gi tshems bar nas byung ma thag dwags po rab 'byams pas phyag sor gyi rtser drangs te sor mos zlos gar gyis glegs bam 'di nyid gsar du bskrun pa'i 'bad rtsol gnang ba zhig ste/ bla slob de gnyis kyis sku ngal ched du bsad pa ni ma 'ongs pa'i gdul byar gyur pa bdag cag rnams la thugs brtse bas nye bar dgongs te/
