spyir rigs pas drangs pa'i nges shes bskyed dgos pa dang*/ de la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa zhig 'byung ba'i thugs kyi re ba dang*/ yid ches gnang yod nges pas/ de lta bu'i sku drin gsab pa'i ched dang*/ dang po'i las can rnams gzhung so so'i dgongs pa ma 'dzings par gsal bar phyes nas/ nges shes bskyed sla ba'i ched du rje bdun pa'i gsung sor bzhag thog /rnam 'grel gyi 'grel pa rkyang pa zur bkol gyis wā ra ṇa sī rig pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gi phyag dpe gsar spel sde tshan nas/ spar bskrun zhus pa lags pas/ phyag dpe 'di nyid kun dga' rwa ba'i nang sos dal du bzhugs pa ma yin par phyag gis 'phur/ spyan gyis gzigs/ ngag thog tu skyor/ thugs la 'dzin/ rang gis sbyang*/ gzhan la spel nas dpal rgyal ba'i dbang po chos grags rgya mtsho'i thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa zhig dang*/ bstan 'gror sman pa'i cha rkyen du 'gro ba zhig bka' drin gnang rogs zhes zhu ba dang*/ chabs gcig de ltar 'byung ba'i smon tshig bcas khra 'gu sprul ming pas/ rje btsun mi la ras pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgrub gnas gnyi shang ka t+ya'i phug dang nye ba'i sras mkhar sgrub sder bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /mkhan po tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i blo rig rtags rig par skrun sngon brjod/ de yang ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgya che ba mdo dang zab pa gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde'i chos 'khor bskor bar mdzad pa rnams/ ji lta bar nyams su len pa'i skabs/ blun dad dang*/ lung gi rjes su 'brang ba tsam gyis 'jug par mi rung ste/ ji skad du mdo las/dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis//sreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du//legs par brtags nas nga yi bka'//blang bar bya yi gus phyir min//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ drang don dang nges don/

dgongs gzhi dang dgos pa sogs legs par brtag dgos shing*/ lhag par kun rdzob kyi snang tshul dang*/ don dam gyi gnas lugs zab mo la gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog /gzhan gyi drangs su mi gtub pa'i nges shes khyad par can bskyed dgos/ de lta bu'i nges shes ni rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang gi gzhi yin pa dang*/ nges par gtan tshigs rigs pa gal che zhing*/ de yang 'phags bod gnyis su nyi zla ltar grags pa ni/ dpal phyogs kyi glang po'i tshad ma mdo kun las btus pa dang*/ chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i tshad ma sde bdun rnams la thos bsam byed pa las 'byung ba yin pas bstan bcos de dag shin tu gal che la/ de dag gi dgongs pa dpyis phyin par rtogs pa'i thabs su/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang bod kyi mkhas mchog mang pos gsar rtsom gnang ba'i nang tshan/ rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i rigs gzhung rgya mtsho ni ches rmad du byung ba ste/ 'phags chen ye shes kyi gzigs pa so so'i skye bo'i blo yi spyod yul las 'das par gsung rtsom gnang ba'i lo rgyus chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las gsungs pa ltar dang*/ ma zad dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos gcig gi khongs su sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i don bkral bar mdzad pa de lta bu sngon chad 'phags bod gnyis su ma byon pa'i khyad chos rmad du byung ba lags pas/ kun gyis thos bsam 'chad nyan gnang rgyu gal che zhing*/ de lta bu'i bstan bcos khyad par du 'phags pa de nyid la las dang po pa'i 'jug sgo lta bur/ bsdus don dpal karma'i nā lan+dā yi mkhan chen rin po che tshul khrims rgya mtshos gsar rtsom gnang ba 'di dag ni/ gzhung gi don bsdus shing go bde la 'jug sla bas dgos don phun sum tshogs pa zhig mchis phyir/ da lam rdzogs chen dpon slob mchog sprul rin po ches spar skrun gnang ba la snying thag pa nas thugs rje dang bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu ma zad/

phyin chad phyag dpe gzigs pa po rnams kyis kyang*/ rig pa glegs bam du ma shor bar/ slob sbyong mthar phyin zhing nges shes khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa zhig bka' drin zhu ba lags/rgyu mtshan ma shes rmongs dad byed pa dang*//gnas lugs ma rtogs blun sgom la brtson pas//dal 'byor stong zad ngal ba don med phyir//yang dag rigs pas nges shes bskyed par gces//zhes 'dzam gling byang phyogs ke na ḍa (Canada) yi yul grur phyag rgya chen po'i chos thun phran bu zhig bshad pa'i zhor du khra 'gu sprul ming pas gong gsal bstan bcos kyi yon tan rjes su dran te bris pa lags/ October 1995༄༅/ /'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa par skrun sngon brjod/ spyir bdag cag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa la bskal pa grangs med gsum dang so bdun la sogs par bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis bsags dgos par gsung la/ yang skabs 'ga' zhig tu tshe gcig lus gcig la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par yang gsungs pa de gnyis mi mthun pa lta bu zhig ste/ tshe lus gcig gis 'grub pa la bskal chen grangs med mang por dka' ba ci'i phyir spyad/ bskal pa mang po de tsam la dka' ba spyad dgos pa'i 'bras bu ni/ tshe lus gcig la thob mi srid pa lta bu lags mod/ 'on kyang gnyis ka thub pa'i gsung tshad ma mi bslu ba zhig yin te/ spyir ma dag 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa spang bar byed pa la chos nyid don dam gnas lugs rtogs dgos shing*/ de rtogs par byed pa'i thabs kyi khyad par gnyis te/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa la sogs pa dbu ma'i slob dpon chen po rnams kyis/ thog mar chos can kun rdzob kyi bden pa la/ dbu ma'i rigs pa rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje'i gzegs ma/

'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog /ngo bo la dpyod pa gcig du bral/ rigs pa'i rgyal po rten 'brel chen mo'i gtan tshigs rnams kyis dpyad nas/ chos can de rnams rang bzhin gyis ma grub par don dam stong nyid du gtan la phab ste rjes dpag lam du byed pa ni lta bas spros pa bcad pa'i skabs shin tu gsal zhing nges shes khyad par can gzhan gyis drang du mi gtub pa zhig bskyed par nus mod/ sgom pas nyams su len pa'i skabs lam bul ba yin la/ grub thob chen po sa ra ha dang*/ te lo pa sogs kyis snang ba sems/ sems stong par ngo sprod pa'i man ngag zab mo/ thabs lam nā ro chos drug dang*/ grol lam phyag rgya chen po la brten nas mngon sum lam du byed pa'i thabs ni/ rigs pas sgrub pa'i lta ba ma yin kyang*/ myong ba nang nas shar ba'i rtogs pa skye bas lam myur ba ste/ khyad par de gnyis las byung ba yin la/ thabs lam de gnyis kyang gcig la brten na gcig shos la 'jug mi rung ba'i 'gal ba can ma yin par gcig graugs su gcig 'gro ba/ rjes dpag lam du byed pas rig pa'i lam nas drangs pa'i nges shes khyad par can bskyed de/ sgom pa dang mngon sum lam du byed pas chos nyid gnas lugs rang ngo 'phrod nas rim gyis 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bde blag tu thob pa ni dgos pa'i mchog gcig yin pas/ de lta bu'i thabs rnam pa gnyis kyi mtshams sbyor lta bu dang*/ mngon sum lam du byed pa'i tshul rgyas par gtan la phab pa ni bstan bcos mchog rgyud bla ma 'di nyid yin te/ rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes/ 'jug 'grel dwags brgyud grub pa'i shing rta las/ “des na yab rje ras pa chen po'i zhal snga nas/ byams chos sde lnga po 'di theg pa chen po spyi yi dgongs 'grel du sgrub ste/ bar pa gsum zhar byung dbu ma'i chos tshul mi ston pa min kyang*/

dngos bstan sems tsam thun mong min pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ byams chos dang po dbu sems thun mong gi bstan bcos dang*/ byams chos tha ma mdo sngags thun mong gi bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir zhes bka' stsal to/ /don gyi dbang gis gzigs nas rje sgam po pa yab sras kyis/ “kho bo'i phyag rgya chen po ni theg pa chen po'i rgyud bla ma'i dgongs pa yin ces gsungs pa dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug rang byung rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ “zab mo rdo rje theg pa la 'jug par 'dod pa gang dag /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma dang*/ kho bos byas pa'i zab mo nang don gyi tshig don tsam khong du ma chud na/ zab rgyas sngags kyi don la dpyis phyin par mi 'gyur bas bstan bcos 'di gnyis legs par slobs shig ces bka' bstsal to/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bstan bcos chen po rgyud bla ma 'di nyid la thos bsam gnang dgos pa shin tu gal che bar brten/ da lam wā ṇa bod kyi ches mtho'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gi bka' brgyud sde tshan nyam skyong tshogs pa nas 'jam mgon kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa phyir mi ldog pa seng ge'i nga ro/ 'di nyid dpar skrun gnang ba dang*/ de yang sngon gyi ma phyir rtsa ba sogs khong du bcug pa nyid gzigs bde'i ched nag 'gros su bzhag pa dang*/ dkar chag zhib rgyas gnang bas dus tshod chud ma zos par 'tshol sla ba sogs khyad chos dang dge mtshan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas las byed pa yongs la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ ma zad/mkhas pa dpe dang ma bral ba dgos//dpe yis mkhas pa bslu mi srid//zhes pa'i dpe ltar 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rgyab rten du thos bsam don gnyer can kun gyis phyag deb spus gzigs gnang ste/ bslab sbyang mthar phyin pa gnang rgyu shin tu gal che zhes zhu ba dang chabs cig /rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa 'di'i mthu la brten nas/

7rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces khra 'gu sprul ming rgan pos rtse gcig tu smon pa dge/rgyal bstan kla klos nyams par byas pa na//snying stobs chen pos skyong bar mdzad pa yi//dam pa'i skyes bu'i tshogs rnams 'phel ba yin//ngo mtshar mdzad pa bzang po'i phyag rjes las//nges don mdo sde zab mo'i dgongs pa dag/rdo rje lta bu'i gnas bdun gyis bsdus nas//bla ma'i rgyud kyi phreng bar spel ba nyid//deng 'dir blo gsar mgrin pa'i rgyan du thob//༄༅/ /shes bya kun khyab mdzod par skrun sngon brjod/ 'jam mgon kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas dgung grangs lnga bcur phebs pa'i rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu pho khyi lo'am spyi lo 1862 lor li thang mkhan po karma nges don nas sdom gsum gyi bstan bcos shig mdzad dgos par skul ma zhus skabs/ nyid kyi dgongs par bstan bcos shig bris na sdom gsum tsam ma yin par shes bya'i rnam bzhag cha tshang ba zhig yod na phan thogs che bar gzigs nas bslab pa gsum gyi bstan bcos shes bya kun khyab ces pa'i rtsa ba mdzad/ de nyid 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang por gzigs phul skabs/ 'di ni nges par bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*/ mkha' 'gros rtsa sgo phyes pa'i stobs las byung ba yin 'dug pas/ mdzod chen rnam pa lnga yi thog mar shes bya mdzod du bzhag nas rang 'grel zhig kyang dgos zhes legs pa'i gnang skyes bstsal bar brten/ dgung grangs nga gcig bzhes pa chu mo phag gi lo spyi lo 1863 la khams kyi sa gnas mang por nyag rong gi dmag gis zing slongs nas thugs sos ma bde ba'i skabs yin mod/ ji mi snyam par dgongs nas mkhan chen bkra shis 'od zer gyis yig bris kyi mthun rkyen mdzad de zla ba bdun pa'i nang 'grel pa cha tshang grub par thugs rtsol chen po gnang ba 'di nyid/ a lags gzan dkar rin po che sogs bod kyi mkhas dbang rnams kyis thugs khur che bzhes kyis par skrun gnang ba ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po cher phan pa gnad la smin pa zhig byung 'dug

/'on kyang sa mtshams 'grul bzhud dog pa'i dbang gis phyi rgyal yul grur bzhugs pa'i thos bsam pa rnams kyis phyag dpe thob dka' ba dang*/ tshong pa 'ga' zhig gis khyer yong ba rnams rin gong ha cang che drag pas thos bsam gnang mkhan dpal 'byor gyi rgyab brten phra ba rnams la phan pa'i ched dang*/ de bzhin ma dpe yig 'bru zhib che ba'i dbang gis phyag dpe yun ring gzigs rtogs gnang mkhan gyi spyan la ma bde ba'i nyams myong byung bar brten/ yig 'bru dang deb gzugs che bar bsgyur nas wā rā ṇa sī rig pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gi rtsom sgrig sde tshan khra 'gu dharmā ka ra tshogs pas par du skrun skabs the wan ka'u shong badz+ra bid+yā'i chos tshogs nas sbyin bdag thabs shes gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu/ zhes phyi lo 2002 zla 1 tshes 19 nyin khra 'gu sprul ming pas/༄༅/ /shes bya mdzod las/ bzhi pa rgyal bstan 'dzam bu'i gling du ji ltar dar tshul par skrun sngon brjod/

spyir dpe cha slob gnyer ba rnams kyis chos 'byung dang*/ lo rgyus kyi skor la do snang che bar gnang na/ dpe bskyed che zhing*/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa gang la yang shin tu mkho gal dang ldan la/ lo rgyus lta bur song bas go sla ba yin mod/ 'on kyang thugs la nges dka' tsam zhig tu song bas/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas (1812-1899) kyis mdzad pa shes bya kun khyab mdzod kyi mdzod gnas bzhi pa las bstan pa'i chos 'byung gi skor 'di nyid/ rtsa ba tshigs bcad blo la 'dzin bde zhing 'grel pa yang zhal gsal la rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa bcas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i phyir na/ bstan bcos chen po shes bya kun khyab mdzod las/ zur du bkol te dpal karma'i nālan+dā'i dpe mdzod khang nas spar skrun gnang 'dug pa 'di nyid kyi slob gnyer ba rnams dang*/ chos 'byung lo rgyus la do snang can kun la shin tu phan thogs che zhing gzigs bde bar byung 'dug pas/ thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ yang bskyar spar log rgyab chog pa'i gnang ba zhus te wā rā ṇa sī/ badz+ra bid+yā yi gtsug lag khang nas bskyar du spar skrun zhus pa lags pas/ rgyal bstan rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ces khra 'gu sprul ming pas/ phyi lo 1999 zla 9 tshes 9 la gnas mchog sā ra nā thar rtse gcig tu smon pa dgechos kyi 'byung gnas wā rā ṇa sī ru//chos 'byung 'di nyid spar du skrun pa yis//chos kyi bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas nas kyang*//chos bzhin spyod nas 'gro rnams bde gyur cig/༄༅/ /blo sbyong don bdun ma phal skad du bkral ba par skrun sngon brjod/ da lam dharma kā ra zhes pa'am chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes pa'i rtsom bsgyur khang 'di nyid gsar du btsugs pa'i dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan ni/ spyir ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i bka' rnams ni/ dri ba dang dris lan gyi tshul du skabs de dang der sil bur gsungs par brten/

bka' rgya che zhing*/ lung grangs mang bas/ don rtogs pa dang*/ khong du chud dka' bas/ rgya gar dang bod du byon pa'i mkhas grub chen po rnams kyis/ rgya chen sdud pa dang*/ zab mo 'byin pa'i bstan bcos sogs mdzad pa la brten nas/ rgyal ba'i bka' rnams kyi don/ blo la nges bde ba sogs byung zhing*/ de lta bu'i bstan bcos rnams kyang*/ dar spel skabs/ btsun pa dang sngags pa'i dgon sde khag rnams dang*/ bshad grwa khag la dar bas/ bstan bcos rnams brtsams gnang ba'i skabs/ rtsom pa po rnams kyis mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod gtso bor bton nas/ don gyi dbang du byas na/ rang lugs bzhag pa dang*/ gzhan lugs dgag pa sogs phra zhing zab pa'i rigs pa la brten dgos pa zhig dang*/ tshig gis dbang du byas na yang sdeb sbyor dang*/ snyan ngag gis bcings te/ don rnams go dka' tsam snang ba'i phyag srol byung ba'i stabs kyis/ mi dmangs dkyus ma rnams kyis shes shing rtogs par dka' ba lta bu byung la/ deng gi dus 'dir dgon sde dang bshad grwar bzhugs pa kho na ma yin par/ dmangs phal pa rnams kyis kyang chos kyi gnad rnams rtogs pa zhig gal che bar brten/ dpe dang rtags sogs kyis go bde bar byas nas/ zab cing rgya che ba'i don rnams la nges shes bde blag tu skyes thub pa gal cher bzung nas chos bshad byas pa sgra 'dzin 'khor thag steng yod pa rnams/ yig thog tu len cing*/ yig thog tu yod pa rnams rig mdzod 'phrul 'khor nang bcug nas/ par skrun byed pa dang*/ de bzhin bod skad du yod pa khag rgya skad dang*/ dbyin skad thog bsgyur ba dang*/ dbyin skad thog yod pa rgya skad dang*/ rgya skad thog yod pa dbyin skad thog phab bsgyur gyis/ thun mong ma yin pa'i chos kyi nyams len khag skad yig so so'i rwa ba las brgal nas/ dam pa'i chos la dad pa dang mos gus yod pa kun gyis/ chos kyi don rtogs shing nyams su len thub pa'i thabs shes dang*/

de yang yon tan dang ldan pa dag la phan pa'i bstan bcos ngo mtshar can bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs par brten/ yon tan dang ldan pa rnams kyi ched du ma yin par/ yon tan dang mi ldan pa'i phal pa dkyus ma rnams la phan pa dang*/ dgon sde dang bshad grwa sogs la sbyang pa thon zin pa rnams kyi ched du ma yin par/ chos sgor gsar du zhugs pa dang*/ chos la mos pa gsar du skyes pa rnams la phan pa'i ched gtso bor bzung nas/ chos kyi gnas lugs mi shes pa rnams kyis shes thub pa dang*/ chos kyi nyams len med pa rnams nyams len dang ldan par byed pa'i ched du chos kyi 'byung gnas (dharma kā ra )zhes pa'i rtsom sgyur tshogs pa 'di nyid gsar 'dzugs byas pa lags pas/ thams cad kyis thugs snang gal chen gnang rogs bka' drin zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga laṃ/༄༅/ /snying rje'i dbang phyug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs//gdul bya'i snang ngor mi yi sha tshugs can//karma pa zhes grags pa'i skyes rabs phreng*//rim par byon pa rnams kyis dge legs stsol//chos la dad pa'i skye bo 'ga' zhig la// chos ldan gtam gyis mthun 'brel byas pa dag/chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes pa'i tshogs pa yis//chos spel phyir du phyogs gcig bsdus 'di legs//deng gi dus sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byin rlabs dus las ma yol ba'i mthu la brten nas/ sa gnas mi 'dra ba khag la gnas pa'i mi rigs mi 'dra ba mang po zhig /dam pa'i chos la ldog med kyi dad pa skyes yod pa dang*/ de yang rgyu mtshan med pa'i rmongs dad dang*/ cal sgrogs rjes 'jug tsam ma yin par ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang*/ des bstan pa'i bka' sde snod gsum sogs/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dang ldan zhing*/ 'dzam gling 'dir gnas pa'i mi rigs rnams kyi sdug bsngal sel thub pa dang*/

lam bzang po 'di la brten nas mthar thug 'bras bu bzang po zhig nges par thob thub pa'i nges shes kyi dad pa brtan po skyes pa zhig yin la/ de dag gis skyes chen mang po gdan 'dren zhus nas gsung chos gnang bar byon pa bzhin/ phran rang la yang bong ba gser du mthong ba lta bu'i sgo nas/ mgron 'bod byas pa ltar/ sa gnas mang po zhig la phyin pa'i skabs spyir mi yi 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal las skyobs pa'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes sogs gang yang med mod/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi bka' drin las/ gsung chos mang po thob pa'i go skabs byung bar brten/ las dang po pa rnams la go bde bar byas nas/ chos bshad phran bu byas pa khag /tshogs pa so sos sgra 'dzin 'khor thag tu bcug pa rnams/ a ri ba mi si krar ka lag rjon son (Mr. Clark Johnson) nas phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa/ slar yang hā yus (Hwa Yue Foundation) rogs ram tshogs pa spyi dang lhag par rang la shin tu snying nye ba karma blo gros bstan rgyas nas 'bad rtsol chen po dang 'gro gron phangs med btang nas chos kyi 'byung gnas (dharma kā ra )rtsom bsgyur tshogs pa btsugs gnang ste/ phran rang sa gnas ma 'dra ba khag la phyin pa'i 'dra par rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus/ de bzhin chos bshad 'khor thag tu yod pa rnams sde tshan drug tu phyes nas dkar chag gsar bsgrigs gnang*/ de yang*/1 ¿ sde tshan dang po/ mdo dang*/ gzhung chen kha shas shig go bde bar byas nas bshad pas de'i skor/2 ¿ sde tshan gnyis pa/ lhag pa'i lha rnams kyi sgom bzlas nyams su len pa'i skabs kyi dmigs rim skor/3 ¿ sde tshan gsum pa/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi nyams len byed pa'i tshul dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i sgom rim gyi skor/4 ¿ sde tshan bzhi pa/ te lo dang nā ro sogs kyi rnam thar mos gus bskyed byed kyi skor/5

¿ sde tshan lnga pa/ so thar dang*/ byang sdom skor/6 ¿ sde tshan drug pa/ mi dmangs la chos spyi 'gro tsam bshad pa bcas sde tshan drug po de rnams chos bshad pa'i yul/ nang pa yin pa dang*/ ma yin pa/ de bzhin chos la dad pa dang yid ches yod pa dang med pa sna tshogs zhig dang*/ yang skabs 'gar chos kyi shes tshad mthon po lta bu dang*/ yid ches dang mos gus de tsam med pa sogs ma nges pa du ma zhig la chos bshad dgos pa'i gnas tshul sogs byung bar brten/ nang chos kyi slob ma kho na yin pa bod kyi bshad tshul dang cung ma mthun pa yang yod srid la/ de bzhin rtsa ba'i zin bris sogs med par thad kar bshad pas zlos skyon dang*/ 'ga' zhig don gal che ba ma tshang ba sogs kyi skyon cha mang po yod nges pas mkhyen yon dang ldan pa rnams kyis bcos bsgyur nges par gnang rogs bka' drin dang*/ de lta bu'i skyon dang nor 'khrul la bzod gsol yang zhu rgyu lags/zab cing rgya che'i don bzang ma mchis shing*//brda dag tshig gi sbyor ba zhan mod kyi//dang po'i las can chos la 'god pa yi//bsam pa bzang pos kun nas slong ste bshad//de phyir ma shes nongs par gyur pa kun//mkhyen spyan yangs pa dag gi drung du bshags//'dir 'bad dge ba cung zad gang mchis pas//'gro rnams thar pa'i lam du 'jug gyur cig/ces khra 'gu sprul ming pas lho phyogs ma la ya'i nags 'dabs su 2001 zla ba 5 tshes 5 nyin bris pa dge/༄༅/ /karma chags med kyi phyag rdzogs zung 'jug par skrun sngon brjod/ spyir gangs can bod kyi ljongs su mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa dang*/ de dag gis phyi rabs pa rnams la dgongs nas bstan bcos dang*/ man ngag gsung mgur sogs dpag tu med pa zhig gnang bar mdzad pa las/ skabs 'dir ni sgrub brgyud karma kam tshang las gyes pa'i gnas mdo bka' brgyud gang las 'phel ba'i mkhas grub chen po karma chags med kyi gsung ste/

spyir mkhas grub chen po de nyid kyi gsung rnams phal skad kyi rnam pa lta bur bzhugs pas 'ga' zhig gis snyan ngag gi nyams dang mi ldan pa'i tshul gleng nas skur ba btab pa yang byung mod/ don gyi char de lta bu zhig ga la yin te/ zab cing go bde bas bka' brgyud pa spyi dang*/ lhag par thun min gnas mdo ba/ de bzhin kaḥdapal rdzogs gsum sogs snga 'gyur rnying ma phal che ba yang khong gis rjes su ma 'jug pa med pa lta bus phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa byung zhing*/ lhag par thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid phyag rdzogs zung 'jug gi man ngag nyin zhag bco brgyad kyis grub pa zhig gsungs pa ni/ gangs can bod kyi lha skal jo bo thugs rje chen po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi thabs la brten pa'i gdams ngag cig yin par brten/ nyams su len bde zhing*/ 'gro phan dang phrin las 'phel ba'i ched khrom chos kyi tshul du gsungs pas sus kyang mjal du rung bar ma zad/ zhi lhag gi nyams len/ bar do dang 'pho ba'i man ngag rnams kyang bstan pas phyag rdzogs kyi gnad rnams 'dir 'du ba dang*/ de dag kyang shin tu go sla zhing nyams su len bde bas phan yon dang dgos pa shin tu che ba zhig bzhugs pa las/ da lam dharma kā ra nas de'i bsdus don gdams ngag le'u brgyad pa 'di nyid par skrun zhus pa lags pas/ thams cad kyis zhib mjal dang nyams len gang zab gnang rogs bka' drin zhu zhes/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas phul ba lags/༄༅/ /phyag rdzogs zung 'jug gi par byang smon tshigasnying rje'i dbang phyug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs//gdul bya'i snang ngor mi yi sha tshugs can//karma pa zhes grags pa'i skyes rabs phreng*//rim par byon pa rnams kyis dge legs stsol//chos la dad pa'i skye bo 'ga' zhig la//chos ldan gtam gyis mthun 'brel byas pa dgachos kyi 'byung gnas zhes pa'i tshogs pa yis//chos spel phyir du phyogs gcig bsdus 'di legs//chos kyi 'byung gnas stag mo lus sbyin du//chos mchog 'di nyid spar du skrun pa yis//chos kyi bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas nas kyang*//chos bzhin spyod nas 'gro rnams bde gyur cigaces khra 'gu sprul ming pas smon pa dge'o//༄༅/

/si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi bka' brgyud gser phreng rnam thar zla ba chu shel gyi phreng ba par skrun sngon brjod/ oṃ swasti/ tshe lus gcig gis rdo rje 'chang gi sa//bgrod par nus pa'i rmad byung lam po che//gdul byar rjes su ston mkhas 'dren pa mchog/bka' brgyud gser ri'i phreng bar gus pas btud//de la spyir nges don gyi mdo rgyud bstan bcos zab mo rnams la thos bsam gnang ba'i skabs dang*/ lhag par dam chos phyag rgya chen po'am/ zab mo nā ro chos drug sogs nyams bzhes skabs/ chos sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang nas bzung rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i bka' brgyud kyi bla ma gser ri'i phreng ba lta bu rnams la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa dang yid ches mos gus khyad par can zhig yod dgos pa dang*/ de yang cal sgrogs rjes 'jug gi rmongs dad tsam ma yin par/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang*/ bstan 'gror sman pa'i phrin las rnams ji lta ba bzhin du shes nas/ yid ches bzlog tu med pa'i dad gus khyad par du 'phags pa zhig bskyed dgos la/ de bskyed pa'i rgyu ni bka' brgyud gser phreng gi rnam thar shes pa la rag las pa'i phyir/ gser phreng gi rnam thar mjal rgyu ni shin tu gal che zhing*/ de yang bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar mang du bzhugs pa las/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas dang*/ be lo tshe dbang kun khyab bla slob kyis mdzad pa'i gser phreng gi rnam thar zla ba chu shel gyi phreng ba 'di khyad par du 'phags par bzhugs mod/ 'on kyang bka' 'bum gyi khrod du par skrun gnang ba tsam las zur du med par brten/ dpe cha ba rnams ni dpal 'byor gyi rgyab rten la de tsam do snang mi gnang ba kho na yin stabs de rnams kyis bka' 'bum cha tshang blu yon zhu ba'am/ bka' 'bum las zur du bton dgos na stabs ma bde zhing*/ grwa rkyang bya bral ba de dag ni mkhas pa dang grub thob 'byung ba'i chu mgo lta bu yin pa'i phyir/

de dag la zhabs zhus 'grub pa'i re bas bka' 'bum las zur du deb gzugs su par skrun zhus lags pa dang*/ lhag par si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis phyag bstar gnang ba'i gser phreng gi zhal thang kun gyi 'dren byed du gyur pa tsam gyis yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog pa zhig bzhugs pa kar shod lha bris pa rnams kyis ga shog gi lam nas dpe bshus byas pa zhig /sangs rgyas mnyan pa sku phreng dgu pa bod nas bros phebs skabs sku ngal la ma 'dzems par gdan 'dren zhus nas rum bteg bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling la phul ba de nyid phyis su rgyal ba'i dbang po rang byung rig pa'i rdo rjes rgya bal sogs su bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i phrin las bskyang ba'i skabs/ si tu chos 'byung las phyis su byon pa'i gser phreng na rim gyi zhal thang kha bskang ba'i tshe/ zur mang lha bris bkra rgyal nas bstan pa la phan pa'i lhag bsam kho nas kha bskang gi zhal thang cha tshang bris nas phul ba bcas bzhugs yod kyang*/ kha shas kyis lha ngo ji bzhin mi mkhyen pa dang*/ yang gtso bo tsam ngos zin kyang*/ 'khor rnams zhal mi tshor ba sogs yod pa rnams la phan pa'i ched du/ rnam thar dang zhal thang lhan du bzhugs pa 'di nyid par skrun zhu skabs/ rdor slob bstan dga' rin po ches gser phreng zhal thang gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi mtshan byang gces nyar gnang ba g.yar po bka' drin byung bas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ rang slob nub ri'i grwa lha bris pa karma dgra 'dul gyis ang ki dang mtshan byang bris yul ri mo bris shing*/ bshad grwa'i dpe khrid pa tshe ring gis gang spyir gra sgrig gnang ba dang*/ the wan du bzhugs pa'i rang dgon gyi bla ma karma tshe dbang gis par skrun gyi sbyin bdag gnang ba bcas kyi mthun rkyen la brten nas deb 'di par skrun zhus thub pa la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ da lam rig mdzod du bcug skabs nyams myong dman pa sogs kyis zhan cha byung ba khag mkhas dbang rnams la bshags shing*/
bka' bslab sogs lhug stsol bka' drin zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas/༄༅/ /se ra rje btsun gyi kar lan klu sgrub dgongs rgyan par skrun sngon brjod/

de yang ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po bu ram shing pas gdul bya rnams kyi ngor zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi sgo 'phar brgyad khri dang bzhi stong dbye bar mdzad pa las sher phyin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la sogs pa ni shin tu gal che ba yin te/ sras bzhi bskyed pa'i yum lta bur gyur pa'i phyir dang*/ lhag par de rnams kyi dgongs don la dngos bstan dang*/ sbas don rnam gnyis yod pa las dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa ni/ 'phags mchog klu yi dbang po yab sras rnams kyis dbu ma rigs tshogs la sogs pas gsal bar mdzad cing*/ sbas don sa lam gyi rim pa rnams rgyal tshab ma pham pa chen pos mdzad pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyis bkral ba yin la/ de nyid kyi dgongs 'grel khyad par can rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i gsung rje btsun ngal gso las ni bka' brgyud rang lugs thun min gyi lta ba/ mar mi dwags gsum sogs kyi man ngag rnams rtsal du bton nas sher phyin gyi dgongs pa dang sbyar bas/ shin tu zab cing nyams len gyi gnad dang ldan pa zhig yin par ma zad/ yang du rje nyid kyis 'grel pa de nyid la mkhas pa rnams kyis brgal lan gnang dgos par bskul ma yang gnang bar brten/ se ra rje btsun pa chen pos kar lan klu sgrub dgongs rgyan 'di nyid gsung rtsom gnang*/ 'on kyang de la mi bskyod zhabs kyis lan gyi spros pa ma mdzad la/ de ni se ra rje btsun chen po'i gsung la gal chung lta bu gnang ba yang ma yin la/ sher 'grel rje btsun ngal gsor skyon dang bcas pas lan gnang ma thub pa ni de bas kyang ga la yin/ des na gnas tshul de la zhib tu bsam gzhigs byas tshe rmad du byung ba'i thabs mkhas dang*/ rnam par dkar ba'i thugs bskyed rgya chen po dang ldan pa ni dngos su mthong thub pa zhig ste/ spyir bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po rnams kyis dgag bzhag spong gsum gnang ba rnams so skye phal pa ltar/

nga rgyal khyod pham gyi kun slong gis brtsad rgyab pa lta bu zhig ma yin par zab cing gting mi dpog pa'i gzhung chen rnams kyi dka' gnad khag rjes 'jug blo gsal rnams kyis phra zhing zhib par rtogs nas nges shes skye ba'i thabs khyad par can zhig yin la/ de'i phyir 'dir yang rje mi bskyod zhabs dang*/ se ra rje btsun rnam pa gnyis nas blo gros gsal zhing shes rab dang brtson 'grus ldan pa rnams kyis/ rnam dpyod kyi rtsal spel zhing sbyang ba'i do ra chen po zhig gsar skrun bka' drin bskyangs yod pa ltar/ 'di dag la brten nas spyir yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i dgongs don dpyis phyin par rtogs pa dang*/ lhag par rje btsun mi bskyod zhabs kyi dgongs pa thun mong ma yin pa'i zab gnad rnams la nges shes khyad par can bskyed thub pa zhig gal che bas/ kar lan 'di nyid spar skrun zhus pa ltar thams cad kyis bzang phyogs nas bed spyod gnang ba ma gtogs/ phyogs lhung dang chags sdang spel ba'i rgyur ma 'gro ba zhig dang*/ lhag par rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs don zab mo rnams la nges shes mthar phyin pa bskyed thub pa zhig bka' drin zhu rgyu lags so/ /zhes rig pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gi dpe rnying gsar spel gyi 'gan 'dzin pa tshe ring gis bskul ma gnang ba ltar/ 'jar man gyi gnas yongs grags kyi ming la hal ci sha yi (Halscheid) zhes nub phyogs pa'i chos dad can rnams kyis dam pa'i chos kyi nyams len byed pa'i sgrub gnas/ dpal rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng bcu bdun pas karma theg chen yid 'ong gling zhes mtshan gyi cod paṇa bstsal ba'i sgrub sder khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa bka' brgyud bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig༄༅/ /zhal 'don blo 'dzin par skrun sngon brjod/ spyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sras dang bcas pa'i phrin las dang*/

gdul bya sems can rnams kyi bsod nams kyi stobs las/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ma nyams par bzhugs shing*/ khyad par hi mā la yi ri brgyud 'dir 'khod pa'i mi rigs mang po zhig chos la dad pa che zhing gzhon nu mang po zhig 'tshang ga shig shig gis rab tu byung nas ris med dge 'dun gyi sder bzhugs te/ dgon sde rnams gong 'phel 'byung bzhin pa'i skabs su/ sngon mkhan slob chos gsum gyis bod gangs can gyi ljongs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gsar du btsugs pa'i skabs kyi phyag srol ltar/ dge 'dun pa rnams kyis spyir 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bde ba 'byung ba'i ched dang*/ bye brag tu spyod yul la gnas pa'i skye bo pho mo rnams la/ gnas skabs na tsha dang*/ shi chad sogs rkyen ngan thog tu babs pa'i skabs su srung bzlog /zhabs rim/ tshe sgrub/ g.yang sgrub/ bsang gsol la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal las bskyabs pa dang*/ mthar thug 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la bkod pa'i thabs gnang ba ni/ theg pa chen po mdo sngags spyi yi nyams len/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la brten nas gzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas shin tu gal che bas/ gzungs dang*/ gsol 'debs/ bsngo ba dang smon lam/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa sogs stabs bde'i zhal 'don khag blo 'dzin bde ba'i ched/ phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas deb gzugs ha cang rgyas pa ma yin pa zhig par skrun zhus pa lags pas/ 'di dag chad lhag dang nor 'khrul med par blo thog nas kher 'don thub pa zhig gal che bas de ltar thugs nges zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris/༄༅/ /stag mo lus sbyin bshad grwa'i nyer mkho kha ton par skrun sngon brjod/ rang re rnams che ba bdun dang ldan pa'i theg pa chen po'i chos sgor zhugs pa ni shin tu skal pa dang ldan pa yin pa'i phyir na/

gzhan phan gyi bya ba la ci nus kyis brtson dgos pa las/ rang tshe 'di'i bde skyid tsam thob pa'i kun slong gtso bor byas te thos bsam byed pa gzhi kun slong ma dag pa dang*/ yang rang nyid kho na thar pa don gnyer gyis sgom sgrub byed pa yang*/ ming theg chen zhes byas rung*/ don theg dman gyi kun slong dang*/ spyod pa las ma 'das pas de ltar mi 'os la/ lhag par 'jig rten phal pa rnams bde ba sgrub 'dod kyi blo yod pa smos med dang*/ sdug bsngal spang 'dod kyi blo yod pa gzhir bcas rung*/ bde ba ji ltar sgrub dgos pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ji ltar spang ba'i tshul mi shes pa la brten nas/ sdug bsngal dang rkyen dag mu mthud nas myong bzhin pa 'di rnams blos yal bar dor ba ga la rung*/ khrid yig dang zhal 'don khag las gsungs pa'i mar shes/ drin dran/ byas pa bzo ba sogs nges par lag len ci thub byed dgos/ de yang 'jig rten pa'i bya bzhag tshong dang*/ so nam/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi sgo nas gzhan phan sgrub par rloms/ de ni 'jig rten phal pa'i spyod par song nas 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu las dam pa'i chos dang mthun par ga la 'gyur/ des na grong chog dang zhabs brtan pa zhes smod par byed rung*/ rang gzhan 'di phyi'i legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba dam pa'i chos la bsten dgos pa dang*/ skyabs dang re sa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum du nges pas na/ bstan 'gror phan pa'i lhag bsam dang*/ kun slong rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ lhag pa'i lha yi sgom bzlas dang*/ gsol 'debs/ smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor rnam par dag pa bcas byas na/ gnas skabs rang gzhan gyi nad gdon bar chad zhi ba/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa/ shes rab dang legs tshogs 'phel bar ma zad/ mthar thug thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur nges pa'i phyir na/ rang don gzhan don gang la yang zhal 'don nges par gnang dgos pa'i phyir/ stag mo lus sbyin bshad grwa ba rnams nas zhal 'don gyi deb chung 'di nyid spar skrun zhus pas rgyal bstan dar zhing*/

'jig rten gyi khams kun tu nad mug 'khrugs rtsod zhi ba'i rgyur gyur ciga'ajigs skrag sdug bsngal gyis mnar 'jig rten 'dir//skyabs dang re sa mchog gsum las gzhan su//de phyir rang gzhan phan bde la sbyor phyir//dad dang spro bas zhal 'don gnang bar gces//zhes stag mo lus sbyin bshad grwa ba rnams nas bskul ngor khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge'o// ༄༅/ /karma pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i dbu ma'i bsdus pa dang*/ zur bkol khas len skyong tshul par skrun sngon brjod/ spyir bdag cag gi ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po'i rjes su 'jug pa kun gyis rgyal bstan yin no cog la chags sdang gis ris su ma bcad par dag snang dang mos gus sbyangs dgos pa smos med kyang*/ rang rang gi me tog phog pa'i lha skal rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams las brgyud pa'i man ngag zab dgur bzhugs pa kun la snang med rgyang skyur du song na de bas ga la rung*/ de'i phyir dpal 7rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa o rgyan phrin las dbang gi rdo rje mchog gis rang re bka' brgyud pa'i phyag dpe gal chen dpe rgyun dkon pa khag gzigs zhib dang par du phyag 'debs gnang ste/ thos bsam sgom pa'i nyams len pa kun gyis mngon sum du bslab sbyang bya rgyu'i go skabs rin thang bral ba zhig gnang ba ni/ bstan pa spyi dang bye brag la shin tu bka' drin che ba las/ da lam phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i rje dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i dbu ma'i bsdus pa dang*/ zur bkol khas len skyong tshul gyi gzhung 'dis/ sgrub brgyud gong ma rnams kyi mtha' bral dbu ma'i lta dgongs dang*/ khyad par 'jug pa'i kar ṭīka chen mo'i dka' gnad ji bzhin rtogs pa la phan thogs rgya chen po 'byung nges pas kun gyis thugs snang zab mo'i sgo nas nyams len mthil phyin gnang ba shin tu gal che/ zhes khra 'gu sprul ming pas phul ba lags/༄༅/

/deb spyi'i par skrun sngon brjod/ srid pa'i 'jigs pa las skyobs shing*//rnam grol bgrod pa'i lam gcig pu//lung rtogs gnyis bsdus zhi bsil chos//gus pa'i phyag gi yul du bsten//de yang gangs can bod kyi ljongs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba nas brtsams da lta'i bar du/ mkhas btsun bzang grub kyi skyes bu khyad par can bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa rnams kyis rang rang gi nyams myong gi steng nas byung ba'i man ngag sna tshogs pa zhig ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs rim byung rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs te bstan bcos dang zhal gdams/ zin bris dang*/ cho ga lo rgyus dang*/ rnam thar sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig rtsom 'bri gnang ste bzhugs pa de dag bar lam dus kyi 'gyur ba la brten nas mang po zhig chud zos su phyin pa ni bod phyi nang tsam ma yin par 'dzam gling gi skye 'gro yongs la gyong gun chen po zhig byung ste/ shin tu phangs pa'i gnas su 'gyur par ma zad/ da lta 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi skal par bzhugs pa dag las kyang*/ kha shas dpe rgyun dkon pas mi mngon pa'i dbyings su phebs la nye ba rnams mi nyams par dpe rgyun spel ba'i ched dang*/ yang phyag dpe shin tu mkho gal che ba khag thos bsam dang nyams len gnang mkhan/ dpal 'byor gyi rgyab rten de tsam med par spros med du bzhugs rgyur thugs mnyes pa rnams kyis stabs bde'i thog nas phyag dpe khag thob pa'i ched/ badz+ra bid+yā yi dpe mdzod khang gis spar skrun zhus dang zhu 'char bzhin/ da lam sbyin pa'i bdag po nas zhal 'debs hin sgor yon sbyar gnang ste/ phyag dpe 'di nyid deb grangs spar skrun gnang ba dang*/ de skabs dpe cha zhu sgrig gi 'gan khur ba dang*/ thon gsar rig mdzod du bcug mkhan bcas thams cad kyis phya ra gru 'degs gnang ba la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhes zhu rgyu dang*/

ma 'ongs par phyag dpe gzigs mkhan rnams kyis dpe cha 'di'i steng nas bslab sbyang*/ zhib 'jug nyams len gang gzab kyis rang don du thos bsam sgom gsum/ gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ gnyis don du mkhas btsun bzang gsum ste dam pa'i ngang tshul dgu yis don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa zhig yong ba'i smon 'dun dang*/ de lta bu gnang rogs zhes kyang zhu ba lags/ de bzhin ma phyi gsal po ma thob pa dang*/ zhu dag gnad smin ma song ba sogs kyi lhag chad dang*/ nor 'khrul byung ba thams cad mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyi drung du bshags shing*/ nor bcos bka' bslab kyang lhug por stsol gnang bka' drin zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas/༄༅/ /bal bod skad gnyis la 'jug sgo par skrun sngon brjod/ spyir bal bod mi rigs gnyis ni khyim mtshes kyi yul gru yin par ma zad phan tshun gcig gi khrod du gcig 'dres nas gnas pa zhig yin pa dang*/ gnyis ka la yang khyad chos phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i chos dang rig gzhung thun mong ma yin pa re yod la/ de ni mi rabs nas mi rabs kyi bar du gsog 'jog dang*/ dka' spyad chen pos gces nyar byas pa zhig yin la/ lhag par de dag ni mi rigs kun la phan pa'i nor bu rin po che zhig kyang yin pas/ rig gzhung de dag mi rigs gis mi rigs gzhan gcig la spel res kyis 'phel rgyas su btang nas/ gcig phan gcig grogs su 'gro ba zhig dgos pa mi rigs gnyis ka'i las 'gan yin pa ni brjod ma dgos pa zhig red kyang chos dang rig gzhung de dag skad yig gcig gi rwa bar tshud nas gnas yod pa las/ de nyid skad yig gzhan gyi rwa ba brgal nas spel dgos pas dka' tshegs dang bcas pa zhig yin par brten/ skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi bslab deb ni shin tu gal che ba ltar/ skabs 'dir khra 'gu bkris chos gling dgon du rab tu byung zhing badz+ra bid+yā'i bshad grwa bslab sbyang byas pa/

rta mang mi rigs can gyi grwa karma rgyal po dang*/ de bzhin shar pa mi rigs can khra 'gu maṅgal dīpa gzhi rim bslab grwar 'dzin grwa bcu pa thon pa'i grwa karma mig dmar gnyis kyis bal bod skad gnyis shan sbyar bslab deb 'di nyid gsar bzo gnang 'dug pa bzhin/ bslab thon pa rab byung gzhon nu gnyis kyis mi rigs phan tshun la phan pa'i lhag bsam khyad par can gnang ba de ha cang bsngags 'os shig yin par ma zad slob deb 'di la brten nas/ phan tshun chos dang rig gzhung gi 'brel ba 'byung ba dang*/ de bzhin/ gnas skor/ tshong las/ bslab sbyang sogs bya ba che phra gang la yang phan pa'i mthun rkyen rmad du byung ba zhig 'byung nges la brten rtsom pa po gnyis la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu ma zad/ rig gzhung spyi dang*/ lhag par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu 'phel zhing rgyas nas yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur bar shog snyam pa'i smon tshig bcas khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/ ༄༅/ /blo sbyong don bdun ma phal skad du bkral ba bskyar skrun sngon brjod/ deng gi dus sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs la brten nas/ 'di ga rgya bal 'bras 'brug gi yul gru rnams su sngar las lhag pa'i dam chos 'phel rgyas byung dang 'byung bzhin pa dang*/ bod du yang bstan pa'i me ro gsos dang gso bzhin pa ma zad/ phyi yi yul gru gzhan nas kyang nang chos la dad pa'i skye bo pho mo rim bzhin je 'phel du 'byung bzhin pa ni skye 'gro spyi yi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du gyur pa lta bu lags/ de lta bu la yang phyi yi kun spyod tsam dang*/ gzugs brnyan tsam gtso bo ma yin par nang gi kun slong gal che ba ste/ mdo las/ rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes dang*/

rje mi la ras pas/ chos 'dul ba dang mdo sde ngas mi shes//rang sems gyong po 'di btul na 'dul ba yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtsa ba rang gi sems 'di nyon mongs pa chags sdang phrag dog la sogs pa'i dbang du ma shor bar/ byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi rtsis zin nas rang gzhan kun la phan pa zhi 'dul dang ldan pa zhig gal che zhing*/ de lta bu ni blo sbyong gi man ngag la brten nas 'byung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan la bsams nas/ blo sbyong don bdun ma zhig bshad pa de sgra 'dzin 'khor thag nas deb thog tu spel 'dug pa la/ zlos skyon dang*/ go mi bde ba cung zad byung 'dug pas bskyar du zlos skyon sogs la cung zad bzo bcos kyis go bde bar byas pa yin/ 'on kyang 'di ni mkhas pa shes rab bskyed pa'i ched du ma yin par gsar bu ba chos la dad pa bskyed pa'i thabs kho nar bsam ste/ go bde ba gtso bor byas pa'i khul lags pas nor 'khrul byung ba rnams mkhas dbang rnams kyi drung du bshags shing bzod gsol zhu ba lags/mkhas dbang rnams kyis chos kyi tshig don kun//mkhyen zin phyir na bshad pas ci zhig bya//nges 'byung mos gus can gyi sgom chen la//chos 'chad pa ni de bas dgos pas dben//de phyir de dag don du brtsams pa min//'di ni blo dman chos tshul mi shes pa//gang dag rnams la phan pa'i kun slong gis//bris la nongs pa gang mchis bzod par gsol//ces 'chad pa pos gsol 'debs su phul ba dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi legs bshad gces btus las/ mnyam med bka' brgyud pa'i lugs kyi phyag chen dang chos drug skor/ par skrun gleng brjod/

mnga' bdag mar pa bka' brgyud kyi ring lugs ni/ grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal te lo pas nub phyogs so ma pu ri'i gtsug lag khang du lo bcu gnyis su sgrub pa mdzad pa'i mthar bla ma dang*/ lhag pa'i lhas lung bstan pa ltar grub pa chen po'i sa brnyes nas do ha rdo rje'i glu dbyangs gsungs pa tsam gyis/ grong khyer gyi skye bo 'bum phrag grol/ slob ma grub pa thob pa brgyad kyis kyang 'gro ba'i don de bzhin mdzad par grags shing*/ te lo pa de nyid la ring brgyud dang*/ nye brgyud kyi bka' brgyud gnyis su babs pa las/ dang po ni/ de nyid kyi zhal nas/ klu sgrub tsār+ya lā ba pa/ /skal pa bzang mo nga yi ni//bka' babs bzhi yi bla ma yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tsār+ya pa las gtum mo/ klu sgrub las sgyu lus dang 'od gsal/ lā ba pa las rmi lam/ su kha sidhi las bar do dang 'pho ba ste/ bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams las brgyud pa yin la/ nye brgyud ltar na/ te lo nga la mi yi bla ma med//nga yi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa yin//ces gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang dngos las gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi yi gdams pa rnams gsan/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas snyan brgyud nor bu skor gsum gyi mdzod gtad pas gdams pa'i bcud thams cad 'dus pa yin/ rje btsun de yi spyan sngar paṇa chen nā ro pas/ dka' chen bcu gnyis/ dka' phran bcu gnyis te/ dka' ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi spyad pa'i mthar tshig dang brda la brten nas gsang sngags kyi don thams cad khong du chud cing grub pa brnyes/ de'i zhal slob ḍom+bi he ru ka yi rnam 'phrul mar pa chos kyi blo gros ni/ 'phags yul du lan gsum byon/ snga rjes sdom pas dpal nā ro pa lo bcu drug dang zla ba bdun du bsten nas/ dgyes rdor dang*/ gsang 'dus gtsos rgyud sde du ma'i dbang*/ bshad pa gdams ngag rnams gsan pa'i tshul yang*/ rje nyid kyi mgur las/

rgya gar gyi nā ro paṇa chen dang*//bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā gnyis//sngon sbyangs smon lam gcig pas mjal//lo bcu drug zla ba bdun du bsten/ /zhes dang*/rje nā ro tā pas gtsor mdzad pa'i//grub thob kyi bla ma rnams dang mjal//spyir rgyud sde bzhi yi man ngag zhus//zhes 'byung zhing 'byon thengs rjes ma'i skabs nā ro pa mkha' spyod du gshegs zin kyang gsol ba btab pas/ byang pu la ha ri'i dgon par dngos su byon/ zla ba drug tu bzhugs nas bde mchog yab bka' dang*/ yum bka'i snyan brgyud rdzogs par gnang*/ gzhan yang grub thob chen po shā ba ris rjes su bzung ba'i rgyal ba mai tri pa dang*/ nub lak+ṣe tra yi mkhas pa ye shes snying po/ lho dug mtsho'i gling na grub thob zhi ba bzang po/ ḍā ki ma mi rus rgyan can sogs mkhas grub du ma bsten nas mdo rgyud mtha' yas pa gsan zhing*/ khyad par nā ro dang mai tri gnyis kyis kha ba can pa rnams 'dul ba'i rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur mdzad/ de lta bu'i mnga' bdag lo tsā ba chen po de la/ bshad brgyud dang sgrub brgyud kyi bka' srol chen po gnyis su byon pa las/ gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor dang*/ dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge*/ gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po gsum la gtso bor bshad pa'i bka' babs shing*/ khyad par sgrub brgyud kyi bka' babs pa ni/ gangs can rna ba'i rgyan gcig rje btsun mi la ras pa ste/ 'phags yul gyi grub thob chen po rnams dang dbye ba med par sku tshe de nyid la zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad nas mi dang mi ma yin gyi 'gro ba tshad med pa grol bar mdzad pa las gtso bo snyan brgyud 'dzin pa nyi zla lta bu gnyis las/ zla ba lta bu ras chung rdo rje grags pa ni/ ma gc-ig grub pa'i rgyal mo dang*/ te pu pa dri med bshes gnyen zung gis rjes su bzung nas/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor phyi ma rnams 'phags yul nas spyan drangs te/

skal ldan mang po rjes su bzung*/ gtso bor rgyal ba khyung tshang pa dang*/ bla ma zangs ri ras pa la snyan brgyud kyi mdzod gtad/ 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zab chos sogs gnang*/ de dag gis 'gro mgon ras chen pa la gnang zhing kaṃ tshang bka' brgyud pa la bka' babs pas grub pa'i dbang phyug karma pak+shi'ang gtso bor chos de nyid las grub pa brnyes pa dang*/ gdams ngag sham bu can bco brgyad kyi nang tshan/ tshe dpag med 'gro don gyi sham bu can ni/ sa kar dge gsum gtsos thams cad la khyab pas mtshon skyes mchog 'di'i gdams ngag zab chos rnams ni gangs can grub mtha' yongs kyi gsos su gyur pa yin no//rje btsun mi la'i thugs sras nyi ma lta bu ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po dang*/ snying rje pad dkar sogs nas shin tu gsal bar lung bstan pa ni mnyam med dwags po lha rje ste/ rje de nyid kyis slob ma thun mong ba rnams la bka' gdams lam rim dang*/ mdo lugs kyi ting nge 'dzin la phyag chen gyi ming gis brgyan pa/ thun min rnams la bla ma mi la'i thabs lam dang 'brel ba'i sngags kyi phyag chen thun mong ma yin pa bstan nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas las can dgra bcom pa lta bu lnga brgya sogs gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol du mdzad pas rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ slob ma'i gtso bo 'ba' rom pa dar ma dbang phyug las 'ba' rom bka' brgyud/ phag gru rdo rje rgyal po las phag gru bka' brgyud/ khams pa dbu se'am rje dus gsum mkhyen pa las kam tshang bka' brgyud/ dbon sgom tshul khrims snying po'i slob ma zhang tshal pa brtson 'grus grags pa las tshal pa bka' brgyud de che bzhir grags pa dang*/ sgam po rtsa ba'i gdan sar dwags po khu dbon gsum/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin/ phyis mkhas grub chen po bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs zam ma chad par byon pas dwags po bka' brgyud bcas lnga'o//de las kyang dpal ldan phag mo gru pa ni/

sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi skur ston pa yin pas rnam par thar pa dang phrin las tshad bzung du ma mchis kyang yongs grags slob ma gdugs thogs lnga brgyar grags pa'i gtso bo rnams las bka' brgyud chung brgyad du grags pa rnams byung ste/ skyobs pa 'jig rten gsum mgon las 'bri gung bka' brgyud/ thang pa bkra shis dpal ba las stag lung bka' brgyud/ 'gro mgon rgyal tsha khu dbon las khro phu bka' brgyud/ gling ras pad+ma rdo rje las gling ras bka' brgyud/ chos rje smar ba grub thob las smar tshang bka' brgyud/ yel pa ye shes brtsegs pa las yel pa bka' brgyud/ za ra ba ye shes seng ge las g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud/ snyi phu gyer sgom chen po las shug gseb bka' brgyud de zung bzhi ya brgyad du grags pa rnams byung zhing*/ re re la'ang chos brgyud gdan sa phrin las mtha' yas pa'i mkhas grub kyi tshang chen po brdol zhing*/ khyad par gling ras kyi thugs sras 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi bu slob kyis bya rgod po'i nyin lam bco brgyad khyab par grags pa las/ gtso bo rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje las stod 'brug gnam gyi skar ma lta bu dang*/ lo ras dar ma dbang phyug las smad 'brug sa'i dregs pa/ gdan sa 'dzin pa'i seng ge dgu tshar las bar 'brug tu grags pa sogs smos kyis mi langs shing phrin las rgya cher skyong ngo*//de bzhin khams pa dbu se'am dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa ni/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas drug pa seng ge'i nga ro byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa ste/ de'i sku phreng rim par byon pa/ grub chen karma pak+shi/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje sogs 'dzam bu'i gling du grags pa'i mi yi seng ge'i skyes rabs phreng ba rim par byon pa rnams kyi zhal slob dang rnam thar phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ mdor na mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud la sa chen po'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i grub thob byon pas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa'i chos brgyud byung ba ste/

dpal nā ro pas/ chos brgyud chu bo'i rgyun las ring*/ /zhes rgyal ba'i bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du nyams dang rtogs pa'i brgyud pa mi chad par rje mar pa la lung bstan pa bzhin rtogs pa'i bstan pa sgrub pas 'dzin pa bka' brgyud rin po che'i phreng ba tshar du dngar zhing bar ma chad du byon/ gtso bor rnal 'byor bla med dang 'brel ba'i gdams ngag rgya mtsho lta bu bzhugs pa las sgom rim gyi man ngag thabs lam nā ro chos drug dang*/ grol lam phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa gnyis las/ dang po chos drug de rgyud sde gang la brten pa'i rdzogs rim yin zhe na/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis/ gdams pa 'di ni pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ ma rgyud mahā mā yā/ snying po kye rdo rje/ yang snying 'khor lo bde mchog bka' srung can gyi gdan bzhi rnams la brten no/ /zhes khyad par can gyi rgyud sde chen po lnga rtsa bshad cha mthun gyi rgyud yan lag dang bcas pa la brten par gsungs pa ni rags pa tsam ste/ don du na rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud mtha' dag dang*/ khyad par gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rdzogs rim mthar thug pa yin te/ gsang ba 'dus pa sogs pha rgyud skor nas rlung gi rnam gzhag shin tu rgyas pa dang*/ sgyu lus 'od gsal dang bcas pa'i gdams pa gsal bar gsungs pa dang*/ ma rgyud bde dgyes skor nas/ rtsa dang thig le'i rnam gzhag shin tu rgyas pa dang*/ gtum mo las rgya dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor shin tu gsal bar gsungs shing*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang sdom 'byung sogs nas rmi lam dang bar do/ saṃṭi dang gdan bzhi sogs nas 'pho ba'i gdams ngag rnams gsal bar gsungs/ khyad par gnyis su med pa'i rgyud dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa ba dang bsdus pa'i rgyud dag las rtsa rlung thig le gsum gyi rnam gzhag dang gtum mo dang las rgya sogs kyi rnal 'byor shin tu rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir ro//gnyis pa grol lam phyag rgya chen po ni/

mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud ces yongs su grags pa 'di nyid tshig gi brgyud pa tsam ma yin par don gyi brgyud pa zhes gsungs pa'i don ni phyag rgya chen po dri ma med pa rtogs pa'i brgyud pa bar ma chad pa yin pa'i phyir rtsa ba'i bla ma'ang phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa gang las brnyes pa de la mdzad pa'i phyag srol da lta'i bar du ma nyams pas brgyud pa rin po che 'dir grags che ba'i gdams ngag phyag rgya chen po la/ mdo lugs dang mthun pa'i spros bral 'od gsal gyi yul la/ yul can yid la mi byed pa'i gdams pas mnyam par 'jog pa dang*/ sngags lugs bde stong zung 'brel gyi phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor las skyes pa'i ye shes dang*/ rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pas khyad par du byas pa gnyis su grags pa'i/ dang po ni/ mnyam med dwags po rin po che'i gsungs las/ 'o skol gyi phyag rgya chen po 'di yi gzhung ni bcom ldan 'das byams pas mdzad pa'i theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ de'ang mnga' bdag mai tri pas bram ze chen po yab sras kyi gdams ngag brnyes nas sngags dang rjes su mthun pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag de kho na nyid bcu pa sogs mdzad la/ de rje mar pas gsan te/ theg pa'i mthar thug snying po'i don//mtha' bral yid la mi byed pa//chos phyag rgya che la ngo sprod gyis/ /zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i lta sgom gyi tshul yang*/ bstan bcos chen po rgyud bla ma las/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med//bzhag par bya ba ci yang med//yang dag nyid la yang dag blta//yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /zhes dang*/ rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can//glo bur dag gis khams stong gi/rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can//bla med chos kyis stong ma yin//zhes gsungs te/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba 'di la bsal bar bya ba'i dri ma ci yang med de/

gzod nas rang bzhin gyi dri ma med pa'i phyir/ yon tan sngar med gsar du bskyed cing gzhag par bya ba cung zad med de/ gdod ma nas yon tan rang chas kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ de dag gi rgyu mtshan yang snying po las rnam par dbyer rung ba'i mtshan nyid can bcos ma glo bur ba'i dri ma dag gis ni khams stong la/ rnam par dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can ma bcos pa'i rang bzhin bla na med pa'i chos sangs rgyas kyi yon tan stobs bcu la sogs pas ni khams stong pa ma yin te/ des na dri ma bsal 'dod dang*/ yon tan bzhag 'dod gnyis ka re dogs kyi rnam rtog gis sgrib pa yin pas de spangs yang dag pa'i de kho na nyid da ltar gyi tha mal shes pa snang stong dbyer med bden rdzun dang bral ba 'di nyid la blang dor gyi bcos bslad mi bya bar so so rang rig pa'i shes rab kyis de kho nar blta zhing bsgom par bya'o/ /lta ba zhes bya ba ni shes rab kyis shes shing lta bar byed pa yin la/ sgom pa zhes pa ni de'i ngang du ma yeng par rtse gcig tu bzhag pa nyid do/ /tshul 'di ni rang byung zhabs kyis/ thams cad bden min rdzun min te//chu zla bzhin du mkhas rnams 'dod//tha mal shes pa 'di nyid la//chos dbyings rgyal ba'i snying po zer//zhes gsungs shing gsal bar mdzad pa dang*/ dpal mkha' spyod pas/ dus da lta'i snang rig gsal tsam 'di//chos kun rdzob bden pa'i rang ngo yin//'di ma bcos ngang gi gnad shes na//don dam pa'i bden pa'ang 'di kho na//gzhung tha snyad mkhan gyi bden gnyis de//lung rigs pa mang yang gnad ma go/gnyis tha dad du bzung bas gnyis med nyams//zhes gsungs te/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa ni glo bur gyi dri ma dung gi steng ser po lta bu'o/ /don dam pa'i bden pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dung gi steng dkar po lta bu'o/ /de ni yul can 'khrul ngor snang tsam ma gtogs yul dung gi steng du dkar ser bsal bzhag bya rgyu med pas na ma bcos par rang babs su bzhag pa ni man ngag yin la/

mdor na 'khor ba dang myang 'das zhes bya ba ni kun rdzob snang tsam gyi ngo nas bzhag cing de gnyis ka'i rang bzhin spros bral 'od gsal de la bde gshegs snying po zhes gsungs pas nges pa'i don du snang tsam dang de yi rang bzhin yang so sor dbye rgyu med de me dang tsha ba lta bu'o/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir yum las kyang*/ gzugs stong pa'o/ /stong pa nyid gzugs so/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs shing*/ dwags po rin po ches/ las dang po pas dbang bskur ma thob kyang phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa bskyed par mdzad pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs 'di yin la/ 'di ni gtso bo bka' gdams pa las byung ba'i gdams pa ste/ jo bos mdzad pa'i phyag chen rnams dang mtshungs shing*/ 'di ni slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i de kho na nyid bcu pa'i 'grel par/ ngo bo pha rol tu phyin pa sngags dang rjes su mthun pa/ ming phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba'i khyad par gsum dang ldan pa'i de bzhin nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes su gsal bar bshad pa ltar ro//gnyis pa sngags lugs bde stong zung 'jug gi phyag rgya chen po ni/ spyir phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba'i tshig gi tha snyad ni sngags kho nar gsungs shing don ni zung du 'jug pa la phyag rgya de'i rang bzhin gyis chos thams cad la khyab pas chen po ste chos thams cad de las mi 'da' ba'o/ /de'i tshe phyi yi snang ba mtha' dag snang stong zung 'jug /nang gi rig pa mtha' dag rig stong zung 'jug /snang rig 'phrad pa'i tshor ba mtha' dag bde stong zung 'jug yin pa las/ dang po gnyis la rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid dang*/ phyi ma la mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po zhes gsungs shing*/ stong nyid dang bde chen so so la phyag chen gyis sgras bstan pa'ang yod de/ phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das//pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can//rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma//phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud//ces gsungs so/

/des na rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid yul shes byar byas/ de mtha' dag 'gyur med kyi bde ba chen por shes pa de yul can shes par byas nas yul yul can de gnyis gcig tu gyur pa zhig la dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud las phyag rgya chen po zhes gsungs shing*/ de thog mar mngon du gyur pa'i dus ni dbang bzhi pa thob pa'i dus dang*/ mthar thug gi rtogs pa ni yan lag bdun ldan gyi rdo rje 'chang thob pa'i tshe rdzogs pa'o//sgom pa'i tshul ni/ rigs pas dpyad mthar ma rnyed pa'i med dgag rjes dpag lam byed kyi rtog sgom tsam ma yin par/ snang rig ma 'gags pa der 'dzin gyi rtog pa med par mngon sum rtog bral lam du byed pa ste/ de'i gdams pa phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor dang*/ chos drug gi sgyu lus rnams te/ des na rgyud bla ma las de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la bsal bzhag mi bya ba dang*/ sngags su snang stong dbyer med phyag rgya chen po'i sgom tshul gsungs pa gnyis ka lta ba'i gnas lugs dbu ma la gcig yin dgos la/ dbu ma'i lta ba ni/ yod ces bya na rtag par lta//med ces bya na chad par lta//de phyir yod dang med pa la//mkhas pas gnas par mi bya'o//zhes gsungs pa de kho na'o/ /de ltar che bzhi chung brgyad kyi bka' brgyud grub thob re res chos sgo rab 'byams rgya mtshor phyes pa rnams tshad bzung bar mi nus kyang*/ rje btsun mi la'i gdams ngag mtha' dag /rgyud dang 'brel ba'i thabs lam dang*/ byin rlabs dang 'brel ba'i snyan brgyud gnyis su 'du bar gsungs shing*/ de kun gyi rtsa ba ni phyag rgya chen po dang nā ro chos drug gnyis lags so//

de ltar sngon gleng mdor bsdus 'di bzhin 'dzam gling zhi bde'i ded dpon chen po 7gong sa rgyal dbang bcu bzhi pa mchog gi dbyin ji'i gsung bsgyur lo tsā ba thub bstan sbyin pa lags nas/ bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi legs bshad gces btus gnang ba'i khongs/ mnyam med bka' brgyud pa'i lugs kyi/ phyag chen dang*/ chos drug gi skor/ par bskrun gnang ba'i gleng brjod zhig dgos zhes phyag las gnang ba pos bskul ba ltar/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas yul wārāṇasī drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags/ badz+rabid+yā'i gtsug lag khang du/ rje btsun mi la ras pa dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas lo ngo 883 'khor ba'i dus chen nyin bris pa dge legs 'phel/ ༄༅/ /rab byung ri zla'i me pho khyi lo'i rgyud lugs lo tho 'bring po par skrun sngon brjod/ 'di ga bal yul khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling dgon gyi grwa rdo rje phrin las dang*/ phur pa rgya mtsho gnyis dpal spungs shes rab gling du rtsis sbyang bar ched gcar zhus nas sbyangs 'bras legs thon thog rab byung bcu bdun pa lcags pho khyi'i lo'i li'u tho gsar spel gnang ba/ hong kong khra 'gu chos tshogs nas spar skrun zhus pa lags pas/ kun rdzob rten 'brel rtsis la brten te gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang ngan legs rtogs kyi sgo nas skye 'gro mang po zhig la phan thogs chen po 'byung ba'i re ba dang smon lam zhu rgyu ma zad/ rtsis dge mchog dang*/ gong gsal slob phrug gnyis bcas la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba lags/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas bod rgyal lo 2132 phyi lo 2005 zla ba 7 tshes 26 nyin/༄༅/ /phyag chen gnyug ma'i de nyid gsal ba dbyin skad du bsgyur ba par skrun sngon brjod/ deng gi dus dad pas rjes 'brang tsam ma yin par dbang rnon chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgo nas phyi nang gi shes yon can mang po zhig gis dam pa'i chos kyi nyams len la 'bad brtson gnang bzhin pa'i skabs/

zab don mthar thug pa phyag rdzogs kyi man ngag dang ldan pa zhig dgos la/ de las kyang dam chos phyag rgya chen po ni/ gdams ngag zab la nyams su len bde ba/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi grub thob chen po brgyad cu rtsa bzhi byon pa rnams kyi dgongs bcud ma nyams pa da lta bod kyi mkhas grub chen po rnams kyis 'chad nyan dang nyams bzhes kyi rgyun ma nyams par zhugs pa khag phyi rgyal gyi skad yig thog phab bsgyur gnang rgyu shin tu gal che zhing*/ lhag par dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi gsung rnams ni gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i myong thog nas byung ba'i man ngag mang pos brgyan pa yin pa'i phyir na/ nyams len gnang ba po rnams kyi gegs sel dang*/ bog 'don sogs gang la yang shin tu phan pa che ba'i man ngag yin par brten/ phyag rgya chen po'i sgom rim zla ba'i 'od zer dang*/ gnyug ma'i de nyid gsal ba gnyis ni khyad par du 'phags shing*/ de gnyis las kyang phyi ma 'di ni nyams len kho na gtso bor gnang bas med du mi rung ba zhig yin pa dang*/ ma zad bsgyur ba po yang skad yig rkyang pa la mkhas pa tsam ma yin par sgom gyi nyams myong cung zad yod pa gal che bas/ lo tsā ba er rig pad+ma kun bzang ni/ sprul sku o rgyan rin po che yun ring du bsten cing gsung bsgyur zhus pas sgom gyi nyams myong yod par brten/ khong gis dbyin skad du phab bsgyur grub pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu/ zhes khra 'gu sprul ming pas 2001 phyi zla 2 tshes 4 la/༄༅/ /7skyabs rje khra legs rin po che'i gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len skor par skrun sngon brjod/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len skor/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ tshad med bzhi/ zhi gnas lhag mthong bcas kyi bka' khrid dang*/ lhag par lta ba'i skor shin tu gal che tshul gyi dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan bcas gsal ba'i phyag dpe 'di nyid/

mdzad pa po skyabs rje khra legs rin po che ni/ bka' brgyud yongs kyi spyi mes mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i zhal slob kyi gtso bo grub thob khams pa mi gsum gyi ya gyal gsal stong sho sgam pa chen po'i sprul brgyud nyi ma'i mtshan can rim par byon pa las/ sku phreng dgu pa karma bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po ste/ 'di nyid rgyal ba'i dbang po sku phreng bcu drug pa rang byung rig pa'i rdo rjes ma 'ongs mngon gzigs kyis lhums su ma zhugs pa'i lo gcig gi gong chu mo sbrul gyi lor ngos 'dzin brtags yig gnang ste/ lo gcig gi ring bka' shog dam rgya dgos pa dang*/ shing mo lug gi zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu nyin bka' shog zhal dbye dgos pa'i gsung bris dbus nas khams khra legs rin po che'i gdan sa khra 'gu dgon du bstsal ba bzhin du/ dus tshod de'i thog brtags yig gsung shog zhal dbye skabs dgon nas lho nub phyogs rta pa'i nyin lam gsum gyi sar pha 'gyur med blo gros ma pad+ma zung gi khye'u lug lo pa zhes de skabs sku 'khrungs ma thag yin par brten kun gyi ngo mtshar skye dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin gnang bas rin po che mchog la thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan mnga' ba dang phrin las 'byung bar tshad mas grub par ma zad/ dam pa'i chos dang rig gsar sems kyi tshan rig gnyis kar bslab sbyang dang nyams myong ldan pas nub phyogs pa'i zhal slob rnams kyis ches nges shes skye sla zhing go bde ba dang phan thogs che bas khyad chos mang po dang ldan pa thugs nges zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas (KTD) gdan sa nas phul/ ༄༅/ /kar rabs rim byon gyi rnam thar par skrun sngon brjod/ de yang rgyal mchog bcu drug pa chen po la sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa dang*/ phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod par brten/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam thar sde tshan gsum dang ldan pa zhig bris zhes/

lung rtogs bstan pa'i mdzod 'chang zhang 'gu a gro rin po che nas gsung bskul gnang ba bzhin/ rtsom sgrig zhu 'dun mchis rung*/ bar lam bstan don yin rlom gyi las brel dang*/ le lo'i dbang du shor nas mthar phyin pa zhig ma byung bar brten/ kar rabs rim byon gyi rnam thar zhal bskang ched du/ snga mo rgyal dbang mchog zhal bzhugs shing*/ rang nyid zhabs zhur sku bcar zhu skabs su bris pa/ thun mong gi mthun snang la yongs su grags pa tsam las/ thun min sku che ba'i yon tan bsgrags na de tsam thugs mnyes po mi gnang bar brten/ mdzad rim mdor bsdus bkod pa las med mod/ skabs 'dir de nyid spar skrun zhus pa lags/ kar rabs rim byon gyi rnam thar 'di bzhin khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling du spar skrun dang 'brel rin med rten 'jog tu 'grems spel zhu bzhin lags na/ phyag dpe thugs mkho mchis rigs nas bka' gsal gnang rogs zhu rgyu dang*/ phyag dpe yang bsgril tshal sogs bdag gces gang legs gnang ba las/ rtsis med gal chung dang*/ zong gi 'du shes kyis tshong bsgyur sogs mi gnang rogs zhes 'bod bskul dang bcas khra 'gu sprul ming gis gus pas phul/ ༄༅/ /lam theg gsum skor rgya yig tu bsgyur ba spar skrun thengs gnyis pa'i sngon brjod/ bdag cag gi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rjes su bzhugs nas/ dam pa'i chos nyams su len pa'i skabs su/ phyi nyan thos kyi theg pa/ nang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa/ gsang ba rig 'dzin rdo rje theg pa ste gsum gyi dgongs pa 'gal med du rtogs nas go rim ma 'chol bar nyams su len thub pa zhig gal che la/ de'i skabs su yang theg pa gsum po so so'i lta ba dang*/ sgom pa/ spyod pa/ 'bras bu dang bcas pa shes dgos pa'i phyir/ theg pa gsum gyi skor go bde bar bshad pa'i phyag dpe zhig gzigs rtogs gnang thub na thos bsam dang*/

nyams len gnang mkhan gnyis kar phan thogs shin tu che ba 'byung nges la brten/ da lam theg gsum gyi skor bshad pa'i dpe cha rgya yig tu bsgyur ba 'di/ chos kyi 'byung gnas nas thengs gnyis pa spar bskrun gnang ba la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ phyag dpe 'dis rgya nag gi skad yig thog /thos bsam gyi sgo nas chos la slob sbyong gnang mkhan dang*/ sgom sgrub kyi sgo nas nyams len gnang ba po bcas/ thams cad la phan thogs yang dag pa zhig 'byung ba'i smon tshig bcas/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas gnas mchog stag mo lus sbyin gyi dben gnas nas bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /blo sbyong don bdun ma rtsa 'grel ne pālī skad du bsgyur ba'i sngon brjod/ spyir ne pāl (Nepal) skad yig 'dzam gling gi sa gnas la dang por dar zhing*/ shes yon gyis phyug pa zhig yin pa dang*/ bod du dar ba'i chos lugs chen po bzhi yang*/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos gtsang ma rgya gar dang ne pāl nas yongs su dar ba zhig yin stabs/ skad yig dang*/ chos lugs de dag gi 'brel ba dam zab thog yul ljongs dang skye dgu thams cad la/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde rgya chen po 'byung ba'i lhag bsam gyi kun slong gis lo tsā ba puṇ+d+r+yeparādzuli nas blo sbyong don bdun ma'i rtsa ba dang*/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po ches mdzad pa'i 'grel pa bcas ne pāl (Nepal) skad yig tu bsgyur ba'i blo sbyong rtsa 'grel 'di dag yongs su grags pa'i zab chos khungs btsun yin par ma zad/ bsgyur skabs kyang bla ma karma phrin las rin po che dang*/ chos kyi nyi ma rin po che sogs bla ma skyes chen dam pa mang por bka' chos dang bka' 'dri zhus nas khungs dang brgyud pa tshad ldan byung 'dug pas thams cad kyis phyag dpe 'di la yid ches bskyed 'os shing*/ slob sbyong dang nyams len gnang grub par zhu/ bka' brgyud mkhan po khra 'gu sprul ming pas bod zla 6

tshes 4 rgyal bas chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen nyin bris pa dge༄༅/ /dwags po'i chos bzhi rgya skad du bsgyur ba spar skrun thengs gnyis pa'i sngon brjod/ ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po sogs las/ sgom sgrub nyams len gyi gdams ngag gnang ba po mchog tu lung bstan pa ni/ chos kyi rje dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu yin la/ de nyid kyis rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa nas brgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag dang*/ jo bo rje dpal mar me mdzad nas brgyud pa'i bka' gdams pa'i man ngag ste/ bka' phyag chu bo gcig 'dres kyi gdams pa bstsal bas/ slob ma grub thob gnam gyi skar ma lta bu byung ba yin la/ rang re rnams kyang de lta bu'i gdams ngag la thos bsam dang*/ nyams len byed pa'i go skabs thob pa ni/ shin tu bskal pa bzang ba zhig byung bar ma zad/ khong gi gdams ngag la yang*/ rgyas par dga' ba rnams kyi ngor thar pa rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ 'bring por dga' ba rnams la lam mchog tu gyur pa rin po che'i phreng ba/ bsdus par dga' ba rnams la dwags po'i chos bzhi ste sde tshan gsum gsung bar mdzad pa las/ tshig nyung don zab/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis ka'i gnad tshang la 'jug bde ba ni dwags po'i chos bzhi 'di nyid yin la/ de nyid rgya skad thog bsgyur ba'i phyag dpe/ da lam chos kyi 'byung gnas tshogs pas spar bskrun thengs gnyis pa gnang ba la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ dpe cha 'dis chos byed mang po zhig la phan thogs 'byung ba'i smon tshig bcas/ khra 'gu pas dbyar gnas pa'i skabs bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /blo ldog rnam bzhi spar skrun thengs gnyis pa'i sngon brjod/ spyir da res dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa ni shin tu bskal pa bzang po ste/ lus rten 'di'i steng nas rang nyid la phan pa'i don chen po dag sgrub thub cing*/

gzhan la yang phan thogs rgya chen po zhig sgrub thub pa yin/ de yang dam pa'i chos la brten dgos pa'i phyir/ rang re chos sgor ma gzhug pa rnams chos sgor bzhugs dgos shing*/ chos kyi sgor bzhugs zin pa rnams kyis dam pa'i chos ma brjed pa'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos/ de lta bu bshad pa de yang rmongs dad dang gzhan zer rjes rgyugs tsam ma yin par mi yi lus rten 'di dang*/ mi tshe 'di la 'brel ba yod pa dang*/ dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan chen po yod pa zhig yin/ 'on kyang blo ldog rnam pa bzhi'i thabs la brten nas ma gtogs gsal por mi shes/ gal te yang dag pa zhig shes na dam pa'i chos nyams su blang ste brtson 'grus rtsom thub pa dang*/ 'bras bu bzang po nges par thob thub par brten/ blo ldog rnam pa bzhi bstan pa'i deb 'di shin tu gal che bas/ da res spar bskrun thengs gnyis pa gnang ba la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ deb 'dis mi mang po zhig chos la bskul ma byung nas phan thogs chen po 'byung ba'i smon tshig bcas/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas stag mo lus sbyin dben gnas nas bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig༄༅/ /maṅgal dīpa slob grwa'i dus deb kyi sngon brjod/ shes yon ni rang rang gi mi tshe la bde skyid 'thob pa'i rtsa ba yin par ma zad/ mi rigs dang*/ sa gnas/ rgyal khab/ mi dmangs bcas gang la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos rung*/ shes yon med na 'grub thabs med pa zhig yin par brten/ gzhon nu'i gnas skabs su shes yon la do snang dang*/ slob sbyong byed dgos pa ni shin tu gal che shos shig yin la/ de lta bu'i slob sbyong thub pa dang*/ mthar phyin pa yang mthun rkyen cha tshang ba'i slob grwa zhig la rag las pa'i phyir/ spyi lo 1987 lor maṅgal dīpa slob grwa gsar btsug thog dka' ngal rim sel gyis sgo nas/ mthun rkyen tshang ba'i slob grwar bsgyur te/ da cha dbyin yig dang ne pālī (Nepal)sogs slob grwa spyi 'gro'i shes yon cha tshang dang*/

lhag par chos dang rig gzhung ma nyams shing*/ drang bden ya rabs spyod bzang gi slob phrug zhig 'byung ba'i ched/ bdun phrag re re bzhin chos dge nas dge ba'i phan yon sogs las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag gsung gi yod pa dang*/ de bzhin dam pa'i chos kyi shes yon 'phel ba'i cha rkyen bod yig bris 'don/ dag yig snyan sum sogs slob sbyong gi mthun rkyen yod pas/ spyi sger yongs la phan thogs yong nges ltar/ gnas tshul lo rgyus zhib gsal dus deb thog bkod pa la zhib gzigs gnang rogs zhu/ slob grwa gsar btsug byed po khra 'gu sprul ming pas phyi lo 2001 zla ba 4 tshes 15 nyin bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /phyi lo 2002 lo'i bka' brgyud saṅgha smon lam chen mo'i sngon brjod/ da lta'i gnas skabs 'dir gnas mchog rdo rje gdan byang chub ljong shing gi drung du lo ltar bka' brgyud pa'i dgon sde khag yod do cog gi bla sprul dge 'dun thams cad tshogs 'dzoms shing 'dus thog 'dzam gling gi khyon 'dir nad mug 'khrug rtsod kyi bskal ngan zhi nas bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing*/ lhag par rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mi nyams par gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i ched du smon lam tshogs kyi yod pa las/ lo 'di'i smon lam gyi sbyin bdag hong kong byang chub phun tshogs gling chos tshogs kyi bla ma skal bzang dang*/ slob ma yongs nas sbyin bdag gnang bar bka' drin che zhu rgyu ma zad/ dad 'byor dang ldan pa rnams kyis rgyab skyor gang drag gnang tshe bstan don la phan thogs che nges ma zad/ sbyin bdag rnams bsod nams che zhing 'di phyi gnyis kar 'bras bzang rgya chen po smin nges la/ de bzhin dgongs par mnga' bar zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge/༄༅/ /kar rabs rim byon gyi lo rgyus par skrun sngon brjod/

spyir bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar nas da lta'i bar/ srid don gyi 'gyur ba dang*/ dmag 'khrug sogs 'gal rkyen mang po zhig byung mod/ 'on kyang dam pa'i chos 'chad nyan dang*/ gdams ngag nyams len gyi rgyun ma chad par bzhugs thub pa'i mthun rkyen gtso bo zhig ni/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams kyis sku tshe gcig kho nar bstan don gyi mdzad phrin bskyang ba tsam ma yin par/ skye ba yang nas yang du bzhes nas phrin las gnang ste/ sprul sku rim byon la brten nas gdams ngag nyams len gyi rgyun ma chad pa byung ba yin la/ de ltar sprul sku na rim du byon pa yang*/ 7rgyal dbang karma pa'i phrin las la brten nas byung bas rgyal dbang karma pa'i sku phreng gi lo rgyus shes pa ni/ chos la yid ches bskyed pa'i rgyur nges pas shin tu gal che la/ 'dir sku zhabs (Chen Ho Jing) gis kar rabs rim byon gyi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug gis phyag deb bris gnang ba 'dis klog pa po mang po zhig la phan thogs chen po 'byung nges snyam nas thugs rje che zhu ba dang*/ de bzhin don chen 'grub pa'i smon lam bcas/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas spyi lo 2001 zla 5 tshes 5 la bris pa dge/༄༅/ /sngon 'gro'i 'don cha phyogs bsdus spar skrun sngon brjod/ rang re rnams mi lus thob pa'i don go /rang gzhan bde ba la 'god pa zhig dgos/ tha na yang rang nyid bde ba thob cing sdug bsngal dang bral ba zhig ma byung na rang gi mi tshe de chud zos shor ba yin/ de yang 'jig rten gyi bya ba la brten nas sgrub par bsam na/ de ni gnas skabs tsam las/ mthar phyin pa zhig mi yong bas/ nges par dam pa'i chos la brtson pa gal che zhing*/ dam pa'i chos kyi nyams len kyang*/ thog mar sngon 'gro nas brtson tshul dang mthun pa zhig dgos par brten/ da lam bla ma pad+ma tshe dbang nas sbyin bdag gnang ste/ mkhan po karma bkra shis mchog gis/

sngon 'gro'i 'don cha/ chos spyod skor/ khrid yig khag bcas/ cha tshang ba zhig spar bskrun gnang ba 'dis sngon 'gro nyams len gnang ba po rnams la phan thogs yang dag pa 'byung nges 'dug pa bzhin/ thams cad kyis phyag dpe 'di la do snang gis nyams len gang gzab gnang rogs zhu zhes khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /zur mang drung pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i rnam thar par skrun sngon brjod/ skyes yul pha ran si (France) nas yin pa nang chos la shin tu dad gus che ba can (Fabrice Midal) zhes pa 'di nyid kyis zur mang drung pa chos kyi rgya mtsho mchog dngos su zhal mjal mi 'dug kyang*/ rnam thar gsung chos sogs mjal ba dang thos pa la brten nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dad gus skyes te sku spar sogs mjal nas rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin pa dang*/ gsol ba btab yod 'dug par ma zad/ khong gis pha ran si'i (France)skad thog la rin po che'i rnam thar phyogs bsdus deb chen po zhig gsar rtsom gyis 'grems spel byas pa gang legs byung yod 'dug cing*/ slar yang rin po che khong dang 'brel pa yod pa'i bla ma grwa pa slob ma sogs 'brel yod khag la bka' 'dri zhus nas thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan rnams rtsad gcod kyis rnam thar rgyas pa zhig gsar bskrun zhu rgyu'i mos pa yod pa de nyid yang dag pa zhig grub pa'i skabs nang chos nyams len byed pa mang po zhig dang*/ lhag par chos rgyam drung pa mchog gi zhal slob slob ma'i brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi chos la phan thogs che bar 'byung nges la brten/ khong gis re bskul zhus tshe bstan 'dzin gyis skyes chen rnams kyis gang la gang 'os kyi rogs ram skyabs 'jug gnang rogs bka' drin zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas phyi rgyal shes rig gi bsti gnas og si phor ḍis (Oxford) grong khyer du bris pa dge/ ༄༅/ /mi pham mkhas 'jug par skrun sngon brjod/

spyir bod kyi mkhas grub bsam gyi mi khyab zhig gis/ dgongs 'grel sogs bstan bcos dpag tu med pa mdzad mod/ de rnams las 'jam mgon kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas kyi mdzad pa'i bstan bcos chen po shes bya kun khyab dang*/ mi pham 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo gnyis ni gzhan gyi rjes brjod tsam ma yin par/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam dpyod dang ldan pas bka' dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos mang po zhig gi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas bstan pas/ thos bsam pa rnams la phan thogs shin tu che bar bzhugs pa las/ shes bya mdzod du ni mdo sngags kyi gzhung dang man ngag thams cad bsdus nas bkral bas/ dpe cha gsar bu rnams la cung rgya che drag pa lta bu zhig la/ mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo 'di nyid du mdo phyogs kyi gzhung chen rnams kho na bsdus te bstan pas/ mtshan don dang mthun par blo gsal gzhon nu rnams kyis 'chad nyan gnang na/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi sgo 'phar yangs por phye nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che mdzad nus pa'i yon tan 'byung nges pa ste/ phung khams skye mched sogs kyi skabs mngon pa gong 'og gnyis kyi dgongs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas bstan pa dang*/ chos kyi sdom bzhi bstan pa'i skabs/ dbu ma rtsa shes/ 'jug pa/ rgyan/ bden gnyis rnams kyi rig pa'i gnad rnams gsal bar bstan pa sogs kyis mngon pa dang*/ dbu ma sogs gzhung chen rnams 'chad nyan gnang ba'i skabs phan pa rgya chen po zhig 'byung ba dang*/ lhag par mdzad pa po nyid khra 'gu'i ri khrod du lo lnga tsam bzhugs shing*/ bstan bcos 'di nyid kyang sa gnas der gsar rtsom gnang ba yin cing*/ phyis su zhe chen kong sprul rin po che pad+ma dri med legs pa'i blo gros de gar zhabs kyis bcags pa'i skabs dag pa'i gzigs snang mtha' yas pa byung ba'i tshul/ bka' drin mtshungs med mkhan rin po che blo gros rab gsal gyi gsung las thos par ma zad/

'jam mgon mi pham nyid sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i skabs kyi zhal chems ltar/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku mkhyid gang ba sku gdung ring srel gyi snying po can/ byin rlabs kyi rten du nye gnas 'od gsal gyis ched du bstsal ba dang*/ mgon po gang gi thugs rjes rjes su bzung ba'i mthu las/ dus zing gi skabs su yang nye zho med par rang re'i dad pa'i rten du byon thub pa ni rten 'brel bslu ba med pa ste/ rig pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang 'dir byin rlabs dus las ma yol ba yod nges pas/ mkhas 'jug 'di nyid la bslab sbyang nges par gnang dgos pa zhig lags pa dang*/ de yang las dang po rnams la phan zhing 'chad nyan bde ba'i ched/ rtsa ba dang*/ sa bcad gnyis lhan gcig tu sbyar nas spar bskrun zhus pa 'dis/ dge 'dun pa rnams kyi shes rab gsum gyi snang ba rgyas shing 'phel nas/ bstan pa spel zhing 'gro la phan pa'i rgyur 'gyur bar smon pas de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig ces khra 'gu sprul ming pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /dbu ma gzhan stong la 'jug sgo par skrun sngon brjod/ drung rma se blo gros rin chen gyi gdung rigs las skyes shing*/ shes rab dang brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa rang dgon gyi bshad grwa'i mkhan po shes rab phun tshogs lags nas/ rang lugs kyi lta ba dang grub mtha' zhal gyis bzhes tshul go bde kha gsal can rtsom bris mdzad pa 'dis/ blo gsal rnams kyis thos bsam gnang ba'i skabs phan thogs chen po zhig 'dug par brten/ badz+ra bid+yā'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang nas par skrun zhus skabs/ rang dgon gyi bla ma kun mkhyen dang bla ma shākya zung gis sbyin bdag gnang ba la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ma zad/ dpe cha ba rnams kyis gzigs rtog dang do snang gang gzab gnang rogs zhu ba dang chabs cig /phran nas kyang bstan 'gror phan thogs 'byung ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam zhu/khra 'gu sprul ming pas byes 'gro skabs bskul ma byung ba ltar phyi lo 2006

zla ba 6 tshes 6 nyin bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄༅/ /the wan bka' brgyud smon lam chen mo'i sngon brjod/ da lam lo 'dir tha'i cung khra 'gu ta ra ab bhes (TARA ABBEY)nas karma bka' brgyud khom me kris (committee) las byed pa'i las rgyun ring*/ lo rer bka' brgyud smon lam chen mo thengs re 'tshogs rgyu'i 'char gzhi 'dug pa ltar smon lam chen mo 'tshogs gnang thub na/ spyir 'dzam gling na deng dus dmag 'khrug dang*/ nad kyi rigs sna tshogs dang*/ sa g.yo/ me skyon/ chu log sogs 'byung bzhin pa dag zhi ba dang*/ lhag par the wan (Taiwan)du dpal 'byor nyams pa sogs kyi 'gal rkyen byung ba rnams myur du zhi bar ma zad/ bye brag sbyin bdag so so'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i thabs ni/ dge 'dun pa spyi nas smon lam gnang ba kho na yin stabs/ chos tshogs dang*/ bla ma grwa pa men 'bar (member) slob ma sbyin bdag thams cad nas mthun lam gang gzab thog 'bad brtson mnyam bskyed gnang rogs bka' drin zhu/ spyi lo 2004 zla 1 tshes 16 nyin khra 'gu sprul ming pas/bla ma bstan 'dzin rdo rje la gnang ba'i phyag yig sgrub bla ma bstan 'dzin rdo rje la skyabs rje rgyal tshab rin po ches ngos sbyor gyi yi ge gnang ba bzhin/ skyabs rje rgyal tshab rin po che ni/ bka' brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan/ rgyal ba yab sras rnams kyi gral du bzhugs pa zhig yin par brten/ thams cad kyis yid ches bya ba smos med la/ phran nas kyang de bzhin zhu bas/ kun gyis rogs phan gang drag yod par zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas 2007 zla 1 tshes 14 la/mkhan po 'jam dbyangs rin po che la gnang ba'i phyag yig nyag rong mtsho kha a ra gling gi mkhan po 'jam dbyangs rin po che 'di nyid/ gser tha bla rung lnga rig nang bstan slob gling nas chos rje 'jigs med phun tshogs mchog gis mkhan por mnga' gsol gnang ba dang*/
