de bzhin dpal rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa o rgyan phrin las dbang gi rdo rje mchog gis kyang mkhan po'i mtshan rtags gnang yod 'dug pa bzhin/ phran nas kyang de dag la nges par gus bkur dang len zhu dgos pa gzhir bcas pa bzhin de ltar ngos len zhu rgyu dang*/ mkhan po nyid nas bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa spyi dang bye brag la phan nges dang*/ rang ngos nas kyang mkhas btsun bzang gsum kyi rnam thar gtsang ma zhig skyong gnang bka' drin zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas phul/bla ma gur drag la gnang ba'i phyag yig dad 'byor ldan pa yongs la 'bul 'bras/ bla ma gur drag 'di nyid/ gnas mchog stag mo lus sbyin du lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub gnang ste/ phyag chen dang chos drug gi nyams len mthar phyin nas/ da cha kho rang gi skyes yul du yod pa'i dge rgyal rje drung dgon du/ sgrub khang gcig gsar gzhengs gnang 'char ltar/ sgrub khang de bla grwa mang po zhig gis nyams len gnang rgyu'i mthun rkyen bzang po zhig tu 'gro rgyur brten/ zhal 'debs sogs gnang na bsod nams rgya chen por 'gyur nges la/ de bzhin kun gyis lhag bsam che bskyed gnang rogs bka' drin zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas phul/bla ma pad+ma tshe dbang la gnang ba'i phyag yig gser snyan du 'bul 'bras/ 'di bzhugs bla ma pad+ma tshe dbang gang nyid/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi gdung rigs las skyes shing*/ chung dus nas chos la dad 'dun che ba'i stabs kyis/ rab tu byung 'dod kyi blo skyes nas/ bal yul khra 'gu dgon gyi dge 'dun pa'i sgrigs khongs su bzhugs nas/ cho ga chos spyod kyi nyams len bslab pa dang*/ lhag par gnas mchog stag mo lus sbyin gyi sgrub khang du bzhugs nas/ sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang gi nyams len/ bla ma/ yi dam/ chos skyong yongs kyi bsnyen sgrub/ grol lam phyag rgya chen po dang*/ thabs lam nā ro chos drug nyams len gnang ba bcas lags pas kun gyi thugs nges zhu/

khra 'gu sprul ming pas/karma zla ba la gnang ba'i phyag yig wa rā ṇa sī badz+ra bid+yā gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gi rten bzhengs las ka'i don du/ rang dgon grwa karma zla ba nas lta rtog byed ring dka' las ngal dub gang la'ang 'dzem med gnas 'khur dang len gnang bar rjes su yi rang thog /ngos dang yid ches dge rtsa'i tshogs pa bcas nas thugs rje che zhes zhu gi yin/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i mthun 'gyur gang zab bgyis/ rten 'brel mjal dar bcas/ wār ṇa badz+ra bid+yā gtsug lag slob gnyer khang nas/ khra 'gu sprul skus spyi lo 1999 zla 10 tshes 31 la bris/btsun ma zla ba g.yang sgron la gnang ba'i phyag yig dpal gyi stod lung mtshur phur bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i zhabs zhus ched/ btsun ma zla ba g.yang sgron la/ mtshur phu'i do dam lhan khang dang*/ rum btegs mtshur sgar phyag khang nas rgyab skyor phyag bris gnang ba bzhin/ yid ches bskyed pa'i yul du 'dug pa de bzhin thams cad kyi thugs la mnga' bar zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas/༄༅/ /bdag cag rnams kyi rnam 'dren mtshungs zla ma mchis pa bka' drin gsum gyi bdag nyid mkhan chen khra sprul rin po che sku phreng dgu pa'i mdzad rnam snying po bsdus pa bzhugs so//thog mar ngos 'dzin/ de yang rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu mo bya yi lo 1933 zla 11 tshes 27 la bde bar sku bltams/ lo shas rjes dpal 7rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa chen po rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje mchog gi sgrib bral ye shes gzigs pa'i dgongs brtag la/ pha 'jam dbyangs don grub dang*/ ma dbang mo'i ming can khyim sgo shar du bstan pa sgo khyi dmar po yod pa zhig la khye'u bya lo pa rtags mtshan can zhig 'byung ngo shar bas de la ngos 'dzin gyis zhes pa dang*/ ring du 'tsho ba sogs kyi bden tshig thugs smon yang bstsal ba ni/bstan pa'i dpal gyur karma blo gros zhabs/

/chos dpal bzang po'i yon tan mkha' khyab tu/ /'phel zhing 7zhabs pad rtag brtan bshad sgrub kyi/ /phrin las phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal 'bar shog/ces ming bkra dang bcas te gnang ba ma zad tā yi si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal pos kyang dgongs brtag phebs pa gcig tu mthun pa byung ste/ khra 'gu sprul sku sku phreng brgyad pa'i yang srid 'khrul med du nges pa rnyed/ me glang 1937 lor dpal khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling dgon du khri 'don mnga' gsol gyi mdzad sgo zab cing rgyas pa dang*/ skyabs rje khra legs rin po ches gtsug phud bzhes nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nod/thog ma'i slob gnyer/ sa yos 1939 lor dge rgan karma dbang phyug gi mdun nas yi ge dkar nag 'bri klog nas brtsams/ rgyud sde blo 'dzin dang dkyil chog skor la sbyangs pa mdzad do/ /sgrub mchod khag gi tshogs dbur phebs pa dang dad ldan sbyin bdag gi re 'dod kyang bskang*/sngar srol grwa sa 'gṛms pa dang sgrib sbyong*/ chu lug 1943 lor lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang dang*/ dpal karma bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i chu 'go 'og min thugs kyi gnas mchog mtshur mdo bo lung gi gdan sa chen por gnas mjal dang*/ dpal 7rgyal ba'i dbang po'i 7zhabs kyi pad+mor phyag 'tshal/ gsol ba btab/ gang gis thugs rje brtse ba chen pos rjes su 'dzin/ lhag pa'i lha gang dga'i skor la dgongs pa zhus par bstan pa 'dzin pa la tshe ring dgos pas/ thog mar sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen sgrub la brtson par mdzad pas nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs pa dang*/ 7rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa dang*/ dbus gtsang*/ lho gnas sogs kyi gnas rnams zhib par mjal te sgrib sbyong yang dag pa mdzad rjes rang yul du bzhud/ bsag sbyong gi rim pa/

bka' drin can gyi dge rgan karma dbang phyug drung nas khrid yig nges don sgron me dang*/ kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung gi steng nas blo ldog rnam pa bzhi zhib khrid kyis phyag 'bum sogs sngon 'gro yongs rdzogs mthar chags dang*/ phur pa dang phyag rdor sogs nyer mkho 'ga' shas kyi bsnyen sgrub kyang mdzad/thun mong rig gnas la sbyangs pa/ dge rgan mchog gi drung nas/ dag yig ngag sgron/ rtogs ldan lhag bsam gyi sum rtags snang ba dam pa/ si tu'i 'grel chen zhib khrid dang*/ rtsis skor lnga bsdus/ gza' lnga/ nag rtsis dang*/ snyan ngag me long ma bcas dang*/ de bzhin sgra kā la pa sa bzang pa'i 'grel chen thog nas bshad khrid kyi sa ris kyang zhib par mdzad do// nang don gzhung lugs la 'bad pa/ bka' brgyud rang lugs kyi bshad rgyun dang ldan zhing*/ lta ba'i bzhed pa yang kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje dang*/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dgongs pa ltar dbu ma gzhan stong chen po'i srol zhal gyis bzhes par mdzad la/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros rab gsal rin po che mchog zhe chen nas rang dgon du ched du gdan zhus kyis bshad grwa gsar du btsug lo drug ring nyin mtshan ltos med kyis gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang*/ thun min nang brtag rgyud gsum sogs la rtag gus sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus drag po gnang bas/ rgyugs 'bul skabs dbye ba rgyu mtshan sogs zhib phra bka' 'dri gang gnang bar nor 'khrul med pa lta bu'i lan thogs med du phul bas/ bshad grwa ba dge 'dun pa'i nang nas dgung lo chung shos yin yang*/ shes rab gsal shos yin par kun gyis bsngags/so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa thob pa/ shing rta 1954 lor bod kyi bla chen rnams rgya nag tu gzigs skor grub nas slar phebs par dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du/ 7rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog 7zhabs sor 'khod pa dang bstun/

khams khul bka' brgyud bla grwa yongs mjal bcar zhu rgyur 'dzoms/ skyabs rje khra sprul rin po che mchog kyang sangs rgyas karma pa lta bu'i drung nas sdom gsum gyi byin rlabs shig thob na ci ma rung snyam ste bzhugs pa'i go skabs stabs legs kyis 'grig nas/ dpal spungs su ched bcar zhus/ skyabs mgon si tu rin po che'i yang srid khri gsol mdzad sgo'i rten 'bul yang phul/ gang gis ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dus chen nyin kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi gzim dkyil nang du dpal karma pa sku yi phreng ba bcu drug pa chen po mchog don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na dpal ldan rang byung rig pa'i ye shes lung rtogs chos kyi nyi ma phrin las don kun grub pa'i sde chen po mchog gi zhal snga nas/ khra 'gu sprul sku rin po che dang*/ zur mang gar dbang rin po che/ drung pa chos kyi rgya mtsho bcas lhan rgyas su tshigs gsum rim nod kyis so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ slar yang gtsug lag khang du srol gnyis kyi byang sdom/ de bzhin sngags sdom thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu'i bka' dbang dang*/ dpal ye shes mgon po'i bka' gtad dang 'brel ba'i gtor dbang thugs rje brtse ba chen pos bka' drin thob/ 'di yan kha phyir blta'i rtog ge ba kho na yin yang*/ skabs 'dir kha nang bltas kyi myong ba mi dman pa zhig skye ba'i byin rlabs khyad par can rgyud la 'phos pa'i skal bzang byung ba nas bzung sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes las tha mal pa'i zhen pa lta bu gtan nas med ces khra sprul rin po che'i gsung rnams zin tho zhig tu gsal ba ltar drangs pa'o//dbang lung khrid sogs zhus pa/ lcags byi 1960 lor dpal 7rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gi zhal snga nas bka' brgyud sngags mdzod/ gdams ngag mdzod/

phyag chen gyi khrid rim yongs rdzogs/ zab lam nā ro chos drug sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi lhag med du zhus/ gzhan yang rin chen gter mdzod/ shes bya mdzod/ rgya chen bka' mdzod sogs/ mdor na bka' rnying gi mkhas dang grub pa'i bshes gnyen dang*/ skyes chen dam pa bcu phrag gcig dang*/ bdun tsam la nye ba'i zhabs rdul spyi bor bzhes/ dad pa'i spyan gyis mjal/ chos kyi bdud rtsi blangs te/ mdo sngags chos kyi bang mdzod gang gi thugs kyi bum par gtams shing*/ dbang lung chos kyi 'brel ba'i bla ma bcu bdun tsam bsten pa'i nang nas snying po don gyi ngo sprod pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ dpal karma pa rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje kho na la bzhed do//bka' rams dam bca' bzhes pa/ me lug 1967 lor dpal karma pa chen po rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje mchog gi bka' dgongs bzhin rgya 'brug sa mtshams sa gnas sbag sa kha zhes par ris med dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas dbang rnams kyi dbus dge 'dun zhal grangs gcig stong lnga brgya dang*/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i sku tshab bcas lhan rgyas pa'i mdun sa ga la bar/ thun mong la yongs su grags pa gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang thun mong ma yin pa nang brtag rgyud gsum gyi bshad rgyugs dang*/ dam bca' bzhag pas der phebs pa'i mchog dman kun gyis dgyes pa'i legs so gnang ba dang*/ skabs der tshogs chen thog gtong sgo bsnyen bkur khag kyang zab cing rgyas pa 'bul lam zhus te/ khra 'gu mchog sprul rin po che sku phreng dgu pa 'di yis ris med mkhas grub yongs kyi mdun sar sngar ma grags pa'i mdzad rjes bzhag go/mtshan gnas che 'don/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gis bka' brgyud pa'i mkhan po'i mtshan gnas gzengs bstod gnang ba ma zad/ dpal 7rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gis kyang*/ bka' brgyud gdan sa ma dgon rum bteg chos sgar gyi mkhan chen mtshan gnas ldan pa'i gzengs bstod gnang ba'i khar/

dgyes mdzad mar pa lo tsā'i dngos slob/ bshad pa'i bka' babs pa/ rngog chos sku rdo rje dang thugs rgyud gcig par zhal gyis bzhes shing*/ bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor bar mdzad/ de bzhin 1976 lor 7rgyal dbang mchog gis phyi rgyal chos tshogs khag la/ chos 'chad spel du gtong gnang mdzad skabs kyang karma bka' brgyud pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i snying po tshang la ma nor ba mnga' ba'i bdag nyid/ sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po zhes par phyag tham gru bzhi ma phab pa'i spyi 'gro bka' shog /phyag 'khyer bstsal ba nas bzung*/ phyi rgyal chos tshogs khag la lo ltar zhabs kyis bcags shing gang la gang 'dul gyis chos kyi rnams grangs du ma'i sgo mo phye nas/ deng dus karma bka' brgyud kyi ring lugs phyi nang gang du 'khod pa rnams la/ mdo sngags kyi chos zab mo 'chad pa'i res mos su babs te/ gsung gi 'dul ba'i dngos slob 'dzam gling shar nub kun tu mang*/ nang pa'i ring lugs su gsar du btsud pa'ang shin tu mang ba sogs yul dus gnas skabs kyi mdzad phrin bla nas blar 'phel bzhin mchis/bstan rgyun spel ba'i rim pa/ me sprel 1968 lo 'gor/ rum bteg gdan sa chen por mchog gi sprul pa'i sku zhwa dmar rin po che/ si tu rin po che/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che/ rgyal tshab rin po che rnam pa bzhi dbus/ blo gsar don gnyer can gyi dge 'dun la/ thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhung chen khag zhib phra'i bshad khrid kyi thugs 'gan mi lo brgyad ring gnang*/ 1976 nang bka' rnying bshad sgrub gling gi dgon du/ thar rgyan sogs zhib khrid dang*/ nang brtag rgyud gsum khrid lung gnang ba dang*/ 1983 nas rum bteg chos sgar gyi ches mtho'i bshad grwa chen mor yang gzhung chen slob khrid mdzad pa dang*/ gnas mchog stag mo lus sbyin du dge 'dun pa na gzhon lnga bcu skor la/ gtso bo gzhung chen khag dang*/

zhar la rig gnas slob sbyong gnang*/dgon pa'i 'gan 'dzin/ khra 'gu bkris chos gling gzhis byes gnyis su dgon gnas nyams pa sor chud/ mi nyams gong 'phel/ rten gzhi gsar 'dzugs sogs rtsa ba'i 'du 'god kyi thugs 'gan legs par bzhes shing*/ 7skyabs rje khra legs rin po che/ zur sprul rin po che/ sprul sku blo gros nyi ma rin po che bcas ngos 'dzin dang*/ khri gsol zhu sgo yongs kyi mdzad 'gan bzhes/ stag mo lus sbyin la bshad sgrub kyi sde/ bya rung kha shor chos sder rgyud sde khag gi phyag bzhes/ dus mchod khag si ta pa yi la zhes par/ btsun dgon la rgyud sde'i slob gnyer/ rig gnas skor/ dpal bkris gling mtho rim slob grwar dge 'dun pa chung gras brgya skor la/ dbyin ji/ ne pa li/ bod yig bcas kyi slob gnyer byed bzhin pa sogs kyi cha rkyen gtso bo dge 'dun 'du ba'i gnas gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas legs par bskrun/ dge 'dun yongs la lto gos chos gsum gyi bdag rkyen bla na med pas bskyangs pa sogs/ mdor na rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i mdzad rjes phul du phyin pa byung dang 'byung bzhin par 'tsho zhing gzhes pa lags so// //zhes pa'i mdzad rnam bsdus pa 'di nyid drung yig bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal nas lo rgyus khungs ldan las btus te sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //
